review_text: Not a large airport my wife and I found this one more like ones we are used to in New Zealand No airbridges but airstairs do the job well especially at smaller airports Arrival was good a lot of taxi touts which is not unusual in Malaysia we used a coupon taxi for transport to our hotel Did not visit the shops or toilets here had a long wait in departure lounge for our flight Met our needs staff helpful

Flew out of Maputo up the coast to Inhambane Found it to be clean well organised free of queues and with fairly friendly staff We used the domestic terminal which was largely devoid of facilities apart from a couple of shops but also virtually devoid of passengers A surprisingly pleasurable experience

Marseille to Zurich A lazy checkin not Helvetic employee who did not want to check my luggage through its final destination neither to release a lounge voucher Star Alliance Gold I finally had a great trip in this old Fokker Crew was extremely attentive flight on time and aircraft clean as snow

Thoroughly workmanlike return flights Johannesburg to Cape Town Cabin crew were efficient and personable Seats AC had adequate leg room Food was adequate and it was helpful to see the three main courses before choosing one Both flights arrived ahead of schedule

Surabaya airport is a very quick and efficient airport On arrival the visa on arrival queue was very short immigration there was a short wait of about minutes by the time I was done with both the bags had already arrived Probably one of the quickest experiences for me from exiting the aircraft to curbside Similar experience on departure quick efficient checkin with Cathay Pacific short lines at security and immigration The terminal is spacious and has a lot of natural light from the full height windows on either side the restrooms were very clean Food options are limited to a Burger King and Starbucks the duty free has a good selection for a small airport The premier lounge which was in a temporary set up was the only disappointment Chose to sit at the Starbucks instead Free wifi at the airport is also quite good

Oldest airport that is still in use but great The mother of all airports has an impressive architecture huge size and is very close to the city Unfortunately SN Brussels airlines is the only largest airline flying there together with some local airlines Unfortunately they want to close it in the next years but the building will not be destroyed

Gatwick to Preveza return with Small Planet Airlines Our flights both ways could not have been any smoother and the experience was faultless I didnt try the food so unable to comment but all the staff were friendly and attentive Would use again

Even though it was a really full flight I still had a good experience as a frequent flyer for United Airlines Everything was the same on the way and I dont have much to say But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago The food tasted great but was familiar to me and I hope I didnt feel deja vu
Everything went smooth from Pyongyang to Beijing Checkin staff were friendly Seats were comfortable Inflight entertainment could have been better Food and drinks decent enough

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

Zagreb Airport is a small but clean airport The airport staff were generally friendly helpful and efficient Moderate queuing time Seating area was a bit crowded during busy hours and lacking charging sockets around seats Fast and free WiFi

A fine small airport great personal service clean well decorated easy parking simple and efficient signage has a luxury feel befitting the Palm Beach Clientele Food selection adequate and reasonable Parking is a breeze Always many security personnel and queue times very short A pleasure to travel to or from

The airport staff are friendly and the waiting time is short very convenient because there are many transport choices to choose The seats are comfortable and there are the sky bridge let me see the airplanes

Avoid at peak times security is a mess Gone are the days of the minute check in and smooth easy journey This used to be my go to airport due to the ease of transit Such a shame they have added so much flight capacity and not matched it with security

When I landed in Anchorage late at night the first thing I noticed was how busy the terminal was I was really hungry after a long hour flight from LAX so the first thing I did was grab something to eat from Cinnabon one of many restaurants at this airport Baggage claim experience was smooth Taxi was readily available outside for transportation to hotel While returning back I had a very smooth checkin and security experience If you enjoy watching beautiful scenery and planes Anchorage will not disappoint As you walk around the terminal you will notice many photo opportunities both inside and outside the terminal

This airport is improving In recent days they had added more space and departure gates also arrival area and baggage belt Security checks is most of the time relatively smooth not so long queue clean toilets Need to improve food options and also lounge experience

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

City of Derry is a small regional airport however check in was very straight forward the Logan Air staff were very friendly The security process was a little over the top however it was fast There is a small cafe within the terminal and its servers drinks and snacks which was more than sufficient for the short wait prior to boarding the aircraft Boarding the flight was by seat number however this was orderly and efficient The flight from City of Derry to London takes just over hour The cabin crew are extremely friendly and provided some teacoffee and biscuits After landing the plane was parked in a remote apron however there was a bus to take us to the terminal upon arrival My luggage was also coming out of the carousal by the time we got to the terminal which meant I was on my way to next destination very quickly Overall this is a great service by Loganair from a regional airport

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient
St Petersburg to Moscow Efficient check in Comfortable seats and a fairly decent snack sandwich Certainly good value for money and spot on with departurelanding times Would use again

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped

Yangon International Airport has Terminals and for International Flights and for Domestic Flights This is the review for Terminal Domestic This Terminal is a new build and many upgraded from the old terminal The airport is very clean and you can find the checkin counter very easily After checkin the nd floor is for departure and the rd floor is for lounges The departure hall is very large and can buy goods and many restaurants which already open early morning am The gates numbers are easily to find

My wife and I flew from Buenos Aires to Miami this January The airplanes appeared to be old with no entertainment flat panels no earphone outlets and no USB charging outlets The seats were old fashion leather wide and comfortable with spacious leg rooms and reclineable backward to almost degrees all of these made the flights very comfortable Meals served were rather good with frequent service of beverages of limited types free wine was included with meals Our experience was far better than most reviewers whose reviews we read

It is an efficiently run small low cost carrier hub As long as you consider it as such it is appropriate and convenient I see it more as a kind of bus stop for airplanes to a limited number of countries Parking is great and affordable an in walking distance to the terminal Guess total distance from car door to plane door is appx metres Services are limited and foodshops overpriced Big airport prices here on this small airfield Boarding procedures check in and security OK Kind staff

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

This airport is functional Not what one would expect of an international Airport It is NOT a beacon of luxury as another review indicated Obviously a joke The staff is mostly courteous some are abrupt and seem tolerant with an air of irritation they keep to themselves Definitely not friendly or welcoming I had hours to spend here let me just say if you are hungry get a small snack and hope your flight crew serves you something you can eat One actual restaurant with a long line and I passed by several times to get a view of the food understaffed and very long wait times to get a seat and have food brought to you I saw several tables waiting about minutes without anything The souvenirs mostly cheap junk I passed The decor Missing or dated Interesting picture of a woman serving tea at the Dublin airport in the s I believe ATTENTION ENTREPRENEURS There is a huge opportunity here Travelers with money and nothing really to spend it on Food Souvenirs Coffee Restaurants Even a good bookstore All modern endeavors would make a killing There is one decent coffee place The pastries are not fresh or very good Save yourself for Italy or France I dont normally rate things so poorly and i personally enjoy my time wherever I am and enjoy different experiences This airport though could be so much better with a refreshed management vision Safe travels

Regional onboard service food and beverages LagosNairobi very good International onboard service food and beverages NairobiWashington good Onboard cleanliness satisfactory Nairobi lounge services good Airline customer support at Airport fair Kenya Airways App unreliable Online customer support very poor

Recently flew to and from Roissy CDG to Biarritz International in the Basque country in south west France for the first time The airport itself is small but there is a good bus service which will take you into the city centre pretty quickly On arrival on the HRS AF flight from CDG this flight seemed to coincide with a number of other flights from the UK which made the baggage arrivals area chaotic In addition the toilet facilities landside need some upgrading and definitely could do with the cleaners visiting there on a more frequent basis especially midafternoon which seems to be the peak time for the airport The rubbish bin in the gents toilet was overflowing when I was there which left a poor initial impression The airport does have an excellent tourism booth with very helpful staff however In addition from the airport one can get onto the nearby motorway very quickly and the care hire agencies also had very helpful staff at the airport especially Europcar On departing Biarritz back to Paris however I discovered that the departures area has only one very small cafe so passengers may not want to enter this area too quickly as the wait could be long and somewhat boring In summary the airport is convenient but it falls well short of the new fresher and modern design of nearby Pau airport which is excellent

Louisville is actually one of the nicest airports in the United States poundforpound In fact Louisville on steroids gives you an idea of what more of our true international gateways should look like but dont I mean Detroit and Minneapolis are good but LAX and JFK Ill start with the good about Louisville Parking is easy and reasonably priced So easy in fact that its literally at the back door of the terminal and nicely covered for all those inclement weather situations The airport is super clean The personnel are aboveaverage in friendliness some of the security and restaurant staff could learn to smile but its hard for me to recount any particularly rude experiences with personnel The terminal is very Louisville and Kentuckythemed making the airport an unmistakable part of the state of Kentuckys cultural identity Security is usually a breeze even if you dont have TSA PreCheck which I have Its almost immediately next door to the state fairgrounds minutes from downtown and minutes from serene natural areas like Jefferson Memorial Forest The terminals are straightforward and wellsigned The public art is very localspecific and themed and attractively positioned As a bonus the airport is UPS primary North American hub so its neat to see the massive cargo planes regularly flying in and out of there The real drawbacks of flying into and out of Louisville are that baggage claim takes a little longer than it should for a relatively small airport and you have to pay close attention to signage right as youre driving off the property to access the freeways and fairgrounds In summary Its hard to go wrong with flying in and out of Louisville Ive been doing it for years and it just feels almost like putting on a comfortable pair of shoes

Check in in Bangkok swift and friendly lounges and boarding in Bangkok and Hong Kong always top notch Service and catering on both flights good What annoys me with flying economy on CX is their unwillingness to credit any Avios in non CX One World programs I was willing to pay a higher fare to get my points but there isnt any which credits points in Economy That is the reason to make me think twice to fly Cathay again in Y in the future

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

Overall an excellent airport Coming in and going out immigration was fast efficient and friendly The airport is very clean and welllaid out for its size and does not feel crowded at all Decent choice of shops and places to eat

I booked London Mexico City London Business Class tickets Outgoing flight gave us access to the Virgin lounge at Heathrow and it was excellent Return flight had problems could not check in or select meal online using iPad their website only works on Microsoft Though in transit I had to go through immigration baggage reclaim and security before handing back my luggage to be loaded on the flight home Refused admittance to their Heineken lounge because I presented more than hours early just arrived on their flight from Cuba Lounge was noisy cramped and spartan when I did get in But flight was good
Great airport Easy to park easy to get to terminal and fast security Beats almost every other larger airport I have been to Not much to do but you wont be there long anyway

I travelled from Coventry to Naples this year and found the airport limited but satisfactory The checkin area reminded me of the old days with cardboard flight destination signs and this was an area that could be easily changed for the better The lines crossed each other to the destinations and did cause some friction between customers The car parking was an experience but again was satisfactory I do not understand why the local bus companies especially those going to Leamington Stratford do not call in On returning the baggage was certainly a LOT better than Birmingham so a plus there In the departure lounge there was a good choice of food and drink at great prices no rip off here Also a small point The newspapers were out and available from about Birmingham they are still under wraps at Good value and friendly Hope they get permission for the bigger one soon

The flight was a very good price the plane was in great shape and the cabin crew were excellent The food could have been better and they ran out of wine quite early but overall a good experience and Id definitely fly with them again If you have a layover book a lounge at Shenzhen airport the food was good and the shower included in the price made a massive difference to a long journey

Arrived at the airport and one of the customer service agents was very helpful He helped me with picking up my luggage connecting to WiFi and was very friendly His name was Houssem Thank you so much for all the hard work

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards
St Petersburg to Moscow Efficient check in Comfortable seats and a fairly decent snack sandwich Certainly good value for money and spot on with departurelanding times Would use again
A smallish airport with limited facilities but clean and comfortable

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free

Domestic passenger Arrived at and departed on from Terminal No issues disembarking Having staff there to ensure passengers with baggage to reclaim dont inadvertently leave without collecting it is helpful On return it took a while to clear security With a number of airports across the UK now using the new scanners meaning liquids can stay in hand luggage its a pity Terminal had not restarted this Good range of shops and restaurants in departures with clear signage and ample seating Flight pushed back on time but there was a wait of about minutes as it sat in a queue for takeoff clearance From previous experience excellent for international travel as most major cities across the world reachable with a direct flight but Gatwick remains my first choice for regional travel

SSHLXRSSH Dash Q A bit dubious as I had never heard of this Egyptian carrier and the name doesnt inspire a great deal of confidence but I was pleasantly surprised A new aircraft on this short minute flight comprehensive safety demo in English that was understandable Complimentary juice and a small snack provided I would not hesitate to use this airline again

I used this airport twice over the last two weeks Given the few international flights the international section was uncrowded Immigration was quick and hassle free Security check too was smooth no need to take off shoes or belts or jackets or pull out toiletries The business class lounge is used by all the airlines and it is a quiet place with a buffet of Indian and Bengali foods and a tended bar Limited number of shops and even limited number of eating places There is a duty free liquor shop just after exiting customs and before exiting the airport with a good selection of whiskeys at prices markedly cheaper than in the city All in all a functional airport that is easy to use with only essential facilities

Sharjah via Mukhalla to Socotra and back onboard nearly full Yemeni Bombardier CRJ plane Check in at Sharjah was a bit chaotic due to much luggage boarding the plane was guided by the station manager personally in Sharjah as there wasnt any seat allocation They have an inflight magazine During the hour flight to RIY a snack was served Crew very nice on the return flight leaving SCT the captain even explained everything what was visible from the windows The plane was in a good shape at least what was visible clean and tidy

Flew TACA Airlines from Lima to Bogota Only the outside of the aircraft and the food carriage were TACA The rest magazine and crew were Avianca Food service for the and a half hour flight was great full meal Full service of drinks juices beers alcoholic I would fly with them again

Think it only has a dozen flights or so a day exclusively under the Air NZ banner now Freedom Air is being reamalgamated into Air NZ It has been well modernised and seems very spacious It has the advantages of a small airport with short distances plane to terminal to baggage collection and to car park We were in the car and off within mins of getting off the lane On departure there is a great upstairs light and airy waitingeating arrivals area with plenty of space and excellent views There are adequate drinks food and shop The only downside was that the hire car companies closed quite early so as we were arriving at pm we had to persuade friends to come and collect us

Brasilia airport is clean and always improving the facilities The architecture is uptodate The airport is well located and you can reach it by bus but no train or subway It has an good commercial area close to the gates The airport facilities are in good condition and are well maintained

NurSultan to Almaty return I bought the tickets on the companys website Initially I planned to travel with just a hand baggage but the day before the flight I managed to add a baggage on the website for tg The flights were excellent Flight attendants sold buy onboard drinks and snacks Arrival was just on time The ticket price turned out to be cheaper even than the Talgo train

I would like to say a huge thank to Yasmin who went to great lengths to find us a new flight the same day but from Bristol airport flight missed just Start of holiday delayed by hours only her professional and helpful support was greatly appreciated Thank you again

Even though it was a really full flight I still had a good experience as a frequent flyer for United Airlines Everything was the same on the way and I dont have much to say But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago The food tasted great but was familiar to me and I hope I didnt feel deja vu

Juliaca is the smallest commercial airport I have experienced Because of the size it is easy to find your way around There is not very much in the airport so bring something to amuse yourself The good news is due to the size it is a very clean including the bathrooms There was a VIP Lounge that I peeked into It consisted of a few chairs and a cooler with soft drinks and beer

The airport is well laid out the gates are simply marked and the staff are extremely helpful There is an information desk to the left of the entrance which will direct you where you need to go Considering this was my first flight and after having a head injury they allowed my parents to go through security with me to guide me through the process Security was slower than I have come to realize is usual and very confusing however once on the other side there were many shopping options and also a great deal of eating options There was suitable seating and the boards with times of departures were readily available The bathrooms were a little messy however

This review is limited to Terminal A I havent flown through Terminal A in years but it still remains a very modern airport terminal It is spacious with plenty of seating and dining options especially at Gates A There is a rather long underground walkway from these gates to the main terminal A The walkway is beneath the tarmac and runways We dined at Legal Seafoods before departure to DFW Excellent food The terminal was very busy given the snowstorm and delayed flights Bathrooms were okay but could have been cleaner WiFi was very fast and easy to connect too Kudos to Logan airport snow clearing crews and the crews deicing planes Our flight to DFW was delayed but we managed to take off Throughout the storm planes kept taking off and landing

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Unprofessional but aircraft is new and clean They cancelled my flight replaced with one with stopover and to change it for a flight on the same day took me a lot of emails to do it New flight was on Lisbon to Sal via Praia they issued tickets to Lisbon to Praia then they corrected it and then my reservation was appearing on a different date Finally after a month of exchanging emails they got it right On their site there is web checkin but is not working They want physical checkin to make sure you preregistered to enter the country and paid euro to do it They have often delays but our flight was on time because aircraft arrived to Lisbon on time Plane BM was new and clean front rows have great legroom Crew was friendly There was no IFE but inflight service was good and sandwich was tasty

IzmirAdnan Menderes is architecturally a very pleasing airport with lots of glass and steel giving it a very modern look The food and shopping were very good the restrooms were spotless and clean and it was very easy to navigate There is free wifi but only for two hours

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

Cusco airport is not big but it is very organized and does have boarding bridges This airport m high from sea level Excellent view from aircrafts This airport is always busy There are some shops and staff are helpful However it does need more seating because I saw many passengers standing up Free wifi is only available for minutes

Despite a delay of about minutes overall it was a good flight Check in was easy the flight attendants were friendly and efficient and the plane was clean and comfortable The only free beverage was water which was no issue on such a short flight

The terminal offers an array of restaurants and shops which gives passengers a well rounded experience The security was smooth and quick with just only a few passengers waiting in line The airport has a very white theme which makes the interior very bright Staff at the airport are generally helpful and able to speak basic to intermediate level of English I had troubles connecting to the WiFi network I asked the airport staffs to help me out because they couldnt figure out the reason of not being able to connect the WiFi All in all Bahrain Airport is one of the nicest airports to travel in addition to Doha and Muscat Airports

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

On the understanding that Srinagar being the capital of Indian administered Kashmir is at the centre of one of longest running conflicts in the world then one should expect a particularly unique experience regarding airport security Srinagar airport in this respect does not disappoint On arrival on Jet Airways from Delhi one is immediately struck by the fact that this is a military airfield masquerading as a civilian airport MiG fighters and helicopter gunships abound at the far end of the airfield and all buildings are camoflauge painted The odd civilian Boening looks incongruous For arriving foreigners you are accosted by a security official fairly politely it must be said to fill in a long registration document He then accompanies you out of the arrival and baggage collection hall on a dirt track to the carpark to ensure you are being met by whoever you had claimed you were on the form Only then can you be on your way If you are not being met I am not sure what your fate would be Departure though is an object lesson in airport security The first hurdle is a kilometer or so before the airport terminal where you are stopped at a roadblock and put your luggage through an xray machine Entering the airport and only passengers are allowed not guests or friends you again put bags through another xray sceeening Then you are allowed to go to check in after which you must as a foreigner fill out another lengthy departure registration form for the police No hand luggage whatsoever is allowed on Delhi bound flights so all you can carry is what you can fit in your pockets therefore travel with a multipocket vest or similar to maximise carry on potential Hand carried clear plastic water bottles do suprisingly seem OK though to carry on The waiting area after check in is basic but OK as long as you dont mind being stared at suspiciously by numerous armed army and poice men Then there is another long queue for a more detailed security check which involves turning out all pockets and being individually scanned Finally you are through to the actual departure area but this is not the end After being released to go out on foot to your waiting Boeing you again go through another security check all pockets and a patdown before eventually you board the plane Great views of the Himalayas to the north on the flight out but since cameras are not allowed on board the memories stay in your mind and not on film

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step

ARNHEL on the standard B Clean and airy cabin legroom fine for such a short hop Coffeetea served for free Courteous FAs gave out a stuffed toy for the baby in our party and took extra care explaining how the infants seatbelt worked Bags were on the belt in minutes at HEL
An old Fokker departure and arrival on time very smooth landing proficient bilingual staff and excellent food omelette with herbs coleslaw and chicken

This airport was previously known as London Manston which is a bit of a joke because of how far it is from London However with a name change new terminal and new budget airline EUJet has started to raise its profile I travelled through there on the way tofrom Amsterdam The airport is small which works to its advantage Check in was very fast and the staff very helpful The car park is right outside the terminal entrance and is very cheap day or week The small cafeteria is good and clean The aircraft are right out side the terminal so no long bus rides or endless walkways On the way back it took less than minutes to reach my car from the time the wheels touched the ground I had no luggage All in all a very good experience
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

My recent return flight from Melbourne to the Gold Coast with REX Airlines was excellent Everything from booking to disembarking on the return flight was easy The staff were friendly and professional Given that CV issues are currently dominating travel within Australia I felt REX Airlines handled everything beautifully

The airport is mostly new after months of renovation and expansion As usual now both domestic and intl passengers undergo passport control and customs either departing or arriving Make sure when departing to get your tourist permit and your passport stamped Immigration personnel were friendly but the lady at Customs wasnt I usually get immigration cleared at the land border point when coming from San Diego but the office at the border closes at night TIJ Immigration is so no worries for late nightearly morning flight Checkin is a bit messy though not slow with Volaris the largest tenant but otherwise smooth with other carriers If you fly Aeromexico well lets say Ive enjoyed better lounges than theirs at terminal A Better spend time at the terminals Starbucks Food is the airport biggest failure small gates too perhaps I believe with nothing other than the aforementioned cafe and some overpriced bad tasting and cramped restaurants Terminal B isnt any better at food its upside is a great local wine shop Free wifi available everywhere

Super easy to navigate this tiny welcoming airport parking garage fees are reasonable car rental is close by drop off and pickup is efficient airport management does actually care facilities are clean food is sparse but there and it is secure Top notch tiny regional airport
It is easily accessible from the city center by metro within minutes It is clean and modern Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear Goods are bountiful

Linz is indeed a very small airport however it serves its purpose Facilities are limited and flying in at pm I found the few shops were almost all shut The hourly bus is excellent value for money at EUR compared to the I paid in London approx EUR and only takes minutes non stop to the city centre Beware there is only ONE medium sized duty free shop after passport control

Vientiane to Bangkok UPlane was clean food was excellent tuna sandwiches plus water and a second drink of either Pepsi Coffee Tea Miranda Orange or more water The crew made this flight excellent for a start there are cabin crew in total which made a difference to the service time delivery Every member of the crew smiled were courteous served ladies first to emulate their countries values and did a great service One small minor point was that my seat back pocket was broken slightly in A Will definitely use again

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of Air KBZ flying from Yangon to Mandalay I bought the ticket just two days before the flight and the fare was very reasonable Checkin was fast and efficient and a Air KBZ employee approached me in the line and escorted me to the checkin desk and helped me checkin The domestic terminal is small and a bit chaotic but this is not Air KBZs fault and should be remedied when the new domestic terminal is finished There are no screens announcing that boarding has commenced so you have to pay attention to the airline employees who walk up and down the waiting area with handheld signs with your airline and flight number on it Boarding was via a bus to the aircraft The plane was clean in good condition and the seats were comfortable The flight crew was helpful and friendly We were served a light breakfast on this minute flight The flight took off and landed on time I would certainly fly Air KBZ again
The new Delta Terminal C is elegant convenient and modern Restaurants gate areas and restrooms were all immaculate Checkin went smoothly Keep it up

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers
Great airport no time waiting In minutes we were out with our check in luggage Professional personnel Thumbs up Signage very good and easy accessible to everyone

The airport of Yangon was very clean with good airconditioning the queue for the visa was not long so it was fast the belt with the bags was easy to find Good impression when you arrive Has also a really good conection with bus to the city center

Koh Samui Airport is a lovely little airport and probably the most attractive airport I have ever travelled through Check in seemed to be very efficient and no long queues There is a large number of shops and restaurants available outside after you have checked in Toilets were ok and reasonably clean but quite a lot of insects buzzing around As many airport in Thailand they mix passengers on domestic flights through different parts of the airport and therefore passengers with international departures clear immigration and board the flight through a different gate to the domestic passengers on the same flight Seems a bit odd but they have a system and it works

What a great little airport Friendly staff in all areas and in my opinion unique system to me anyway of scanning the hold luggage whilst youre with it before its loaded onto the aircraft Domestic departure lounge is small but plenty of seating available

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji

Dhaka to Jessore I find the name of this private airline in Bangladesh a bit funny Other than that no complaints Arrived at the domestic terminal in Dhaka minutes before the scheduled morning departure due to being severely delayed due to road traffic The checkin desk completed all formalities rushed us through security had a limo ready for us to escort me and my partner to the aircraft at the remote stand The flight left after our boarding and exactly on time I have never experienced this kind of dedication and professionalism with an airline The flight to Jessore lasted minutes onboard a clean and attractive Dash Q and we were served a sandwich cake and a water bottle by friendly and smiley flight attendants The return flight to Dhaka a couple of days later was just as good but we made sure we arrived promptly for checkin this time We were served a mini burger cake and water bottle

Forl airport is very small The service before leave and after the arriving is very good and friendly The location is good also because is possible to join city like Rimini Bologna and Ravenna in a very few time Quite good the service for the disable people

Although I had a long layover here and as a single female passenger I was a tad concerned after having read other reviews However the airport is absolutely fine interesting architecture in the landside area a few cafes small shops selling local goods and lots of banks People were very friendly and there was a sense of calm compared to most airports I have been to especially in my home country Scotland and the UK Customs and security were a doddle and once airside there are the usual airport shops plus a few local and individual shops with interesting goods on sale The gate area was modern bright and airy again it was very ordered and peaceful
TFNGMZ return on ATR Very good minute flights Served cup of water and chocolate bar Great views of a snow capped Mt Teide on left going and right returning

The international arrivals and departure section at Harare Zimbabwe airport is a revelation On arrival all the staff including Immigration and Customs were friendly and welcoming and this contributed to an excellent first impression and a speedy processing Possibly helped by having obtained visas before flying On departure check in was efficient and again the friendly staff were most helpful There is a full range of facilities airside and clean toilets At present there are not too many international flights but the experience was excellent

Luang Prabang to Vientiane CheckIn was fast well organized and the staff friendly The departure arrival was on time and the aircraft made a very well maintained impression During the flight despite the short flight time of only minutes there were small bites and drinks The seat absorbency was slightly larger than other airlines Overall a good surprising experience

Return leg was an older model configured in Business about half full Actually the seating is better than the configuration as you have more feet room Food was really good especially the Salmon Cod and Prawn ceviche a true delight The bed was comfortable and the service attentive movie choice the same as going out days previous One criticism is that priority bags do not come out first I awaited mins for my bag to arrive and nearly missed my connection although arriving at and a departure on next flight at The second leg on older plane entertainment system not working at all Breakfast and service was good arrived on time and again no priority bags first This is one area they need to work on Hence Ground service only star

I have to say I found the staff exceptionally helpful My dad requires special assistance and the staff were prompt understanding and efficient and could not do enough for him The airport is clean and obviously busy
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

Departing from Terminal Lots of space light and helpful signaling Security was well organized and relatively fast moving but the queue was huge Actually three queues one for facial ID one for carryon security checks and the final one for passport control The automatic passport check did not work for us maybe because we had not come to the country through this airport and there were moments of confusion among us and the supervisor The terminal itself is a bit aseptic Impersonal and way too long Food options could be better And a bit of color or additional greenery would have been great

Return journey Clean modern aircraft comfortable seat tasty food and drying and great cabin crew On the way back ground staff checked our bags through to EDI on BA even though we did not have the journey on a single ticket Impressive and enjoyable journey and I would happily use them again

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

Cabin was clean Personal screen was big enough and a lot of entertainment programs were available Seat was very comfortable My personal area was spacious Tullys Coffee was offered with tasty chocolate Flight attendants provided quick and responsive service Everything was excellent

Overall a great airport with great facilities and ample outlets to eatdrinkshop The only issue about this airport is the queues at immigration and security which is serious For instance immigration at arrival took minutes although there were only people in front of me and this was because only windows were open for processing

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

Flew in from Baltimore on Southwest What a great little airport Easy to navigate spotless facilities fast wifi and good options for coffee and snacks A great alternative to Boston for access to Cape Cod

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

This is a great airport us my wife and self We fly from it twice a year We have just returned from Lanzarote We had no problems at all until we arrived back at hrs mins late There was a full plane load of passengers and only Border Control Officers on duty We were stood in a snakelike queue for nearly half an hour in a room that was like a shed I think that Border Control can do a lot better and should be doing so After saying this we are flying from Doncaster again in Sept

The Plaza Business Lounge at Brisbane Airport was comfortable enough with a range of food and drinks but no tonic for a GT There were very few toilets in the lounge though On board the A the seat was comfortable and the service was friendly and responsive My vegetarian meals were good but breakfast was served far too early interrupting sleep The plane for the connecting service to Sapporo was an unreconstructed A with oldstyle business class seating but comfortable enough for a hour flight The service and vegetarian food out of Taipei were both excellent Overall China Airlines is a good way to travel between Australia and Japan at a reasonable price
Their airport is pragmatic on the right size to be passenger friendly and with all major needs served like SIM cards and ATMs available Beware of overpriced rides to the city center or your hotel

I flew Ariana Afghan Airlines from Kabul to Delhi Timing was good but very crowded while boarding The flight was enjoyable but no entertainment Good and enough food provided Very friendly and helpful staff on the flight The ticket was very reasonable price

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport

The airport was not busy when we arrived but this did not stop it taking minutes to pass through immigration and collect bags Facilities are what you expect from an airport about years out of date and did not expect anything different I guess Found the staff to be unfriendly and there were no painted on smiles available here

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point

Had a great flight from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines A brief winter maintenance delay ensured a safe departure and while we experienced mild turbulence leaving Philadelphia and again upon arrival in Washington the pilots handled it smoothly Due to the conditions inflight service was not possible but safety remained the priority The Main Cabin Extra seats made for a much more comfortable experience and with a flight time of under minutes we arrived quickly and safely Republic continues to deliver a reliable and professional service for the American Airlines group

New airport building with good facilities Minimal airport food facilities and retail outlets other than jewellery Good facilities for vehicles to pick up at ground level and drop off at first floor level Excellent toilet facilities and very clean throughout with good air conditioning Construction of second runway in progress together with airport buildings to cater for expected increase in tourism Downside was that there was no wifi facilities other than those offered by fast food franchises

Everything went smoothly on this short flight to Paro We flew a new plane with lovely grey leather seats seat pockets with metal springs it all just smelt new that was a bonus Crew friendly and accommodating So from Katmandu to Paro you need to have window seat on the left of the plane It was my most scenic commercial flight ever stunning views of the Himalayas and Mount Everest for over half the flight sit on the left ABC seats and then the remarkable descent into Paro airport landing at the prettiest airport I ever been to and I have travelled a fair bit Unless the flight in darkness your baggage lost or severe delay non of which happened for me I cannot see how this short flight could fail to impress A cheese roll and drink included Get to Bhutan on this flight

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

GOTAYTGOT We choose this airline because it was a part of a charter trip We went on a seat A its was quite big It was as you expect in a economy class airplane not much legroom quite cramped The seats were quite nice but you will notice that they have been there for a while but it works fine The cabincrew are very friendly and nice The food onboard was okay You cant expect that much from an airline in the food section We thought we were going to get breakfast as we flew at in the morning Instead we got meatballs in a sauce which was really nice

AZDMHD Aseman is one of the only airlines that provides domestic flights between Yazd and Mashad Tickets are cheap and service is ok There was a delay of hr which feels endless waiting at a small domestic airport Despite the delay the flight was comfortable on a Fokker aircraft Not much legroom but fine for a flight of about mins Some snacks were included and that was ok Friendly staff

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

Osaka to Busan Great value budget airline Web site and onboard magazine promise free water but none was offered Checkin at KIX was about minutes checkin at PUS was zero with no other customers in sight Offered decent seats even though we hadnt prebooked them Outward flight was delayed due to air traffic control restrictions at KIX but landed on time due to timetable padding Return flight left early but landed slightly late after circling around western Japan for ages Boarding on both flights smooth Bus to terminal at PUS but sky bridge on return flight Perfectly adequate and reasonably efficient for a budget airline and a onehour flight Would use again

Easy access by bus or taxi Two terminals International on the right Domestic on the left as you face them but only metres apart Signs in English as well as Russian although all announcements are in Russian as you would expect How many of the staff speak English may be a good question one who does is the AviaNova manager Easy layout to navigate in domestic terminal although there is not much space for the checkin queues so they snake around the room However the staff for my flight anyway were very efficient and the queue moved quickly Security check was quick and easy Airside has an expensive cafe and coffee shop as well as a newsstand and gift shop Plenty of comfortable seating WiFi is available good signal but every site I tried came up with Security Certificate not issued by Trusted Source so theres possibly some bug in their software I didnt do any more than just log in Bussed to plane only complaint as with so many of these airports is that you go upstairs to a departure lounge and then have to walk back down for the bus

I prefer using this airport over almost any other in Texas major cities but in true American airport form there are advantages and drawbacks to using San Antonio SAT Here are the pros Access from either I or US is pretty easy considering that interchange is one of the busiest in the city Access to the very busy touristic downtown is relatively easy as the airport isnt far away by rideshare Parking is easy access from the parking garages to the terminal is easy signage leading to and within the airport is pretty easy to follow Delta checkin was quick and friendly Gate agents were professional and helpful Staff in the stores generally seemed friendly The terminal is mostly clean the presecurity checkin area is very spacious and modern Using CLEAR and PreCheck I breezed through security However here are the drawbacks Security TSA had an officious dour attitude that Id expect much more in Houston Miami LAX or NYC not San Antonio Dont know what that was about The restrooms were filthy Seating throughout the terminal was not at all ample for the crowds of people waiting to fly out the airport desperately needs expansion and that includes more seating and general modernization postsecurity Upon return baggage claim was remarkably slow for a small airport albeit a small airport serving a large metropolitan area So pound for pound SAT is an overall good option and Id still rather use them than anything in Houston or Austin but there is still room for improvement

Tallinn is my favourite airport of all airports Ive been to Its so small lovely and there are never crowds flowing around There are about gates The Business Lounge is quiet and comfy and theres always enough food Its main difference is the low ceiling compared to other airports There arent many restaurants or shops but the Tax Free Shop has almost everything needed for your flight Staff very friendly and WiFi works well

Hobart Airport is much more user friendly now though the terminals have not been connected so Jetstar passengers are still relegated to the old botched international venture built for the old Ansett The new catering in domestic is good but It is shameful that there is no WiFi intenet access anywhere It would cost a few hundred dollars at the most for the Tasmanian Government to give free WiFi access at Hobart Airport and so reinforce the image it is trying to give as a progressive State It is doubtful that a private company will ever do it and Tasmania would top all the other states in lateral thinking if it did it for free
Singapore to Tioman Island We found the check in staff very welcoming friendly and helpful The flight in the dash was what real flying is all about Again the crew were very friendly

I use this little airport for flights between northern England and SE Asia via AMS on KLM I find it a very convenient feeder airport to the AMS hub and the small size of the terminal ensures that arrivals are swift and painless Im on the road within mins of hitting the tarmac in most cases Staff are generally friendly and helpful By contrast nearby NCL which used to be very quick and efficient is much more hassle with some of the most miserable ground staff in Europe
The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

As living in the north of The Netherlands Bremen airport is a good alternative for Amsterdam Recently flown from the new low cost Ryanair terminal Its basic clean and blue There is a multipurpose shop which sells everything from a to z at somewhat inflated prices and small coffee shop Seating is mostly in plastic chairs which you could find at your local dentist Reasonable but we had an early flight so it was not so crowded Would not like to be there when its get full There are also some paid internet terminals The airport is well situated from the city center and freeway from the parking garage you are within minutes in the main terminal building Bremen is still a great small airport but they need to get some other low cost airlines on board besides Ryanair

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else

The airport is mid being rebuilt arrivals still in progress but departures all complete Departures was very quick no checkin or security queue it was a Tuesday but our plane was fairly full Great clean toilets friendly staff the only major fail is despite it all being brand new there is nowhere near enough seats expect to be sitting on the floors also not much food on offer if you cannot eat wheatbased food groups

Tashkent Airport can be difficult to navigate Regulations are strictly enforced especially at departure Upon arrival I noticed that the people do not observe lines and not speaking Uzbek or Russian can be a disadvantage Make sure that you fill out and keep all official forms you receive There is one for each hotel you stay in and there are matching customs forms for arrival and departure you need to list valuables and cash and produce both forms when leaving the country Departure gate is a floor below the departure area There is now an escalator and carts are available for taking bags from the entrance gate to the escalator but only passengers may enter the departure gate Good luck if you have more than one or two bags There are no porters or at least not when I was there I had forgotten about the customs forms after I had to repeatedly insist to the airline representative that I was allowed to check in more than one bag and the customs official said I could not take my money out of the country without submitting both forms You will have to remove your shoes and socks and put on blue plastic booties before going through security The airport personnel were courteous and even friendly but it was clear that no exceptions would be made

Great service overall Timely departure after very organized boarding procedure Aircraft clean and well air conditioned for boarding Staff very friendly and professional Good meal service with table cloth tableware and drinks in glasses Good infos from cockpit Would surely fly Thai Smile again
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of Air KBZ flying from Yangon to Mandalay I bought the ticket just two days before the flight and the fare was very reasonable Checkin was fast and efficient and a Air KBZ employee approached me in the line and escorted me to the checkin desk and helped me checkin The domestic terminal is small and a bit chaotic but this is not Air KBZs fault and should be remedied when the new domestic terminal is finished There are no screens announcing that boarding has commenced so you have to pay attention to the airline employees who walk up and down the waiting area with handheld signs with your airline and flight number on it Boarding was via a bus to the aircraft The plane was clean in good condition and the seats were comfortable The flight crew was helpful and friendly We were served a light breakfast on this minute flight The flight took off and landed on time I would certainly fly Air KBZ again

Arrival on Sunday morning Apr Good airport quick luggage delivery clean airport Departure on Thursday evening Apr Check in correct no air conditioning very hot temperature more than C on the evening very crowded due to small boarding lounge and not enough seats Only one small bar in international area for more than large aircraft B departing at the same time

Excellent flight more leg room than other airlines cabin stewardess who was excellent and tended to all passenger requirements served all passengers with complimentary food with drink which is unknown nowadays Good old fashioned service and customers do count Flight from Waterford VG th June

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

Going to Washington Dulles Airport is easy when departing and arriving regardless of connectionsgood staff lounges and great AeroTrains and Mobile Lounges to connect different terminals They have good food in various terminals and airline lounges

It was the cheapest way to go back after yet another season in Asia and honestly I didnt expect too much But the plane was quite new and the cabin was in a good condition Departed on time unlike the connecting domestic flight by another airline before There was an inflight entertainment system available and it seems to be modern but after a night spent in two different airports I hardly used it for anything other than the D map Although the food was served not as elegantly as some airlines do it was quite delicious and I could choose what I preferred on both meals despite sitting not in the middle of the cabin Note that there are only soft drinks available but for me it doesnt really matter The seats are not exactly Emirateslike but still quite comfortable for an hours flight The headphones were usual cheap earbuds unfortunately but they also included an adapter which I took away and which will let me plug in my own headphones on some later flight great and I just dont understand why airlines besides those smart few who provide multiuse washablecup large headphones couldnt distribute just that on request rather than generating tons of cheap headphones waste The flight was smooth and arrived minutes early Definitely would fly Tianjin Airlines again if the price is right and the route will fit my plans and will stop at Chongqing or Tianjin where I havent been yet as well should I have time for that

Older Dash but comfortable and good leg room but very noisy Departed on time friendly sole flight attendant juice and water on offer and great views of the Atolls they were organised friendly and have pride in their brand and country cant ask for more than that A bit pricey but no competition I guess

Last year I flew from Saint John Airport on my way back to Toronto Although the airport is quite small but the service is fast and very friendly Check in staff at Air Canada counter was very friendly and even the security staff were courteous to all passengers As soon as boarding was announced we embarked the aircraft followed by a short walk as there are no air bridges used at this airport

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

We had to return early from a holiday in Dubai and it was considerably cheaper to fly from Sharjah than from Dubai Sharjah is a relatively small airport but has a reasonable duty free area a food court with a number of very reasonably priced outlets and very friendly staff It was very clean and staff were constantly and vigilantly cleaning the public areas Unfortunately the check in desk for Pegasus was very slow and boarding was slow as well Nevertheless a stress free experience Would definitely use Sharjah again

We took a short flight from Vientiane to Luang Prabang and service at every touchpoint from checkin to arrival was delivered with smiles professionalism and efficiency A clean aircraft with ample leg room was another example of their star service If my experience was the standard that Lao Airlines delivers then this airline will surely go places Highly recommended

There in December Jan and Mar times very quick handling of luggage etc comfortable waiting area and free internet No queues for Immigration desk One point that is minor if you dont know where the bus to Rotterdam centre is located you may have a problem however I took a taxi and then it takes only minutes Its much more agreeable than the big airports like Toulouse Orly JFK or even Schiphol also in the Netherlands

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

What a great little airport Friendly staff in all areas and in my opinion unique system to me anyway of scanning the hold luggage whilst youre with it before its loaded onto the aircraft Domestic departure lounge is small but plenty of seating available

This airport is functional Not what one would expect of an international Airport It is NOT a beacon of luxury as another review indicated Obviously a joke The staff is mostly courteous some are abrupt and seem tolerant with an air of irritation they keep to themselves Definitely not friendly or welcoming I had hours to spend here let me just say if you are hungry get a small snack and hope your flight crew serves you something you can eat One actual restaurant with a long line and I passed by several times to get a view of the food understaffed and very long wait times to get a seat and have food brought to you I saw several tables waiting about minutes without anything The souvenirs mostly cheap junk I passed The decor Missing or dated Interesting picture of a woman serving tea at the Dublin airport in the s I believe ATTENTION ENTREPRENEURS There is a huge opportunity here Travelers with money and nothing really to spend it on Food Souvenirs Coffee Restaurants Even a good bookstore All modern endeavors would make a killing There is one decent coffee place The pastries are not fresh or very good Save yourself for Italy or France I dont normally rate things so poorly and i personally enjoy my time wherever I am and enjoy different experiences This airport though could be so much better with a refreshed management vision Safe travels
Modern infrastructure and worldclass service Known for its efficiency cleanliness and design it has become one of the most impressive airports in India
I flew AirAsia into here from Kuala Lumpar A friendly and efficient airport the connecting bus had me in Melbourne in about the same time as to Tullamarine as there was no jerking about

The largely renovated and rebuilt MCO airport is absolute class Clean well organized from the signage to the dropoff to security and aesthetically pleasing in most areas Returning to the US the new international arrivals area and postcustoms area so arrivals really is just gorgeous If you have Global Entry you breeze through in seconds with courteous officers that speak English and Spanish That alone is unique for a large US airport where many passport control officers are known for their powertripping belligerence but Orlando pleasantly provided the opposite of all that The signage to trains rideshare and hotel shuttles is granularly specified such that its easy for anybody to follow at least when leaving terminal Cinternational Leaving MCO the next morning arrivals at terminal A had clearly been renovated and was looking quite sharp CLEARPreCheck in tandem reduced security from a minute wait to a minute one The shuttle tram facilities between gates and terminals are showing their age and the terminal A gates area is also showing its age and could also use some more and better seating throughout but I wouldnt necessarily consider them dumpy I suppose that MCO will get to renovating those facilities as they can Truly MCO seems to be running like a welloiled machine that is geared to leave visitors to their city with a first and last positive impression

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

Great Airport We travelled from Manchester and from landing to leaving the airport it only took us minutes For the return flight we checked our bags in minutes and took just another to get through security etc The departure lounge is bright and welcoming and boarding just took a few minutes Good experience I wish more airports were like this

Landed at Hangzhou Airport around using AirAsia X from Kuala Lumpur Immigration clearance was smooth and no hassle I claimed my luggage in just a few minutes Washroom services are as good as other airports in China The only lacking is the number of available seats on the departure floor at the checkin counters area
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

Awful airport On arrival was very smooth to be fair but the passport control queue was horrendous for those with UK passports and no accessibility and on departure despite wearing the sunflower lanyard and having booked fast track I was declined at fast track and made to queue for security and with my disabilities I struggle with long queuing The departure hall was very busy and hot with not many places to sit I had a great holiday in the Algarve but it was tarnished by the atrocity that is Faro Airport on a positive note however the toilets were very clean

Its a pleasure to travel with Cyprus airways They are so kind and really try to help The staff in Dubai is super friendly and playful with my daughter Im a nervous flyer and I always feel at ease when travelling with Cyprus airways
