Flew to Vagar Faroe Islands Smooth flight lasting hrs mins each way Flight attendants were friendly and efficient Seats comfortable and spacious adequate storage space for inflight luggage Free snacks served as well as alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

I have used it many times New Esenboga Airport is excellent Comfortable clean helpful staff Duty free is small but can find everything During the evening times its very busy for domestic arrivals nearly flights land in minutes International arrivals are also fair enough Great airport

Excellent small airport which is newly built few flights in the afternoon when it is at its busiest It is located way out of town hence you need to have pre booked transport to reach the town as no public transport is available The building is air conditioned which is a relief from searing heat The washrooms needed a bit of TLC The shopping was expensive as is the case at any international airport Food options are plenty Aircraft turn around time is quick Overall a good airport WiFi is free for one hour
Excellent timely departure and arrival The cabin was clean the staff kind and the bags were promptly delivered Nothing to complain about

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport

Moscow to Bangkok Rossiya fly some of Aeroflots long haul flights with exEtihad Boeing s Their concept is strange They still have an old personal entertainment system but it only gives you a route map Really Instead they have an inflight wifisystem but to be able to use it you need to download Rossiya app before the flight wifi is only for the system its not connected to the WWW They do not have power sockets is economy class and remember your own headphones as well Our flight was on time No complains Food was ok nothing fancy They serve you two free meals with basic drinks no alcohol This will keep your belly full all flight Ive used many airlines and I have no complaints about Rossiya Ticket was cheap plane was comfy and clean flight was on time service was ok basic Russian style and they didnt lose our bags Good value Just remember what i told you about the entertainment system
I think it is a great airport compared to most Chinese airports Today Hangzhou Airport is quite different from what it used to be Its very large and modern and has good service

The refurbishment is finished Everything looked clean and new Fast checkin Information screens were giving correct and uptodate information Good catering facilities to have a drink coffee or sandwich Cheap duty free shops which are not the biggest but still have a good assortment of quality products spirits sweets perfumes etc

The south domestic terminal in Anchorage is world class and beautiful This new terminal is very modern spotlessly clean provides amenities expected at an international airport and offers a view of the surrounding mountains that is breathless The displays of local wildlife native culture and art is unsurpassed by most airports in the world However the old north terminal which is now connected to the south terminal by a concourse is sad Anchorage is one of the five most busy airports in the world for international cargo airlines but not for international passenger service The few international airlines that do provide passenger service mostly during the summer months are forced to use the north terminal as US customs is located there All the comments seen on this site are about the north terminal made by international travelers and are undoubtedly true Wish they all could have been processed through the magnificent south building

Gatwick to Preveza return with Small Planet Airlines Our flights both ways could not have been any smoother and the experience was faultless I didnt try the food so unable to comment but all the staff were friendly and attentive Would use again
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet

I booked London Mexico City London Business Class tickets Outgoing flight gave us access to the Virgin lounge at Heathrow and it was excellent Return flight had problems could not check in or select meal online using iPad their website only works on Microsoft Though in transit I had to go through immigration baggage reclaim and security before handing back my luggage to be loaded on the flight home Refused admittance to their Heineken lounge because I presented more than hours early just arrived on their flight from Cuba Lounge was noisy cramped and spartan when I did get in But flight was good

Arrival at this airport was simple with its connection to the Hanover SBahn suburban train system Hanover airport is a convenient size not an overwhelming number of gates but large enough to have plenty of connections Checkin today with Swiss Airlines went smoothly we were asked for our destination visa but not grilled and luggage was processed without difficulty Security checking was slow today probably because of Middle East tensions but security personnel were good humoured and friendly Cafes and shops on the land side closed before pm there are limited shopping possibilities on the air side but one good cafe

Islip to Baltimore with SWA A hidden gem in the NY area for local flights terminal is clean and spacious with good facilities all round A much better option than the scrum at JFK or LGA particularly if you are out of the city and have a rental car

This airport has undergone a transition from ugly duckling to something of a beautiful swan Spacious beautifully furnished comfortable are just some of the words that come to mind There is plenty of signage and even passengers on discount airlines are treated as if they are appreciated Although it doesnt have a butterfly garden I would compare this in ambiance to Singapore Changi on a much smaller scale of course Burmese charm is everywhere The CIP lounges are spacious well stocked well staffed and offer a good selection of local and international snacks I wish every airport in Asia was more like this one

Billund is an excellent airport with good facilities practical layout and friendly and efficient staff My only gripe is the airport bus which is extortionate DKK to Aarhus and runs at often perplexing times that seem to have no correlation to when major flights are landing Ive travelled here every other month from various UK airports for about years and sometimes have to wait up to hours to get away As the airport is far from where most foreign travellers want to be unless they really like Lego you often have little option but to wait for the bus or pay even more for a taxi

Always great and good value for money No issues with delayed flights and a smooth journey overall Friendly staff and onboard service even on super short flights eg Bangkok to Trat At Trat airport they also have complimentary snacks and drinks

Harrisburg MDT is a great airport Small but connected to many international gateways Security lines are short Food options are limited but good I only wish they offered a NYC area connection My airport of choice

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else

BRUJNBBRU with a stopover in Tripoli There were some troubles with the inflight entertainment On our way to JNB there were not enough headsets so we couldnt use the inflight entertainment On our way back from JNB to Tripoli the inflight entertainment in our part of the plane didnt work at all The food was okay and the cabin crew friendly Its definitely value for money but there are some things to improve

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again

Bremen is a small and convenient airport and my experience proved enjoyable Arriving with Air France I disembarked in the main terminal Very short walk to the baggage claim I picked my suitcase within ten minutes Tram line frequently connects the airport with the city centre every min during peak hours min otherwise travel time min A oneway ticket costs however beware that the machines accept neither credit cards nor bank notes greater than Easy departure with no queue at baggage dropin I breezed through security Bremen uses the fullbody scanner which makes the screening process much faster Security staff efficient and friendly Bright departure lounge but there might not be enough seating facilities if all gates are used at the same time Only issue Not enough toilets facilities either landside well hidden at the very end of the building or airside one toilet block only

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

JNZDLC Flight departed and arrived on schedule Aircraft was newish MA clean and tidy Cabin announcements in English as well as Chinese but no cabin service only hour flight so acceptable especially given price of ticket RMB Aircraft named Modern Ark apt as modernised Chinese version of old Antinov design Overall perfectly acceptable

Orlando to Manchester with Thomas Cook Airlines A low cost airline which provided a really good experience especially given the very low price of the ticket The flight departed one hour late but caught up and arrived on time Food was really good The entertainment was limited only a few movies but good Excellent flight for a cheap price

The main airport of Armenia has been completely rebuilt and the old Soviet style one is no longer operating The new terminal is clean and modern dutyfree shopping is in abundance As most fights arrive at midnight border control takes at least min During covid times all boarding passes need to be printed so take extra time in mind Taxis easily overcharge dram should be more than enough Overall a good experience

I tried to arrange a group trip with SyrianAir from London to Aleppo via Damascus and back Initially all was fine until they cancelled the first leg of the journey to Damascus a week prior to us leaving The next flight was days later but there was no immediate plane to Aleppo once we had arrived at Damascus which meant we would have to take a bus up instead a journey we werent too keen on While friendly the staff are fairly useless and I sat for MANY hours trying to sort things out We changed the flights to stay the same number of days but decided to go to Aleppo at the tail end of the trip under our own steam and the fly Allepo to London again via Damascus on the same ticket Unfortunately the staff didnt really get the group concept and kept issuing tickets for the wrong dates for different members of the group It took too many visits to their offices in Baker Street to finally get everyone on the same flights at the same time The flight to Syria was fine late and we managed to get up to Aleppo ourselves but the day before we were to fly out again we went into the Syrian air offices to confirm everything was ok IT WAS NOT They had cancelled the flight to Damascus without informing any of us and we had to arrange a midnight bus from Aleppo to Damascus Airport to make the correct flight back to London Luckily this one hadnt been cancelled But it was late My advice Dont Fly SyrianAir and if you do check on your flights constantly

Small airline but a good one Despite heavy turbulence on the flight from Kuala Lumpurs old airport to Tioman Island I felt safe and that the FAs knew what to do in the event of an emergency Cant be sure of course but it felt that way Good information from the crew about the turbulence Small planes but comfortable for the relatively short flight Good service during the flight

Flew Amsterdam to Belfast International on Easyjet EZY and I found the overall experience to be very good There was a slight delay in take off due to ATC however not a a major issue The onboard cabin crew lead by Clark were excellent and very customer oriented Great flight on Easyjet

YYZAMSYYZ Legroom was okay got the exit row on the way back Food decent for a charter Seat width normal unlike Air Transat they dont squeeze an extra row of seats in I didnt feel the need to upgrade to Economy plus The personal entertainment device portable hard drive with monitor was great Worth the euro on the day flight back

Stockholm Vsters is a tiny airport located around minutes drive west of Stockholm The name is therefore misleading as Vsters is a proper mediumsized town in its own right The place has a very friendly easygoing feel to it There is very little to do save buy a cup of coffee or something stronger if thats to your taste but then I have never had course to spend more than minutes at the airport There are special very efficient buses to Stockholm and elsewhere which connect with incoming and outgoing Ryanair flights It is also possible to take a regular bus into Vsters A totally hasslefree calm place to begin or end a journey

The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

Hassle free check in is something unheard of at this Airport Not even a professional customer friendly staff in the check in counter Staff treat passengers as some kind of nuisance to their work they prefer to gossip between themselves rather than clearing passengers in the queue

Flew WAWLWOWAW last week The airport is very big and airy and clean No problems going through passport control either way and no issues with security The airport is quite empty but it has a duty free section some places to drink a coffee or have something to eat both inside and outside the departures so quite satisfactory With the huge fall of the Hryvnia the prices in the coffee shop are reasonable the gift shop Baltona is not a bargain as they quote in Euro Travelling to the city is about Hryvnia by taxi which is now about Euro There is free wifi that worked fine for me I would not hesitate to fly through Lviv again

XIYCTUAUH Arrived from Xian on domestic flight in Terminal which was newly opened in Spring All very clean and tidy with clear signs in Mandarin and English Quite a long walk to Baggage Reclaim for the furthest gates but not unreasonable Toilets clean and plentiful with both squat and regular options For International Departures there are main dining options before Checkin either KFC or local Chinese food There are a few stores selling various local foods and some souvenirs CheckIn pretty good and Passport Control and Security all pretty smooth No requirement to remove belts or laptops for security scanning but do enforce the ml liquid rules from Europe In the International Departures no dining opportunities but a couple of coffeeshop options along with the usual array of Duty Free shops Most departures are from one of the airbridges Announcements made in both Chinese and English Toilets are clean

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

Bangkok to Osaka Smooth check in and efficient seat allocation They didnt check cabin baggage weight nor size Had to buy food and drinks as refused internet preorder because we used a travel agent Seats ok but a night flight which was very uncomfortable Saw in the inflight magazine we could upgrade enroute to premium economy a good idea For B a good flight
Modern infrastructure and worldclass service Known for its efficiency cleanliness and design it has become one of the most impressive airports in India

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

A surprisingly large and spacey airport given the size of Porto Boarding times security and seating were all great cuz of the practical layout Even during peak season theres plenty seats available Prices at the foodcourt were lower than youre used to in Europe Theres a convenient metro connection to the city center So all in all a hassle free airport

Unexpectedly Good I wasnt really sure what to expect and feared a tricky experience but in fact Fiji Airways were excellent I paid for extra legroom on the first leg but even on the long routing from Nadi to Vancouver the standard economy seat had excellent legroom Ive been more cramped in Qatar economy than this especially their recent seat config So this was a real bonus Crew were good and friendly I guess the weaker points are the food which is pretty basic and entertainment Both flights were ahead of schedule Id definitely fly with them again

Having stepped off an A a day before it was quite a strange experience to be one of just four passengers on the seater propeller ATR aircraft from Bangkok to Laos But the one hour and fiftyminute flight experience was lovely Following the traditional Sabaidee greeting from the friendly twoperson cabin crew we took off on time The elegantly uniformed flight attendant had a frangipani placed in her hair echoing the countrys national flower as well as it being in the airlines logo The x seating was comfortable with ample leg room Although a small airline it had an inflight magazine It was a sunny day and flying at around feet we had a clear view of the mountainous green scenery below A small snack box was offered which contained a tuna and cheese sandwich and drink and hot coffee was also served On arrival at Luang Prabang stepping out umbrellas were available just in case you found it too hot or if it was raining to walk to the terminal building The return flight was also on time this time with around or so passengers nearly all enjoying posing for photos by the aircraft
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

Arrival was easy and bags arrived quickly waived through health control and landside within minutes departing again no issues although the airport was busy with the evening departures there was plenty of security checkpoints open and plenty of staff each employee at the airport I encountered was helpful and friendly once through security there is a excellent Duty Free and several restaurantsbars along with a small selection of shops

I used this airport twice over the last two weeks Given the few international flights the international section was uncrowded Immigration was quick and hassle free Security check too was smooth no need to take off shoes or belts or jackets or pull out toiletries The business class lounge is used by all the airlines and it is a quiet place with a buffet of Indian and Bengali foods and a tended bar Limited number of shops and even limited number of eating places There is a duty free liquor shop just after exiting customs and before exiting the airport with a good selection of whiskeys at prices markedly cheaper than in the city All in all a functional airport that is easy to use with only essential facilities

Originally booked through Canaryfly Upon arrival at airport we saw that our flight was cancelled We didnt receive any notice but it turned out very smooth as we were already booked on a Binter flight at the original time To us it seemed as this happens frequently and they have a good system in place The flight was enjoyable and the cabin crew did a very good job

Airport was much better than expected In the general area are a few food options incl coffee shop icecream bar and a few fast food choices They even have a small duty free We were in the TAAG lounge called the Pearl lounge Clean comfortable with basic drinks food Staff are very friendly Did not see showers Internet is available but weak Other than internet this lounge is better than many US lounges I have visited I was expecting something much worse

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

The new Terminal C is a significant improvement over the old Delta terminal This is a spacious terminal with plenty of light from the floor to ceiling windows giving views of the airport runwaysaprons and CitiField and Arthur Ashe Stadium The walk from gate to gate was rather long Restrooms are plentiful and clean however in some locations they could use more stalls given the number of passengers who traverse this terminal Dining options are placed conveniently I had a delicious lunch at one of the restaurants The airport WiFi is very fast and worked flawlessly

First time flying with Jet they didnt disappoint We flew on a new A neo aircraft Crew were friendly efficient We got drinks services going but only coming home We paid for inflight meals both ways tea coffee or hot chocolate were included The food was very good hot Drinks were good value

Xian to London on th Feb Aircraft only years old Good amount seat recline with charger available however the entertainment system need an upgrade It is the coronavirus outbreak at moment the crew did an excellent job measuring temperature and disinfected the aircraft Excellent cabin service I went back to spoke with cabin crew they are willing to share their stories and experiences The lack of entertainment system is covered by the excellent crew service

We found Munich Airport to be an excellent airport very well laid out with two level gate system that seems to work very efficiently Very easy to follow signage good seating Check in and baggage drop off was well managed by friendly staff at Singapore Airlines service desks Gates and boarding in designated assigned groups seemed to work quite well Well presented airport

Milwaukee is a great airport to spend a couple of hours in Decent food selection a great interminal aviation museum and the most incredible airport used bookstore Ive experienced Wish I had brought another carryon bag as I could have filled the thing with all the great books at reasonable prices I wanted to buy

The passenger terminal in Fargo has limited but all the essential services I used it for arriving and departing to hub cities for onward connections Taxi drivers were near the baggage belts soliciting fares On departure you check in on the main floor and take escalators one flight up To your left is a large enough gift shop with the usual items plus North Dakota State University memorabilia On the right is a food court with a few eateries including a Subway The security check was smooth Once on the airside there is a coffee shop and a kiosk of a shop a miniatiure version of the gift shop on the other side There are quite a few chairs and signage is good A very easy airport to use and quick to get out of and quick to get in

A totally stressfree experience as sampled on a return charter flight from the Tampa Bay area Just eight departure gates but ample seating and a friendly barcafe No TSA hassle either A good gateway to Biloxi the Mississippi Gulf Coast and even Mobile AL Close to I

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

This was my nd flight to FLL in months after a year absence This review is limited to Terminal Arrival was at the A Concourse gates which mean a rather long connectors to the BC concourses common area One huge advantage of FLL airport over the others is the car rental facility which is directly across the airport roadway from the terminal The renovated terminal is spacious brightly lit and has a central TSA Entry point for all concourses Each concourse offers dining options a plenty For Christmas Day travel there was enough seating for all with power ports and USB ports at each gate The bathrooms are very clean and maintained at regular intervals Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished Terminal is a joy to travel through

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

Vintage airport that has been updated and serves lots of people on domestic flights The energy level is high and the view of the runways and operating area is excellent Fun place to arrive or depart with plenty to see and no end to the peoplewatching opportunities Pretty efficient as well

Attractive food comfortable seating In particular the flight attendants are professional and dedicated to helping passengers Head flight attendant Ms Hang and Ms Chi are very enthusiastic and very considerate in assisting passengers The flight crew is friendly and professional xut n hp dn ch ngi tin nghi c bit t tip vin chuyn nghip v rt tn tnh n cn h tr gip hnh khch trong sut chuyn bay tip vin trng c Hng c Chi nhit tnh lm v rt n cn h tr cc hnh khch t bay thn thin v chuyn nghip

Kolkata to Colombo Average aircraft no IFE available Legroom is less but seat width is satisfactory Crew was quite active throughout the hour flight Announcements were clear and audible Restrooms were clean but only the rear restroom was allowed for the economy class passengers Boarding was smooth Food served was scanty but then it was a flight at am so no one was really hungry
It is located in the city center and easily accessible by buses and MRT The size is not big Signposts are clear Employees are friendly and helpful The ambience is clean

Flew with AIRDO a low cost airlines owned by ANA from Tokyo Haneda to Hakodate Flight was on time and full of passengers who were en route to observe the cherry blossoms in Hakodate Cabin crew was really professional friendly and attentive Legroom was good seat was comfy cabin was clean Soft drinks water apple juice tea orange juice coffee was served to all passengers even it was a low cost airlines Both of take off and landing were smooth

Burbank is a very small regional airport serving the San Fernando Valley and northern Los Angeles suburbs with only gates and no jetways but its a very good alternative to the chaos that is LAX There are flights on Southwest dominant carrier United US Airways JetBlue American and Alaska to all major western USA airports plus DallasFt Worth and New York JFK The terminal is very small and can get overcrowded during peak times and foodbeverageconcession options are very Spartan but its easy to navigate has excellent free wifi and the security screening process is streamlined and wellrun You can also walk from the terminal to the longterm parking lot which you cant do at LAX

Visited Uganda on and departed on Both arrival and departure experiences were smooth Arrival hall is rather large There is mandatory health screening before one can proceed to visapassport control Obtaining a visa is relatively easy Present valid passport and make payment Baggage claim appeared to be a rather large area with perhaps carousels At departure level the lighting seems rather deem There is the mandatory screening of bags before you can enter and check in for the flight The staff is very friendly The facilities are clean and the departure hall appears small given the amenities gift shops dining and duty free The Karibuni Lounge is excellent It puts to shame US airline lounges in the USA with its food offerings and amenities Bathrooms are cleaned frequently by an attendant Overall no issues with EBB airport Immigration control staff are very friendly The only drawback to this airport is that passengers have to be dropped off in the parking area and then make their way around the roadway to the departure level

Tashkent Airport has become very efficient on the international side Immigration and customs both on the way in and on departure were quite user friendly Not a lot of shops and restaurants but that was not inconvenient Readers should be aware that the domestic terminal is on the other side of the runway and it could take up to minutes to connect from one side to the other side using a taxi

I have flown here only on private aircraft The commercial airlines have yet to discover this often overlooked resource The parking and terminal buildings are great Reminds me of how Chicago Midway used to be before the most recent spate of reconstruction like a hometown feel Very clean facilities and the commercial pax I have spoken to all seem to enjoy it Mostly the lack of a commute to Chicago I think

Worst Airport in the world arrived to check in then security on baggage Then Passport machine thought great all good Walked through Duty Free then a mile long queue to get through to B gate BA is B gate Poor shops nobody could shop or eat unless you had got their hours early This queue apparently is normal and is called the new fast track what a joke One person in a box checking passports again Run to B hundreds of people standing there no way could you board in Groups just a free for all Again with one woman at the gate before you got on the coach to the plane still coaching you out to the plane She was checking everyones passport again Why havent they upgraded this system by now and built satellite gates off the main airport Not going back there

I commute regularly between Perpignan and Manchester and it is my favourite airportIt only has one cafe and one shop but these are conveniently situated and adequate for the number of people there I can walk yards to check in there are rarely any queues and there is no need to rush through security The place is small but thats its charm no hassle no long walks and friendly and helpful staff To fly from most airports you need to allow a good two hours to get from a dropoff point to check in and then to a gate In Perpignan minutes suffices

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

Recently flew throughout Myanmar on the following routes YangonMandalayHehoMandalayNyaung U BaganHehoThandweYangon on their Fokker and ATR aircraft Checkin interesting as there are no computers and everything is weighed manually Ground crew cordial but not overly friendly Flight crews were friendly and always helpful Catering is good for the short flights with croissants and drinks being offered on even the shortest of flights unthinkable in Europe Aircrafts were always spotless and comfortable

Paris Orly to PointePitre Overall good experience decent food friendly service on the inbound flight Outbound all of the crew disappeared at night difficult to get something to drink Some security concerns upon landing in Paris Crew didnt check the cabin at alltwo teens sleeping in lie flat position until touchdown No one to wake them up no one to remind them to put their seat in an upright position never saw that before Seats are ok but angled lie flat

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever

Flew via Halifax on way from Heathrow to Toronto As its a pretty small airport theres not that much to do apart from look at the lobsters in the lobster shop we couldnt believe it when so many people were boarding planes carrying lobster boxes There are a few eateries both land and airside which are not wildly overpriced just average food on offer Tim Hortons provided a decent sandwich Overall we quite enjoyed the hours we spent there though If you go up the lift in the main concourse area theres a small viewing platform room which is a calm and relaxing place to be We watched the few planes that came in and out for minutes before going through security Everywhere there are plenty of staff to offer help all dressed in lovely tartan uniforms and without exception totally friendly There is also free wifi so we took full advantage of that We did ask one member of staff if we had time to go and see Halifax She replied in a friendly but blunt way Youd have to take a bus to get there and theres not really much to see anyway Its small but clean efficient and did the job for the few hours stopover

Ive been through this airport several times and I must say its incredibly clean and sparkling and definitely puts Gatwick to shame The people of Tunisia are very friendly which adds to the overall positive experience However I have a concern regarding the pricing While all airports tend to charge fees the prices here seem a bit exorbitant I wonder why this is the case Additionally I have a personal issue with the height of the walkway that crosses about meters up I understand this might not be a problem for most but it would be great if the sides of the walkway could be covered for those of us who arent fond of heights Other than these few points its an excellent airport with great service

Great airport small and friendly Not too bothered about duty free shops its an airport for quick in and out like most should be flights seem to be moving to Alicante but lets support this little airport and its staff Car hire very easy

Malaga to Birmingham I booked this flight online one week before flying I needed to book for adults one child and one infant However I found when checking prices it was cheaper make two separate bookings than the whole group at once I booked for two adults then another booking for one adult and two children This is unbelievable Also you arent allowed to check in online until hours before you fly unless you book a seat for euros each Which is a bit impossible as you are in holiday at this point Just another money making scam However we booked for free while in Spain and our hotel were kind enough to print our boarding passes for us The plane was clean but the seating is just too cramped My husband had sit with his knee protruding into the isle and the trolley kept knocking him when going past Food and drinks are too expensive luckily we bought some snacks and refreshments from the departure lounge before leaving Malaga The staff however are really helpful and Im sure they know its not the comfortable of places to sit for hours and do make an effort in making people feel welcome and providing a good service They were quick to help with the needs of my month old The pilot kept us informed of any changes as we were experiencing a lot of turbulence We were also informed as we approached the UK coastline and also times for arrival were given The plus side we didnt have any hold luggage and were able to check in infants pram at the departure gate Meaning we didnt have to wait in the long bag check in queues Overall we paid premium prices for seats on a below average quality plane Thanks to the stewards for their efforts in trying to compensate for this

I wanted to acknowledge the entire ground staff including the Security who helped us a great deal to arrange boarding the aircraft We reached airport just min before scheduled departure and the checkin was closed After requests since we as a family had to take onward flight from Delhi the ground staff went out of their way to help us

LAN Peru LIMLAX economy flight filled to capacity FAs friendly and competent new with the standard LAN seatback VOD Uusually for a Boeing standard size carryon luggage now actually fits in the overhead compartments noisy as usual but reasonably comfortable flight apart from the seats which have no footrest and dont recline very much good food and drinks service Booked as part of a flight from SJC to SCL the LAN booking system seems to work better now and was cheaper than booking through AAs system

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The check in was fast and the staff friendly The departure arrival were punctual and the aircraft made an average good maintained impression The seat distance was sufficiently good Despite the short flight there was a small bite and water Overall a good experience

Leon Bajio to Puerto Vallarta Punctual airline Small plane but confortable for a minute flight and very clean Excellent service and good attitude of ground staff and flight attendants They offer you a small snack on board free of cost The check in process at the airport was quick because the airplane has a passenger capacity

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues

Comfortable and clean provincial airport Didnt use any facilities other than the toilets which were clean and tidy Only real criticism is lack of seats at the gates I was on a full A flight to Brisbane and there were only seats for about passengers There is also no segregation of incoming and outgoing passengers the former have to weave their way through those people waiting to board Passengers seated in the rear half of the cabin were requested to go down stairs across the tarmac then up stairs to the rear door of the aircraft However by the time I reached the front of the queue the outside doors had been locked so I had to fight my way through the whole length of the aircraft cabin

I have been to many many airports all over the world and Little Rock is one of my favorites It is small but modern and clean There are never long lines and the personnel are always helpful and friendly After being away from home for months I always look forward to the simplicity and comfort of LR airport I like that baggage claim is after you meet up with the people waiting to get you as well
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

Arrival was great with no queues and security quick and easy Luggage arrived on carrousel very quickly Departure less good with long queues at security and long waits Fortunately plenty of seats in departure lounge Not much to do in lounge and poor range of food outlets WiFi free but nonexistent and unable to connect

Ljubljana Airport has undergone a major update over the last few years and has increased in size quite substantially Line of sight signage is good making navigation around the airport very easy Arriving from a Schengen country results in a very fast entry procedure to the country Departing was also a breeze with very friendly and efficient staff we were checked in through security customs and in the lounge in very short time Waiting areas are comfortable and duty free shopping and other outlets well staffed and spotlessly clean

Luang Prabang to Vientiane CheckIn was fast well organized and the staff friendly The departure arrival was on time and the aircraft made a very well maintained impression During the flight despite the short flight time of only minutes there were small bites and drinks The seat absorbency was slightly larger than other airlines Overall a good surprising experience

TNR to SMS via TMM A real delightconvenient timely clean friendly and attractively priced serving routes where you might not generally expect that Its great that theyre introducing some competition to the national carrier and we have nothing but compliments for the staff and the excellent service onboard

Kaohsiung International Airport is great but small There are some shops and restaurants The biggest point is that the airport is clean quiet and efficient the directions are clear as well Besides this international airport are really near downtown Kaohsiung The subway system is partially done recently you can take the KMRT to any place in downtown

Departing from Terminal for a domestic flight The airport was well connected with the public bus and train The terminal in general was clean modern and efficient Check in was fast and completely automatic via machines with ground staff was ready to help Surprising no long queue at the security and everything was smooth There were numerous comfy seats available for passengers Shopping and dining were also really good and at reasonable price

Zagreb Airport is a small but clean airport The airport staff were generally friendly helpful and efficient Moderate queuing time Seating area was a bit crowded during busy hours and lacking charging sockets around seats Fast and free WiFi

Got to be one of the worlds smallest airports The terminal is the size of a large living room You can literally drive up to the front door and walk in This made the airport very efficient and easy to use but dont bank on having a gourmet burger before your flight You will have to make do with a snickers bar and an Irn Bru from the vending machine To be fair it was very clean and is a good hub for the northern extremities

I use this little airport for flights between northern England and SE Asia via AMS on KLM I find it a very convenient feeder airport to the AMS hub and the small size of the terminal ensures that arrivals are swift and painless Im on the road within mins of hitting the tarmac in most cases Staff are generally friendly and helpful By contrast nearby NCL which used to be very quick and efficient is much more hassle with some of the most miserable ground staff in Europe

This airport is very small for the number of passengers and airlines it is serving Everywhere seemed to be crowded and felt cramped I thought they needed more space for better facilities and customer service Transferring from the train coming from London to the terminal and between terminals was very easy and well signage The prayer room is available and wellmaintained and the toilets are clean Not a pleasant experience for shopping and dining as there are too many people in a cramped space

I flew TokyoSapporoTokyo I was pleasantly surprised at the efficiency and professionalism of the staff The crew spoke English We departed and arrived ontime The great price combined with the excellent service ensures I will fly Skymark again

I had to cancel my travel plans from Dar Es Salaam to Arusha due to a medical emergency Coastal Aviation was very supportive understanding and efficient in processing my situation Much appreciated Great company

Air North describes its class of service as Yukoner Economy which I thought probably referred to a concept of warmhearted hospitality and generosity This held true for my first flight in their but after flying in the HS Im wondering if the term is actually more about resilience in the face of harsh conditions Cramped conditions in the HS aside the service overall was pretty good staff were almost all friendly and efficient flights ran on schedule and reasonable food was provided No inflight entertainment system but at the time I flew the stunning everchanging landscape below was all the entertainment I could want

Dhaka to Jessore I find the name of this private airline in Bangladesh a bit funny Other than that no complaints Arrived at the domestic terminal in Dhaka minutes before the scheduled morning departure due to being severely delayed due to road traffic The checkin desk completed all formalities rushed us through security had a limo ready for us to escort me and my partner to the aircraft at the remote stand The flight left after our boarding and exactly on time I have never experienced this kind of dedication and professionalism with an airline The flight to Jessore lasted minutes onboard a clean and attractive Dash Q and we were served a sandwich cake and a water bottle by friendly and smiley flight attendants The return flight to Dhaka a couple of days later was just as good but we made sure we arrived promptly for checkin this time We were served a mini burger cake and water bottle

Terminal International The arrivals hall was a long walk from the gate to customs and immigration but aided by moving walkways and wide corridors Baggage collection was very rapid and despite the enormous volume of passengers clearance through immigration was superefficient with lots of staff ushering passengers to the right lanes Departure was a similar experience with long queues being very effectively managed by extremely helpful staff The free wifi is fast and effective throughout the airport Most of the food and beverage options landside are for Japanese or Asian food all of which are a bit pricey There is also a very good outdoor viewing deck a rarity these days Airside there are lots of shops and food outlets much more than the landside offerings Importantly the terminal offers a large open space with heaps of charging stations and comfortable seating PA announcements are clear and in multiple languages One word of caution walking from the central area to the boarding gates can take as much as minutes so factor this into your timing

What a lovely little airport Check in staff very helpful top security must say and very good information desk Pity about the facilitiess and layout of the airport despite the levy charge Fast punctual service and with a smile

I flew Brisbane to Honiara on the th April Flight Left early was only full and arrived minutes early Add kg of luggage good plentiful food and beer what more could you want Entertainment was poor but its only a hour flight so I survived Staff friendly which is much more than I can say about the BA Qantas staff on the Flights coming out from Ireland

Brand new airport On the positive side for Chinese standards it certainly is welldesigned and wellconnected Bright and clean checkin area Good choice of restaurants and cafes both before and after security controls As to the negatives the security controls are quite inefficient and slow the airline lounges are all quite poor and certain gates from upward are very far up to min walking

Bogota to Pereira After reading many bad reviews were prepared for anything Fortunately everything went well Our slightly overweight baggage was not an issue kgkg the ground staff was friendly Not knowing if they charge extra for not printing the ticket we did the check in ourselves but seeing many with an airline printed ticket I assume this is not an issue The flight left minutes earlier the cabin crew was friendly as well and during the short flight they even offered us a small free drink The plan was clean the captain friendly So overall a great experience Not much to complain about really

I like that Recaro seats were used The seat was very soft and legroom was actually the most I have gotten thus far even for such a tiny plane like the A neo It was very well kept and modern and the cabin was spotlessly clean There was even a meal on the short flight of hours Excellent experience However there was no screens for IFE but there was a cool magazine that kept me entertained so yeah However there unfortunately was a karen or kevin or whatever you call it on our flight The crew were very professional

Extremely friendly wheelchair assist personnel I am disabled and was being moved from gate to gate and since I had some layover time I decided that I would like to get a snack at one of the fast food shops The wheelchair assistant not only took me there but he helped me get my order as well The people everywhere were friendly Cleanliness wasnt top grade but adequate

Airport Facility Check in staff service Staff was not really friendly Lounge the airport Lounge not airBaltic In this Lounge you can find some light snacks and beverages but the price of entry is not worth it Seat comfort Seats were good for Economy on domestic European flights Seat pitch A bit more than enough Legroom A bit more than on the vast majority of European flights Cabin safety videoinfo they have video displayed on screens above passengers seats Comfort items almost do not exist Cleanliness Its usually clean on airBaltic flights Lavatory cleanliness it was clean Selection of meals preorder the passenger has a lot of options Selection of drinks onboard a wide selection several seasonal drinks are available Selection of snacks onboard different snacks are available and light meals are available Good quality Food a bit overpriced Only one magazine but it is mostly advertisement WiFi was not available on that flight This airline is good for flights up to hours Ticket prices are not high so if person needs to get from point A to point B airBaltic would be a good option

Absolutely tiny airport but great at the same time has a lot of character Lacking service stalls but thats due to the scale of the airport and the expectations of people derived from visiting larger airports

It was years ago I used this airport and wow so much has changed The check in on nd level had moved to a much more spacious rd level It made the experience totally different in a positive way No longer does it feel cramped Staff are friendly and signage are very clear The only thing that still need improving is the variety of shops available air side and food options It is still pretty basic at this stage With more and more airlines flying to OKA they can be more ambitious and open up more shops and restaurants to cater for us

I had not heard of Air KBZ before I made the booking for my Myanmar trip However all of the three domestic flights Mandalay to Thandwe Thandwe to Sittwe and Sittwe to Yangon went very well ontime arrivals food and beverages free of charge although the flights were short friendly staff modern and clean aircraft I would fly Air KBZ again in case I return to Myanmar

Boarding on TLV was done on time but delayed to get permission to depart A was in a good condition and clean Stewardesses were professional and friendly Inflight service was beverages coffee water sandwich and granola bar On the return flight there was a minutes later departure schedule change they informed us with email days in advance

Lufthansa operated by Germanwings from Barcelona to Berlin Tegel and back Both fights on time with very quick boarding and ground service First flight was a year old A plane was very clean and comfortable The return flight on a year old A despite the old age of the aircraft it was very clean comfortable and showed signs of great maintenance service You cold only tell that it was that old becouse it was considerably louder but the journey was very enjoyable The snacks are not very good but I can forgive that on a h min flight Great comfort in the seats with more legroom Great value for money and going to try Eurowings

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through
Kualanamu airport is very good Check in counters are good the waiting room is comfortable and clean But the toilets are not too clean but no problem The airport staff are good

This is a good airport The cleaning can be improved but I do like the layout its not a very very long walk but it is long if you ask me I go here for my vacation flights instead of having to drive hours to the nearest true international airport Overall Columbus has a good airport Would definitely fly here again

I passed through this airport in July They had done a lot of improvements since the first time I flew through in and I know that its not totally finished now The price of food and beverages is pretty expensive The airport looks good and clean The staff are professional

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National

Not Verified The new airport is much better than the old but the issue with taxis remains The military controls the airport and hence which taxis are used No meters and extortionate fares Better off walking minutes south on road outside arrivals right angle to airport terminal and pickup a bluebird or AA cab from there Clean and metered Pity the Government does not stop in and do something about this as it is a horrible welcome to what is otherwise a friendly and interesting city and region

Found arrival experience excellent Check in on departure was good and quick Security was good and quick However toilets before security were not good no lock or even handle on gents toilet door Cafe was ok but no toilet After security there where vending machines but if you had no euros you couldnt get anything aircon lacking

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

Not a large airport my wife and I found this one more like ones we are used to in New Zealand No airbridges but airstairs do the job well especially at smaller airports Arrival was good a lot of taxi touts which is not unusual in Malaysia we used a coupon taxi for transport to our hotel Did not visit the shops or toilets here had a long wait in departure lounge for our flight Met our needs staff helpful

The airport is good and surprisingly large for a city of this population due to large number of tourists Most depart on Terminal S South note the terminal as the other terminal is far away Check in and security were smooth and fast There are adequate facilities for shopping or a drink The airport as well as Alaska Airlines have a good record of on time departure A good airport though there is not many lounges

Shanghai to Tehran return July Direct flight to Tehran Economy class Aircraft A Fare was quite good Checkin fast Cabin crew showed Iranian hospitality No individual inflight entertainment but fairly speaking since the flight was at night One toilet closed for whole trip the other two were not clean and almost out of tissue Food was enough and fine for me Many drink options Flying time was less than hours on my way to Tehran and less than on the way back to Shanghai Considering all the above I will certainly choose this airline next time for my trip to Tehran

An enjoyable flight It left on time and check in was easy The seat was quite comfortable for a short flight The staff were very friendly and efficient The food was surprisingly good as well The flight offered refreshments twice In fact more food then my flight on QANTAS from Sydney to Cairns

Good small airport The staff is not friendly at all First nobody smile in that airport and when i pass the gate they dont greeting at the search point and passport point One guy he just pointing me by hand what to do and chewing gum in your face

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh

As AC has given up this route we again flew with this Lufthansa subsidiary from YYC to FRA and on to Venice Boarding went smoothly as AC staff now handle this aspect for Eurowings which they didnt do last year The plane left and arrived on time which allowed us to make our connection with Lufthansa Cabin crew were very helpful and fluent in both English and German The seating in business class in and the seats were very comfortable As we chose the evening flight we were able to sleep for a number of hours The seats recline into a fully flat position Comfortable blankets and pillows were provided The food was excellent with a choice of three entrees A fairly good selection of movies was available All in all a much better experience than the one we had last year Lufthansa must be having success with this route as there are now two flights daily from YYC to FRA I find it curious that AC gave up this route

The airport is much better now since the renovation is complete Plenty of parking when you arrive There are a range of shops Patchi chocolate Bookstore Coffee bean tea leaf bodyshop in the predeparture area and a restaurant There are ATM machines a baggage sealing service and currency exchange stand but they never have Singapore dollars Check in was a breeze done in several minutes Passport control is quick Once you enter the departure lounge to the right is a food court that sells food to order manly Asian dishes There is a convenience store some stores that sell traditional Bruneian foods and watch perfume stores I was told more stores will be added soon The waiting area has good lighting there are priority seats near the gate for those with young children and elderly people The toilets were clean There is a prayer room for Muslim travellers On arrival there is a short walk to customs and immigration Separate counters for local ASEAN Diplomatic and foreigners There are plenty of trolleys at the baggage carousel There is a green and red channel there are several officers always on duty I left a hand luggage on the plane luckily I was able to retrieve it There is a door at the side of KFC which leads back to the arrivals hall The bag was aleady in the office for me to collect In the arrivals hall there is a KFC and Burger King also Counters for DST and Progressif which are the mobile phone carriers You can purchase tourist sim cards which have minutes and data pre loaded There is a counter for tourist information and Hertz Avis car rental Upon exiting the terminal there is a taxi service taxis are metered You can also use the ride hailing app Dart There is a local bus service but its not available for the late flights If you have a long layover and and your passport lets you exit the airport the Airport mall is a minute drive or minute walk away but but be careful as there are no footpaths

Terminal is the area I am reviewing this trip We used the short stay car park as you can walk undercover into the terminal Very easy although not the cheapest option Finding the Aer Lingus checkin was simple and as we stood in line the single checkin operator asked for passengers for Belfast to come forward first which was great The airline uses T for short hops to Belfast and Dublin the main activity for long haul is in T Security was very quiet and efficient for those of us who understand and stick to the rules One family was annoyed at having to surrender much of their liquids and cosmetics because they did not know the rules My partners bag was sidetracked for search Apparently her paperback novel attracted their attention Mine thankfully did not so go figure Once through we ran the gauntlet of the Duty Free maze and found our way to the Aspire Lounge included with the economyflex ticket Boarding was simple with the ATR aircraft having only seats Returning the aircraft was parked very remotely for some reason and we were bussed to the terminal at times I thought we were on an executive allareas tour By the time we got there the bags were on the belt and we were away

We were originally booked in Premium Economy with Air Canada Due to a substitution of aircraft we were switched onto Omni in economy class While the aircraft was fairly old and we were delayed hour in takeoff everything else was fine Seats were comfortable food was okay and cabin crew were very friendly and efficient Air Canada processed the promised refund due to us being downgraded We would be okay with flying Omni again but prefer flying on an aircraft with a premium economy cabin

Short flight to Shiraz from Tehran Mahan Air already has a reputation of being an airline of choice for travelling within Iran for both safety and service and I could see why While the type of plane is old an A it was well maintained and clean The seating was very impressive definitely the widest and the most legroom I have had in a long time in both long and shorthaul flights For a hour flight I was surprised to be served a substantial cold meal Nonalcoholic beverages are served on the flight The service was courteous and efficient but not warm We landed minutes early The airfare was dirt cheap one way at last minute You cant book directly on their website with an international card but can certainly book through thirdparty sites but checkin is available online

The security staff at Aberdeen airport are not up to standard Many of them are aggressive and argumentative and their main aim is not to be friendly or courteous I have been fortunate enough to travel to many countries and I say without hesitation that the security staff at Aberdeen airport are either the most poorly trained that I have encountered or that they are paying no attention to the training they receive The management team needs to review the training of the security staff at Aberdeen airport urgently
Small airport clean and friendly staff However they have horrible wifi Make sure you have a good data plan if you have to sit for a while for your flight

When we arrived at Luxor airport got off the coach all I can say was what appeared like a pack of wolves were waiting to help with bags Now Im a ft stone bloke so am well capable but even despite this I ended up almost having to wrestle my bag away from a very eager helper who all the time was whispering under his breath drink please interspersed with something It appeared as if there was a supervisor or someone that they didnt want to hear their requests if so they were spectacularly unsuccessful in stamping out this sort of overaggressive help Having managed to wrestle free of the initial wave of helpers get inside the building once again there was another helper to lift bags onto the xray belt This time however as he didnt have any English phrases apparently the helper was saying something in Egyptian again whispering while showing me an Egyptian Pound note folded in the palm of his hand as a prompt Having now managed to get through these levels of assistance there was of course another helper at the other end of the xray machine who was equally helpful in taking the bag off the belt similarly looking for money Next up was the checkin desk itself yes you have guessed it there was yet another helper at the head of the queue to again lift the bag onto the checkin conveyor There is a sign on display at the desk stating that all baggage assistance was free of charge but this was clearly not having any effect on the various helpers that have to be negotiatedovercome Finally naturally there is the customary help in the toilets where even though I am at yrs of age well capable of washing drying my hands I was presented with some toilet paper with the by now customary demand for money All in all never again

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

Phoenix is the easiest of all major US airport to get in and out of I picked Phoenix as my home based in part because I needed a reliable airport considering how often I fly and PHX does not disappoint The new terminal is really excellent and the improved lounge situation at Terminal is really appreciated

The whole experience was very professional Flight was completely comfortable clean and the air crew were friendly and helpful The flight was on time and the in flight service was just excellent for such a short flight

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

An excellent regional airport with good updated facilities including its super cafe which will provide you with coffee and toast for that early morning departure From car park to check in takes just a couple of minutes and baggage return the same Air Southwest staff from check in flight deck and cabin crew are exemplary As a regular traveller with them I recognise so many friendly faces I find flying with them and from Plymouth a pleasure

I was subjected to a very intimate search three times by two different TSA agents The scanner was obviously malfunctioning How do I know Well I was clean but it kept saying I wasnt Then walking on the tarmac to the plane a baggage handler insisted that I had to valet my carryon bag Once inside seeing the mostly empty luggage bays I complained to the flight attendant She went and brought the bag to me with apologies Arrival was okay but the I had to follow a bread crumb trail of corridor stairs and turns all with inadequate signage Eventually I arrived at two luggage bays and was at first relieved to see my flight posted as unloading But it turned out that we did not get our luggage in hand for hr mins No information from the uncommunicative employee in the Baggage Office She said they were trying to find the agent to see if he has any more bags Im being generous here She told me to scan a lost baggage claim code which did not work
Friendly and fast service Enough toilets seats and bins But shops close early and have a extremely poor selection in duty free If you want anything make sure you get it before coming to the airport

Round trip from Guatemala to Roatan via San Pedro Sula and Tegucigalpa respectively June For all hour flying segments service was exemplary lunch box on every flight with delicious sandwiches On the way back departing Roatan plane was intensively checked for an oil leakage threatening our connection at Tegucigalpa with passengers getting nervous about the situation but TACA agent in the waiting room was reassuring Even offered a free phone call to Guatemala The plane got fix and we landed just in time in Tegucigalpa with TACA personnel waiting for us at the door of the plane with umbrellas over the tarmac to get to the other plane When we landed in Guatemala all luggage arrived too Great service from all the involved staff at all the airports and flights

Louisville is actually one of the nicest airports in the United States poundforpound In fact Louisville on steroids gives you an idea of what more of our true international gateways should look like but dont I mean Detroit and Minneapolis are good but LAX and JFK Ill start with the good about Louisville Parking is easy and reasonably priced So easy in fact that its literally at the back door of the terminal and nicely covered for all those inclement weather situations The airport is super clean The personnel are aboveaverage in friendliness some of the security and restaurant staff could learn to smile but its hard for me to recount any particularly rude experiences with personnel The terminal is very Louisville and Kentuckythemed making the airport an unmistakable part of the state of Kentuckys cultural identity Security is usually a breeze even if you dont have TSA PreCheck which I have Its almost immediately next door to the state fairgrounds minutes from downtown and minutes from serene natural areas like Jefferson Memorial Forest The terminals are straightforward and wellsigned The public art is very localspecific and themed and attractively positioned As a bonus the airport is UPS primary North American hub so its neat to see the massive cargo planes regularly flying in and out of there The real drawbacks of flying into and out of Louisville are that baggage claim takes a little longer than it should for a relatively small airport and you have to pay close attention to signage right as youre driving off the property to access the freeways and fairgrounds In summary Its hard to go wrong with flying in and out of Louisville Ive been doing it for years and it just feels almost like putting on a comfortable pair of shoes

The airport is a charming little place up on the Sunshine Coast There are only about flights a day going to Sydney and Melbourne It has recently been upgraded and expanded the gate area is much bigger and has food outlets and toilets It opens up on to the runway and provides nice views Its an easy airport to handle as it isnt too big to get lost in but isnt so small so as to feel cramped The butterfly sanctuary between checkin and security which must be walked through as it is on the pathway is a lovely touch and provides a unique atmosphere The ground staff are very friendly If heading up to the Sunshine Coast it is often cheaper and quicker to fly direct rather than to Brisbane and by far it is an easier airport to use
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good
