Sapporos New Chitose airport is very effective and user friendly facility Located somewhat far from Sapporo it is perfectly linked to the city and the region by rail Quick checkin quick baggage delivery good choice of food outlets landside but not a lot of things to do airside The train station is underground as almost everywhere in Japan All in all very good star

Overall our experience my wife and myself in transit twice in KGL has been satisfactory certainly compared with airports in the region with regard to seating not very comfortable but OK cleanliness including toilets signage and announcements attitude of official personnel security and boarding procedures Free WIFI did not work However we have been ripped off when purchasing goods from the VIVA GLOBAL DUTY FREE SHOP billed much higher prices than advertised no receipt received for some goods which we also paid far too much in USD We did not have our luggage on arrival at destination travel with Rwandair to BRU our suitcases arrived early next day via another company but we had to collect them from the airport since Rwandair does not have a policy of sending delayed luggage to the home

Think it only has a dozen flights or so a day exclusively under the Air NZ banner now Freedom Air is being reamalgamated into Air NZ It has been well modernised and seems very spacious It has the advantages of a small airport with short distances plane to terminal to baggage collection and to car park We were in the car and off within mins of getting off the lane On departure there is a great upstairs light and airy waitingeating arrivals area with plenty of space and excellent views There are adequate drinks food and shop The only downside was that the hire car companies closed quite early so as we were arriving at pm we had to persuade friends to come and collect us

Domestic passenger Arrived at and departed on from Terminal No issues disembarking Having staff there to ensure passengers with baggage to reclaim dont inadvertently leave without collecting it is helpful On return it took a while to clear security With a number of airports across the UK now using the new scanners meaning liquids can stay in hand luggage its a pity Terminal had not restarted this Good range of shops and restaurants in departures with clear signage and ample seating Flight pushed back on time but there was a wait of about minutes as it sat in a queue for takeoff clearance From previous experience excellent for international travel as most major cities across the world reachable with a direct flight but Gatwick remains my first choice for regional travel

Juliaca is the smallest commercial airport I have experienced Because of the size it is easy to find your way around There is not very much in the airport so bring something to amuse yourself The good news is due to the size it is a very clean including the bathrooms There was a VIP Lounge that I peeked into It consisted of a few chairs and a cooler with soft drinks and beer

Everything went smoothly on this short flight to Paro We flew a new plane with lovely grey leather seats seat pockets with metal springs it all just smelt new that was a bonus Crew friendly and accommodating So from Katmandu to Paro you need to have window seat on the left of the plane It was my most scenic commercial flight ever stunning views of the Himalayas and Mount Everest for over half the flight sit on the left ABC seats and then the remarkable descent into Paro airport landing at the prettiest airport I ever been to and I have travelled a fair bit Unless the flight in darkness your baggage lost or severe delay non of which happened for me I cannot see how this short flight could fail to impress A cheese roll and drink included Get to Bhutan on this flight

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

We arrived late at night nearly midnight so were exhausted We went through passport control reasonably quickly and the baggage reclaim was also very smooth Very modern airport and due to less passenger traffic very efficient Taxi to railway station was done in under minutes Very clean toilets included which is often a rarity Overall I would have to say I prefer Zhulyany over Borispol which I have been flying through for years due to its better connections to the city Though in London it is not very convenient as Wizz Air fly from Luton

I flew Lao Airlines from Luang Prabang to Hanoi It was a short one hour flight and the service revised by Lao Airlines was everything you could expect for a flight like this They served drinks and a snack which was a tasty sandwich although there was no vegetarian option The staff were friendly There was no inflight entertainment but that didnt bother me as the flight was so quick
You can change your seats at echeck in without charge Both flights were on time Aneo was clean there were no inflight service for the hour flight Stewards were efficient and friendly enough

There is also an excellent restaurant on the mezzanine floor overlooking the runway It opens at noon which gives adequate time for a good lunch before the departure of the Luton flight at Information on bus transportation to and within Nimes is at httpwwwtcnfr

Arriving passengers are bussed to the terminal where visa stamps are paid for or collected These are not visas in the traditional sense but a tourist tax of Immigration simply involves having your passport stamped there seemed to be no checks and this was done speedily Baggage delivery was very quick on a fast moving belt and you are soon outside of the terminal building Departing passengers have to endure a number of queues to get into the terminal but once through checkin is reasonably quick Luggage weight checks are very thorough and they seem disappointed if your luggage is within limits and recheck it a few times in the hope it gets heavier Departure forms are completed after checkin airside there are the usual range of caes some offering free WiFi which is really great and things you never knew you wanted Buses take you to your plane This would be a good airport by European standards and is an example to others in Egypt of how it can be done The one thing that annoyed me was that in the Gents Toilets supposedly free you were hassled even whilst occupied for a tip by the attendant he did not get one

Arriving and departing from this regional airport is far less stressful than dealing with the airports in Cancun or Mexico City There are fewer passengers of course plus the airport is well organized and clean Checkin was fast and easy and security was well organized courteous and fast There are several places to enjoy a snack or meal before takeoff The waiting area is spacious and uncrowded and offers great views of planes landing and taking off Wifi was free and worked well

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good

KULCTUKUL The Shuanglin terminal is equipped with all the usual amenities The toilets are clean the terminal is clean The terminal also has signs in EnglishChinese Going through customs and immigration is a breeze You can reach the city centre easily by bus or taxi however signs to the bus outside was not to clearly shown

First time from and to the new A terminal Didnt believe it but everything worked excellently No queues at checkin security passport control customs Bus gate had enough lift capacity so went down without wait On arrival baggage was on the belt in minutes and then in minutes off the airport Again no wait at immigration Food choices are fine both airside and landside Take into account this is just minutes some km from downtown Good choice and far superior to overcrowded Borispol with long queues dingy terminals and km from the city centre

A relatively large regional airport for a small town However Darwin is the state capital of Northern Territory We checked in for the flight went through security and then waited for the flight to depart There were no hassles or problems Everything went smoothly

Small clean airport Close to the city centre If one arrives for a later flight in the evening arrive with a full stomach as nothing is open after It is an efficient small airport with quick security The TV is still on at full volume in the departure area

Loved it Takes no more than minutes from entering to get to the gate When you depart minutes It was like heaven compared to Toronto where there are long lines lots of computers and where it takes so long to get to the gate and where you dread the lineups getting off the plane for the same reason It is convenient it is quick clean and has a Tim Hortons

Flown HanedaChitose and FukuokaHaneda in the new A Very good seats almost like business class seats Service on board was excellent Drinks and snacks for a small fee about euro for a coffee Will fly with them again when in Japan

We flew from Sydney to Zhengzhou and vice versa on Tianjin Airlines recently overall it was a great trip ground staff were very friendly they even reserved a couple extra seats for us so that my two young kids could have a decent sleep on the way home cabin staff were also very friendly they were very helpful throughout the flight Legs rooms great food service was decent as well The only minor issue is their entertainment system was very old there were just a handful movies to select from also their D map system was not functioning for both sectors which meant you couldnt tell where you were currently other than that it was really a great flying experience

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

Flew them on the Frankfurt Sarajevo trip on board their B I found the airline staff professional and friendly which cant be said about the customs at SJJ airport most of whom looked downright angry and like they hate their job The BH airlines crew were great and boarding was quick and breeze The flight arrived a few minutes early and I found the cabin fairly modern and clean

Kefalonia Airport has a new hall which is big enough for passangers waiting The queing went fine although there are not many desks The toilets were new and clean Coffee and sweat breads are in the hall In de waiting area is a small shop Personnel was very kind and helpful

The terminal offers an array of restaurants and shops which gives passengers a well rounded experience The security was smooth and quick with just only a few passengers waiting in line The airport has a very white theme which makes the interior very bright Staff at the airport are generally helpful and able to speak basic to intermediate level of English I had troubles connecting to the WiFi network I asked the airport staffs to help me out because they couldnt figure out the reason of not being able to connect the WiFi All in all Bahrain Airport is one of the nicest airports to travel in addition to Doha and Muscat Airports

I have been to many many airports all over the world and Little Rock is one of my favorites It is small but modern and clean There are never long lines and the personnel are always helpful and friendly After being away from home for months I always look forward to the simplicity and comfort of LR airport I like that baggage claim is after you meet up with the people waiting to get you as well

A small airport with a modern purposebuilt terminal with direct raillink from the city With only one flight to serve on a Sunday afternoon service all round should have been and was excellent Plenty of seating although that in the bar was a bit utilitarian

A modest little airport in Sabah Arrived on a domestiic flight from KL so no formalities Leaving again domestically to Kota Kinabalu was a breeze with very fast efficient checkin bag scan etc The airport is clean light airy and efficient by modern standards a joy to use

Mandalay airport is not very big so is very easy and fast to go around The ground staff are very friendly like all the burmese people The airport was clean lots of light and good airconditioning There is a smoking area inside There are also some souvenir shops and a few places to eat To get the stamp at customs it took a lot of time as there werent many desks open and many flights at the same time so many people started to stress a little

Juan Santamara International Airport has gotten much better over the years Clean and modern The arrival process customs and immigration are as smooth as they can be Departures are easy too they could do better with the Exit Tax process long lines and no where to fill out the forms I understand some airlines will start allowing you to pay in advance which is excellent The food inside the terminal is ridiculously expensive I paid for a fast food breakfast sandwich I still dont understand why they have to check each carryon bag again at the gate when we were just screened and xrayed going through security It just slows the boarding process down

Short flight to Shiraz from Tehran Mahan Air already has a reputation of being an airline of choice for travelling within Iran for both safety and service and I could see why While the type of plane is old an A it was well maintained and clean The seating was very impressive definitely the widest and the most legroom I have had in a long time in both long and shorthaul flights For a hour flight I was surprised to be served a substantial cold meal Nonalcoholic beverages are served on the flight The service was courteous and efficient but not warm We landed minutes early The airfare was dirt cheap one way at last minute You cant book directly on their website with an international card but can certainly book through thirdparty sites but checkin is available online

SSHLXRSSH Dash Q A bit dubious as I had never heard of this Egyptian carrier and the name doesnt inspire a great deal of confidence but I was pleasantly surprised A new aircraft on this short minute flight comprehensive safety demo in English that was understandable Complimentary juice and a small snack provided I would not hesitate to use this airline again

Traveled to Haikou from this airport as there were no flights from Macau to Haikou It is a fairly large airport with a small aviation museum in the departures hall However the airport was a bit old and wasnt very clean Overall it was quite a good airport with interesting activities to pass the time

My trip to Belize took me through BZE times It is a classic sleepy room airport an updated arrivals hall with a mechanical carousel a communal departure area serving the or gates glass doors really that lead to the tarmac separated by the small warm somewhat chaotic checkin area Some staff were friendly and enthusiastic security checks were minimal Few large jets come to BZE but they do seem to be timed near each other Most flights are prop planes to the interior and the offshore reefs There is a pleasant open air deck that allows views of arriving and departing passengers walking to and from their planes There is nothing else to do while waiting for your flight Bring a book Amenities are few tiny gifts shops snack bars and a cafeteria A good place to people watch Very stressfree and it serves its purpose Ambergris Cay was our real destination Well worth the trip

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights

Return leg of my round trip Again the great thing about this airline is the departure from Bangkoks main airport rather than the budget terminal across town Check in was done smoothly and boarding is by passenger ramp instead of being bussed about the airfield so is very convenient and quick Flight departed on time and was fairly uneventful Flight arrived minutes ahead of scheduled time The only let down of the journey was deplaning at Ha Noi was by ground service ramp and bus to the terminal

This is a quite modern airport and serves the country well after that being said I felt the airport is terribly connected to the other parts of the island and it makes you rely heavily on taxis or hotel transfers On arrival they will ask you for the Mauritius all in one form if you do not have it they will send you to the end of the line so that you can fill it online the airport provides free wifi for that then they will ask for hotel accommodation and return tickets make sure you have then handy or this will delay you and everyone else standing in line The staff seem to be friendly specially if you speak French Bathrooms were clean and after immigration and security on departure there are plenty of food options including global fast food giants I would say that I enjoyed my time while using this airport

Cusco airport is not big but it is very organized and does have boarding bridges This airport m high from sea level Excellent view from aircrafts This airport is always busy There are some shops and staff are helpful However it does need more seating because I saw many passengers standing up Free wifi is only available for minutes

Flew last week from Munich to Tyunmen TJM Siberia B with Europeanstyle business cabin middle seat free Smooth checkin my coat was taken by a smiling attendant but no help to put my kg luggage in the locker No entertainment during the hours journey redeye but more than decent meal with appetisers and good Chilean wine I hope that my return flight in two days will be at least as peaceful although the linguistic capacities of the crew should be improved
Excellent except that the parking is free and hence clogged We landed taxied to within years of the terminal walked straight through the door to baggage arrivals and within minutes were in the car

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

An airport is usually a necessary evil This one is different it makes you feel good It is a facility owned by Bangkok Airways and is a small efficient and charming outfit Tofrom the plane you are transported by small open electric buses to the arrivaldeparture hall These are roofed but in the open air surrounded by a neat park On arrival luggage arrived in minutes and delivered to the small arrival hall Checkin and security took minutes without any shortcut but with customer attention and care The pasture hall has no shopping Great but serves some complimentary snacks Restrooms as indeed the entire facility was spotlessly clean A true feelgood facility Other Bangkok Airways facilities in Thailand follow the same attractive concept

Going to Washington Dulles Airport is easy when departing and arriving regardless of connectionsgood staff lounges and great AeroTrains and Mobile Lounges to connect different terminals They have good food in various terminals and airline lounges

Landed at the newer of the two terminals Baggage collection was fast and was able to buy a phone card easily on the lower Arrivals level but telephones were only on the upper Departures level Security was tight with baggage tags checked by airport staff No illegal taxi touts hounding you and bus into the city was quick and easy On departing the airline waiting areas were large and comfortable The food in some places was cheap very cheap Same as supermarket price for bottle of Pepsi Had a gate change but was handled quickly and easily Efforts were made to keep me informed despite being the only foreigner on my flight New monorail will soon open from airport to city Airport taxi prices are not too expensive but be prepared for a wild and crazy ride

Three trips between CCS and BLA I found Conviasa to be clean modern friendly and welcoming My Spanish is functional but quite basic and when I struggled there was usually multilingual staff even on the short hop from Caracas to Barcelona and back Luggage allowance on this flight is a generous kg and a free drink is provided despite the flight time being only minutes Seats comfortable with more room than I was expecting All in all Conviasa offer a superior albeit slightly more expensive service on this short route than do their competitors Avior

Klagenfurt is very small and the staff there might not be as busy as their colleagues from other airports Likewise the ground handling is very fast and efficient Moreover the personnel are overwhelmingly friendly and helpful Unfortunately there is no airport lounge and the only small caf is before the security check The seats in the waiting area are not the most comfortable ones as well Travelling to and from KLU by car or bus is just fine however if you want to go by train it might turn out as a nightmare The closest train station is only a stop for commuter trains SBahn and is located more than one mile away from the terminal

Departure hall clean spacious and air conditioned Well organised queuing system with KLM staff tagging hand baggage in advance to make check in run smoothly Each airline had their own desk Security fast just remember to have your red immigration card Food outlets fine but limited Shopping limited as two shops sold the same items Duty free had a good range of perfume and drinks but beware if you are European and outside the Eurozone prices are more expensive for cosmetics than what you would pay in High Street shops Didnt fully investigate alcohol but you need to look carefully for offers and compare them to a local supermarket We werent travelling with children but I didnnotice any play facilities on offer Seats OK Arrival Hall just had fans but didnt have to wait long for luggage There are toilets in the baggage reclaim hall these were clean and well maintained For a small island a really good airport

Small regional airport With just two terminals it is pretty painless to navigate Lines at the security checkpoint move fast I was told that a contractor operates the checkpoints In my experience staff was friendly and two or more lanes were open Some restrooms in the secure area were closed off due to renovations in progress Concessions were limited but there is a McDonalds a Subway a news store and a coffee outfit Because its a regional airport many code share flights are operated by smaller airlines flying commuter aircraft If youre not a fan of turboprop aircraft avoid Piedmont Air operating as US Air Express on DHC planes
The size is not big Passengers can walk around easily Signposts are clear Employees are friendly and helpful The efficiency of the immigration is good It is clean and modern

Excellent security Left my laptops by mistake at security and went to my plane I noticed once in the plane While I couldnt deboard the staff and pilot called security and they were found and brought to lost and found A friend picked them up days later

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

Birgi Airport has recently had a makeover so new there were no arrival or departure boards In many respects it reminded me of Pisa Aeroporto before it got too big On arrival I was nearly the victim of a potential scam Unlicensed taxi drivers gather around the door to the arrivals hall They spot your name on a card being held by a genuine tour company As you come into the arrivals hall they call out your name and when you acknowledge them they claim to be your pre booked taxi Fortunately I noticed my name on a card being held by representatives from the genuine company I had booked with For departing flights eat before you set out for the airport At checkin there is just one very small snack bar and shop Panini and water just over EUR and not a great deal of seating Everything was clean and new but facilities are extremely minimal with only vending machines for refreshments after security Waiting in the gate area the seating is insufficient to cope with the number of passengers I thought it was also very warm but probably not so for your average Sicilian Access to aircraft is by descending several flights of stairs and then crossing the tarmac on foot

Be Aware Arrival at the airport was okay the immigration line was long but it moved pretty quickly The airport was clean and looks pretty new Our main problem with this airport is the departure security check point where you have to apparently place all liquids below the authorised limit in ziplock bags Nowhere in the airport is there a sign saying that all liquids must be in clear plastic bags The check in agent said nothing nothing from the airline and did I say no signs We got to security and were told to throw away our items or pay US per ziplock bag If that didnt feel like an organised racket then I dont know what else qualifies This type of action is dishonest in every respect but at that point we had no choice Weve travelled through London Luton and they have the same plastic bag policy but not only are signs of it everywhere they provide the bags This felt like a shady scheme and we quite honestly will try to avoid this airport in future PS Duty free alcohol was cheaper in out home country as well

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

Johannesburg to Cape Town The SLOW lounge at JNB sets the standard with an impressive array of food even at am and ample seating The bar service is good too and some neighbours had already finished their third refill of pink champagne by the time they boarded the same flight As is common on other BA flights Group passengers were kept waiting on the airbridge before boarding actually commenced Service on board was friendly and efficient but very much old school BA as far as the fourcourse lunch was concerned At least one was able to see the main course before choosing it Departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule and baggage collection was speedy too Overall a decent flight

Arrived on the last evening flight from Barcelona tourist desk very helpful and received our luggage within minutes No taxis available so took the airport bus driver was very helpful and even dropped us a short distance from our hotel

The mid morning flight took off on time from CCU and as I had to go to Bangalore for work my company had booked this flight for me Web checkin and baggage drop were smoothly done Boarding also started on time Landing and disembarkation also happened swiftly along with baggage retrieval which was good IndiGo may not be a glamorous carrier but it gets the job done of taking you from point A to point B efficiently

Stockholm Bromma is a small airport Its very clean and the service was efficient Great proximity to the city centre Landing baggage collection and exit was super easy Taxi driver able to wait right by the carousel so there is no confusion about meeting places

Rigolet Labrador to Goose Bay Labrador on October on an Air Labrador twin Otter Aircraft has been well used over the years but provided a comfortable and quick way back to Goose Bay Bush flying copilot loaded and unloaded the bags seating well wherever there is an empty seat No complaints about the service and would not hesitate to fly with them again

I have a been a frequent traveler of AustinBergstrom Airport AUSKAUS since the airport opened back in I have seen the airport grow and change over the years The changes over the years have been for the better Notable things about AustinBergstrom International AUS there are two terminals the main Barbara Jordan terminal where all the restaurants lounges and stores are and the South Terminal currently Allegiant and Frontier Airlines there is a family viewing area outside the airport for watching planes and having a picnic There are currently lounges AA UA DL and a Chase Sapphire Terrace there are many good places to eat including many local restaurants my favorite are Taco Deli Salt Lick BBQ Second Bar Kitchen Annies and Juiceland it takes about minutes to walk from one end of the terminal to the other along the way you will see lots of places to eat drink and shop Pros clean great dining bars and rest areas The Delta lounge is the nicest lounge in the airport Cons restaurants close early so if you arrive on a lateish flight you will not have food options

Flight from Rome to Turin the plane was old but very clean the hostesses were all very friendly Its better than other low cost airlines because they let you bring both a trolley and a small handbag in the cabin while on other low cost such as Ryanair that isnt allowed

It was my first time to fly with Asiana Airline Service is world class check in counter staff are super friendly Flight crew are very friendly excellent service always there on call you press button and the air hostess is there Always smiling Food was beyond and above the first class standard I flew Sydney to New York via Incheon Seoul all flights had the same standard Desk crew in JFK New York was just as friendly I give Asiana Airline for punctuality on time arrival and departure I give them for flight crew I give them for food quality

A very friendly team of airport workers overall Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

Because LH flights from FDHCGN are now to FRA only and at inconvenient times followed by connections to CGN by train I elected to fly InterSky instead Very clean aircraft and professional service throughout But for an Economy one way ticket price of they could surely provide at least a free cup of coffee Poor value everything else fine

I fly this airport several times per year The name and location sounds like a bigger adventure than it actually is The airport is small so boarding an A is already something that keeps everybody busy However there are not that many flights ground staff are friendly and helpful

Check in at San Andres had to be done at the airport since I had a bag to drop off the line was very long so I waited about minutes Since there are no drinks or snacks available for sale on the plane I bought some stuff at the airport to bring along on the plane Flight back to Bogota was quite smooth quiet and easy I flew back on the same plane that had brought me to San Andres Nothing to complain about Cheap option to San Andres and very efficient

A beautifully decorated small airport located near the city of Lyon France This airport is not too large but it has all international facilities available Very neat and clean Luggage collection was faster However there are very few chair to sit on for waiting Taxis are available

Durban to Cape Town with Comair This is a hour flight which was full The business class seats were the same as economy but with a little extra legroom and the middle seat was empty The FAs were mature and friendly There was a full bar service and light lunch was served The aircraft was clean left on time and arrived on time A relatively smooth flight unlike BA they serve refreshments and full bar service on this short haul domestic flight

Flying Icelandair Saga business class is a real pleasure I got access to the Lounge in Toronto boarding was smooth and the seats though not flat bed comfortable for at five hour flight In flight service started with a glass of sparkling wine This was followed by a bar service and a a three course meal served on a textile table cloth textile napkins proper glases tablewear and silver The cured lamb entree and the braised brisket with mashed potatoes fennel fried cherry tomatoes in red wine sauce were all excellent as well as the chocolate lava mousse and the wines Connecting time in Keflavik was enough though a little bit stressful A rich breakfast was served between Keflavik and Helsinki I very much appreciated the friendly and professional staff It always feels safe to have Icelandic pilots in the cockpit

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

My husband and myself were at Alicante airport returning from a short break I am disabled following a subarachnoid haemorrhage years ago I really needed to feedback on my support from Carmen who reported she has worked many years in the assistance area she was so kind and helpful and made my journey much more settled I cannot thank her enough Regards Kath Robinson

Arrival was easy and bags arrived quickly waived through health control and landside within minutes departing again no issues although the airport was busy with the evening departures there was plenty of security checkpoints open and plenty of staff each employee at the airport I encountered was helpful and friendly once through security there is a excellent Duty Free and several restaurantsbars along with a small selection of shops

Check in at San Andres had to be done at the airport since I had a bag to drop off the line was very long so I waited about minutes Since there are no drinks or snacks available for sale on the plane I bought some stuff at the airport to bring along on the plane Flight back to Bogota was quite smooth quiet and easy I flew back on the same plane that had brought me to San Andres Nothing to complain about Cheap option to San Andres and very efficient

Yangon International Airport has Terminals and for International Flights and for Domestic Flights This is the review for Terminal Domestic This Terminal is a new build and many upgraded from the old terminal The airport is very clean and you can find the checkin counter very easily After checkin the nd floor is for departure and the rd floor is for lounges The departure hall is very large and can buy goods and many restaurants which already open early morning am The gates numbers are easily to find

Everyone working at the ground services at LPB airport gave us excellent service We somehow missed that we could not board Laos Airline flight to Vietnam without proper documents We had read we could get on arrival visas in Vietnam A staff member helped us considerably instructing and helping us get emergency visas I think we might have missed our flight if it was not for her Just wanted to acknowledge her excellent service

The improvements I mentioned in were completed on schedule and have given this airport a new and modern feel Unfortunately the upper level is no longer a viewing deck area However a new restaurant with a view of the airfield was installed on the ground floor Facilities are top class considering the size of the airport A brand new baggage retrieval area was added to the airport The layout of the airport works well Staff are still just as friendly

Apias airport has been upgraded and presents a warm pacific feeling The immigrationcustoms staff should be taught to smile though especially after tourists are sold on the idea of a friendly pacific paradise proudly operated by the friendliest people on earth

Ive been through this airport several times and I must say its incredibly clean and sparkling and definitely puts Gatwick to shame The people of Tunisia are very friendly which adds to the overall positive experience However I have a concern regarding the pricing While all airports tend to charge fees the prices here seem a bit exorbitant I wonder why this is the case Additionally I have a personal issue with the height of the walkway that crosses about meters up I understand this might not be a problem for most but it would be great if the sides of the walkway could be covered for those of us who arent fond of heights Other than these few points its an excellent airport with great service

Always great and good value for money No issues with delayed flights and a smooth journey overall Friendly staff and onboard service even on super short flights eg Bangkok to Trat At Trat airport they also have complimentary snacks and drinks

MADTFN Departed a bit late due to chaotic boarding process But arrived on time due to shorter flight time than usual Except for that issue fligth went well Crew really nice and worked hard Seat ok just economy with a bit recline and comfortable They served a full warm breakfast On board IFE available to use on you personal device nice choice of moviesshows Good service for the Iberia low cost carrier
We took flight from Kathmandu to Delhi The aircraft was Airbus Flight was quite good and on time Food that was given during flight was good and well presented cabin crew was so friendly and humble

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements

One way Jetairfly flight from Antwerp to Berlin Tegel minute delay was only announced at the planned time of departure Nearly new aircraft the largest that is able to fly on Antwerps runway thin seats but ok for short holiday flights Very quiet and clean Friendly professional cabin crew excellent service Prices of onboard food and drinks are for airline service reasonable This airline often has very good deals available even on short notice Very reasonable price but the available fares vary a lot Flight was about full so they dont seem to be doing too bad The airline tries to be something in between a fullservice carrier a charter operator and a lowcost operator

Domestic h flight from Ulaanbaatar to Dalandzadgad in South Mongolia on Hunnu Air in July Checkin and security clearance at the old ULN Chengis Khan Airport reasonably swift Departure and arrival on time Very pleasantly appointed ATR in good state of repair Friendly flight attendants Coffee water snacks All announcements in Mongolian and Russian I guess Cabin crew also speaks no English
Contrary to another review there are good facilities after passport control Including shops Bistro and cafe Very clean and definitely not a shed

Originally booked through Canaryfly Upon arrival at airport we saw that our flight was cancelled We didnt receive any notice but it turned out very smooth as we were already booked on a Binter flight at the original time To us it seemed as this happens frequently and they have a good system in place The flight was enjoyable and the cabin crew did a very good job

We arrived late at night nearly midnight so were exhausted We went through passport control reasonably quickly and the baggage reclaim was also very smooth Very modern airport and due to less passenger traffic very efficient Taxi to railway station was done in under minutes Very clean toilets included which is often a rarity Overall I would have to say I prefer Zhulyany over Borispol which I have been flying through for years due to its better connections to the city Though in London it is not very convenient as Wizz Air fly from Luton

Arrival at this airport was simple with its connection to the Hanover SBahn suburban train system Hanover airport is a convenient size not an overwhelming number of gates but large enough to have plenty of connections Checkin today with Swiss Airlines went smoothly we were asked for our destination visa but not grilled and luggage was processed without difficulty Security checking was slow today probably because of Middle East tensions but security personnel were good humoured and friendly Cafes and shops on the land side closed before pm there are limited shopping possibilities on the air side but one good cafe

Des Moines KDSM is an all round great airport It is a very easy airport to navigate in and it doesnt take long to get through security at all It always seems to be clean and free wifi is always a plus While there seems to be a lack of shopping and food choices there are a few that all seem to be good places of business Terminal seating is in the process of being expanded as it doesnt hold the demand all of the time Its a great airport to depart and arrive to It isnt very big but will get you where you need to go
Overall the airline offered a clean cabin efficient crew almost friendly good seat spacing and ontime service Pretty good for a budget airline

It is clean modern and spacious It is easily accessible by the Leonardo Express from Termini about half an hour Employees are friendly and helpful and can speak English well The WiFi connection is stable Signposts are clear

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

Osaka to Busan Great value budget airline Web site and onboard magazine promise free water but none was offered Checkin at KIX was about minutes checkin at PUS was zero with no other customers in sight Offered decent seats even though we hadnt prebooked them Outward flight was delayed due to air traffic control restrictions at KIX but landed on time due to timetable padding Return flight left early but landed slightly late after circling around western Japan for ages Boarding on both flights smooth Bus to terminal at PUS but sky bridge on return flight Perfectly adequate and reasonably efficient for a budget airline and a onehour flight Would use again

Not recommended if having a long time between connecting flights but otherwise it is good The airport is clean and tidy A good variety of shops to cater for the traveller Food is varied international flavours and of high quality Immigration is slow allowing only person at the counter at a time so therefore families and groups take longer to process Allow more time to be processed through immigration versus other countriesairports and allow longer transit times if connecting to another flight If needing to connect to a domestic flight look out for the transit cart I had a hrs layover between flights and Bali International is not the place to do this There is no air con and no power points I would never transit through Bali again if the layover time is longer Id try flying via Jakarta instead Checkin counters open hrs before departure checkin area is airconditioned but was told there are no seats inside which is roughly right I did have to checkin at area E which was down corridors and stairs and it was a big air conditioned space I saw lots of vacant seats but if was too late to know this after sweltering in the predeparture checkin area where there are cafes
Great little airport all staff friendly and helpful Security checks speedy and done with a smile Could some of the staff be used to show other airports how it is done

I was visiting family in India so this was the airport we went to and it was actually really good there They had lounge chairs at the gates The only problem was the constant beep during a conveyor belt motion and it was really annoying and it spread throughout the airport I really do think this is a great airport overall

Moscow to Bangkok Rossiya fly some of Aeroflots long haul flights with exEtihad Boeing s Their concept is strange They still have an old personal entertainment system but it only gives you a route map Really Instead they have an inflight wifisystem but to be able to use it you need to download Rossiya app before the flight wifi is only for the system its not connected to the WWW They do not have power sockets is economy class and remember your own headphones as well Our flight was on time No complains Food was ok nothing fancy They serve you two free meals with basic drinks no alcohol This will keep your belly full all flight Ive used many airlines and I have no complaints about Rossiya Ticket was cheap plane was comfy and clean flight was on time service was ok basic Russian style and they didnt lose our bags Good value Just remember what i told you about the entertainment system

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

TLLAMS a busy morning flight on the perennially cramped CRJ Compared to my last flight with Estonian a year ago the service much better and Tallinn airport keeps improving and is now probably the nicest small airport in Europe clean free wifi comfy seats and even a library No service whatsoever on Estonian Air which besides being governmentowned is on par with Ryanair for what it offers But as a way to get from Point A to Point B its acceptable

Flew to Dublin yesterday th October after catching train from Preston where I had been working for a few days to Squires Gate which is about a minute walk ADF was a bit of a disappointment but checkin and security a breeze Staff friendly and efficient Depatures lounge was a bit oldfashioned not necessarily a bad thing quite nostalgic really but was very clean and the cafe was good Aer Lingus as always a joy to travel with

Sharjah via Mukhalla to Socotra and back onboard nearly full Yemeni Bombardier CRJ plane Check in at Sharjah was a bit chaotic due to much luggage boarding the plane was guided by the station manager personally in Sharjah as there wasnt any seat allocation They have an inflight magazine During the hour flight to RIY a snack was served Crew very nice on the return flight leaving SCT the captain even explained everything what was visible from the windows The plane was in a good shape at least what was visible clean and tidy

This airport is located in a train station next to it which is pretty cool but can cause major traffic getting in to it The inside is clean and well kept with plenty of restaurants Security is just ok not many lines open so it can take a long time to get through The issue I have like most Chinese airports is that they dont use the jetways much and make you walk out on tarmac and take buses sometimes to and from aircraft In our case it was in the rain which made for an uncomfortable trip Not sure why when jetways were open and they have enough but from what I can tell is that when the plane is not to depart after landing it gets stored over night and if you fly in later at night you will have to take bus so I try to avoid night flights into this airport
Not Verified Courteous and friendly staff Flight left early by about minutes when it was confirmed all planning to fly were on board Crew was great Seating was great

Quick flight with good service and friendly staff Checkin was efficient Aircraft was clean and welcoming Only negative was the arrival at a station where bussing brought us back to the terminal rather than an airbridge

This is my home airport whilst small it has a basic array of services and amenities you would expect from a larger airport The terminal looks pretty fresh and is thoroughly modern There isnt much landside although there are a couple of shops and restaurants for basic needs The security areas move promptly and the transborder security is easy to get through because there arent that many US departures Once youre airside the domesticinternational area is quite good with a decent array of shops and restaurants This is a small airport so youre out of luck if youre hoping for luxury goods but you can find many of the basic items you might need The seating areas are bright with plenty of glass to let in the prairie sunshine There are two lounges including a small but comfortable Maple Leaf Lounge Transborder is a different story While its an improvement over the tiny TB area in the old terminal its still a very small space with only one restaurant TGI Fridays and a Tim Hortons kiosk that only sells coffee donuts and not much else Baggage claim runs efficiently although its not in a secure area which always makes me nervous Customs tends to process people quickly Transportation is easy with a good array of car rentals onsite and very convenient bus transportation downtown The airport is not that far from the city centre so a bus is actually a pretty good option Also there is free WiFi and washrooms are generally clean and well kept if somewhat small There are three airport hotels a short walk outside and at least two of them have restaurants All things considered Winnipeg Airport delivers what you would expect it to

UIOCCS There were no problems to speak of nor was the experience extraordinarily positive First off I should say that I had problems in booking via the Santa Barbara website and so had to visit their agency in Quito I had my bags fairly thoroughly checked by migration people in Quito but thats understandable given the flow of drugs in the region The flight itself was fine Boeing no obvious neglect crew were friendly enough food was decent We did leave about mins late At the Caracas end our bags were slow in arriving It seems that there are problems but you may get lucky and avoid them as I did

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

There is a need for some chairs and a table to sit and reorganise after the security check This is especially important for people with knee other implants requiring putting on the shoes Cannot do this in standing position I kept the bag on the only one table and was putting on the shoes in standing position One security lady officer showed her displeasure and asked me to remove the bag from the table Not very helpful

TNR to SMS via TMM A real delightconvenient timely clean friendly and attractively priced serving routes where you might not generally expect that Its great that theyre introducing some competition to the national carrier and we have nothing but compliments for the staff and the excellent service onboard
Small airport which makes everything easier But going through security was a hassle with lines nothing compared to Beijing though Dont expect much of it given the size Very clean

It is clean modern and spacious It is easily accessible by the Leonardo Express from Termini about half an hour Employees are friendly and helpful and can speak English well The WiFi connection is stable Signposts are clear

Bremen is a small and convenient airport and my experience proved enjoyable Arriving with Air France I disembarked in the main terminal Very short walk to the baggage claim I picked my suitcase within ten minutes Tram line frequently connects the airport with the city centre every min during peak hours min otherwise travel time min A oneway ticket costs however beware that the machines accept neither credit cards nor bank notes greater than Easy departure with no queue at baggage dropin I breezed through security Bremen uses the fullbody scanner which makes the screening process much faster Security staff efficient and friendly Bright departure lounge but there might not be enough seating facilities if all gates are used at the same time Only issue Not enough toilets facilities either landside well hidden at the very end of the building or airside one toilet block only

We booked the flight because it was rather cheap on ctrip hours before departure my wife got a message that my flight from Changsha to Chengdu was cancelled and we should call the airline company Due to Chinese New Year and the Coronavirus it was pretty hard to contact anybody so we decided to take the car to the airport At the airport the ticket desk was unable to change my ticket Sichuan Airlines was unable to change my ticket so we had to call ctrip After nearly hours we got the schedule change and I was able to get an earlier flight Would have wished the airlines had offered me the schedule change by themselves Service on the flight ChangshaChengdu was nonexistent I am not sure if that was due to turbulence or to the virus but it was just a twohours flight and I had brought some food of my own In Chengdu I had to get my luggage and wait for hours to check it in again fortunately there is a good lounge for transit passengers at Chengdu Airport At pm the Sichuan Airlines counters got really busy as there were many flights departing It was really crowded but service was quite quick I was pretty surprised when the flight to Rome got cancelled maybe due to personnel shortage because of the virus My gutfeeling says the flights to Prague and to Rome were pretty empty so they cancelled one flight Passangers to Italy got rebooked to our flight and even that one was not full Seats were a bit narrow and my earphones did not work but I was so tired takeoff at am that I did not need any inflight entertainment Luckily there was no foodservice at the start so passangers were able to sleep The flightattendants handed out bottled water and snacks when I awoke I found snacks and water on the vacant seat next to me Very thoughtful hours before landing they served breakfast It was not a lot we did not even get trays It was Chinese food and I liked it but for Europeans who cannot eat spicy food the choice was not good I am used to spicy food but even I considered the breakfast to be quite spicy No drinks were offered for breakfast Luckily I always try to get a seat near the galley so I could get hot water during the flight for my tea Allinall Sichuan Airlines was quite cheap the aircraft semiclean and inflightentertainment choices were okay If you are not too tall and do not need to many amenities I can recommend this airline Worst flight I ever had to China but still reasonably comfortable

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

Earlier I reviewed here the disastrous departure with AA from MIA and it seems only fair that I should write about the excellent arrival procedures at Santo Domingo airport On the short walk from the plane to the arrival booths there are some people randomly checking Covid documents At the booth you need to show by phone or paper your electronic E ticket and then it is a breeze When I arrived at the booth there were officers on duty and the line was very short The luggage was on the carousel within minutes of landing and an official will check your bag tag with that on your luggage Plenty of taxis but a bit pricey and a great start to arriving in the DR

SJO is a very modern airport immigration is friendly but asks to see all your papers come prepared if you do not hold your tickets carpeted floor free wifi Internet expensive gift shops and food carts taxi fare is high usd for a minutes drive before checking in you must pay departure tax it now costs usd you can pay with credit card overall good experience I will be back in the summer

Brussels to Stockholm and return They land at Bromma very close to the city small and friendly airport Checkin staff and cabin crew were friendly and helpful Plane was a BA with in one row instead of Look a little old inside Nevertheless good value for your money Cheap fares and drinks and snacks at good prices available on board We will fly them again when we go back to Sweden
I agree with the previous reviewers comments This is a great little airport An added bonus is that there is now a direct train link to Jerez centre as well as Cadiz and the surrounding cities

A small easily accessible airport with good seating no long walks to gates and helpful staff There is the usual choice of shops and a caf serving a variety of snacks including regional specialities The airport is clean and well signed

Seat Comfort was excellent Legroom was excellent The hard product is very good The soft product is abysmal and food is unacceptable Communication is poor The staff is truly detached from their customers Not just the flight attendants but the gate agents and counter personnel It seems like they dont want to be at their job jobs So detached that when we landed in Madrid the purser welcomed us to Paris France I almost always fly British Airways This time a segment was on American Never again

PSC airport is currently undergoing remodeling and expansion which are due for completion in early With what is completed thus far the layout is a significant improvement from the old outdated one The look and feel of the airport is definitely more modern in keeping with the times Being a relatively small airport going through TSA is fairly quick At this time the restaurant options are not great but I expect them to improve upon completion I hope the airport is able to lure more flights and more airlines in the future Compared to the two relatively nearby airports YKM and ALW this is the nicest and largest of the three

This is a small but tidy and well run airport that I suspect will increase in demand in near future Everything is laid out well there are modest food and drink facilities clean toilets and small offices for several car hire firms Hertz Europcar Sol etc An excellent starting point for exploring northern Spain Currently Ryanair flies there twice a day from Stansted and I believe Liverpool Good overall

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre
Mahon is clean light and airy with reasonable shopping facilities and bars the seating area is particularly good with a view of the airfield and runway and plenty of space
Everything was very good We used the lounge in the airport The services were great

Chisinau airport is the only international airport of Moldova and sometimes seems to be out of proportion with the growing traffic But anyway despite its small size after the latest restructuration it became a very efficient and easy to fly from The ground staff are very productive and manages the traffic with a great dexterity The number of shops and food choices remains low but its not really an airport of transit The main flaw of Chisinau airport is access to and from the airport without real shuttle service provided There is a minibus marshrutka route to the railway station but it doesnt service all night long and you often need to require a taxi very cheap Airport is very clean and staff is very professional

Isnt it fascinating that you can buy any spirit in a one liter bottle but water only in l bottles I asked and the not so friendly stuff assured that the whole airport just sells little bottles at the gates that is after security check Oh and when I asked why she cleverly replied just because I have never seen an airport that poor with food and beverages Dont come hungry or thirsty

Beijing to Pyongyang The Tupolev aircraft is as comfortable as many that are flying around the US The checkin experience was quick at Beijing and Pyongyang The crew were friendly and smiling during the flight The burger was quite tasty and I got a beer with it Baggage quickly delivered at both ends

Ankara airport is lovely clean and a pleasure to be in It feels very new and modern and has a lot of glass to let natural light in Security is very fast and efficient and connecting to and from the city is fairly easy with a shuttle bus that costs TL Unfortunately like all Turkish airports to get free wifi you need a code sent to your mobile so if youre traveling and dont have a sim card that works then youre out of luck Otherwise its not a problem

BMAMMX one way The flight was comfortable with professional and friendly staff The free food and drinks served onboard were top quality The central location of Stockholm Bromma was very advantageous for our city break but checkin and boarding was a hassle Checkin closes minutes before departure which means that half the passengers were cramming at the check in desks in the last minute Free seating onboard the plane resulted in more cramming after the security because everyone wants a good seat It was a real circus In my opinion min checkin deadline instead of min and allocated seats instead of free seats would have been optimal

Ms Terri V who was the boarding agent for my flight provided phenomenal customer service when it was needed most When I realized that my lay over time from my connecting flight to my final destination was tight she was able to move me up four rows with no extra charge She was friendly patient and wanted to do what was right for the customer given my situation when many others may have not cared as much She is someone other boarding and TSA agents should emulate not just here in San Antonio but around other airports as well

Ljubljana airport is very practical for passengers and all procedures are carried out quickly There are not many flights and passengers in the morning so the experience is even better The employees are professionally friendly but not much more very very few smiles In the dutyfree shop some Croatian products are offered as Slovenian ones which is probably an unintentional mistake The coffee at the bar is excellent The toilet which was otherwise clean smelled of nitrogen compounds probably due to insufficient or absent ventilation In the waiting room in front of the bridges to the plane at least some of the otherwise comfortable seats were torn It was also possible to see through the windows into neglected closed and abandoned rooms which they probably do not know what to do with The airport is a very important point of entry to my beloved country so even some seemingly trivial carelessness is out of place

Cute little airport everything functions as it should No big lines its nice and clean and organized It was very easy getting into a shuttle after landing and getting to the hotel a great price too Im always a fan of getting to a new place and not having a chaotic mess of people trying to rip you off on transportation that was definitely not the case in Ko Samui

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

Small super convenient airport Its small but efficient Has one food counter with the really good food Better than most airports Have to walk out on tarmac to plane Arrival and exiting are quick and easy Wait about minutes to minutes for bag and out the front door in steps Outside attendant are great The give directions and keep pick up lines organized enough Gets a for Convenience

Domestic arrival was good canteen facilities are reasonably priced Toilet was clean in arrival hall International departure money exchange facilities available The security check was not particularly friendly boarding was smooth via gate with Virgin Australia using an air bridge

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place
Great regional airport Min check in time for Lufthansa flights is mins Good connections via MUC to international destinations Reasonable amenities at the airport

I would like to express my gratitude to the airport staff for caring about my comfort and positive impressions of the company I would like to express special gratitude to the employee Annette for helping me resolve the issue with my luggage The flight was comfortable and in a safe atmosphere for me

We flew from Sydney to Zhengzhou and vice versa on Tianjin Airlines recently overall it was a great trip ground staff were very friendly they even reserved a couple extra seats for us so that my two young kids could have a decent sleep on the way home cabin staff were also very friendly they were very helpful throughout the flight Legs rooms great food service was decent as well The only minor issue is their entertainment system was very old there were just a handful movies to select from also their D map system was not functioning for both sectors which meant you couldnt tell where you were currently other than that it was really a great flying experience

Considering the standard for Brazilian Airports the Capitals is very modern Good options for shopping and eating and even some cinema theaters As it is one of the hubs of the country the traffic in intense most of the time There is a lack of good transportation options for the city There is no subway station the buses are rare and uncomfortable and the taxis are quite expensive

A very friendly team of staff overall at Memphis Airport Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

After much fanfare and glowing reviews surrounding this relatively new transpacific airline operating out of Taipei I decided that I had to give it a try to see if it lived up to its hype The booking experience was straightforward and smooth when online check in opened I managed to select a seat at no extra cost and successfully managed to download the mobile boarding pass into my digital wallet So we were off to a good start The Aneo is a great choice for regional and short to midhaul flights its configuration in economy making the cabin intimate and cosy with fewer passengers stuck in window seats Another good start was when boarding proceeded smoothly and we took off on time Legroom was comfortable without being too generous with Google putting it at cm the longhaul industry average but nothing spectacular The cabin appeared to be spanking clean and in tiptop condition with its comforting shade of brown appeasing to the eyes Both USBA and USBC charging ports were offered and the seat even included a pillow for this short hop cross the Taiwan Strait Unfortunately dining options seemed to have fallen short with the food rather bland and not as appetising A small packet of juice was offered but no choices were given and neither was plain drinking water Another pet peeve is that in this day and age somehow Starlux does not have their IFE system connected to their PA system hence the IFE system was not allowed to be used during takeoff and landing Its the first time Ive experienced something like this on an aircraft that has an IFE system which by the way was pretty comprehensive The crew were all very professional and courteous and consistently checked on passengers during the short flight As a bonus we landed minutes ahead of schedule thanks to the speedy boarding and takeoff process All in all still a very attractive option in this competitive market though it falls short in an few areas and certainly has room for improvement

An airport is usually a necessary evil This one is different it makes you feel good It is a facility owned by Bangkok Airways and is a small efficient and charming outfit Tofrom the plane you are transported by small open electric buses to the arrivaldeparture hall These are roofed but in the open air surrounded by a neat park On arrival luggage arrived in minutes and delivered to the small arrival hall Checkin and security took minutes without any shortcut but with customer attention and care The pasture hall has no shopping Great but serves some complimentary snacks Restrooms as indeed the entire facility was spotlessly clean A true feelgood facility Other Bangkok Airways facilities in Thailand follow the same attractive concept

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

Overall a great airport with great facilities and ample outlets to eatdrinkshop The only issue about this airport is the queues at immigration and security which is serious For instance immigration at arrival took minutes although there were only people in front of me and this was because only windows were open for processing

Orlando to Jackson I am a frequent traveler and have flown my entire life My mother is a Delta flight attendant of years and when I was young she would take me on her flights I had flown over times before the age of Given this background I am very particular when it comes to my air travel Going into flying with Via I had my reservations as I normally stick to the main carriers but their service and in flight experience greatly exceeded both me and my fiancs expectations Would gladly fly with Via Air again and look forward to the next chance I get to fly with them

Free WiFi cleanliness and planning are good Queue for security and immigration took around minutes Should deploy more staff for this purposes Restaurants after check in are less and with no good choice

Older Dash but comfortable and good leg room but very noisy Departed on time friendly sole flight attendant juice and water on offer and great views of the Atolls they were organised friendly and have pride in their brand and country cant ask for more than that A bit pricey but no competition I guess

The airport is mid being rebuilt arrivals still in progress but departures all complete Departures was very quick no checkin or security queue it was a Tuesday but our plane was fairly full Great clean toilets friendly staff the only major fail is despite it all being brand new there is nowhere near enough seats expect to be sitting on the floors also not much food on offer if you cannot eat wheatbased food groups
