One of the smaller airports by Chinese standards but a very positive experience for the passenger Good signage short distances to walk from plane to baggage carousel and a mere minute wait for luggage to be on the belt Good public transport to greater Qingdao region including resorts area by the sea Beware of taxi touts go to the official taxi line where you get a taxi from a dispatcher who registers the ride and also hands out a complaint info card just in case When departing from Qingadao dont come to the airport too early Checkin also for international flights is min before scheduled takeoff and there is not much to do in this airport Just some shops and two socalled coffee shops with a limited choice of snacks Found out too late about a VIPlounge which is hidden in a corner to the far right of the international departure lounge Access charge is yuan but had no time to use it Friendly airport staff quick security check plenty seating at gates one restaurant one coffee shop and one airline lounge airside duty free and souvenirs Facilities clean and well maintained All in all a very positive impression

A very small but easy to navigate airport It is small to the extent it could kind of be a bus station I arrived in Mexico through SLP but did not depart from this point thus my experience is based on arrivals only However I could see almost the entire airport anyway Upon arrival I was greeted with very friendly immigration officials I left my information documents that I was given to fill out enroute on the plane I didnt realise until I got the counter and went to hand them over The friendly official was extremely helpful and gave me replacements and helped me fill it in as I looked tired My bags arrived very quickly through the small carrousel and I was able to pick them up and move to a customs check point At this point you are randomly picked for checks I was picked however I was dealt with by another very friendly and helpful official who made me feel very welcome to Mexico Finally I took a taxi to my hotel Once out of the control area there is an area with information and helpers on hand to get you a well priced taxi or bus into town Overall a great little airport that punches well above its weight that could serve to much larger airports as an example of good customer service

We were on a chartered flight taking a group of very special kids to Lourdes in France Team were so friendly and welcoming Lovely comfy accommodation clean and spacious Lovely touch was a special package snack for our VIPs Thank you Titan

The Embraer continues to be a gamechanger for the American Airlines Group especially on shorthaul routes like the minute flight from Washington Reagan National DCA to Philadelphia PHL Despite the brief duration and some turbulence the crew efficiently completed firstclass service while maintaining a friendly and professional demeanor The firstclass seat provided more than enough comfort for the journey reinforcing the Es reputation as an excellent aircraft for regional operations Given Republic Airways strong performance American Airlines should seriously consider adding Republic to its wholly owned subsidiaries

Pasco Kennewick in Washington State is a small efficient airport currently under rebuild On arrival my bags were delivered quickly and it was a short but slightly circuitous route to landslide longer because of rebuilding work On departure checkin was quick TSA was both quick and helpful and the gate area reasonably spacious There is a cafe in the gate area and the walk to the plane is very short The one downside of the gate area is that there is loud musak playing over the tannoy presumably to entertain us at the same time as the gate announcements hence you have no idea what the gate announcement is saying Car parking is free for the first minutes The free wifi was too slow for use there is a premium version for a fee

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future

Upon arrival in Chiang Mai we had to take the bus to the terminal which thankfully was a quick trip Customs was fast and the baggage claim was easy Even as a small airport there were friendly and helpful employees It was easy to get around especially finding taxis I would prefer Chiang Mai over Bangkok airport and I will continue to go to this airport

Gatwick to Joburg troubles just beginning to brew in Libya The start seemed off putting when I noticed an extra three hours on the flight time from Tripoli to Joburg which the booking office could not explain also when I was not on the reservations list at checkin However the latter was sorted without hassle Service on flight to Tripoli was fine plane new and clean food good However we landed in a sandstorm which was worrying Fortunately we were herded along to the departures lounge as all signs in Arabic Onward flight delayed by a couple of hours due to sandstorm Toilets at the airport were inadequate in number but reasonably clean We were then taken on what felt like a mystery tour on an airport bus down a dirt road turned out to be to the other end of the runway where our plane sat all on its own amidst military aircraft The three hour extra time was now clear as it was a much smaller plane than expected a few passengers had seats allocated on row numbers which were not on the smaller plane however there was enough room and extra for everyone boarding Once again food and service fine There was a refuelling stop at Kinshasa During my week in S Africa the revolution in Libya took off I expected to lose my money and have to rebook myself back on an alternative carrier However when I contacted Afriqiyah in Joburg they said I was rebooked on Egyptair travelling back same night as my original booking They sent me email confirmation and my trip home went smoothly The Afriqiyah staff were helpful and efficient in spite of what was obviously a stressful time for them On the basis of value for money Afriqiyah is excellent but be prepared for a journey with a difference

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

The airport is well laid out the gates are simply marked and the staff are extremely helpful There is an information desk to the left of the entrance which will direct you where you need to go Considering this was my first flight and after having a head injury they allowed my parents to go through security with me to guide me through the process Security was slower than I have come to realize is usual and very confusing however once on the other side there were many shopping options and also a great deal of eating options There was suitable seating and the boards with times of departures were readily available The bathrooms were a little messy however

A very shortened Flight due to favourable Tail Winds saw us arrive minutes early into Bangkok excellent My goal was just to sleep on this overnight flight That goal was achieved and a comfortable hours sleep was enjoyed The actual Seat was looking shabby old No Food or Drink were taken so I can not comment on the service Would fly Gulf Air again if going to the UK

On time departure and arrival for all flights Flights were relatively smooth Aircraft clean with friendly flight crew providing the usual no frills service IFE worked flawlessly with a good selection of movies DALHOU CUNBNA and BNADAL were on B aircraft This type of aircraft has no power ports to charge personal devices Further there are no trays in the armrest in row HOUCUN was BMAX This is a gorgeous aircraft with large overhead bins and mood lighting

Vintage airport that has been updated and serves lots of people on domestic flights The energy level is high and the view of the runways and operating area is excellent Fun place to arrive or depart with plenty to see and no end to the peoplewatching opportunities Pretty efficient as well

Arrived here for the safari and climb up Mt Kilimanjaro Arrived around hrs you walk into a big room with two areas I have a visa and I do not have a visa So we got in the no visa line Well actually it wasnt so much a line as a big confluence of people and soon we found out why there are multiple windows you need to go to before passing through customs to collect your baggage I had read a blog about the visa scenario at JRO before I left so I had an idea of what to expect but upon returning home I reread the blog and realized that I didnt retain all of what was stated It was all there but like most things in life experience trumps book knowledge You need to get in the far right line first to pay for the visa for USA for non USA Bring large bills preferably new I had been told this prior to the trip so I came prepared with new bills circa or maybe it was Bottom line they werent from before which is the cut off year for American bills accepted in Tanzania After you pay you go to the nd line and get your photo taken and the visa is placed in your passport Get through with that and you realize you still cannot see your baggage you need to go to the rd line for fingerprinting By this time all of the I have a visa people were gone so there were more lines available for this last step All in all it took us minutes from the time we entered the room to the time we saw our baggage Yes its a long time but if you purchase your visa before travelling you only save maybe minutes and you need to consider the fact that you have to mail in your passport for an extended period to receive that visa Add to that you need to purchase the passport photos for the visa for us its worth it to spend the extra time in the airport and never allow your passport to be sent in the mail You save money on the photos because they take your picture at JRO The return leg went very smoothly you get in line they run all of your bags and you through security then you turn in your checked baggage and go through security again with your carry on took about an hour and we were at our gate no worries
The plane was modern and the cabin very clean and appealing The crew was very friendly and professional Fast check in and at Belgrade Airport the suitcases arrived very fast
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

Small airport with helpful staff In the arrivals hall there is nothing special On departure you can enjoy your time on the st floor snacks bar with some good choices The view to the apron is good from the departure hall The only negative side is that the air conditioning system is not good at all

Modern airport departure and arrival were quick efficient and smooth This not a big nor busy airport so there is never any big queues Immigration police cordial and friendly Almost feels like there is too much airport staff for volume of passengers particularly when departing staff in the multiple cafs looked bored I appreciated the clean toilets and multiple drinking water fountains where you could fill up water for free Duty Free felt was the biggest letdown very generic and poor Not much local Dhofari or even Omani products I think it could be better used to sell the country and region one final time before visitors leave instead of overpriced cheap souvenir tat or the usual generic Toblerone you can find at any airport in the world Even local products like the luxury Amouage perfumes were at the usual price with no deals which was a shame

Cochin International Airport is a beautiful environment friendly and comfortable airport From the infrastructure to the furniture the process the staff everything about this airport exudes comfort and positive vibes The airport is powered by solar panels wooden interiors and well functioning toilet fittings and fixtures make this airport an environment friendly one

A very good experience arriving and departing The airport is modern clean and efficient No delays or problems arriving Queuing at immigration did not take too long and bags had already arrived after that Departure is also very good No immigration formalities for departure so you get into the departure lounge quite quickly I used the business lounge which was very comfortable with good wireless internet and a reasonable food selection

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

Berlin to Hurghada It was the first time I am flown with Germania It was a good choice after Air Berlin terminated service on this route They offer free baggage kg a complimentary hot meal and three legs of complimentary non alcoholic hot or cold drinks on this hrs trip If the flight is booked more you have the possibility to upgrade to an extra legroom seat containing up to inch more legroom head phones and one beerwhine Flight attendants were very friendly and caring all the flight One documentary and one movie were shown on overhead screens But if you are not interested in their IFE bring your own device CheckIn was a bit confusing because they tell that your seat is advised automatically which I believe is not the truth There were many free seats Therfore this was not a problem but would be if this flight have been more crowded All in all a very good price service ratio
I have went with Novair four times OSLLPA x OSLTFS OSLFUE Great service good looking planes comfortable seats No delays new clean A The only less good thing the food

UIOCCS There were no problems to speak of nor was the experience extraordinarily positive First off I should say that I had problems in booking via the Santa Barbara website and so had to visit their agency in Quito I had my bags fairly thoroughly checked by migration people in Quito but thats understandable given the flow of drugs in the region The flight itself was fine Boeing no obvious neglect crew were friendly enough food was decent We did leave about mins late At the Caracas end our bags were slow in arriving It seems that there are problems but you may get lucky and avoid them as I did

A moderate sized airport with fast security processing times decent dutyfree shopping and enough seats with a power socket Signaling isnt the clearest however as the airport was build in steps Half of the gates are bus boarding only It has a convenient metro connection to the city center Wifi was quite good and staff friendly and helpful

Flew the short minute flight from Yangon to Thandwe Ngapali Beach in January One class cabin with economy seats in a setup Despite the short flight service was excellent with a breakfast snack mainly pastries and teacoffee served as well as lollies on descent Having flown Air China the day before on two flights of hours Mann Yadanarpon Airlines were in a different league Smooth flight good views though given the still developing infrastructure in the country flights were expensive

We had airport assistance for my elderly mother and the chap who met us at the plane Giorgious was excellent He spoke very good English and was super courteous and respectful and helpful throughout our transit He took us through immigration and then onto our lounge for a flight to London with Aegean Airlines He knew us by name within an instant and always explained what was happening next He should be celebrated The staff at the boarding gates were also very courteous and respectful as well I cant speak highly enough of everyone we dealt with at Athens Airport Even the ladies serving at the cafe considering how busy it was was excellent friendly and on point Its always a pleasure when you meet good people doing good things Well done Athens airport

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

A very smooth experience for a sunday morning flight Security was quick and efficient taking under minutes to pass through The departure lounge had a good range of shops and places to eat while waiting for the flight The gate was just a few minutes walk from the main departure lounge area and boarding was very efficient With good local transport links and parking options the airport does all one needs from a regional airport and is a lot easier than travelling to a London airport

Its always a pleasure going through this airport It is clean spacious and easy to navigate Immigration and customs are always fast and efficient There are a good number of dutyfree shops although not as many food outlets
Not Verified Courteous and friendly staff Flight left early by about minutes when it was confirmed all planning to fly were on board Crew was great Seating was great
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the flight departed on time The staff were friendly and efficient The seat was comfortable too Only tea coffee and water is available free of charge which is no big deal given its such a short flight

Found arrival experience excellent Check in on departure was good and quick Security was good and quick However toilets before security were not good no lock or even handle on gents toilet door Cafe was ok but no toilet After security there where vending machines but if you had no euros you couldnt get anything aircon lacking
Departed on october to Paris Orly abd back on October Airport very clean opened early in the morning Check In and Security Checks are easy early in the morning

Excellent airport and decent size it is not as huge as other asian mega hubs but it means getting in the out of the airport is very quick From touching town to the taxi it took mins maximum Signposts are very clear and there are so many staff to help you all very friendly The airport is dated and is due for a refurb yet it is spotless Departure experience was also great Check in was easy immigration and security very fast and smooth despite not having priority lane for business class custmers There are some interesting shop aside the global boutique and plenty of seats to rest There are even free lounge area which is like a living room Airlines lounges in TPE arent good quality with the exception of Cathay Pacific but there are a lot of FB offers especially in Terminal

Saint Marie to Antananarivo What an absolute pleasure flying with this new airline Madagasikara Airways Finally competition to Air Madagascar with prices half the price of the national airline reliable ontime departure convenient schedules and complimentary drink and snacks onboard with an extremely friendly cabin attendant who made announcements in languages Planes are serviced in South Africa Sad to see that despite all this the plane was only half full hopefully more will hear of it as it really deserves to succeed

Dhaka to Coxs Baza Booked a discounted ticket more than a month ago Didnt expect too much Just on time departure arrival Thats what I got Boarding luggage handling was smooth Cabin crew wasnt exactly cordial but professional enough It was a min ride but the captain was able to make it bumpy despite clear weather Cheese sandwich cake was good enough for a shorts haul flight like this but as expected no IFE Aircraft was manufactured in so common for local Bangladeshi carriers But the seats were good pitch even for a Dutch national who flew alongside me was well over Hope for a similar experience with Regent next time

Great space Felt secure and secluded as a solo traveller Staff were great in a full cabin they were onto everything The wifi was dreadful though Food plentiful and tasty An hour and a half late leaving but with snow in UK thats hardly surprising

I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to the staff of Lost Found at the Venice airport At arrival at Venice Marco Polo airport my suitcase was lost The staff there was very helpful throughout the process in my application and delivery of my suitcase to my home address The luggage was delivered within hours So I was delighted with the service and want to give credit to staff and delivery Thank you

Munich to Kabul Privilege Style is flying this year old Boeing on behalf of other customers as a charter airline The flight was okay seats are comfortable enough and i felt safe throughout the journey

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

Being first time flyers with Rex we were delighted with the personal service at airports and in the air Assisted with booking in luggage and seating details Being tall enough leg room to be comfortable We would choose to fly rex whenever possible

Great little airport incredibly close in to the city centre minutes by metro from the Domestic Terminal to the central station and the international terminal is spacious with comfortable seating by the gates and good value shopping The only downside is the tedious minute bus transfer to get there from the Domestic Terminal

A very smooth experience for a sunday morning flight Security was quick and efficient taking under minutes to pass through The departure lounge had a good range of shops and places to eat while waiting for the flight The gate was just a few minutes walk from the main departure lounge area and boarding was very efficient With good local transport links and parking options the airport does all one needs from a regional airport and is a lot easier than travelling to a London airport

Having read reviews here I expected a nightmare but everything went very smoothly Terminal A seems to be new and very efficiently organised Staff friendly and helpful and lines short It was a quiet period so it might be different at Thanksgiving and other busy times

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

Attractive food comfortable seating In particular the flight attendants are professional and dedicated to helping passengers Head flight attendant Ms Hang and Ms Chi are very enthusiastic and very considerate in assisting passengers The flight crew is friendly and professional xut n hp dn ch ngi tin nghi c bit t tip vin chuyn nghip v rt tn tnh n cn h tr gip hnh khch trong sut chuyn bay tip vin trng c Hng c Chi nhit tnh lm v rt n cn h tr cc hnh khch t bay thn thin v chuyn nghip

General Mitchell is a breath of a fresh air Its clean friendly and efficient Theres actually a classy little used book store and a museum full of model planes and blimps and whatnot If you get lost it is your fault my friend The whole place is like one of the models in the museum accurate well labeled and miniature Everything is right in front of you Theres an Amtrak station a block away minutes and to get to Union Station in Chicago is hard to beat This airport is tiny but its the easiest one Ive ever dealt with
I think it is a great airport compared to most Chinese airports Today Hangzhou Airport is quite different from what it used to be Its very large and modern and has good service

The seats in the Terminal waiting areas are very comfortable The security process looked ominous at first but I was constantly moving and when it came time for the scan I did not have to take off my belt or shoes and got through the security process comfortably I wish Portland Airport was like that

Uneventful flight with on time departure and arrival Usual Southwest nofrill service Clean aircraft and friendly flight crew In Flight Entertainment was easy to log on and watch live TV NFL football Unusual for this particular aircraft the overhead cabins were not as large as other aircraft

Klagenfurt is very small and the staff there might not be as busy as their colleagues from other airports Likewise the ground handling is very fast and efficient Moreover the personnel are overwhelmingly friendly and helpful Unfortunately there is no airport lounge and the only small caf is before the security check The seats in the waiting area are not the most comfortable ones as well Travelling to and from KLU by car or bus is just fine however if you want to go by train it might turn out as a nightmare The closest train station is only a stop for commuter trains SBahn and is located more than one mile away from the terminal

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

Flew to Dublin yesterday th October after catching train from Preston where I had been working for a few days to Squires Gate which is about a minute walk ADF was a bit of a disappointment but checkin and security a breeze Staff friendly and efficient Depatures lounge was a bit oldfashioned not necessarily a bad thing quite nostalgic really but was very clean and the cafe was good Aer Lingus as always a joy to travel with

Flew in and out of Rio Galeao airport in October Terminal was quite clean and quiet and quite a lot of shops but not too many which is neat The walking was a lot though and there were no conveyor belts to speed from the security to my gate all the way at the other end of the airport This is one of two points that could be improved The other one is is that some employes doing reaserch and statistics about client satisfaction were walking aroud the gates to get info No problem there But there are far too many I got interupted almost every minutes and I think that the airport cancould relax on that An otherwise great airport

This was the most amusing flight I have ever flown as I got to share some laughs with not only fellow passengers but with a hostess Anyway I was seated in row row was an exit row so I was invited to sit there since it was empty and was willingable to assist in case of an emergency Te leg room is excellent and I measure cm The staff were professional and courteous Bags came out quickly We were given water upon boarding then a chocolate bar then a croissant filled with chocolate sauce worth the calories and finally a small drink

A quick visit to Rome from Prague on Ryanair The airport location close to the city is great with a painless connection via Airport Link Bus Train The entire trip easily purchased on the Trenitalia app for only to Termini The airport terminal itself is large enough to accommodate flights at the same time could be stretched to capacity with more traffic Boarding and disembarking on foot with some shops available Staff was curtuous so our departure was on time The proximity to Rome is a strong selling point when comparing to FCO

Osaka to Vladivostok Second time to fly S very good experience from checkin to boarding timeprocedure and flight itself Checkin was smooth boarding was quick and efficient The aircraft was new the legroom was decent and the snack offered inflight surprisingly good Total flight time was about h we landed minutes earlier than scheduled Overall high marks for S

I flew with my husband from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo to see the pyramids and Egyptian Museum with a return flight to Sharm three days later The flight took off on time the cabin crew were friendly and the seats were comfortable Unfortunately my husband was taken ill in Cairo and I decided we needed to return to the UK I cancelled our return flight on the morning we were due to fly back to Sharm The money was in my bank two days later I would fly Air Cairo again

You might use Moscow Vnukovo when flying to cities within the CIS on regional airlines or catching a charter flight to Turkey Egypt etc The airport is located southwest of the city it takes about minutes and Roubles tofrom Yugo Zapadnaya metro station by minibus in normal traffic taxi drivers ask the usual extortionate rates as in Sheremetyevo The building is very small and displays a bizarre mixture of typical drab Soviet facilities and shiny renovated areas that you could almost call Scandinavian Arriving at about am on a redeye flight I was greeted by a pack of stray dogs roaming the street outside the terminal but then I was able to wait for the first bus into town while having an excellent cappuccino in the new cafe inside the arrival area with plenty of seats and cheerful service from the very friendly staff Immigration is the same as everywhere else in Russia even though this was the only place where I was asked to produce a copy of my invitation and health insurance On an afternoon visit the departure sector which is located on the same level as the arrivals was almost deserted Services on offer are scarce one exchange office with ridiculously short opening times one Atm one cafe a couple of windows selling airline tickets and providing general information in Russian exclusively Everywhere around the airport there are obvious signs of big renovation works going on Im really curious to see what comes out of it in the future All in all one of the most relaxed ways tofrom Moscow and Russia

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him

First time the flight left on time and even earlier for the first time in years I thought we were going to be landing way in advance Unfortunately we were then in a holding pattern in Bangkok for mins You win some you loose some It was a ten year old Boeing The first meal service was lovely the breakfast was poor I didnt eat that The recline on my seat was broke which isnt a deal breaker for me anyway Crew were great I still think they can improve but the convenience is the key with a direct flight

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh

Loved it Takes no more than minutes from entering to get to the gate When you depart minutes It was like heaven compared to Toronto where there are long lines lots of computers and where it takes so long to get to the gate and where you dread the lineups getting off the plane for the same reason It is convenient it is quick clean and has a Tim Hortons
Great airport Easy to park easy to get to terminal and fast security Beats almost every other larger airport I have been to Not much to do but you wont be there long anyway

Small regional airport With just two terminals it is pretty painless to navigate Lines at the security checkpoint move fast I was told that a contractor operates the checkpoints In my experience staff was friendly and two or more lanes were open Some restrooms in the secure area were closed off due to renovations in progress Concessions were limited but there is a McDonalds a Subway a news store and a coffee outfit Because its a regional airport many code share flights are operated by smaller airlines flying commuter aircraft If youre not a fan of turboprop aircraft avoid Piedmont Air operating as US Air Express on DHC planes
TFNGMZ return on ATR Very good minute flights Served cup of water and chocolate bar Great views of a snow capped Mt Teide on left going and right returning

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

Not that much leg room If you are over cm tall you will be bashing your kneecaps but otherwise the seat is pretty comfortable The services from the cabin crew were friendly and efficient Due to Covid restrictions no snack was served on this flight There is no screen in the seats so you must supply your own inflight entertainment Would definitely use the airline again as their routes are handy and they were punctual

This airport has improved phenomenally in the last years Apparently some operations have been outsourced to a private company and gone are many of the inefficiencies we used to run into earlier Immigration plus custom is now a breeze and the officials are actually customer friendly Food services have come a long way The guys who used to scan baggage before check in are gone so the check in process is much faster More helpful signs posted Bathrooms much better but need to improve further Scan of carry on baggage post immigration gets a bit painful at peak hours but not any more than at Dubai or Abu Dhabi Since the traffic through this airport is modest its peak hours late evening early morning do not cause shortage of seats Parking is a different problem you might waste a long time trying to find a spot during peak Ambience is great helped by sound architecture bright lighting vast open spaces

My brother and I and Flew for the first time everyone was very helpful they even put us in the sky lounge which consists of a buffet and drinks They did no extra charge and they helped out through the whole time without necessarily babying us Thank you for the experience

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is

We flew to Cairo from our Sharm elSheikh resort as many others did in order to tour the capital city of Egypt The aircraft was very comfortable and seemed quite new They offer great catering for the one hour flight Couldnt fault it

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date

WestJet from Calgary to London Heathrow was excellent The flight attendant introduced herself by name and provided a warm welcome Remembered customers names as well A very decent sparkling wine and hot towels were served before take off Menu choices were good and dinner was quite tasty Breakfast options were far better than on other carriers There was a good choice of wines poured generously IFE system was pretty standard Seats comfortable Overall the quality of the premium economy product on WestJet is far superior to Air Canadas and better than British Airways

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal
Lisbon to Salvador Bahia Flight plastic free The first one I have travelled with And they had Ipads to comfortable watch what we preferred The distance between the chairs was large

The more I travel the more I appreciate Port Moresbys Jacksons International Airport Whilst the speed at checkin is dependent on the systems sometimes it takes longer but usually its quite fast its always a breeze moving through this terminal from checkin to security to immigration and into the departure lounge The lounge itself has great seating with good food options and drink options as well as shopping POM isnt Changi but then again Changi is matchless
Comfortable enough flight which was fairly on time We were surprised that there was no catering on this flight of about hours Only took hand baggage

Ive flown through this airport or times now and its always a good experience Its a lovely modern building the staff are very helpful securitycustomsimmigration has always been quick and painless It only takes mins by train they have a decent airport hotel located in the domestic arrivals terminal and its always spotless

A very easy airport to use Arriving on an evening Ryanair flight deplaning was quick passport control almost friendly and the airport bus was immediately outside to speed us to town for only Return was just as easy the security staff were friendly plenty of seating in both the main airport and the gate area No WIFI but one rarely gets everything

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers

Rio de Janiero to Curitiba via Sao Paulo Really good experience really smooth inflight entertainment and free food and drink the cabin crew were really friendly This really beats European customer service the leg room is still the same but just the service outweighs it for me

Munich to Kabul Privilege Style is flying this year old Boeing on behalf of other customers as a charter airline The flight was okay seats are comfortable enough and i felt safe throughout the journey

The new Terminal C is a significant improvement over the old Delta terminal This is a spacious terminal with plenty of light from the floor to ceiling windows giving views of the airport runwaysaprons and CitiField and Arthur Ashe Stadium The walk from gate to gate was rather long Restrooms are plentiful and clean however in some locations they could use more stalls given the number of passengers who traverse this terminal Dining options are placed conveniently I had a delicious lunch at one of the restaurants The airport WiFi is very fast and worked flawlessly

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

Air North describes its class of service as Yukoner Economy which I thought probably referred to a concept of warmhearted hospitality and generosity This held true for my first flight in their but after flying in the HS Im wondering if the term is actually more about resilience in the face of harsh conditions Cramped conditions in the HS aside the service overall was pretty good staff were almost all friendly and efficient flights ran on schedule and reasonable food was provided No inflight entertainment system but at the time I flew the stunning everchanging landscape below was all the entertainment I could want

An excellent short flight with great onboard service from a friendly attentive cabin crew Leg room was ok and the seats were comfortable enough for a short flight Overall a good experience and good value

Pros Very good interiors and wellmaintained seats cleanliness lighting Ample space available between knee and seat in front of you Wellmannered and clear language English and Hindi speaking crew led by Ms Unnati Didnt have food nor used washroom so cannot comment on that Journey was comfortable and no bumpy rides encountered Communication from cockpit was also clear everytime Cons Boarding was not done in zoneseat number wise Quite some mosquitoes seen before take off which bit me and some passengers Crew applied some spray but wasnt enough Pricing was a big letdown as huge increase seen while booking on Feb for my journey date of Feb in a short span of time Slight delay in takeoff after closing of doors

Its a pleasure to travel with Cyprus airways They are so kind and really try to help The staff in Dubai is super friendly and playful with my daughter Im a nervous flyer and I always feel at ease when travelling with Cyprus airways
Everything was very good We used the lounge in the airport The services were great

My wife and I flew from Buenos Aires to Miami this January The airplanes appeared to be old with no entertainment flat panels no earphone outlets and no USB charging outlets The seats were old fashion leather wide and comfortable with spacious leg rooms and reclineable backward to almost degrees all of these made the flights very comfortable Meals served were rather good with frequent service of beverages of limited types free wine was included with meals Our experience was far better than most reviewers whose reviews we read

Busy and crowded on both Sundays However queues were manageable Inbound immigration went smoothly Baggage hall is still a scrum but more staff on duty to assist Check in was quick and efficient Food and drink are overpriced Sufficient seating in boarding area

I have to say my second arrival in Dar was much better than the first First time arrived amid a plague of flying cockroachlike insects that were all attracted to the light inside the terminal Spent ages swatting them in a huge line for immigration that took over an hour only to then be told I needed a special permit and had to pay USD I already had a business visa Not wanting to argue I joined the next disorganised line paid my USD and waited another minutes to get my passport back Notable that everyone in the special line was Caucasian Second time all desks open for immigration friendly hello from the official and a quick stamp and on my way No special permit needed this time for some reason Bags came out quickly and was out of the airport within minutes of landing Lets hope that the new terminal will be finished on time and that there will be no more special line

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

I had a better experience than most of the other people who posted reviews here The airplane departed on time in Tblisi and arrived even a bit earlier Seats are comfortable Checked luggage is free which is very rare these days Be prepared for zero interaction with the staff members in the plane though Only at the entrance the staff greets you They seemed quite friendly though Theres no option to buy food and no information apart from an announcement that the landing has started The life vests looked quite old frayed and stained at least the one that the safety instructor showed maybe the ones stored under your seat are newer If you dont need luxury and you bring your own food this airline is really fine I dont know how they act in case of delays or cancellations though

Small airport which was about minutes on bus to the city center Facilities was good and clean Baggage claim was fast and thoughtful as at many other Japanese airports Signs and directions were also clearly noted in English

Highly recommended airline offering excellent value for money I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals a hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my hour transit a free single hotel room and a free shuttle from airport to hotel all for It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only

Very good airport clean little queue times wifi works well and there are many options for eating One thing that I liked very much about this airport is that on the third floor there are many food options This airport is not very big but its space is very well used

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

CVG is my home airport and I have always had a good experience compared with other large cities However I recently returned from a trip and had parked in Long Term parking Previously I had only to walk out the door and across the pick up lane to the well marked shuttle buses and ride to the long term parking Apparently they have revised the whole set up and there is zero accessible signage to direct you to a brand new pick up spot for the shuttle buses There should be a sign at the old spot telling of the new one signage in the actual terminal near where arriving customers will see it as they enter the luggage retrieval area arrows and signage that distinguishes the east and the west pick up areas are for different things eg the East is for Uber etc and the West is for parking shuttles note there is a sign for the bus shuttles in the west end only after you have walked about of the way there once in the line designated for different shuttles there needs to be signage that distinguishes which shuttle lot bus will be stopping where there are at different shuttles stopping in this lane and the bus itself needs to have signage eg long term parking This is such a huge oversight please correct it so you can maintain your excellent reputation

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

Frankfurt to Berlin our first flight was cancelled but they arranged me other flight Next day I use Air Berlin also this time their service was on time and good service and cabin crew they are very friendly and helpful I was very happy their service

My brother and I and Flew for the first time everyone was very helpful they even put us in the sky lounge which consists of a buffet and drinks They did no extra charge and they helped out through the whole time without necessarily babying us Thank you for the experience

Very good facilities as there are plenty of shops and restaurants Great transport connection particularly as the JR station is just at the basement However capacity at the international terminal seems to be pretty constrained There can be very very long queues at both checkin and security when a few flights depart at around the same time

This is a large airport that is undergoing runway expansion which is very visible on takeoff and landing For a midmorning flight the C concourse was very but not very crowded Seating at the gates can be a premium however we had no difficulty finding seating The connecting hall has all kinds of restaurants both fast food and sit down Airport WiFi is easy to connect and fast The bathrooms are impeccable There is an attendant on duty who is constantly cleaning the bathrooms after every use The attendant greets passengers saying welcome to the cleanest bathrooms in CLT Kudos to Airport management

The airport is new and clean however it is already overstretched For departures there are only a couple of snack bars and small shops in the departure area and for an international departure theres only one cafe Although your plane may be parked at a jetbridge you may not board from the jetbridge but rather have to go outside and use stairs Alternatively you may board at gate but then walk in the arrival corridor to the jetbridge at gate Check in and security were easy and fast At arrivals the tourist information office was closed There is no area for rental car return you will have to go in to the building to tell them you have returned Signage on the roads to the airport is not very good and it is tricky to reach the airport from any direction other than downtown There is construction at the airport entrance and perhaps that will address this issue The airport makes a good arrival spot for the Eje Cafetero Arriving with Easy Fly our bags arrived almost instantly

We used the airport facilities both for international arrivaldepartures and domestic sea plane The international part was no so bad at all the Covid Clearance was fast and correct luggage arrived within a reasonable time and all worked pretty well Not really first class but not as bad as some reviews should indicated Staff was courteous and friendly The transfer tofrom the sea plane terminal was bumpy literally speaking and luggage handling somewhat chaotic but somehow it worked and with a bit of positive attitude we really found it pretty good and quite amusing The business class lounge was not the most modern and delicate one for sure but had what we needed and was quite comfortable Check in Qatar was very well organized friendly and correct in every way Same for immigration and document control We give the airport good marks not need to worry when going tofrom Maldives

Hassle free check in is something unheard of at this Airport Not even a professional customer friendly staff in the check in counter Staff treat passengers as some kind of nuisance to their work they prefer to gossip between themselves rather than clearing passengers in the queue

This review applies only to Terminal Arrival Departure For one of the busiest days of the travel season Sunday after Thanksgiving the terminal was busy but surprisingly uncrowded From the boarding areas there are views of the airfield and parking apron Seating is plenty though at busier times there can be a dearth of seating Food options are limited given the size of the terminal To order food the iPads which contained flight info links to newspapers and magazines have been eliminated U now have to us a QR code to scan the menu from your phone WiFi service is excellent Easy to connect and fast There was barely a wait to go through security with TSAPre The bathrooms on both arrival and departure were clean with an attendant cleaning the bathrooms frequently Terminal lacks a lounge nonetheless its a good terminal

Great airport to travel from and return to No great distances to walk easy access to check in counters TSA actually seems to care and think rather than defaulting to lowest level of acceptable service ie Denver Early morning flights are great as the food court has great breakfast burritos and coffee The only problem seems to be the luggage getting from the plane back to you Once you have your bags the rest of the trip out is a breeze

Beijing to Weihai with Shandong Airlines Comfortable clean and modern plane with ample leg room far more generous than Etihad and the other premium airlines I have experienced Some delay due to air traffic congestion however bags promptly delivered on arrival Water provided by friendly and attentive crew for the short flight

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

Sharm el Sheikh to Dusseldorf When I got to the airport I found out that my flight was delayed by minutes I had asked the ground staff to please check my luggage through to Hamburg as I had a connecting flight with Eurowings from Dusseldorf The agent informed me that he could easily check me through but he would need the permission from Germania He wrote an email to them and so I had to wait about minutes until he had shown me their response The response stated that they had no agreement with Eurowings and that I would need to pick up my luggage and check it in with them again As the flight was already delayed by minutes I would miss my connecting flight in Dusseldorf to Hamburg When I had arrived in Dusseldorf I had found out that my luggage was not carried on my flight Lucky me my connecting flight was cancelled Theoretically the Ground Service does not even deserve a one star rating The Crew on the other side was very friendly and provided great service Seat on the aircraft was very comfortable and I had enough space for my legs as well

Very good airport clean little queue times wifi works well and there are many options for eating One thing that I liked very much about this airport is that on the third floor there are many food options This airport is not very big but its space is very well used

TAR Aerolineas is a new regional Mexican carrier which operates several routes in Mexico Flew a domestic route roundtrip and found the service to be topnotch Aircraft brand new and clean punctual departures and arrivals attentive ground and cabin personnel excellent value for money Would choose them again when my travel plans take me to Mexico

Great medium sized airport Travel fairly frequent from Hannover mainly from Terminal B to the UK The three terminals are very similar Good city centre connection with SBahn Fast checkin to gate usually same for arrival to out of door
This airport is great It has all the necessities that an airport should have I dont get how it is placed in the world It should be a top airport All the staff are very helpful and friendly

Excellent security Left my laptops by mistake at security and went to my plane I noticed once in the plane While I couldnt deboard the staff and pilot called security and they were found and brought to lost and found A friend picked them up days later

It is a mediumsize International airport located in the city easy to arrive Served with all the big airlines companies in Brazil and also Surinam Airways TAP Portugal and flights to Miami and Fort Lauderdale by LATAM and AZUL The terminal is clean and offers lots of options for shopping and food The departure lounge could be bigger Sometimes it is filled of people and the seats are not enough The staff are good and prepared

Friendly flight attendant who take care of the passengers efficiently Excellent flight but the cabin of the Dash needs a very serious refresh and more confortable seats The flight time was respected On the gate the employees of Air Canada Jazz offer a good service

Having gone through so many different airports around the world Kuching Airport is definitely one of the better airports to use Airport workers here checkin counters security immigration etc are generally fine but can be improved especially on the level of professionalism in their communication with passengers The airport may look very new but there is a need to improve some facilities such as seating areas especially the terminal Air Asia uses at one end of the single terminal and the automated passport gates at the arrival hall Cleanliness can be improved as well particularly on the toilets Overall Kuching Airport is a good and hasslefree airport to use

I booked return flights from Sydney to Rome via Guangzhou where the airline provides an easy and comfortable option of a free hotel depending on the gap between your next flight The stopover option is incredibly well handled with transport provided to and from your hotel I thoroughly recommend this as Guangzhou has a great easy to use metro system and its very easy to get around The A fleet used are in excellent condition with pleasant staff although meals can be a let down one on my return journey was actually inedible However the real test of a good airline is when things dont go to plan My return flight from Rome was cancelled due to a technical issue after we had boarded the flight We spent hours on board with regular updates provided before the Captain made the decision not to fly Prior to disembarking which involved reentering Italy and collecting our bags lunch was served on board a nice touch Once back in the terminal we were given further meal vouchers and asked to return an hour later On return we were bussed to the nearby Sheraton where all accommodation and meals were covered for hours while the plane was repaired and put back in service These changes left only hours to change to my rescheduled flight from Guangzhou to Sydney however to my delight China Southern provided a hotel option close to the airport allowing for a refreshing stop and rest before the final long leg back to Sydney So sure I arrived on Sunday morning instead of Friday night as planned but the way I was looked after was very good I would certainly recommend China Southern and will fly with them again

My first experience with Malm Aviation flying from StockholmBromma to Malm Cheap fares friendly cabin crew comfortable aircraft free meal and coffee on that domestic flight Do you recognize SAS Youre right it isnt SAS It is Malm Aviation

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

I was very nervous as was flying on my own for the first time and with my young child All staff were very helpful from the minute we walked into the airport The lady who booked us in was so considerate When we got on to the plane we were met by Joanie she was so welcoming and involved Samuel straight away Joanie then went above and beyond during the flight to make sure we were ok and to help me keep Samuel occupied She was so kind and thoughtful and was very complementary about his behaviour To absolutely blow us away she let us meet Johnathan and Catherine I hope I have names right this made Samuels day He couldnt stop smiling Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to them all what a super team I will definitely be using Loganair again
Madrid to Granada Excellent Efficient and attentive cabin crew Arrived and left on time New aircraft and comfortable seats Straightforward boarding and disembarking Highly recommended

I thought it was great In the past Ive been very critical of Manchester Airport but credit where its due my recent experience was very good As always we parked in Jetparks and got the shuttle bus I hadnt been through Terminal for about years as all of my recent flights have been from the dump that is Terminal What a refreshing improvement the expanded Terminal is The checkin area is bright and clean passport control was a doddle and it took just minutes to get through security albeit this was at in the morning I had a wander round bought some duty free and sat and relaxed for a while until my flight was ready It was a bit of a trek to the departure gate for my flight to Frankfurt but no real problem Boarding was via the airbridge so thank goodness no messing about with buses to far flung areas of the tarmac And our flight took off exactly on time My return flight was a week later Again an airbridge was available and the arrivals gate was fairly close to Immigration One of the travellators was being repaired but in a couple of minutes I was through passport control and amazingly my bag was in the first batch then straight through customs and out through Arrivals where the JetParks bus was waiting All told minutes from the plane to my car So Manchester Airport can be a smooth and stress free experience

I flew Motor Sich this past July from Kyiv to Odesa and it was a great experience It was on one of their AN s and to my surprise the seats were the most comfortable economy seats I have flown not to mention the most room Also when checking in my bag was a few kilos overweight and they let me check it with no extra charge Would definitely fly Motor Sich again

I have used Monastir Airport now for years and whilst the queues at immigration can be slow at times I think the other facilities and friendly staff more than make up for this Transport links are excellent if you are an independent traveller

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

First time the flight left on time and even earlier for the first time in years I thought we were going to be landing way in advance Unfortunately we were then in a holding pattern in Bangkok for mins You win some you loose some It was a ten year old Boeing The first meal service was lovely the breakfast was poor I didnt eat that The recline on my seat was broke which isnt a deal breaker for me anyway Crew were great I still think they can improve but the convenience is the key with a direct flight

There was hardly any delay just minutes The plane was old but reasonably clean Staff were friendly I could buy a good sparkling white wine The flight was safe and uneventful So bring your own noise cancelling headphone and enjoy a decent flight at low cost

This was my nd flight to FLL in months after a year absence This review is limited to Terminal Arrival was at the A Concourse gates which mean a rather long connectors to the BC concourses common area One huge advantage of FLL airport over the others is the car rental facility which is directly across the airport roadway from the terminal The renovated terminal is spacious brightly lit and has a central TSA Entry point for all concourses Each concourse offers dining options a plenty For Christmas Day travel there was enough seating for all with power ports and USB ports at each gate The bathrooms are very clean and maintained at regular intervals Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished Terminal is a joy to travel through

For a small town scale Manado airport is pretty good Has several places for check in Several lounges equipped with internet access and good food The lounge area is quite spacious and has good service from Avsec This airport is set as the transit airport for Raja Ampat another greatest diving spot in indonesia located in Papua and also has an international direct flight like Singapore etc

Used to be very busy in the Soviet times since then reduced the traffic by at least At the same time the new terminal was built with more adequate waiting spaces It is rather modern and clean Food service is kind of slow Public transportation to the city is not on top and I used parknfly only once

Gatwick to Denver I was placed on a Wamos flight by Norwegian and almost cancelled due to all the terrible reviews but I didnt find it that bad at all We brought our own movies to watch and our own food which I normally do on a flight anyway as I like healthy stuff Ive had worse legroom on other flights and the staff were more friendly and helpful than many others Ive known and I fly a lot The plane was pretty old but perfectly functional The staff were so great that I told them Id write a review because I felt that the pasting theyre getting online is unfair and makes us travellers look rather spoilt to be honest

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

Checkin security check an immigration at Xiamen Airport swift although not very friendly Contract lounge large with decent FB choices Boarding for both flights well organized Both flights with good FB offerings and service and on time IFE very good The big letdown was again the lack of frequent flyer points for members of other One lWorld airlines besides Asia Miles There was not even a fare bookable in economy which attracts frequent flyer points I fly frequently within the OneWord alliance and no other carrier has this practice I will therefore stick to the other members of Oneworld in the future

We flew to Cairo from our Sharm elSheikh resort as many others did in order to tour the capital city of Egypt The aircraft was very comfortable and seemed quite new They offer great catering for the one hour flight Couldnt fault it

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

Check in at Penang quick and easy and only small queue at security Used the Plaza Premium Lounge ok but nothing special Flight boarded slightly late but the boarding process was well managed Cabin was clean and included the latest short haul business class seat comfortable and ample legroom for a short flight Even on a minute flight business class passengers get a hot meal in this case chicken satays which were very tasty Flight landed on schedule and baggage already on the belt by the time we had walked from the gate Good experience with Malaysia Airlines

Shanghai to Tehran return July Direct flight to Tehran Economy class Aircraft A Fare was quite good Checkin fast Cabin crew showed Iranian hospitality No individual inflight entertainment but fairly speaking since the flight was at night One toilet closed for whole trip the other two were not clean and almost out of tissue Food was enough and fine for me Many drink options Flying time was less than hours on my way to Tehran and less than on the way back to Shanghai Considering all the above I will certainly choose this airline next time for my trip to Tehran

This review is limited to Terminal This terminal is very convenient as all of Southwests gates are in one location which means connection times of minutes is more than enough to catch connecting flight As I had a very short layover I did not access WiFi The terminal was crowded midmorning but theres plenty of seating The bathrooms are very clean

This airport is very small for the number of passengers and airlines it is serving Everywhere seemed to be crowded and felt cramped I thought they needed more space for better facilities and customer service Transferring from the train coming from London to the terminal and between terminals was very easy and well signage The prayer room is available and wellmaintained and the toilets are clean Not a pleasant experience for shopping and dining as there are too many people in a cramped space

My first time flying easyJet and I had a good experience Both flights were ontime the planes were clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional A relatively short hop between London and Sicily The Captains were good at keeping us informed of progress I ordered some drinks on board but no food Perfectly adequate and I would definitely consider them in the future if the price and route are right

GOTAYTGOT We choose this airline because it was a part of a charter trip We went on a seat A its was quite big It was as you expect in a economy class airplane not much legroom quite cramped The seats were quite nice but you will notice that they have been there for a while but it works fine The cabincrew are very friendly and nice The food onboard was okay You cant expect that much from an airline in the food section We thought we were going to get breakfast as we flew at in the morning Instead we got meatballs in a sauce which was really nice

AMSAAL and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Aalborg every minutes weekdays but only hourly during the weekend travel time is mins and costs DKK Checkin efficient and hasslefree using selfservice kiosks Free Internet computers are available landside a nice touch Security staff very friendly Boarding area is rather cramped with limited seating do not go airside too early
This is a smashing little airport friendly well laid out and very well run Because of its location very attractive to fly in and out of too always a big shock returning to Gatwick Good ice cream too
