Bangkok to Taipei Having now taken four flights on V Air my comments remain virtually the same as my earlier review I arrived at the newly opened international terminal at Bangkoks Don Mueang airport about minutes prior to the scheduled departure Checkin took less than minutes even though the plane was around full The aircraft pushed back minutes late but arrived precisely on time The seat is comfortable with more leg space than is usual on budget carriers my preordered meal of chicken teriyaki was excellent and the FAs are efficient and cheerful One even came to my seat to welcome me back having seen me on my last flight almost months earlier I wish all budget carriers were of a similar standard
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time
It is located in the city center and easily accessible by buses and MRT The size is not big Signposts are clear Employees are friendly and helpful The ambience is clean

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements

Berne Airport Airport of the Capital of Switzerland is a regional airport with connections to Europes major cities Also connecting to the international hubs of Munich and Amsterdam CheckIn time only minutes prior to departure time Airport Authority is building a new terminal which will be opened by may Temporary terminal is in use until the opening of the new terminal Staff is very friendly The motto is to serve the passenger from leaving the taxi or public transport until boarding the aircraft

Uneventful flight with on time departure and arrival Usual Southwest nofrill service Clean aircraft and friendly flight crew In Flight Entertainment was easy to log on and watch live TV NFL football Unusual for this particular aircraft the overhead cabins were not as large as other aircraft

Pittsburgh International is a modern wellkept airport but it has been sad to its usage steadily decline over the last years or so The US Airways hub is no longer and the airport has had a difficult time with the transition Unfortunately this has meant plenty of vacant gates and ticket counters For the passenger PIT offers free wifi though the signal is really only active near the Skymall McDonalds right in the centre of the terminal Security lines are wellorganised While I was joining the line an employee suggested to a group of us that we use the special annex screening gate which had no waiting That was really good advice which had all of us through and into the secure area in no time Overall it is still a clean comfortable airport I just really miss the days when so many more people used it on a daily basis

Flight from Rome to Turin the plane was old but very clean the hostesses were all very friendly Its better than other low cost airlines because they let you bring both a trolley and a small handbag in the cabin while on other low cost such as Ryanair that isnt allowed

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

I had two flights with Atlantic Airways Flight Bergen Faroe Islands and Faroe Islands to Copenhagen one week later Both flights on time Comfortable seats clean aircraft good food friendly service I will flight with Atlantic Airways again with pleasure

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

Internal flights in Colombia BOGSMR CTGBOG were real value for money The planes were clean the service was good and the free Juan Valdez snack peanuts and some little cookie were delicious Excellent value for short flights

I flew TokyoSapporoTokyo I was pleasantly surprised at the efficiency and professionalism of the staff The crew spoke English We departed and arrived ontime The great price combined with the excellent service ensures I will fly Skymark again

Tular to Antananarivo Quick Checkin on time plane a bit old refreshments and a snack served friendly flight attendants The fare was somehow high but this is Madagascar You shouldnt come here if you are pampered by lowcost carriers

Hong Kong to Kolkata An excellent flight where I was doted on by two very amiable and helpful cabin crew members It helped that I was one of just two passengers in the business class section which had seats in two rows of x A menu card was provided and my selection was tasty and filling A good complement of drinks and spirits was on offer However they have not changed their dessert a small cup of Haagen Daz ice cream in at least years It is always served solid frozen I passed on it and had some port wine instead The flight departed on time from a satellite terminal which was reached by a short bus ride from the main terminal Arrival was on schedule Indian government landing cards required of foreigners were provided on board The seats are traditional business class recliners and were reasonably comfortable Boarding was smooth intermixed with main cabin travelers through a jet way Ipads with a small selection of films and shows were provided soon after take off It was difficult to slot them into the metal clasps on the back of the seat in front of you you needed to hold on to the ipad to watch your program Magazines and newspapers on offer Lots of storage space overhead Leg space could be a tad extra once you recline fully your toes juts on the bottom of the front seat Announcements were made in clear English and for a very thoughtful touch also in Bengali the language of the destination city Cathay Dragon had a duty free catalog and three of my four selections were available for purchase This is one aspect of travel I very much enjoy as it lets me pick up last minute gifts

Very clean and well taken care of This airport is served by so many great airlines with diverse destinations I do think that GRR needs more international routes At GRR the airport is not too big so it makes efficient travel Also they have a good selection of shops and stores The airport facility looks really modern and cool for being over years old The only cons is that sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the staff doesnt manage high groups of passengers well Would give an if I could

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date

SkyUp is definitely an interesting airline Going into this trip I was not really sure what to expect from a low cost airline that tends to receive high ratings We had booked second row seats for dollars each My original seat which was located on the left side of the aircraft ABC did not have the extra legroom that was promised However since the flight was mostly empty I was able to move to the right side of the aircraft seats DEF These rows had substantially more seatpitch and could definitely be compared to that of other airlines premium economy As for the seats themselves they were quite thin and similar in shape to that of spirit airlines or easyjet but nonetheless it still had a great recline angle In terms of service itself the airline does not have any food or drinks besides water on flights to or from any city but Kyiv so beware and plan to bring your own food onboard There was no in flight magazine or wifi only a QR code for you to download an online journal before takeoff The aircraft landed on time and overall it was a smooth flight

Bornholm to Copenhagen The flight on halfanhour was smooth and on time Very relaxed boarding and in the air you are offered coffeetea and a piece of chocolate by smiling crew Seats OK aircraft clean and announcements informal Danish as also often experienced on ofter Scandinavian carriers DAT now serve several routes inside Denmark and have always been ontime Tickets on this route however somewhat expensive compared to earlier days

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green
The airport is cool clean well ventilation and beautiful The navigation sign is clear help the customer easily navigate inside the airport The staff are considerate and thoughtful

I had to cancel my travel plans from Dar Es Salaam to Arusha due to a medical emergency Coastal Aviation was very supportive understanding and efficient in processing my situation Much appreciated Great company

There are two options for getting from Dar es Salaam to Zanzibar a twohour ferry journey or a minute flight The main airlines flying this route are Auric Air and Air Tanzania Ordering the ticket via Opodo was easy and the airline operates from Terminal a small building about km from the main terminals Checkin was efficient and the waiting room had several powerful air conditioning units You could even buy food and drink Tickets were checked and we were walked across to the Cessna It had three seats in each row and although tight it was not uncomfortable It only had a pilot and we flew at about feet giving us a clear view of the sea and then the island It ended with a very smooth landing close to the terminal

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus
I found very good customer service by each and every worker at the airport whom we dealt with Wifi facilities were excellent with no interruptions Overall it passes the required tests

Travelled in transit LGWTIPACC back in November and on both outward and return legs I found the staff helpful and courteous Although the airport may not be up to the international standards of LHR or AMS nonetheless a compact tidy terminal It also has an excellent duty free shop Remember though that Libya is a dry country The only Becks you can buy is non alcoholic

Ive flown through this airport or times now and its always a good experience Its a lovely modern building the staff are very helpful securitycustomsimmigration has always been quick and painless It only takes mins by train they have a decent airport hotel located in the domestic arrivals terminal and its always spotless
Its not crowded Its very new and clean airport Sign and directions are easy to follow Before my departure time I really enjoy spending time Ankara airport Esenboga

Only good thing about Bangalore airport terminal is it is beautiful and clean No other facilities available like other airports It does not have much food stalls and shopping area near GATES Moreover toilet are very far from gate location Less seating areas

LX from Vienna to Zurich operated by Helvetic Airways The flight was completely full but boarding was expertly handled by the crew and went very smoothly The EE is a small aircraft and space in the overhead bins is limited The crew assisted passengers with finding a place for their carryon luggage and in the end all luggage could be stored somewhere Also the crew were very friendly and courteous As this was a very short flight a small snack was served which was excellent All in all a very comfortable short flight on a small aircraft with an excellent crew

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

This airport is head and shoulders above any other airport I have been to and Ive been through a few Every person I interacted with form check in to security to service staff were all over the top friendly with great senses of humor The security line is the fastest I have ever seen I have never waited in a line here even during the holidays maybe minutes max The gates are clean and modern tons of outlets and different seating arrangements lots of space for only having gates Loads of parking for an airport of this size I was able to park my car like meters from departures and left it there for a week I know how infuriating flying can be especially when things go wrong but it goes a long way when people are so friendly This is my favorite airport and I go out of my way to fly out of here please give these people the recognition they deserve

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

Excellent small regional airport spotlessly clean with very friendly staff slight oddity that the baggage reclaim belts are in the arrivals hall but I was out within th mins of the plane touching down and you cant get much better than that

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

Arrived via DME from LHR and MAN with S airlines and same route return Probably the fastest ever transit through an airport I have ever experienced even if it is only a small provincial one Had to return the day after I arrived and with the assistance of friendly helpful staff collected my late luggage All in all a great little airport if a basic one

Surabaya airport is a very quick and efficient airport On arrival the visa on arrival queue was very short immigration there was a short wait of about minutes by the time I was done with both the bags had already arrived Probably one of the quickest experiences for me from exiting the aircraft to curbside Similar experience on departure quick efficient checkin with Cathay Pacific short lines at security and immigration The terminal is spacious and has a lot of natural light from the full height windows on either side the restrooms were very clean Food options are limited to a Burger King and Starbucks the duty free has a good selection for a small airport The premier lounge which was in a temporary set up was the only disappointment Chose to sit at the Starbucks instead Free wifi at the airport is also quite good
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD
We flew from Toronto to Paris Flight attendants were very helpful and welcoming We especially appreciated Emersons help He was great Ground crew were great too

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

Ljubljana airport is very practical for passengers and all procedures are carried out quickly There are not many flights and passengers in the morning so the experience is even better The employees are professionally friendly but not much more very very few smiles In the dutyfree shop some Croatian products are offered as Slovenian ones which is probably an unintentional mistake The coffee at the bar is excellent The toilet which was otherwise clean smelled of nitrogen compounds probably due to insufficient or absent ventilation In the waiting room in front of the bridges to the plane at least some of the otherwise comfortable seats were torn It was also possible to see through the windows into neglected closed and abandoned rooms which they probably do not know what to do with The airport is a very important point of entry to my beloved country so even some seemingly trivial carelessness is out of place

Anchorage airport north terminal is clean and spacious with very fast and efficient checkin and security There are lots of interesting things to look at in the airport Plenty of eating options and shopping Clean bathrooms and good WiFi No complaints at all

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you

WestJet from Calgary to London Heathrow was excellent The flight attendant introduced herself by name and provided a warm welcome Remembered customers names as well A very decent sparkling wine and hot towels were served before take off Menu choices were good and dinner was quite tasty Breakfast options were far better than on other carriers There was a good choice of wines poured generously IFE system was pretty standard Seats comfortable Overall the quality of the premium economy product on WestJet is far superior to Air Canadas and better than British Airways

This airport has terminals one for USA flights and one for non USA flights Not big airport Inside is very clean and staff are very helpful However there are long waiting times at immigration and customs Customs has no scanner machines so they have to open all bags for checks Needed almost hours to finish immigration and customs When departing it is very quick Inside the airport there are only a few shops

This place is clean and efficient Lots of room and well staffed airport Both the internationaldomestic terminal and the USA pre clearance terminals are modern and the lines are usually moving very quickly US Customs is exceptionally efficient and considering the volume of persons traveling the process is smooth and the staff is excellent and friendly US citizens get to experience an even smoother passage with the automated terminals Just make sure you follow all the rules because some of them might seem unnecessary but if you have had a big win at the casino declare it or loose it after a night in a terrible local lock up and a visit to a magistrate back in town the next day if it is not a Friday

Istanbul to Tripoli This airlines is decent and I was served particularly well The food and beverages were great and the in flight entertainment contained a lot of movies to watch Also the WIFI was pretty fast and effective

This was the most amusing flight I have ever flown as I got to share some laughs with not only fellow passengers but with a hostess Anyway I was seated in row row was an exit row so I was invited to sit there since it was empty and was willingable to assist in case of an emergency Te leg room is excellent and I measure cm The staff were professional and courteous Bags came out quickly We were given water upon boarding then a chocolate bar then a croissant filled with chocolate sauce worth the calories and finally a small drink

I have flown several legs with Qantaslink over the past months The Q has a more comfortable seat than the new seats in Qantas Boeing and soon to be Airbus s apart from their newest aircraft VHA which has seats so hard that a wooden bench would be more comfortable Ground Service Im pretty disappointed that you cant select your seats until hour before you leave for us less desired Red FF or no FF customers and all the seats up the front are blocked off for Qantas preferred customers Baggage drop and collection has been efficient on all flights where I have checked my luggage On board cabin crew do their jobs and the pilots are friendly Most delayed departures have ended in on time or early arrivals Food they may as not bother I dont consider tiny cent sized corn chips with some sauces a meal or even a snack I think Qantas and Qantaslink need to do alot better here One bonus is that unlike Rex you can purchase a lounge pass with your flight to allow you to relax have some food or drinks and get away from the crowds before our flights out of capital cities Lounge passes unless youre a Qantas Club member or Gold FF and higher cost Boarding disembarking When they dont use those ramps which are great for people with mobility issues disembarking is pretty efficient but when the ramps are used it can take up to minutes for them to put the ramp onto the aircraft The buses that take passengers to and from remore stands are a safety hazard if you have mobility or balance issues then sit in a seat as the drivers seem to be very heavy on the brakes

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

Return leg was an older model configured in Business about half full Actually the seating is better than the configuration as you have more feet room Food was really good especially the Salmon Cod and Prawn ceviche a true delight The bed was comfortable and the service attentive movie choice the same as going out days previous One criticism is that priority bags do not come out first I awaited mins for my bag to arrive and nearly missed my connection although arriving at and a departure on next flight at The second leg on older plane entertainment system not working at all Breakfast and service was good arrived on time and again no priority bags first This is one area they need to work on Hence Ground service only star

With flights starting at around USD between Seoul and Yantai Shandong Airlines proved to be the cheapest option beating Asiana China Eastern and Korean Air Given the price I was a little hesitant to believe the service to be of a high level however I was pleasantly surprised I was given a friendly greeting in English on boarding crew holding a basket of sweets for passengers to take as they headed to their seat For the rest of the flight the crew seemed to conduct their service pleasantly with a smile On the outbound flight to China apple chips and bottles of water were offered however on the return leg a delicious hot meal was offered consisting of a sweet and sour type meat dish with rice Highly surprising considering the flight time was less than an hour Interestingly on both flights the captain performed a detailed speech in Chinese and English Despite the fact that the Boeing was several years old it was fitted with Boeings Sky interior and its interior seemed to lack any signs of wear and tear The interior including the toilets appeared to have been cleaned well The seats were comfortable and had ample legroom for the short flight The IFE onboard consisted of overhead screens these played the moving map on the outbound flight at Mr Bean on the return journey Overall a good journey

Brasilia airport is clean and always improving the facilities The architecture is uptodate The airport is well located and you can reach it by bus but no train or subway It has an good commercial area close to the gates The airport facilities are in good condition and are well maintained

The airport is so peaceful and clean the staff at the airport are so calm and friendly The duty free shops are so easily accessible and the food at the airport is so tasty The announcements of the arriving or departing planes are so clear and the sings and directions are so bright

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

Flying from Fayetteville to CLT on July The young man at AA was unfriendly like I never seen before Your ID put your bag take your bag were his only words No greeting no thank you no have a good flight I recently moved to Fayetteville for a job from New York Flying often Never flew from Fayetteville used Raleigh for that There was no soap in the restroom at am already Security was okay did not use thank you or please in their lexicon I will fly from Raleigh next time

Passenger wise Indias th busiest airport but infrastructure wise one of the most smallest airport in India When flight lands they dont even provide bus to arrivals but needs to walk from aircraft to terminal via on tarmac Arrivals is very small only baggage belt in a limit spaces but baggage can take more time Toilets are just ok should be more clean Prepaid cab and also uber have pick up point just after exit no issues finding them at the same time many taxi drivers will approach you offering ride Airport needs proper management new terminal is under construction and hope that it is better managed

Singapore to Yangon I didnt know what to expect when I booked this flight but I dont regret The airplane was clean staff was friendly and food was good Also a lot of space for the legs good entertainment and opportunity to charge phonetablet In the EmiratesGaruda league in my opinion

I was very excited to land here as this airport is famous around the globe for its risk landings The infrastrucure per se is very basic you deplane on the tarmac and then walk to the arrivals staff were ok I found people in the Madeira island to be very friendly Do not come without pre booked stuff as I noticed they inflate the prices for tourists who decided to book on the spot The airport is clean and security is fast long lines though Snacks on the land side much cheaper than air side
My budget airline fare turned out to be a complete surprise with full service and a fairly new A plane The service friendliness and cleanliness are no less than those of Singapore Airlines

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Berlin Tegel is a very unique airport both is positive and negative ways After arriving at Berlin Tegel and disembarking the aircraft we had to queue up on the jetbridge as the customs checkpoint was right after the jetbridge A very interesting concept Right after that was a small baggage carousel then out of the departures area This meant that there was basically no departures area We had to wait quite some time for our baggage When we returned to to the airport our checkin process was pretty smooth and the lounge was easily accessible There was a huge observation deck which spanned the roof of a terminal offering beautiful views of the runway and tarmac a good place to spend the time However you have to go through a small security check and buy a ticket before entering Every two gates had its own departure area with seats and its own security checkpoint This meant snaking queues into the public area each time a flight was boarding and it was hard to walk around with baggage because there was little space Inside the tiny departures area there was insufficient seating and insufficient space for the boarding queue Everyone was squeezed at the gate and there was absolutely no order or anything No queues set up

Tanahmerah to Korowai Batu This route is a governmentsubsidized one operated with tiny aircraft carrying only about a dozen passengers No advance booking possible but Dimonim staff were helpful in getting us on a flight the same day Departure time was uncertain but we eventually got on the plane Once aboard it was a great flight offering sweeping views of the rivers and rain forests below Cheap too

In August Johannesburg to Maun and Kisane to Johannesburg Both flights were spot on time Service on board was fine with drinks and light snacks served for the roughly hour flight in each direction Aircrafts were in good shape and the seats comfortable for this type of trip Checkin in Joburg was easy and very quick Check in in Kisane was a breeze as the airport is tiny All in a good experience and a great way to enhance your Botswana experience

The airport is much better than before after the construction of the new terminal and the renovation of the old one Much cleaner more shops better signage etc However the passenger experience is affected by the lack of jet bridges and the use of buses for going to and from the aircraft The buses are hot in the summer and cold in winter and they are probably unsafe during the pandemic If jet bridges cannot be added then passengers should be allowed to walk to and from the aircraft with buses used only during poor weather The external spaces also need some greening up and better maintenance

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step

Bornholm to Copenhagen The flight on halfanhour was smooth and on time Very relaxed boarding and in the air you are offered coffeetea and a piece of chocolate by smiling crew Seats OK aircraft clean and announcements informal Danish as also often experienced on ofter Scandinavian carriers DAT now serve several routes inside Denmark and have always been ontime Tickets on this route however somewhat expensive compared to earlier days

Traveling through Murtala International airport in Lagos Nigeria is an experience Staff are generally friendly and smiled a lot My documents were repeatedly checked I counted ten checkpoints altogether At five of them I was asked if I would hand over some money They weirdest situation was that the customs officer asked how much money I carry and then after hearing the honest as he was a customs officer answer asked me if I would give him some of it The airport is quite run down and processes are not streamlined Boarding was rather chaotic with passengers placed on different coloured seats after the boarding passes were scanned

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you
Mahon is clean light and airy with reasonable shopping facilities and bars the seating area is particularly good with a view of the airfield and runway and plenty of space
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

Excellent flight great room and staff were excellent Little English is spoken I had originally booked Hainan but they cancelled initial booking and booked me to Capital Very limited entertainment and glad I had a book

The Airport is clean and well put together Food options have increased after adding KFC and TGI Fridays alongside Burger King The guy at the checkin counter gave us a hard time because he kept enquiring about our Singapore Visas even though for Bahrainis going to Singapore there is a Visa on Arrival and I kept telling him that Id been to Singapore times already and Id never had to apply for a predeparture Visa but he kept asking his colleagues about it The staff at the Pearl Lounge were friendly and I loved the free Evian Bottles

My first experience with Malm Aviation flying from StockholmBromma to Malm Cheap fares friendly cabin crew comfortable aircraft free meal and coffee on that domestic flight Do you recognize SAS Youre right it isnt SAS It is Malm Aviation
Newquay airport is excellent apart from the abysmal state of seating in the main departure lounge Seating all torn and very scruffy It has been like this for a long time Unacceptable

Pittsburgh International is a modern wellkept airport but it has been sad to its usage steadily decline over the last years or so The US Airways hub is no longer and the airport has had a difficult time with the transition Unfortunately this has meant plenty of vacant gates and ticket counters For the passenger PIT offers free wifi though the signal is really only active near the Skymall McDonalds right in the centre of the terminal Security lines are wellorganised While I was joining the line an employee suggested to a group of us that we use the special annex screening gate which had no waiting That was really good advice which had all of us through and into the secure area in no time Overall it is still a clean comfortable airport I just really miss the days when so many more people used it on a daily basis

I travel frequently both internationally and domestically and St Louis Airport provided one of the smoothest travel experiences I have had to date Staff were efficient and seemed to actually care about their jobs food and beverage options were plentiful and the terminal was easy to navigate The security process was also extremely efficient and wellstaffed The only negative thing I have to say about this airport is that the seating areas at the gates could have been cleaner as chairs had dirt and particles of who knows what all over and in between them However not all of the seating was like this and it didnt bother me as there were many cafes and bars to hang out in Overall one of the better airports I have been through and I have been through countless Great job STL

Wow We were amazed at the transformation of this airport in the space of year since being taken over by a German company Previous check in desks removed and brand new ones on a different wall far more Check in was seamless and plenty check in desks A new security area which was quick and smooth apart from the aggressive female member of staff shouting at passengers and rolling her eyes brand new duty free area Such an improvement Heraklion airport in Crete could take some tips We were stesssed thinking about our return journey but the airport has vastly improved Arrival area is also spacious and easy All toilets in the airport have been renewed
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet
Both flights were on time friendly crew and there was an inflight service for this minutes flight Airplane was clean Due to short runway only passengers could board on departure from Kastellorizo

It was first time at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport it was is one of the nicest and biggest airports I have come through in the USA anywhere in the world This multi level airport has many boarding bridges There are many shops and restaurants The staff were friendly and welcoming The airport is welldecorated and wellmaintained and easy to get in or out Public areas are a huge clean and bright
Loved this airport was friendly decor like someone said is s hawaiian Very comfy armchairs only thing missing was a bar Car hire easy to find and Hilo just down the road

Both arrival and departure from MGA was problem free No crowds The only short queue was immigration on arrival If not included in the air fare there is an entry charge of US and a departure charge of US The facility is modern and clean Shopping here is not cheap but the quality and variety of merchandise is excellent Eating is much more expensive than outside the airport but prices compare favourably with European equivalents The waiting areas have ample seating and are cool Unlike many other airports there is a lack of electronic information boards But it has the charm of some of the once small manageable airports we once had in Europe

Zurich to Dresden via their hub in Dusseldorf Both flights on As Checked in in ZRH without any hassle or feeling entering a lowcost carrier Gate bridging in airports convenient and saved time Flights were both precise on timing and arrival Luggage inscribed transferred and delivered within Minutes on final destination Transit in Dusseldorf smooth Payable catering service onboard rendered several interesting options from printed menu leaflets The airline was better than most reviews indicate I must render them credit at least out of If I had access to their lounges in ZRH and DUS the trip would have been perfected Not cheap but reliable no faults and could fly them again

Great little airport Everything in one location baggage belts next to car hire desks and you walk out into the car park and collect your car Will be my preferred choice now rather than coming in via LAX or SAN and facing a hour drive

The wheelchair attendant verified everything for me Verified with me verified with the LYFT driver by asking his name verify the LYFT ride by licenses plate verified I felt ok and I knew where I was going For me its humiliating to be pushed in a wheelchair I never felt humiliation this time I truly felt cared for This trip wasnt the greatest vacay Ive had but when I got home I felt great I want to thank this positive smart caring young man Some ppl have a gift a few share it in this way If your lucky enough to meet this young man at DFW Airport youll know its him Im talking about here
It is a shame that the people at security do not speak English This is an international airport For the rest it is okay food is good and it is reasonably clean

Kuala Namu International Airport is it is the second largest airport after SoekarnoHatta International Airport but the first airport which has a direct rail link to Medan city the capital of North Sumatra Kuala Namu is the most comfortable and the most modern airport in Indonesia

Berlin to Hurghada It was the first time I am flown with Germania It was a good choice after Air Berlin terminated service on this route They offer free baggage kg a complimentary hot meal and three legs of complimentary non alcoholic hot or cold drinks on this hrs trip If the flight is booked more you have the possibility to upgrade to an extra legroom seat containing up to inch more legroom head phones and one beerwhine Flight attendants were very friendly and caring all the flight One documentary and one movie were shown on overhead screens But if you are not interested in their IFE bring your own device CheckIn was a bit confusing because they tell that your seat is advised automatically which I believe is not the truth There were many free seats Therfore this was not a problem but would be if this flight have been more crowded All in all a very good price service ratio

The more I travel the more I appreciate Port Moresbys Jacksons International Airport Whilst the speed at checkin is dependent on the systems sometimes it takes longer but usually its quite fast its always a breeze moving through this terminal from checkin to security to immigration and into the departure lounge The lounge itself has great seating with good food options and drink options as well as shopping POM isnt Changi but then again Changi is matchless

Everyone working at the ground services at LPB airport gave us excellent service We somehow missed that we could not board Laos Airline flight to Vietnam without proper documents We had read we could get on arrival visas in Vietnam A staff member helped us considerably instructing and helping us get emergency visas I think we might have missed our flight if it was not for her Just wanted to acknowledge her excellent service

I agree that it is a small tidy airport with close proximity to the city It is great that the tram is literally as you walk out the front doors with a frequent service to the city Bremen is such a great little city

Flew in from Baltimore on Southwest What a great little airport Easy to navigate spotless facilities fast wifi and good options for coffee and snacks A great alternative to Boston for access to Cape Cod

The Fokker was certainly old but clean The flight announcements were made in Farsi and English to my surprise The flight was smooth on time and without any nervousness Food was surprisingly excellent Chicken rice and a bottle of Pepsi

Arrival was a very good experience as the new airport layout is a great improvement Departure was problematic I have always used Brussels Airlines which allows you to check in a dedicated facility in the city This time I was with Kenya Airlines and the check in process was chaotic with only one small kiosk and many people with no idea of a queue trying to check in Once through into the departure lounge things improved greatly and the business class lounge was a revelation comfortable air conditioned and well appointed

Busy and crowded on both Sundays However queues were manageable Inbound immigration went smoothly Baggage hall is still a scrum but more staff on duty to assist Check in was quick and efficient Food and drink are overpriced Sufficient seating in boarding area

Miami to La Paz via Santa Cruz in The flight departed with some delay due to bag loading and towing services not available on time However the flight was relaxing and smooth Dinner was good There is no entertainment per seat There are cabin monitors The aircraft was an old Boeing The pilot managed to arrive on time to catch the connecting flight to La Paz This flight was in a B older version as well but with good service One elements to point was the counter staff at Miami was very helpful with my bags and seat selection

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

Extremely friendly wheelchair assist personnel I am disabled and was being moved from gate to gate and since I had some layover time I decided that I would like to get a snack at one of the fast food shops The wheelchair assistant not only took me there but he helped me get my order as well The people everywhere were friendly Cleanliness wasnt top grade but adequate

Durban to Cape Town with Comair This is a hour flight which was full The business class seats were the same as economy but with a little extra legroom and the middle seat was empty The FAs were mature and friendly There was a full bar service and light lunch was served The aircraft was clean left on time and arrived on time A relatively smooth flight unlike BA they serve refreshments and full bar service on this short haul domestic flight
Madrid to Toulouse Once again a punctual and comfortable flight Good legroom on time departure and arrival On flight entertainment was however not working you have to pay for anything on board

Forl airport is very small The service before leave and after the arriving is very good and friendly The location is good also because is possible to join city like Rimini Bologna and Ravenna in a very few time Quite good the service for the disable people

Chongqing Airport is one of the biggest in Southwest China The new terminal is just km away from the old terminal and is well connected by metro line The airport terminal is very spacious and well designed that incorporates with many new technologies Mine was a direct flight by Hainan Airline to JFK The departure area has all sort of restaurants and shops which makes the last minute shopping possible Facilities are very clean and well put My only concern is the long waiting time at the border control

Chiang Mai to Khon Kaen with Kan Air A small but very efficient airline ATR very clean ground staff did a great job and the biggest surprise options between fish and chicken meal with rice for a minute flight with rounds of drinks I choose this airline as the fastest way to go from Korat airport closed to Chiang Mai via Khon Kaen to avoid a hour bus ride As for the price this was half than a bus ticket to Chiang Mai Excellent

What a great flight of hour and minutes Aircraft was clean departure was on time and crew was very friendly Legroom is reasonable for such a small plane No IFE or wifi but inflight service was very good with options of sandwiches juices coffee and chocolate
Great regional airport Min check in time for Lufthansa flights is mins Good connections via MUC to international destinations Reasonable amenities at the airport

This airport is so backward its unreal Today you get charged nearly three euros to get hot water for your own teabag You get charged ten euros development fee as you leave Same as Galway airport ten years ago six euros to get out again development fee now its shut Last time I flew from Knock the fee was the same Never went back because of the fee Now the place has hardly changed where did that money go Great idea to put an airport on top of a hill dont have to come down so far but hardly a great advert for Irish aviation or Mayo
A small but full service airport Doesnt have some of the amenities of larger airports but you would not expect them Clean Great service Short wait times Highly recommended

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

As the previous reviewer noted Eilat airport terminal is in the centre of the city and surrounded by hotels I didnt believe the taxi driver for a few seconds when he dropped us there Once inside we got a thorough grilling by security and our bags swabbed throughout for explosives I think we got extra attention as foreigners but the female security official was very friendly and jovial much nicer that the humourless officials who you normally meet Checkin and hand baggage checks were quick and easy as the only flight was our seater Arkia departure There is a shopcafe on both landside and airside parts but we didnt get a chance to try either Overall it does the job well just be prepared for the security

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more

Sharm el Sheikh to Dusseldorf When I got to the airport I found out that my flight was delayed by minutes I had asked the ground staff to please check my luggage through to Hamburg as I had a connecting flight with Eurowings from Dusseldorf The agent informed me that he could easily check me through but he would need the permission from Germania He wrote an email to them and so I had to wait about minutes until he had shown me their response The response stated that they had no agreement with Eurowings and that I would need to pick up my luggage and check it in with them again As the flight was already delayed by minutes I would miss my connecting flight in Dusseldorf to Hamburg When I had arrived in Dusseldorf I had found out that my luggage was not carried on my flight Lucky me my connecting flight was cancelled Theoretically the Ground Service does not even deserve a one star rating The Crew on the other side was very friendly and provided great service Seat on the aircraft was very comfortable and I had enough space for my legs as well

Sydney to Tianjin via Zhengzhou My wife and I could not have been happier with the flight service food and entertainment options provided Staff were great and went out of their way to help other guests We read a lot of reviews prior to our trip and can honestly say we did not experience negative factor Great choices on meals and entertainment pillows and blankets surprising amount of legroom in economy We are going back to China soon and dont see any reason to travel with another airline Great pricing and options for further exploration in China add to the airlines appeal

Billund is an excellent airport with good facilities practical layout and friendly and efficient staff My only gripe is the airport bus which is extortionate DKK to Aarhus and runs at often perplexing times that seem to have no correlation to when major flights are landing Ive travelled here every other month from various UK airports for about years and sometimes have to wait up to hours to get away As the airport is far from where most foreign travellers want to be unless they really like Lego you often have little option but to wait for the bus or pay even more for a taxi

Excellent flight great room and staff were excellent Little English is spoken I had originally booked Hainan but they cancelled initial booking and booked me to Capital Very limited entertainment and glad I had a book

Bennett at the TSA first check point was so incredibly sweet to our son and his attitude was great Im sure everyone that works for the TSA feels this way on the inside but he was clearly showing it to us on the outside Keeper

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

The whole experience was very professional Flight was completely comfortable clean and the air crew were friendly and helpful The flight was on time and the in flight service was just excellent for such a short flight

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport

Frankfurt to Sao Paulo with TAM Airlines Service was attentive friendly and acceptable for economy class Food is as good or less good as with other airlines Seat is standard and what you get for economy The IFE is rather slow and not as quickly responding as for example in the of LAN Overall a good and pricewise interesting way to travel to South America Luggage was damaged upon return at FRA but ground staff not interested in being friendly or understanding

I flew Yeti Airlines June from Bhairahawa the airport near Lumbini the birthplace of Buddha to the capital Kathmandu It was a morning flight on time the ground staff were friendly cabin crew was friendly They served soft drinks on this minute flight Reading material offered The jetstream is a turboprop engine aircraft and has seating capacity for person in an x arrangement The flight was smooth Yeti Airlines has the reputation of flying on time Though its safety record is not very encouraging but has been spotless and blemish free since it separated its mountains region operations in the name of Tara air as its subsidiary Sky miles their frequent flyer program is very popular and has many other benefits like discounts in hotels than award tickets The name Yeti also is an attraction to the visitors

Malaga to Birmingham I booked this flight online one week before flying I needed to book for adults one child and one infant However I found when checking prices it was cheaper make two separate bookings than the whole group at once I booked for two adults then another booking for one adult and two children This is unbelievable Also you arent allowed to check in online until hours before you fly unless you book a seat for euros each Which is a bit impossible as you are in holiday at this point Just another money making scam However we booked for free while in Spain and our hotel were kind enough to print our boarding passes for us The plane was clean but the seating is just too cramped My husband had sit with his knee protruding into the isle and the trolley kept knocking him when going past Food and drinks are too expensive luckily we bought some snacks and refreshments from the departure lounge before leaving Malaga The staff however are really helpful and Im sure they know its not the comfortable of places to sit for hours and do make an effort in making people feel welcome and providing a good service They were quick to help with the needs of my month old The pilot kept us informed of any changes as we were experiencing a lot of turbulence We were also informed as we approached the UK coastline and also times for arrival were given The plus side we didnt have any hold luggage and were able to check in infants pram at the departure gate Meaning we didnt have to wait in the long bag check in queues Overall we paid premium prices for seats on a below average quality plane Thanks to the stewards for their efforts in trying to compensate for this

I commute regularly between Perpignan and Manchester and it is my favourite airportIt only has one cafe and one shop but these are conveniently situated and adequate for the number of people there I can walk yards to check in there are rarely any queues and there is no need to rush through security The place is small but thats its charm no hassle no long walks and friendly and helpful staff To fly from most airports you need to allow a good two hours to get from a dropoff point to check in and then to a gate In Perpignan minutes suffices

Having used Tijuana many times in the past I was surprised while using it recently after a year break The renovations are still under way but it is a clean modern and efficient airport that works well The queues are generally quick and the staff know what theyre doing With some great connections to mainland Mexico and a couple of new discount airlines using the airport it is a great alternative to SAN Only annoying bit is the lack of any decent food and beverage once youre through security Over priced and average The upside is you can check in for most flights in Mexico up to minutes before take off so basically you can just walk through security and to the gate

Arrival was great with no queues and security quick and easy Luggage arrived on carrousel very quickly Departure less good with long queues at security and long waits Fortunately plenty of seats in departure lounge Not much to do in lounge and poor range of food outlets WiFi free but nonexistent and unable to connect

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Friendly flight attendant who take care of the passengers efficiently Excellent flight but the cabin of the Dash needs a very serious refresh and more confortable seats The flight time was respected On the gate the employees of Air Canada Jazz offer a good service

Los Angeles to Cusco via Lima We were pleasantly surprised when Lan Airlines delivered our luggage hour from the airport the day after we landed American Airlines in the US didnt tell us sbout collecting our luggage in Lima before flying to Cusco must go through Customs so it never arrived in Cusco Lan Airlines Personnel were very helpful to fill the forms out and to deliver was unexpected Thanks for helping make our trip great

Security was good because you didnt have to get liquids or electronics out of your bag Airport was clean and spacious My one huge complaint however is the service in Autogrill Italia The staff member asked me if I would like to pay times without putting it through to the card machine She would just point at it and then say PAY There was a language barrier but I feel there may have been an intelligence barrier because I stood there for mins wanting to pay and not being able to

LX from Vienna to Zurich operated by Helvetic Airways The flight was completely full but boarding was expertly handled by the crew and went very smoothly The EE is a small aircraft and space in the overhead bins is limited The crew assisted passengers with finding a place for their carryon luggage and in the end all luggage could be stored somewhere Also the crew were very friendly and courteous As this was a very short flight a small snack was served which was excellent All in all a very comfortable short flight on a small aircraft with an excellent crew

A modern and moderate sized airport for the capital of Finland Staff was friendly and helpful queuing times were very short due to modern handluggage scanners The terminal itself isnt very big but has an easy to follow layout There are a lot of dutyfree stores and foodcourts of course theyre all overpriced as one might expect Connection to town is offered by trainconnection All in all a good experience

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time

Jeju to Seoul The online website to purchase tickets was easy to use as a foreigner There was an English option unlike Tway air The checkin boarding process was very efficient The plane was spacious and the seats comfortable for a budget airline I would fly with them again

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

Johannesburg to Cape Town The SLOW lounge at JNB sets the standard with an impressive array of food even at am and ample seating The bar service is good too and some neighbours had already finished their third refill of pink champagne by the time they boarded the same flight As is common on other BA flights Group passengers were kept waiting on the airbridge before boarding actually commenced Service on board was friendly and efficient but very much old school BA as far as the fourcourse lunch was concerned At least one was able to see the main course before choosing it Departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule and baggage collection was speedy too Overall a decent flight

The passenger terminal in Fargo has limited but all the essential services I used it for arriving and departing to hub cities for onward connections Taxi drivers were near the baggage belts soliciting fares On departure you check in on the main floor and take escalators one flight up To your left is a large enough gift shop with the usual items plus North Dakota State University memorabilia On the right is a food court with a few eateries including a Subway The security check was smooth Once on the airside there is a coffee shop and a kiosk of a shop a miniatiure version of the gift shop on the other side There are quite a few chairs and signage is good A very easy airport to use and quick to get out of and quick to get in

I arrived from Phnom Penh and then departed to Bangkok On arrival at the domestic airport there was no air bridge and it was a very short walk to the main building It took a while for the luggage to come out but luckily the arrival area was not crowded Departed from the international terminal to Bangkok The terminal was new and clean and check in staff very friendly and helpful There was only one security line open but the queue wasnt too long After security there were few shops and a great Plaza Premium Lounge if you fly Bangkok Airways they also offer their own lounge The Plaza Premium lounge was quiet well design and spacious Overall a great and smooth departure experience

Beijing to Pyongyang The aircraft was clean cabin crew friendly and the flight on time You get the Pyongyang Times to read aboard I flew for the first time this type of a Tupolev and found not much difference to some other aircraft The food was acceptable The selections of beverages could be better

The refurbishment is finished Everything looked clean and new Fast checkin Information screens were giving correct and uptodate information Good catering facilities to have a drink coffee or sandwich Cheap duty free shops which are not the biggest but still have a good assortment of quality products spirits sweets perfumes etc

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

I would like to share my positive experience with Egypt Air as this Airline have really exceeded my expectations Friendly and professional cabin crew with delicious catering Highly recommended and for sure will fly Egypt Air again

The airport is a charming little place up on the Sunshine Coast There are only about flights a day going to Sydney and Melbourne It has recently been upgraded and expanded the gate area is much bigger and has food outlets and toilets It opens up on to the runway and provides nice views Its an easy airport to handle as it isnt too big to get lost in but isnt so small so as to feel cramped The butterfly sanctuary between checkin and security which must be walked through as it is on the pathway is a lovely touch and provides a unique atmosphere The ground staff are very friendly If heading up to the Sunshine Coast it is often cheaper and quicker to fly direct rather than to Brisbane and by far it is an easier airport to use

Great regional airport by Spanish Standards Easy to Navigate when both landing and departing Arrivals was easy immigration was quick and at the end of the arrivals lounge is the transit bus to the city centre minutes from getting of the plane and on a bus into the city Check in was easy and simple the only departures terminal has about check in desks in the main hall and queues at security where not to long The airside shopping is adequate and walking to the furthest gate takes no more than minutes

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

Good checkin and boarding excellent lounge but a disappointing experience with an unfriendly and ignorant worker at the security check There were only a few passengers at the airport no queue at the checkin counter The lounge was impeccable with a friendly staff a very good choice of snacks drinks and reading material The only negative moment was in the priority security line despite that there were no passengers in the line right after am The worker who checked my passport and boarding pass sternly told me that next time she would not allow me to use the priority security line if I dont present my Silver Finnair Plus card The Priority Security note was boldly printed in a big font on my boarding pass which she was holding in her hand so Im afraid to think she could not read English RIX in general is a good airport but the management has to teach priority security line workers to read and understand at least two words in English Priority Security

Had an excellent experience travelling through Dublin airport to Miami The security was efficient We precleared US customs and immigration which took minutes saving us from having to do it through Miami There was a good choice of food and drink but very limited once you enter the US zone

After so many negative comments I believe a positive is in order Honolulu to Lanai check in a breeze courteous and friendly we paid per bag but now only Flight basically on time aircraft ATR quite comfortable after all flight is only minutes Flight attendants very friendly juice and water offered Bags delivered promptly Will fly them back to HNL and will only post if flight is any less enjoyable

La Paz Sucre in an exMexicana Ticketing process is manual and very slow beware and get your tickets before the airport We were handed a little snack bag as we boarded then served drinks on board a great way to provide good service on a short flight
Makassar to Singapore Crowded flight Long checkin queue and time The takeoff is smooth Great service a good meal The flight attendant is great
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

Have flown with Air Canada many times and have always had a good experience Our last trip was to Florence via Zurich Flights LX out and LX in No issues whatsoever Check in was smooth boarding in Toronto was about the easiest we have experienced in a while seats were fine service was good The only minor issue was that the seatback in the seatback in front of me was broken somehow and I couldnt put the tray back easily Also whats with offering WiFi but only to Aeroplan members of a certain level I find that annoying Other that that everything was good

Berne Airport Airport of the Capital of Switzerland is a regional airport with connections to Europes major cities Also connecting to the international hubs of Munich and Amsterdam CheckIn time only minutes prior to departure time Airport Authority is building a new terminal which will be opened by may Temporary terminal is in use until the opening of the new terminal Staff is very friendly The motto is to serve the passenger from leaving the taxi or public transport until boarding the aircraft

Frankfurt to Berlin our first flight was cancelled but they arranged me other flight Next day I use Air Berlin also this time their service was on time and good service and cabin crew they are very friendly and helpful I was very happy their service

SJO is a very modern airport immigration is friendly but asks to see all your papers come prepared if you do not hold your tickets carpeted floor free wifi Internet expensive gift shops and food carts taxi fare is high usd for a minutes drive before checking in you must pay departure tax it now costs usd you can pay with credit card overall good experience I will be back in the summer

There are many different airport choices for this area Harrisburg MDT offers a good selection of carriers United Delta US Air Air Canada Allegiant which does wonders to keep the prices reasonable Which makes it an appealing choice relative to Hagerstown State College Lancaster or Williamsport There are also only gates in the terminal The daily parking garage is an easy walk theres a shuttle to longterm parking and a reasonable number of places to eat The terminal is clean reasonably quiet and very easy to navigate and use Unlike Philly Baltimore Pittsburgh or Reagan National

The airport is clean very functional and not too big to the point it becomes customer unfriendly As expected most products available to buy are well overpriced Passport control and security was a breeze

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight
The set of counters of Cathay Dragon was a bit out of order since every counter was excessively full due to the great number of passengers Business Class and Marco Polo Club and Oneworld Members

Overall our experience my wife and myself in transit twice in KGL has been satisfactory certainly compared with airports in the region with regard to seating not very comfortable but OK cleanliness including toilets signage and announcements attitude of official personnel security and boarding procedures Free WIFI did not work However we have been ripped off when purchasing goods from the VIVA GLOBAL DUTY FREE SHOP billed much higher prices than advertised no receipt received for some goods which we also paid far too much in USD We did not have our luggage on arrival at destination travel with Rwandair to BRU our suitcases arrived early next day via another company but we had to collect them from the airport since Rwandair does not have a policy of sending delayed luggage to the home

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in
An old Fokker departure and arrival on time very smooth landing proficient bilingual staff and excellent food omelette with herbs coleslaw and chicken

Went to Anchorage in late Airport has some restaurants on the security side of the airport but not a good choice and the quality was not too good The gift shops on the other hand are excellent especially if you are looking for Native American art Be warned that quite a few souvenirs are like snow shakers with water which will be taken off you by security if you need to pass through them again Information screens were useful Plenty of seating and quite a view out of the terminal window
