Facing similar difficulties in redeeming miles as mentioned in our recent BKKKIX review we had to additionally pay for possible unusable future miles for this route class We were contacted at least thrice for seat changes to end up with this aircraft The aircraft has seat configuration seats A G K The seat seems narrow storage space is limited fully reclined bed is possible but youd need to rise up to use this feature Although the A seat is a window seat but your feet always point to the aisle and some seats may not be able to see out of the window The G K seats are worse since both have feet pointed to the opposite and face each other Thus no privacy is assured as hypothesised The IFE has no map features only elapsed times are available aircrew couldnt get the map features for me Honestly we notice that service quality varies depending upon who youre ROPStar Alliance status ages familiarity with crew etc This flight was over booked and some were offered to downgrade to PE with USD compensation experiencing what just described we regret that we didnt take that offer As THAI loyal customers wed suggest the airline to consider our comments to improve its quality to be competitive with other Star Alliance carriers in the similar routes which we had rated all of them as excellent

Round trip from Guatemala to Roatan via San Pedro Sula and Tegucigalpa respectively June For all hour flying segments service was exemplary lunch box on every flight with delicious sandwiches On the way back departing Roatan plane was intensively checked for an oil leakage threatening our connection at Tegucigalpa with passengers getting nervous about the situation but TACA agent in the waiting room was reassuring Even offered a free phone call to Guatemala The plane got fix and we landed just in time in Tegucigalpa with TACA personnel waiting for us at the door of the plane with umbrellas over the tarmac to get to the other plane When we landed in Guatemala all luggage arrived too Great service from all the involved staff at all the airports and flights

Excellent small airport Arrived from JFK and departed to JFK homepoint DTW Arrival It was raining so as a courtesy we were bussed to terminal ride minutes Passage through passport control took minutes The passport control officer smiled and welcomed me Ample shops landside I was able to buy postcards and stamps to mail them to friends Taxicabs to town do not have meters rate is fixed at euros Careful driver clean taxicab Departure minutes at security minutes at passport control Passport control officer smiled again why are US CBP personnel so unable to master the skill of smiling Airside only tiny snack shop Lovely sunny morning so we walked a few feet on tarmac and up staircase into airplane

We booked a day trip to Luxor from Sharm and flew Air Memphis Aircraft was an old MD which was tired looking inside and out but clean Friendly cabin crew juice and a snack were served Dont let appearances put you off

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

Yangon to Mandalay Lounge photo and In flight meal photo are added We can access Lounge at Yangon International Airport for all Business Class traveler variety of Breakfast Lounge is located at the rd floor of Yangon International Airport Terminal for domestic In flight meal is great but simple because it is just a hour short flight

It is not the most beautiful airport in the world but not the worst I always found it OK speed to checkin pass passport control is OK Shopping cheap and wide range of products VIP Lounge comfortable but old fashioned The information system is getting better and friendliness of officials is good

Check in in Bangkok swift and friendly lounges and boarding in Bangkok and Hong Kong always top notch Service and catering on both flights good What annoys me with flying economy on CX is their unwillingness to credit any Avios in non CX One World programs I was willing to pay a higher fare to get my points but there isnt any which credits points in Economy That is the reason to make me think twice to fly Cathay again in Y in the future

I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to the staff of Lost Found at the Venice airport At arrival at Venice Marco Polo airport my suitcase was lost The staff there was very helpful throughout the process in my application and delivery of my suitcase to my home address The luggage was delivered within hours So I was delighted with the service and want to give credit to staff and delivery Thank you

Flew Lublin to Heraklion Very comfortale trip without delays friendly helpful and professional crew good amtosphere on board everything fast and without problems I felt safe during the journey and I think that I will choose Small Planet for my next year holiday
It was very great flying in Vistara today then any other Company I liked this because of several reasons like hospitality Seat comfort cabin staff service food Etc Keep it up

I had not heard of Air KBZ before I made the booking for my Myanmar trip However all of the three domestic flights Mandalay to Thandwe Thandwe to Sittwe and Sittwe to Yangon went very well ontime arrivals food and beverages free of charge although the flights were short friendly staff modern and clean aircraft I would fly Air KBZ again in case I return to Myanmar

Neos airline division of TUI Germany You can web checkin and you can change seat allocation without pay Plane arrived on time boarding and welcome was professional and crew was helping passengers with their carryons to be placed on bins New and clean aircraft service was great with two servings with tasty food and good variety of juices do not offer beverages but have wine coffee tea IFE is only drop screens to see the flight path and you can hear music from channels with earphones buy or your own

Infrastructure lacking excellent welcoming courtesy Plane from VIE landed on the one runway turned around and taxied to a parking area from which we descended staircases promptly rolled up to the front and rear doors This airport does not know the concept of gate We walked to a huge barn of a building and all joined the line of nonUkrainians At this point some passport control official undertook a mental exercise called thinking lets open the other line for Ukrainians for these passengers That immediately cut the wait in half my wait was minutes The passport official who stamped my passport smiled note to US CBP agents thats when the ends of the mouth go up and said Welcome Then enter the other half of the huge building with a currency exchange a clean bathroom and not much else Overeager taxicab drivers were in abundance but I and many of us took the Viking bus to our river cruise ship

Excellent flight more leg room than other airlines cabin stewardess who was excellent and tended to all passenger requirements served all passengers with complimentary food with drink which is unknown nowadays Good old fashioned service and customers do count Flight from Waterford VG th June
Its easy to get around very friendly people and easy to get bags and leave Always a good experience and they have free wifi so never a problem with communication

A nicely laidout airy and spacious airport with excellent facilities and courteous staff a proper Estonian showpiece With TLL only km from the city centre taxi fares are very reasonable Security was efficient and from a UK perspective refreshingly unofficious

GRX is fairly spacious for a regional airport Very clean marble interior with plenty of seats landside to use without having to buy anything are you listening UK airports and even though it has only one caferestaurant the food is usually great value edible and affordable lots of tapas dishes too Longshort stay parking amazingly cheap Airbus service to city is aways available and there always seem to be plenty of taxis waiting outside Very friendly security staff too A good alternative to using Malaga airport

I guess the main factor to consider when assessing TVM aiport is perspective Most visitors to the airport are NRI returning home Hence issues like good shopping and dining dont really matter to most As an NRI what I really want is fast processing whether it is arrival or departure This has historically been the major lament about Indian aiports In this regard TVM airport gets top marks It is easy to drive into and there is good parking space Ticketing security checks and immigration are fairly quick and the aiport staff do not hassle you as long as you have your valid documents ready it is better to have a printed ticket with you It is not a fancy airport although the buildings are modern and clean but I am very proud of it

Newark to Paris As a result of the delays in receiving their ALR aircraft Premera air contracted EuroAtlantic to fly the Newark ParisCDG routeThe check in took about mins as it was a full flight It took about mins to get through security at Newark due to the lack of TSA staff and screening equipmentThe seats were comfortable ahd a personal TV screen in each seat which had a limited selection of films and TV shows There was also a USB port to charge personal devices There were no headphones offered on board luckily we had our own set The scheduled flight time was hrs mins we took off about mins late but we managed to arrive on time into CDG The EuroAtlantic staff were friendly and attentive and looked after the passengers on the flight Meals and drinks were provided to those passengers who booked their meals through the Primera air website Overall this flight was great value for money

Quick flight with good service and friendly staff Checkin was efficient Aircraft was clean and welcoming Only negative was the arrival at a station where bussing brought us back to the terminal rather than an airbridge
Great airport Excellent shopping facilities Very clear directions Very helpful staff A cut above the rest of the small airports I have visited

Tular to Antananarivo Quick Checkin on time plane a bit old refreshments and a snack served friendly flight attendants The fare was somehow high but this is Madagascar You shouldnt come here if you are pampered by lowcost carriers

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

Cusco Airport is another wonderfully crowded and poorly designed airfield in Peru ie Lima Chiclayo Byzantine brutalist concrete architecture aside this airport is by far the worst designed for providing any kind of logical flow for a singlerunway airport serving a large metropolitan area It would seem that nobody in government has looked at what can be done with the cramped space and volume of passengers to try and make a more hospitable clean and userfriendly facility Unfortunately this airport will remain the sole thoroughfare for all international Machu Picchu travelers for the foreseeable future Maybe Peru can step up to the plate and make some major changes to this facility and take a field trip to Quito and check out their new airport which is very nice

TimisoaraMunich The flight was h min and operated on a SAAB which was in pretty good shape I believe these are former Crossair props Was offered a decent breakfast on this flight although a little bit disappointed that the cheese omlette was cold Otherwise good selection of drinks and friendly crew Overall a good deal for the price Would fly them again

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

We booked a day trip to Luxor from Sharm and flew Air Memphis Aircraft was an old MD which was tired looking inside and out but clean Friendly cabin crew juice and a snack were served Dont let appearances put you off

Having stepped off an A a day before it was quite a strange experience to be one of just four passengers on the seater propeller ATR aircraft from Bangkok to Laos But the one hour and fiftyminute flight experience was lovely Following the traditional Sabaidee greeting from the friendly twoperson cabin crew we took off on time The elegantly uniformed flight attendant had a frangipani placed in her hair echoing the countrys national flower as well as it being in the airlines logo The x seating was comfortable with ample leg room Although a small airline it had an inflight magazine It was a sunny day and flying at around feet we had a clear view of the mountainous green scenery below A small snack box was offered which contained a tuna and cheese sandwich and drink and hot coffee was also served On arrival at Luang Prabang stepping out umbrellas were available just in case you found it too hot or if it was raining to walk to the terminal building The return flight was also on time this time with around or so passengers nearly all enjoying posing for photos by the aircraft
UIA is always a great experience in businessclass Great service onboard Very lovely crew The lounges in KBP and MUC are also very relaxing Looking forward to flying UIA again

Flew KigaliNairobiDar and return midMarch Aircrafts were all on ageing B except the st leg was on the smaller Embraer A flight cancellation was clearly announced days in advance allowing for alternative and even better options compared to original schedule All flights on time FAs catering and seating were all good Could select my preferred exit seat free with amble legroom through KQs homepage Transfers in Nairobi were smooth Twothree pieces of luggage were received well both ways Paid access to lounge in Nairobi discounted to USD due to Silver status with Kenya airways Miles earned and given generous luggage allowance together with the inexpensive ticket make this detour over Nairobi worth the trouble as compared to direct flight alternatives All flights on time
A small but friendly airport which is quite central The facilities are adequate for the size of the country It is clean and tidy and the staff are helpful

Its been years since I traveled through Terminal The refurbished Terminal is a world class modern airport terminal It is spacious brightly lit with plenty of seating and dining options aplenty There are oodles of power ports and USB ports at the gates however some of the power ports were not working Bathrooms are very clean The concourses are wide and directions easy to follow to baggage claim Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished terminal is a significant upgrade to the old terminal

CPTGBE GBEJNB First flight a clean Bae in very good condition half empty with loads of leg room Food excellent for an airline and service find Second flight on an equally clean ATR with equally good snacks All flights on time Much prefer them to SAX or Airlink

Used this airline for an internal flight in China last October from Kunming to Lijiang and just had to take some photos etc but not a joke crisp new airline with latest Boeings smart logos etc Short flight but adequate English used and friendly crew

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

Domestic arrivals quick and easy No holdups at Baggage Reclaim or delays getting into Arrivals Hall International Departures in separate building which looks like it has just been finished Nov with a number of Islands with associated Checkin Desks and machines all on one level Relatively quick and then onwards to Departures which are up a set of escalators leading directly to a small but efficient security scan area Beyond that was Passport Control split into Argentinian passport holders and everyone else Not much of a queue and things moved quickly into the Departure Lounge Selection of shops selling local things duty free big named alcoholcigarettes etc spreading out left right as the gates were all along one side looking out towards the apron and taxiways Friendly helpful staff at the food cafe with good snackfood selection available Clear announcements and reasonable departure boards around the lounge area Boarding process quite slick with separate clearly labelled queues Quite a long taxi to the runway Pretty good airport for the capital city gateway to the country

Thoroughly enjoyed our experience Friendly staff seats felt spacious Delicious meals Our inter island flights were great too loved being able to disembark through both doors Take note interisland flights have lower weight for carry on but checking a bag is free so it was just fine

ARNHEL on the standard B Clean and airy cabin legroom fine for such a short hop Coffeetea served for free Courteous FAs gave out a stuffed toy for the baby in our party and took extra care explaining how the infants seatbelt worked Bags were on the belt in minutes at HEL

There is also an excellent restaurant on the mezzanine floor overlooking the runway It opens at noon which gives adequate time for a good lunch before the departure of the Luton flight at Information on bus transportation to and within Nimes is at httpwwwtcnfr

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

Beijing to Pyongyang The aircraft was clean cabin crew friendly and the flight on time You get the Pyongyang Times to read aboard I flew for the first time this type of a Tupolev and found not much difference to some other aircraft The food was acceptable The selections of beverages could be better

Nanjing to Xian The check in process for this flight was smooth Cabin crew were friendly and courteous Hot meal with beverages were served However the standard of the in flight catering was neither appealing nor appetizing The passengers who sat next to me even returned the meal to the flight attendant It is indeed below average Only Chinese movies is available from the drop down LED screen Tianjin Airlines have plenty of room for improvement

Flew Shanghai to Tinajin Although crowded at times in the summer heat everything went well Checkin queues were very long I was lucky to check in at one of the numerous golden pass counters as have been invited by my companion Although Hongqiao is for domestic flights it is not difficult for a foreigner like me to have the right orientation Airport is clean and very clear and correspond to high international standards

Beautiful state of the art equipment but some poor organisation despite lots of friendly staff Nobody tells you the procedure join this queue then shuffle along only to be told you should have gone to the luggage weighin queue first Weigh luggage then rejoin back of check in queue Told to go to security shuffle along for a bit then someone asks for departure card Leave security queue go to desk where you collect and fill departure card then rejoin back of security queue Suggest check in desk staff give you a departure card so you will know to fill it in before going through security Takes a while to shuffle through that and go through immigration departure check then security check All took about one and a half hours At gate we were divided into groups Not enough seats for group although most passengers are in this group Infrastructure is very impressive and no doubt they will eventually streamline procedures Sign posting would be a good start Shopping and dining facilities are mostly not yet open so I cannot comment on this aspect yet So first taste of new terminal not half bad Clean spacious excellent kit friendly staff but poor procedures

Flew via Halifax on way from Heathrow to Toronto As its a pretty small airport theres not that much to do apart from look at the lobsters in the lobster shop we couldnt believe it when so many people were boarding planes carrying lobster boxes There are a few eateries both land and airside which are not wildly overpriced just average food on offer Tim Hortons provided a decent sandwich Overall we quite enjoyed the hours we spent there though If you go up the lift in the main concourse area theres a small viewing platform room which is a calm and relaxing place to be We watched the few planes that came in and out for minutes before going through security Everywhere there are plenty of staff to offer help all dressed in lovely tartan uniforms and without exception totally friendly There is also free wifi so we took full advantage of that We did ask one member of staff if we had time to go and see Halifax She replied in a friendly but blunt way Youd have to take a bus to get there and theres not really much to see anyway Its small but clean efficient and did the job for the few hours stopover

Hiroshima is a small regional airport with virtually all flights internal Japanese flights Most westerners visit Hiroshima using land routes from other cities so the airport is not as western friendly as bigger Japanese airports This means there are few public announcements in English though the standard of English for check in staff was very good The food concession stands also cater to Japanese tastes only so you are out of luck if you only like western food There are also no magazines or books in any language other than Japanese Surprisingly wide range of souvenirs though most wont be much use to long haul travelers eg frozen salmon steaks oysters etc Transport to downtown very good as a limousine bus leaves from outside terminal and arrives pretty much next to the Bomb Dome which most people are going to

An excellent short flight with great onboard service from a friendly attentive cabin crew Leg room was ok and the seats were comfortable enough for a short flight Overall a good experience and good value

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

This is a great airport us my wife and self We fly from it twice a year We have just returned from Lanzarote We had no problems at all until we arrived back at hrs mins late There was a full plane load of passengers and only Border Control Officers on duty We were stood in a snakelike queue for nearly half an hour in a room that was like a shed I think that Border Control can do a lot better and should be doing so After saying this we are flying from Doncaster again in Sept

Excellent airport with ample space and good architecture Checkin very efficient Immigration officers very friendly because now there is a small machine on the left side with which you can evaluate the service of service of the officer from poor to excellent in grades It is true that it doubles as a military airport but you could have a rare sight of military jets standing nearby

Berlin to Paris Flight on time clean and modern plane It was impossible to buy any drinks due to an issue with their visa machine The crew was ok but they could smile a bit more At Orly airport we had to disembark by bus which took minutes to finally be at the south terminal

Minsk Airport was recently renovated and even though the layout may be outdated it looks brand new The airport is easy to get around and there are plenty of signs and directions for the passengers I did not experience any queues at all neither at checkin nor with the security and passport control it was all very quick and professional The terminal is extremely clean just like the city is which is almost surreal at times given that it is the place where thousands of people pass through every single day Food and shopping options seem standard for the airport of this size there is a dutyfree shop a souvenir shop fast food restaurant and a few cafeterias The only problem is that I havent seen any money exchange offices Airport staff are very professional and efficient When it comes to wifi there is a minute free connection however one can buy a very cheap wifi service for several days which also works in the city The main downside of the airport is the fact that it is so far away from the city and that there are no low cost options
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Not bad
Excellent timely departure and arrival The cabin was clean the staff kind and the bags were promptly delivered Nothing to complain about

Dont understand all negative reviews yes you can not compare this airport to a modern European or US one but short lines friendly people despite unfriendly behaving tourists enough seating to wait Smooth entry into the country expect to enter a country that is years back in time and you will enjoy your trip
Kualanamu airport is very good Check in counters are good the waiting room is comfortable and clean But the toilets are not too clean but no problem The airport staff are good

It is a mediumsize International airport located in the city easy to arrive Served with all the big airlines companies in Brazil and also Surinam Airways TAP Portugal and flights to Miami and Fort Lauderdale by LATAM and AZUL The terminal is clean and offers lots of options for shopping and food The departure lounge could be bigger Sometimes it is filled of people and the seats are not enough The staff are good and prepared

Frankfurt to Sao Paulo with TAM Airlines Service was attentive friendly and acceptable for economy class Food is as good or less good as with other airlines Seat is standard and what you get for economy The IFE is rather slow and not as quickly responding as for example in the of LAN Overall a good and pricewise interesting way to travel to South America Luggage was damaged upon return at FRA but ground staff not interested in being friendly or understanding

HELLPA return with A Booked flights months earlier and reservation for exit seats for extra charge from their call center was kept at check in Generous legroom Friendly attentive crew flight deck announcements and clean aircraft made hrs flight more enjoyable for a leisure flight Also our pre booked Holiday Meal on outbound flight was surprisingly tasty and hot and portions were more filling than we have had for this route with other carriers Only minus was inbound flight meal which was bit tasteless perhaps due to LPA catering Drinks for purchase but all in all flight with them DK offered more holiday feeling than our national carriers charter flight offers Baggage came fast at LPA but in HEL it took more than min due to ground handling problems

Friendly ground staff at checkin Immigration a breeze Duty free shop limited though Smoking area present in departure lounge Some restaurants available for those feeling peckishat cut throat prices considering the price VIP lounge looked cozy enough didnt go in Departure area great for plane spotting All in all a clean facility well run not overwhelmed yet
Mediumsized modern airport clean and easy to navigate around Easy public transport to and from city centre

I flew from Blackpool airport to Belfast for the first time I always fly from Liverpool to Belfast with Easyjet but the flight times were better and it was slightly cheaper to fly with Jet from Blackpool I was expecting a small airport with limited facilities but nothing prepared me for the facilities here Parking is free which was a bonus for me when booking on arrival however both car parks P and P were full and ended up abandoning my car on a grass area known as an overfill car park This was a minute walk to the airport On arrival there was nothing before the departure lounge The cash machine was out of service and WHSmiths closed Paying the airport charge was no problem and I was assisted with my baggage tag by a very helpful Jet worker The worst experience was going through security where the staff were extremely rude not just with me but with an elderly couple in front of me I agree that security needs to be strict but not intrusive and this was made a much more uncomfortable experience by the rudeness and lack of customer service with the staff I will never be using this airport again and even after a drink from the limited choice in the cafebar I was still reeling I can safely say this is the st and last time I will use this airport

Very clean and well taken care of This airport is served by so many great airlines with diverse destinations I do think that GRR needs more international routes At GRR the airport is not too big so it makes efficient travel Also they have a good selection of shops and stores The airport facility looks really modern and cool for being over years old The only cons is that sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the staff doesnt manage high groups of passengers well Would give an if I could

Flown HanedaChitose and FukuokaHaneda in the new A Very good seats almost like business class seats Service on board was excellent Drinks and snacks for a small fee about euro for a coffee Will fly with them again when in Japan

Thumbs up for Belfast City Airport Excellent revamp New improved security area Bigger Duty Free Shop not sharing any space with other retail Much more passenger seating Good new bar with charging points and a family table service area The views of the apron have not been compromised This makeover is long overdue now gives Belfast International a run for its money and much more user friendly than London City my final destination today

Apias airport has been upgraded and presents a warm pacific feeling The immigrationcustoms staff should be taught to smile though especially after tourists are sold on the idea of a friendly pacific paradise proudly operated by the friendliest people on earth

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Kaohsiung International Airport is great but small There are some shops and restaurants The biggest point is that the airport is clean quiet and efficient the directions are clear as well Besides this international airport are really near downtown Kaohsiung The subway system is partially done recently you can take the KMRT to any place in downtown

Domestic terminal is easy to use not much going on and no crowds or wait times It has sufficient seating capabilities but restaurant and shopping options are fairly limited But it serves its purpose is reasonably clean and convenient

Linz is indeed a very small airport however it serves its purpose Facilities are limited and flying in at pm I found the few shops were almost all shut The hourly bus is excellent value for money at EUR compared to the I paid in London approx EUR and only takes minutes non stop to the city centre Beware there is only ONE medium sized duty free shop after passport control

Myself and family travel via Liverpool Airport two to three times a year It remains our first choice since we began using it ten years ago where previously we tended to travel via Manchester Liverpool is smaller than most international airports but this has its benefits less crowds less queuing and easy access The staff throughout the airport are friendly and ready to help The signage is easy to read and well proportioned Lifts are available Liverpool recognises the Sunflower scheme Our experience has been security is strict but quick and friendly to get through Prices are typical airport prices for a small bottle of water reasonable I suppose when considering the ridiculous prices airports are allowed to charge where ever you go I can only presume it is down to airport owners and the high rents they charge The only shops I ever see that are really busy are the food beverage and drinks outlets Again our experience has been food is fresh and well prepared The one downside are probably the toilet facilities a bit smelly and like most airports today no free drop off zone Why airports in the name of security are allowed to charge astronomical prices for parking I have never understood Captive audience I suppose All in all I would give Liverpool Airport stars out of Freshen up the loos be the first actually run an airport for the passengers benefit in pricing and parking and you get a

Hobart Airport is much more user friendly now though the terminals have not been connected so Jetstar passengers are still relegated to the old botched international venture built for the old Ansett The new catering in domestic is good but It is shameful that there is no WiFi intenet access anywhere It would cost a few hundred dollars at the most for the Tasmanian Government to give free WiFi access at Hobart Airport and so reinforce the image it is trying to give as a progressive State It is doubtful that a private company will ever do it and Tasmania would top all the other states in lateral thinking if it did it for free

I booked this flight solely because it was by far the cheapest option for me to get to my destination on new years eve I hadnt known much about Garuda Indonesia before except for the fact that its a star airline I must say I was pleasantly surprised Everything from checkin transfers food and service was excellent I was travelling with my elderly relative for whom wed requested a wheelchair for who was escorted by hand to her seat upon boarding something which Ive ever seen on another airline We had a very tight connection in Jakarta minutes which was managed very well by ground staff at all airports The ground staff at Melbourne Airport assured me that our luggage would be loaded onto the connecting flight I was panicking when our flight from Melbourne departed slightly late due to our already tight connection but the ground staff at Jakarta Airport were preprepared and were ready waiting for us to escort us quickly to our connecting flight and we thankfully made the connection Overall a great experience

A good airport to fly in and out of Lines are not long and staff are friendly While it is outside of the city there is OC Transpo service via busways directly to downtown The only down side is that there arent many food options past security

My jewel among low cost airlines Courteous efficient and highly safety oriented cabin crew Very enjoyable flying experience thru out Every time the washroom had been used the crew checked it for cleanliness Great public announcements

There was hardly any delay just minutes The plane was old but reasonably clean Staff were friendly I could buy a good sparkling white wine The flight was safe and uneventful So bring your own noise cancelling headphone and enjoy a decent flight at low cost
The folks at Delta and Sky West were great They took great care of daughter and her room mate on their way home for spring break They made a special trip to get our bags at the Elko Airport

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

TAR Aerolineas is a new regional Mexican carrier which operates several routes in Mexico Flew a domestic route roundtrip and found the service to be topnotch Aircraft brand new and clean punctual departures and arrivals attentive ground and cabin personnel excellent value for money Would choose them again when my travel plans take me to Mexico
Very good array of shops ahead of security Very modern very clean Far nicer than the other airports that Ive encountered in Brazil

A good experience overall with Eastar Jet flying from Jeju to Gimpo The flight was cheap and easy to book on the airlines website I was sent an email a couple of days before flying Pity it was only in Korean I assumed it to be a routine one that airlines commonly send and assume I was correct as there were no repercussions Baggage is a stingy kg why and mine was I was charged for one extra kilo which seems like taking rules to extremes Everything else was satisfactory Checkin was quick the flight was more or less on time and reasonably comfortable and baggage reclaim quick

Had a great flight from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines A brief winter maintenance delay ensured a safe departure and while we experienced mild turbulence leaving Philadelphia and again upon arrival in Washington the pilots handled it smoothly Due to the conditions inflight service was not possible but safety remained the priority The Main Cabin Extra seats made for a much more comfortable experience and with a flight time of under minutes we arrived quickly and safely Republic continues to deliver a reliable and professional service for the American Airlines group

Yangon to Thandwe and pleasantly surprised by Air KBZ Snacks served onboard seats generally comfortable Organisational issues with boarding and a slight delay in departure from Yangon Check in at RGN was not very organised however once inside the departure terminal ground staff were more helpful They give you a coloured sticker to put on your shirt to ensure you get on the correct flight Would use again

AZDMHD Aseman is one of the only airlines that provides domestic flights between Yazd and Mashad Tickets are cheap and service is ok There was a delay of hr which feels endless waiting at a small domestic airport Despite the delay the flight was comfortable on a Fokker aircraft Not much legroom but fine for a flight of about mins Some snacks were included and that was ok Friendly staff

At last a quiet clean and efficient airport Terminal F without the tiresome duty free The hourly Borispil Express train will drop you off near Terminal D and you need to catch a halfhourly shuttle bus to Terminal F mainly for LCC flights as its something like a m walk otherwise The number of flights is fairly small and seemingly mainly Ryanair Plenty of room to wait just a couple of refreshment options Straightforward passport control and security no queues Plenty of seats in the departure lounge easy access to gates good view of airport operations No duty free Hooray A couple of refreshment stands No air bridges but then LCCs dont use them anyway A very relaxing experience particularly in contrast to departing from a UK airport

Really lovely small but clean airport Passport Control was really smiley and friendly and our bags were ready on the cute luggage belt by the time we were through which was quick albeit from a small BA Embraer jet Toilets were absolutely spotless

Gatwick to Prevesa We have flown now this route three times with Small Planet Airline since most recently out on and back and consider that this airline just gets better and better On the latest occasion both flights left on time and arrived early The aircraft was spotlessly clean and comfortable with smart leather seats and bright multicoloured headrest covers The friendly cabin crew were professional and safety aware whilst the commentaries from the flight deck both before take off during the flight and before landing was informative and very well executed For a no frills budget airline the catering was both plentiful and reasonably priced eg full English breakfast with coffee if you wanted it for Great to see that this airline has revived the old tradition of offering boiled sweets to all passengers with courtesy prior to the aircraft starting its descent Based on our experience I would have no hesitation in commending Small Planet Airlines

DYU to FRA Somon Air flights are very difficult to book outside Tajikstan so although their flight times suited me I ended up booking my outbound flight to Tajikstan with Turkish Air I did manage to book my return flight with some local help whilst in Tajikstan and was pleasantly surprised Aircraft was a new Boeing flight was comfortable and the cabin crew very good There were only approx passengers on the flight which is probably more to do with the problems booking rather than the quality of their service There is no TV IFE but as most of the Somon Air flights are through the night this wasnt a problem I wouldnt put anyone off flying with Somon Air but they really do need to offer flight booking outside Tajikstan with the major travel agents in order to be competitive

Seat C A swift flight mainly with Sleep as it was an overnight flight Airplane was clean although the business class seating looked very old well worn arm buttons and seat capsule panelling The Bahrain Gulf Air lounge was a super treat with Dinner options such as Pizza and Lasagne all were very good I certainly look forward to booking my next Gulf Air flight

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options

I always have great experience flying with GOL It is efficient and provides great value for money The crews are friendly and the plane looks well maintained They provide snacksmeals during their flights depending on flight duration and Decent entertainment system together with a free wifi for messaging

On our departure from Simferopol to Moscow we were very pleased with friendly and efficient service at the checkin and the information desks But upstairs in the waiting area we were struck by absolutely different attitude The attempt to have some drinks before boarding finished with success only at the third cafe Its name somehow Happy potatoes Sorry not very sure But I am absolutely sure about the names of the cafes where we were met with rudeness and unhelpful attitude The names of those cafes are Skybar and We were flying on the st of July Such a shame to be let down by such a beautiful airport

Tontouta International Airport is located km outside of Noumea If you catch a cab to the airport be prepared to pay for a twoway journey as cabbies are not guaranteed a return fare back into town Theres no point turning up early for your flight The airport only operates when flights are due to arrivedepart Checkin counters the small souvenir shop and cafe dont open till minutes prior to scheduled departures Duty free shopping is only available airside which can only be accessed minutes prior to departure Surprisingly smoking is permitted in all parts of the terminal In summary Tontouta is a very basic facility offering very basic services On a more positive note all the airports ground staff were exceptionally friendly helpful and good natured including checkin agents security immigration and customs officials

Surprisingly good experience departing Lisbon Airport Terminal on a Sunday evening with only hand luggage Far less crowded than I remembered from previous visits maybe I was lucky and security was a breeze The duty free area has been updated and toilets were clean It still has the low cost look and feel and does not have very attractive departure lounge or places to plug your phone and laptop but overall pretty efficient
The plane was modern and the cabin very clean and appealing The crew was very friendly and professional Fast check in and at Belgrade Airport the suitcases arrived very fast

Flew NIKI from Valencia to Vienna Quick boarding and ontime departure Cabin was clean and the flight was smooth and relaxed Cabin crew provided drinks and a very good cheese sandwich Later they provided us another round of water and coffee Seats a little bit narrower than other airlines Paid for a return ticket for flying with a very good airline

Great little airport Everything in one location baggage belts next to car hire desks and you walk out into the car park and collect your car Will be my preferred choice now rather than coming in via LAX or SAN and facing a hour drive

PSP is a great little airport The s style terminal is fairly well designed but with the advent of security screening areas its a bit harder to negotiate Rental cars are right outside the door from the baggage carousels The weather is seldom a problem so flights stay pretty close to their schedules Parking is reasonably priced and convenient to the terminal
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

I was stopped by the airport because i had a problem with my passport the bluebird staff did everything to help me get on the plane on time The staff ran with me to the place where they make you a new passport and the Security head took me in his car to the airplane they all did a great effort to let me fly to my destination and not cancel it Thank you guys

Not Verified The new airport is much better than the old but the issue with taxis remains The military controls the airport and hence which taxis are used No meters and extortionate fares Better off walking minutes south on road outside arrivals right angle to airport terminal and pickup a bluebird or AA cab from there Clean and metered Pity the Government does not stop in and do something about this as it is a horrible welcome to what is otherwise a friendly and interesting city and region

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

Flew Nairobi to Zanzibar with Flycom Excellent airline Flights are prompt arriving and take off is to the minute on time Ground staff are helpful as are the cabin crew Planes are clean and appear well maintained Baggage arrives with the passengers A good way to fly locally in E Africa

LAN Peru LIMLAX economy flight filled to capacity FAs friendly and competent new with the standard LAN seatback VOD Uusually for a Boeing standard size carryon luggage now actually fits in the overhead compartments noisy as usual but reasonably comfortable flight apart from the seats which have no footrest and dont recline very much good food and drinks service Booked as part of a flight from SJC to SCL the LAN booking system seems to work better now and was cheaper than booking through AAs system

PSC airport is currently undergoing remodeling and expansion which are due for completion in early With what is completed thus far the layout is a significant improvement from the old outdated one The look and feel of the airport is definitely more modern in keeping with the times Being a relatively small airport going through TSA is fairly quick At this time the restaurant options are not great but I expect them to improve upon completion I hope the airport is able to lure more flights and more airlines in the future Compared to the two relatively nearby airports YKM and ALW this is the nicest and largest of the three

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

I was very nervous as was flying on my own for the first time and with my young child All staff were very helpful from the minute we walked into the airport The lady who booked us in was so considerate When we got on to the plane we were met by Joanie she was so welcoming and involved Samuel straight away Joanie then went above and beyond during the flight to make sure we were ok and to help me keep Samuel occupied She was so kind and thoughtful and was very complementary about his behaviour To absolutely blow us away she let us meet Johnathan and Catherine I hope I have names right this made Samuels day He couldnt stop smiling Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to them all what a super team I will definitely be using Loganair again

My first time flying with Malindo now Batik Air Fabulous experience smooth checkin luggage included Friendly attentive staff Much more comfortable seats that either Air Asia or Jetstar Good pricing I have already booked another flights Impressive economy airline for the price you pay

This airport has terminals one for USA flights and one for non USA flights Not big airport Inside is very clean and staff are very helpful However there are long waiting times at immigration and customs Customs has no scanner machines so they have to open all bags for checks Needed almost hours to finish immigration and customs When departing it is very quick Inside the airport there are only a few shops

The flight was a very good price the plane was in great shape and the cabin crew were excellent The food could have been better and they ran out of wine quite early but overall a good experience and Id definitely fly with them again If you have a layover book a lounge at Shenzhen airport the food was good and the shower included in the price made a massive difference to a long journey

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

Gatwick to Denver I was placed on a Wamos flight by Norwegian and almost cancelled due to all the terrible reviews but I didnt find it that bad at all We brought our own movies to watch and our own food which I normally do on a flight anyway as I like healthy stuff Ive had worse legroom on other flights and the staff were more friendly and helpful than many others Ive known and I fly a lot The plane was pretty old but perfectly functional The staff were so great that I told them Id write a review because I felt that the pasting theyre getting online is unfair and makes us travellers look rather spoilt to be honest

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

Lovely experience through check in and security at around am this morning th July The chap at Tui desk was friendly professional and helpful All four members of staff at security were great Helpful friendly and professional Lovely atmosphere At the caf a lovely women served me Smile on her face Finally going through to boarding gate yet again a friendly cheerful and helpful lady checked me in am by this stage Its a small airport The shop and caf are small Im not here to shop or sit drinking Im here to have an ideally stress free start to my holiday The staff make this place Thank you

A brand new airport opened for Dakar in called Blaise Diagne Its infinitely better than the old one mentioned in other reviews on this page which is no longer in use The new airport is clean and modern with helpful staff Once inside I felt like I was already in Europe I had no problems with security or checked baggage

I read a huge amount of negativity about this airport prior to my trip there it was a five hour transit stop going from London to Bangkok I was certainly concerned reading all the previous reviews However I didnt experience any real issues The airport is very large so easy to find a quiet spot there are plenty of power outlets and getting online is extremely simple you just log on and take a pic of your passport Granted you wont be able to do very much online unless youve got one of the VPNs that work behind the great China firewall but if you have an iPad with a couple of movies downloaded the time will soon pass There was a reasonable amount of shops open both for coffee and souvenir shopping The train that youll need to take to get to your gate is frequent clean and fast Overall Ive been to more interesting airports but my message would be dont stress out reading the negative reviews I had no issues whatsoever

Good transport connection via BAB Moderate parkingrates close to the terminals CheckIn only minutes prior to departure Short distances More than daily flights major Star Alliance hubs MUC and FRA and direct flights to holiday destinations Daily lowcost flights to London STN Vienna Rome FMO is a good choice for travellers in northern NRW western Niedersachsen and eastern Holland who want to start their journeys business travel as welll as holiday travel relaxed and in a friendly atmosphere

Juan Santamara International Airport has gotten much better over the years Clean and modern The arrival process customs and immigration are as smooth as they can be Departures are easy too they could do better with the Exit Tax process long lines and no where to fill out the forms I understand some airlines will start allowing you to pay in advance which is excellent The food inside the terminal is ridiculously expensive I paid for a fast food breakfast sandwich I still dont understand why they have to check each carryon bag again at the gate when we were just screened and xrayed going through security It just slows the boarding process down

Security was good because you didnt have to get liquids or electronics out of your bag Airport was clean and spacious My one huge complaint however is the service in Autogrill Italia The staff member asked me if I would like to pay times without putting it through to the card machine She would just point at it and then say PAY There was a language barrier but I feel there may have been an intelligence barrier because I stood there for mins wanting to pay and not being able to

Modern airport departure and arrival were quick efficient and smooth This not a big nor busy airport so there is never any big queues Immigration police cordial and friendly Almost feels like there is too much airport staff for volume of passengers particularly when departing staff in the multiple cafs looked bored I appreciated the clean toilets and multiple drinking water fountains where you could fill up water for free Duty Free felt was the biggest letdown very generic and poor Not much local Dhofari or even Omani products I think it could be better used to sell the country and region one final time before visitors leave instead of overpriced cheap souvenir tat or the usual generic Toblerone you can find at any airport in the world Even local products like the luxury Amouage perfumes were at the usual price with no deals which was a shame
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

This June we booked on La Compangnie Newark to Paris return Our flight over was cancelled hours before departure We had firm bookings on a flight Paris to London La Compagnie offered us a later flight instead of Paris to Nice Of course we could not make our Paris to London connection We dropped that and waited until the next morning flying directly to London from Nice We incurred an extra nights stay in Nice taxi rides a lost ticket from Paris to London lost return flight when you dont show for the first flight you lose the return and a lost night in our London hotel adding up to over a thousand dollars in extra costs At the end of our stay in England and Paris we were told that our flight from Paris to Newark was also cancelled If we arrived at am at Orly we would be put on the morning flight instead of the more comfortable afternoon departure Flights for people both cancelled and we are repeat customers The check in people at La Compangie said the company would meet us they did not would reimburse us if we showed receipts they did not After multiple attempts to contact anyone by phone and waiting for weeks they more or less told us too bad we owe you nothing Unless you are willing to see your flight changed with very little notice and you have a great deal of flexibility or insurance at the other end do not fly this amateur operation

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

As AC has given up this route we again flew with this Lufthansa subsidiary from YYC to FRA and on to Venice Boarding went smoothly as AC staff now handle this aspect for Eurowings which they didnt do last year The plane left and arrived on time which allowed us to make our connection with Lufthansa Cabin crew were very helpful and fluent in both English and German The seating in business class in and the seats were very comfortable As we chose the evening flight we were able to sleep for a number of hours The seats recline into a fully flat position Comfortable blankets and pillows were provided The food was excellent with a choice of three entrees A fairly good selection of movies was available All in all a much better experience than the one we had last year Lufthansa must be having success with this route as there are now two flights daily from YYC to FRA I find it curious that AC gave up this route

A newly started airport in North Bihar catering large population of North Bihar and even some area of NepalThe airport is actually an operative airport of Indian Airforce and runway is simultaneously used for civilian service The Terminal being used is a temporary one and a new terminal will come soon is years This airport should be seenused for service and facilities but for logistically importance for reaching some of the most undeveloped area in India with ease Terminal is one of the smallest in India but managed nicely no parking available have to park outside the campus on the road from main gate the terminal is just min walk so not an issue trolleys are there washroom are clean there is one tea and snacks shop just near main gate in the campus and use that if you need anything after that wont find anything inside Hope they construct a new terminal soon Though cabs are available outside but no option of prepaid or authorized cab inside better to book cab in advance

On our departure from Simferopol to Moscow we were very pleased with friendly and efficient service at the checkin and the information desks But upstairs in the waiting area we were struck by absolutely different attitude The attempt to have some drinks before boarding finished with success only at the third cafe Its name somehow Happy potatoes Sorry not very sure But I am absolutely sure about the names of the cafes where we were met with rudeness and unhelpful attitude The names of those cafes are Skybar and We were flying on the st of July Such a shame to be let down by such a beautiful airport

I returned this week from Tyumen to Munich Another B this time with vintage business cabin and seats As I was alone in the section I missed the Europeanstyle seats that would have allowed me to completely lie down instead of sitting with a recline Crew were smiling and helping with more polyglot aptitudes than during my preceding flight Excellent tasty lunch with Sardinian I checked red wine Takeoff and landing right on time I shall not hesitate to fly with UTair again
You can change your seats at echeck in without charge Both flights were on time Aneo was clean there were no inflight service for the hour flight Stewards were efficient and friendly enough

Launceston Airport has seen a large redevelopment program completed over the period At the northern end of the terminal are checkin counters for Qantaslink Jetstar Virgin Blue and Tiger Airways which has created more room than before Southern end of the terminal has two baggage carousels added with car rental counters opposite for Avis Budget Europcar Hertz Thrifty Red Spot New upgraded retail outlets are provided in the central section of the terminal which are Newslink Long Bar and Hudsons Coffee This central area has been expanded with a greater amount of room making it easier when more than one flight is in at the same time New security area directs passengers downstairs to new roomy departure lounges which are now at the lower level Windows at the central section and the departure lounges give visitors and passengers great views of the mountains east of the airport This redevelopment has made Launceston Airport a lot more user friendly than previously

IzmirAdnan Menderes is architecturally a very pleasing airport with lots of glass and steel giving it a very modern look The food and shopping were very good the restrooms were spotless and clean and it was very easy to navigate There is free wifi but only for two hours

Flying Izmir to Ercan The International section is Very clean and modern Quick and efficient passenger service from checkin through passport control and all the way to boarding Its always a pleasure to use Izmir Adnan Menderes airport for arrivals and departures internationally The duty free shops are spacious and have many shopping options The toilets are clean and stocked I have no complaints always hasslefree flying out and through Izmir The WiFi is also a bonus very fast and user friendly to access

Surprisingly good experience departing Lisbon Airport Terminal on a Sunday evening with only hand luggage Far less crowded than I remembered from previous visits maybe I was lucky and security was a breeze The duty free area has been updated and toilets were clean It still has the low cost look and feel and does not have very attractive departure lounge or places to plug your phone and laptop but overall pretty efficient

The Embraer continues to be a gamechanger for the American Airlines Group especially on shorthaul routes like the minute flight from Washington Reagan National DCA to Philadelphia PHL Despite the brief duration and some turbulence the crew efficiently completed firstclass service while maintaining a friendly and professional demeanor The firstclass seat provided more than enough comfort for the journey reinforcing the Es reputation as an excellent aircraft for regional operations Given Republic Airways strong performance American Airlines should seriously consider adding Republic to its wholly owned subsidiaries

Boarded by airbridge on an AN with very good condition crew was very friendly Legroom was plenty and seat was very comfortable We departed on time Soon after departure they offer free coffee and water and buy food from a menu Captain made announcements of the flight path We had a great experience with them

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place

The airport claims it has smooth transit and easy to read signs in English helpful staff and an efficient process My experience was the complete opposite After arriving and trying to find my departure process I was told to go back backandforth to the same places by people who could not understand what I was saying this took minutes to an hour and each time I had to rewait in line again So finally I said Im not leaving till you direct me to the right place

I would like to share my positive experience with Egypt Air as this Airline have really exceeded my expectations Friendly and professional cabin crew with delicious catering Highly recommended and for sure will fly Egypt Air again

Paris to Cape Town Flew Joon for the first time in July it was the last leg of a very long flight from Memphis to Cape Town There were some ups and downs with JoonThe flight was delayed by hours mechanical when boarding everyone lined up and they let on some passengers and then the line didnt move for minutes As far as inflight Wifi did not work that was the only issue FA and staff were really good Everyone was super friendly and helpful I had an economy Duo Seat and there was plenty of room The entertainment system worked very well Bring your own earbudsheadset the ones they give you are not very good As far as the food goes it was not really any better or any worse than what I have had on KLM or Delta long haul flights The A flew so smooth on of my favorites

Bangalore to Hyderabad My first time with Air Costa they been operating as a regional airline India for years A great experience the legroom was really good seats comfortable and the aircraft very new Its low cost so besides a glass of water it costs But given the flight time of little over an hour thats no problem The range of food and beverages looked good though The flight was mins late the only downside

I was here on a stopover on the way to Bangkok I didnt have too many problems and the terminal wasnt that crowded it was early morning Also free internet worked well which was helpful Staff seemed friendly though not really helpful The toilets were overcrowded and not clean Not many shops or restaurants that I saw Overall this airport is nothing to right home about but my experience wasnt that bad Qatar airways is a good airline and hopefully the new airport in Doha is better than Doha international

This was my first time on EVA Air and I must say that it was a highly impressive experience Yes it was pricey flying premium economy but at this will be the only way to fly when traveling to Asia from here on out unless traveling business I found the premium economy cabin to be more than satisfactory The seats of course were not lie flat but they still had enough pitch to be comfortable And the one thing that stood out were the cushions in seating There was enough padding that I wasnt even remotely uncomfortable throughout the entire flight I arrived in Taipei from LAX comfortable and refreshed The service was good and the food though not Michelinrated was still perfectly fine I would fly them again While some may say its not different enough from coach to make it worth the money when youre it makes a big difference Ive flown economy to Asia and never again

Pretty much the only option between the islands around St Maarten and Winair knows that so their proces are high We paid each for two times twelve minutes of flying Having said that it is real fun to fly their Twin Otter out of Saba with the shortest runway on earth and than landing at the rollercoaster runway at Saint Barthlemy The move our departure time one hour forward Sabas tiny airport is more like a bus stop and the plan cans land with too much wind so its always unsure Taking off is spectacular since the engines are pushed to their limits before being catapulted on the runway The plane doesnt give you any personal space there is no service of any kind but the view is great Since the same plane took us form SXM tot SBH we could stay inside and repeated the whole thing Flying Winair between the Caribbean islands is part of the experience so dont skip it
The airport is cool clean well ventilation and beautiful The navigation sign is clear help the customer easily navigate inside the airport The staff are considerate and thoughtful

The airport is clean very functional and not too big to the point it becomes customer unfriendly As expected most products available to buy are well overpriced Passport control and security was a breeze
The new Delta Terminal C is elegant convenient and modern Restaurants gate areas and restrooms were all immaculate Checkin went smoothly Keep it up

The crew were attentive and friendly and constantly checking we are ok I would especially like to thank flight attendant Osher who noticed I was upset and on the verge of crying and took me aside for a chat tissue and tea This made me feel I am already at home even before landing

SkyUp is definitely an interesting airline Going into this trip I was not really sure what to expect from a low cost airline that tends to receive high ratings We had booked second row seats for dollars each My original seat which was located on the left side of the aircraft ABC did not have the extra legroom that was promised However since the flight was mostly empty I was able to move to the right side of the aircraft seats DEF These rows had substantially more seatpitch and could definitely be compared to that of other airlines premium economy As for the seats themselves they were quite thin and similar in shape to that of spirit airlines or easyjet but nonetheless it still had a great recline angle In terms of service itself the airline does not have any food or drinks besides water on flights to or from any city but Kyiv so beware and plan to bring your own food onboard There was no in flight magazine or wifi only a QR code for you to download an online journal before takeoff The aircraft landed on time and overall it was a smooth flight

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

Basically a well designed terminal that requires upgrading Immigration and visa on arrival procedures are quick as foreign passport holders go to separate counters both for arrival and departure Luggage delivery is fast but then you will have to queue for at least minutes as every piece of luggage has to go through the only screening machine in the customs hall No taxi or airport shuttle is available and you will have to rely on touts or on military staff very friendly to help you find a vehicle to take you to town unless you have prearranged transport with your hotel Departure hall is not airconditionned and was infested by mosquitoes out of duty free shops were closed and the single airline lounge has been closed for a long time One positive point all areas including toilets are kept very clean

Great service overall Timely departure after very organized boarding procedure Aircraft clean and well air conditioned for boarding Staff very friendly and professional Good meal service with table cloth tableware and drinks in glasses Good infos from cockpit Would surely fly Thai Smile again

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food
Macau Intl airport is spacious Security was efficient and fast Checkin counter queues not long and fast Staff at the counters were good and friendlyThe boarding gates were big and not crowded
Mediumsized modern airport clean and easy to navigate around Easy public transport to and from city centre

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more
OPOMIR return Cabin crew friendly breakfast served it was nothing special but not bad for plane food There was no entertainment onboard but the planes were clean
