The seats in the Terminal waiting areas are very comfortable The security process looked ominous at first but I was constantly moving and when it came time for the scan I did not have to take off my belt or shoes and got through the security process comfortably I wish Portland Airport was like that
Havana Cayo Coco return A one hour flight with an old ATR turboprop Seats surprisingly comfortable and we were offered a free drink plus candy onboard Nothing special but we arrived on time

The airport is clean and not large Signposts are clear Passengers can get around easily Employees are friendly and helpful Security check is efficient The prices charged at food outlets are reasonable

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

Flight SN on the st of October Efficient boarding welcoming crew and comfortable seats The flight left with a slight delay of but arrived earlier in Stockholm The highlight was the crew Charming well groomed cheerful and carried out an excellent cabin bag management during boarding The seemed to be enjoying their jobs and their enthusiasm was contagious It was a pleasure to fly them

Smooth flight and comfortable seat Premium economy still a good value on Finnair The cabin chief was competent as I got a problem with only one choice of meal Im platinum and I was upset to see the poorest service during the dinner on board he went to apologize so its good but when you pay euros you expect a better service concerning the food The flight attendants have to be more smiley

Self service check in is great Put sanitizers nearby please Gate seating is adequate but dirty You really need to vacuum between the seats I wiped the seats before using them Please install more charging ports on seating Charging accessibility is currently inadequate in the Anchorage airport TSA check in was friendly and efficient on our departure You need better Wifi

Domestic arrivals quick and easy No holdups at Baggage Reclaim or delays getting into Arrivals Hall International Departures in separate building which looks like it has just been finished Nov with a number of Islands with associated Checkin Desks and machines all on one level Relatively quick and then onwards to Departures which are up a set of escalators leading directly to a small but efficient security scan area Beyond that was Passport Control split into Argentinian passport holders and everyone else Not much of a queue and things moved quickly into the Departure Lounge Selection of shops selling local things duty free big named alcoholcigarettes etc spreading out left right as the gates were all along one side looking out towards the apron and taxiways Friendly helpful staff at the food cafe with good snackfood selection available Clear announcements and reasonable departure boards around the lounge area Boarding process quite slick with separate clearly labelled queues Quite a long taxi to the runway Pretty good airport for the capital city gateway to the country

Tiny but well kept airport different design not too many flights but departure lounge seemed chaotic Immigration is friendly but takes a long time a few shops you need to pay attention to the counters to find out where youre going to checkin Overall experience fair
Overall the airline offered a clean cabin efficient crew almost friendly good seat spacing and ontime service Pretty good for a budget airline

I was travelling from London to Minsk via Amsterdam for a holiday in Belarus I just about made my connection and the boarding process was efficient and ground crew friendly The Embraer was quite roomy inside because there are only two seats to a row The staff spoke English but not well and the level of friendliness and customer service was adequate but lower than you would find in a western airline We arrived in Minsk a little bit ahead of schedule and I thought the airport there seemed modern and efficient The food and drink on board were quite good The airline is good value for money and their online booking process was very clear and easy to use

This is a small airport but the new passenger terminal is great Fast service helpful people and clean This is a good alternative of Brussels airport We like it and for sure if possible we will try again

Arlanda to Marsa Alam return All things considered it was better than the Tui equivalent where our and year olds were only offered coffee or tea no water as a beverage for paid meals Staff were friendly food looked great we packed our own and no price gouging on the drinks service

Considering the standard for Brazilian Airports the Capitals is very modern Good options for shopping and eating and even some cinema theaters As it is one of the hubs of the country the traffic in intense most of the time There is a lack of good transportation options for the city There is no subway station the buses are rare and uncomfortable and the taxis are quite expensive

AMSAAL and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Aalborg every minutes weekdays but only hourly during the weekend travel time is mins and costs DKK Checkin efficient and hasslefree using selfservice kiosks Free Internet computers are available landside a nice touch Security staff very friendly Boarding area is rather cramped with limited seating do not go airside too early

BrusselsAleppo DamascusBrussels Cheapest tickets to Syria direct flights from Brussels to Aleppo and Damascus friendly crew adequate food Although older Airbus they were clean and looked well maintained and a lot of legspace

First time flying with Jet they didnt disappoint We flew on a new A neo aircraft Crew were friendly efficient We got drinks services going but only coming home We paid for inflight meals both ways tea coffee or hot chocolate were included The food was very good hot Drinks were good value

Very clean airport arrival and departure very well organized Lots of places to sit with a view of the runway in the departure hall The Billa supermarket located in the airport terminal is a good choice Transport fromto the airport very easy

A very shortened Flight due to favourable Tail Winds saw us arrive minutes early into Bangkok excellent My goal was just to sleep on this overnight flight That goal was achieved and a comfortable hours sleep was enjoyed The actual Seat was looking shabby old No Food or Drink were taken so I can not comment on the service Would fly Gulf Air again if going to the UK

Small airport yet very efficient Dont come too early as there is not much to do Queuing is almost nonexistent staff checkin and security are very friendly There is a restaurant with view on the tarmac and a small airport shop before the security Arrival is very fast to minutes including bagage reclaim There is a bus stop right before the terminal taking you to AntwerpenBerchem train station a major train station with fast connection to Brussels or anywhere in Belgium Very close to the city center Highly recomended for users who like fast airports
Flight RGNTVYMGZ on an old ATR Plane very worn from the inside and outside Cabin crew very friendly and efficient Small snacks and drinks offered on each sector Recommended

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future

Sapporos New Chitose airport is very effective and user friendly facility Located somewhat far from Sapporo it is perfectly linked to the city and the region by rail Quick checkin quick baggage delivery good choice of food outlets landside but not a lot of things to do airside The train station is underground as almost everywhere in Japan All in all very good star

The flight was about one hour and yet the flight attendants managed to hand out refresher towels then they gave each passenger a snack box and on the the third service round each passenger was given a drink All this was done unhurried with poise and a smile Such an unexpected level of star service In addition boarding was ontime flight departed and arrived on time What a great airline

An excellent regional airport with good updated facilities including its super cafe which will provide you with coffee and toast for that early morning departure From car park to check in takes just a couple of minutes and baggage return the same Air Southwest staff from check in flight deck and cabin crew are exemplary As a regular traveller with them I recognise so many friendly faces I find flying with them and from Plymouth a pleasure

On time departure and arrival for all flights Flights were relatively smooth Aircraft clean with friendly flight crew providing the usual no frills service IFE worked flawlessly with a good selection of movies DALHOU CUNBNA and BNADAL were on B aircraft This type of aircraft has no power ports to charge personal devices Further there are no trays in the armrest in row HOUCUN was BMAX This is a gorgeous aircraft with large overhead bins and mood lighting

De Havilland Dash of s to s vintage though obviously old with little patches of tranished white paintwork on the airframe revealing its true age Inflight service was better than I expected Hostesses were friendly and courteous Though they serve packet towels some sweets on a tray and bottled mineral water they did so with high level of politeness The only bugbear I can highlight is the lack of a hot snack and hot teacoffee on the flight that wouldnt have cost too much and flight was hr mins

Because LH flights from FDHCGN are now to FRA only and at inconvenient times followed by connections to CGN by train I elected to fly InterSky instead Very clean aircraft and professional service throughout But for an Economy one way ticket price of they could surely provide at least a free cup of coffee Poor value everything else fine
Newquay airport is excellent apart from the abysmal state of seating in the main departure lounge Seating all torn and very scruffy It has been like this for a long time Unacceptable

A short flight with this airline on behalf of Swiss Plane was all clean and modern and had USB outlets Staff was friendly and professional Food and beverages were buy on board unfortunately but a bottle of water and a chocolate were complementary All in all a rather uneventful flight but good and professional as it should be

The largely renovated and rebuilt MCO airport is absolute class Clean well organized from the signage to the dropoff to security and aesthetically pleasing in most areas Returning to the US the new international arrivals area and postcustoms area so arrivals really is just gorgeous If you have Global Entry you breeze through in seconds with courteous officers that speak English and Spanish That alone is unique for a large US airport where many passport control officers are known for their powertripping belligerence but Orlando pleasantly provided the opposite of all that The signage to trains rideshare and hotel shuttles is granularly specified such that its easy for anybody to follow at least when leaving terminal Cinternational Leaving MCO the next morning arrivals at terminal A had clearly been renovated and was looking quite sharp CLEARPreCheck in tandem reduced security from a minute wait to a minute one The shuttle tram facilities between gates and terminals are showing their age and the terminal A gates area is also showing its age and could also use some more and better seating throughout but I wouldnt necessarily consider them dumpy I suppose that MCO will get to renovating those facilities as they can Truly MCO seems to be running like a welloiled machine that is geared to leave visitors to their city with a first and last positive impression

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice

Airport is brand new after going through modern reconstruction Airport surrounding has also gone through a modern reconstruction Signage was seen throughout the airport passport control and security is upstairs accessed through an escalator Pens used to fill out a departure form were running out with no other pens in the surrounding area Passport control was quick and so was security despite there being a long line it soon disappeared Couple of food shops Chinese dim sum Khmer etc Overall the airport has been refitted to a modern state gates shops etc were new and staff were friendly

Milwaukee is a great airport to spend a couple of hours in Decent food selection a great interminal aviation museum and the most incredible airport used bookstore Ive experienced Wish I had brought another carryon bag as I could have filled the thing with all the great books at reasonable prices I wanted to buy

We found Munich Airport to be an excellent airport very well laid out with two level gate system that seems to work very efficiently Very easy to follow signage good seating Check in and baggage drop off was well managed by friendly staff at Singapore Airlines service desks Gates and boarding in designated assigned groups seemed to work quite well Well presented airport

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

I had forgotten what the airport was like but it was great very small and compact no air bridges to aircraft just a quick walk across the airfield Immigration was very easy and efficient as international flights seem to land one at a time The luggage was swiftly off the aircraft and minutes you are in your taxi off to your Hotel Check in again was very quick we arrived very early and were first in the queue your taxi drops you off curbside and you walk about paces and the checkin is in front of you Immigration was very quick minutes and you are airside very limited space and a sad sight of a Burger King Fortunately we went upstairs to the BusinessFirst Lounge shared by most airlines it was empty when we arrived but filled very quickly good tea and coffee a bit limited offerings but ample really Called when the flight was boarding chaos downstairs but they were calling priority boarding and eventually all went as planned

Guayaquil Airport is modern and clean but if you arrive on a domestic flight there is no transit You need to go out and do checkin and security Arrivals can be crowded and staff are not that friendly The one smile that I got was from the girl selling chocolates at the store inside

IND is one of our two main options along with CVG when flying Both are excellent Traveling from Indy this week reminded me why I like it In morning and afternoon there are multiple good choices and most are reasonably priced in comparison to many other world airports crowds are nowhere near some airports so it is easy to move around TSA has always been friendly and efficient unlike some airports restrooms are generally cleaner than many other airports We do wish there were a couple of direct flights options to Europe but for flying domestically we like IND
UIA is always a great experience in businessclass Great service onboard Very lovely crew The lounges in KBP and MUC are also very relaxing Looking forward to flying UIA again

The airport is fine and clean food was good and getting through the security was fine However the so call dutyfree store is another matter everything was way over priced For example the Local Rum Appleton years old was over USD That is very expensive to pay that kind of money in Jamaica for local rum on a dutyfree when you can buy the same in Ontario Canada one of the higher liquor tax jurisdictions for under USD All of the products on the dutyfree were way overpriced You can get the same rums in the USA at the supermarkets for less from the dutyfree store of Montego bay airport I purchase a Cuban Havana Club year old in Havana on December for USD

I returned this week from Tyumen to Munich Another B this time with vintage business cabin and seats As I was alone in the section I missed the Europeanstyle seats that would have allowed me to completely lie down instead of sitting with a recline Crew were smiling and helping with more polyglot aptitudes than during my preceding flight Excellent tasty lunch with Sardinian I checked red wine Takeoff and landing right on time I shall not hesitate to fly with UTair again

Forgot my mask and expected to be greeted with a negativecold attitude but it was quite the opposite The attendant was quick to help me get my bag tags helping me use the kiosk most efficiently and a cloth mask Each attendant I came across from the ticket counterTSA securitygate were very friendly Thank you for starting my travel so well

Travelled in transit LGWTIPACC back in November and on both outward and return legs I found the staff helpful and courteous Although the airport may not be up to the international standards of LHR or AMS nonetheless a compact tidy terminal It also has an excellent duty free shop Remember though that Libya is a dry country The only Becks you can buy is non alcoholic
Taipei Hualein TaiChung Both flights by ATR cabin was clean and comfortable Very friendly crew Drinks service on both flights

Both arrival and departure from MGA was problem free No crowds The only short queue was immigration on arrival If not included in the air fare there is an entry charge of US and a departure charge of US The facility is modern and clean Shopping here is not cheap but the quality and variety of merchandise is excellent Eating is much more expensive than outside the airport but prices compare favourably with European equivalents The waiting areas have ample seating and are cool Unlike many other airports there is a lack of electronic information boards But it has the charm of some of the once small manageable airports we once had in Europe

The wheelchair attendant verified everything for me Verified with me verified with the LYFT driver by asking his name verify the LYFT ride by licenses plate verified I felt ok and I knew where I was going For me its humiliating to be pushed in a wheelchair I never felt humiliation this time I truly felt cared for This trip wasnt the greatest vacay Ive had but when I got home I felt great I want to thank this positive smart caring young man Some ppl have a gift a few share it in this way If your lucky enough to meet this young man at DFW Airport youll know its him Im talking about here

Departure hall clean spacious and air conditioned Well organised queuing system with KLM staff tagging hand baggage in advance to make check in run smoothly Each airline had their own desk Security fast just remember to have your red immigration card Food outlets fine but limited Shopping limited as two shops sold the same items Duty free had a good range of perfume and drinks but beware if you are European and outside the Eurozone prices are more expensive for cosmetics than what you would pay in High Street shops Didnt fully investigate alcohol but you need to look carefully for offers and compare them to a local supermarket We werent travelling with children but I didnnotice any play facilities on offer Seats OK Arrival Hall just had fans but didnt have to wait long for luggage There are toilets in the baggage reclaim hall these were clean and well maintained For a small island a really good airport

Checkin security check an immigration at Xiamen Airport swift although not very friendly Contract lounge large with decent FB choices Boarding for both flights well organized Both flights with good FB offerings and service and on time IFE very good The big letdown was again the lack of frequent flyer points for members of other One lWorld airlines besides Asia Miles There was not even a fare bookable in economy which attracts frequent flyer points I fly frequently within the OneWord alliance and no other carrier has this practice I will therefore stick to the other members of Oneworld in the future

MSP Airport does a great job with stores and restaurant options and recently completed some moderate improvements in aesthetics to terminal They currently offer a total of electric parking spots which are spread out across sites It appears the planning team completely overlooked this aspect of the customer experience

Saint Petersburg to Samara The airline is very good The cabin is clean and comfortable and with this always promised food and friendly staff As for the baggage allowance things are even better the baggage allowance is kilograms

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

New airport building with good facilities Minimal airport food facilities and retail outlets other than jewellery Good facilities for vehicles to pick up at ground level and drop off at first floor level Excellent toilet facilities and very clean throughout with good air conditioning Construction of second runway in progress together with airport buildings to cater for expected increase in tourism Downside was that there was no wifi facilities other than those offered by fast food franchises

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

The airport is pretty clean Though its small its pretty cute like a park or resort This uniqueness suits the vacation vibe of the beautiful island of Koh Samui Different types of seating areas are available there are a few shops diners and a caf Checkin and immigration were both very efficient A courtesy corner full of snacks and drinks is available for free to all passengers However I wasnt able to connect to the airport WiFi

This airport is head and shoulders above any other airport I have been to and Ive been through a few Every person I interacted with form check in to security to service staff were all over the top friendly with great senses of humor The security line is the fastest I have ever seen I have never waited in a line here even during the holidays maybe minutes max The gates are clean and modern tons of outlets and different seating arrangements lots of space for only having gates Loads of parking for an airport of this size I was able to park my car like meters from departures and left it there for a week I know how infuriating flying can be especially when things go wrong but it goes a long way when people are so friendly This is my favorite airport and I go out of my way to fly out of here please give these people the recognition they deserve

Pretty much the only option between the islands around St Maarten and Winair knows that so their proces are high We paid each for two times twelve minutes of flying Having said that it is real fun to fly their Twin Otter out of Saba with the shortest runway on earth and than landing at the rollercoaster runway at Saint Barthlemy The move our departure time one hour forward Sabas tiny airport is more like a bus stop and the plan cans land with too much wind so its always unsure Taking off is spectacular since the engines are pushed to their limits before being catapulted on the runway The plane doesnt give you any personal space there is no service of any kind but the view is great Since the same plane took us form SXM tot SBH we could stay inside and repeated the whole thing Flying Winair between the Caribbean islands is part of the experience so dont skip it

Comfortable and clean provincial airport Didnt use any facilities other than the toilets which were clean and tidy Only real criticism is lack of seats at the gates I was on a full A flight to Brisbane and there were only seats for about passengers There is also no segregation of incoming and outgoing passengers the former have to weave their way through those people waiting to board Passengers seated in the rear half of the cabin were requested to go down stairs across the tarmac then up stairs to the rear door of the aircraft However by the time I reached the front of the queue the outside doors had been locked so I had to fight my way through the whole length of the aircraft cabin

Arrived on the last evening flight from Barcelona tourist desk very helpful and received our luggage within minutes No taxis available so took the airport bus driver was very helpful and even dropped us a short distance from our hotel

I was very excited to land here as this airport is famous around the globe for its risk landings The infrastrucure per se is very basic you deplane on the tarmac and then walk to the arrivals staff were ok I found people in the Madeira island to be very friendly Do not come without pre booked stuff as I noticed they inflate the prices for tourists who decided to book on the spot The airport is clean and security is fast long lines though Snacks on the land side much cheaper than air side

Traveled to Haikou from this airport as there were no flights from Macau to Haikou It is a fairly large airport with a small aviation museum in the departures hall However the airport was a bit old and wasnt very clean Overall it was quite a good airport with interesting activities to pass the time

This airport is situated good one hour away from Udaipur Small and basic airport Nothing at arrival hall not even a teasnack shop Toilets need to be more clean and hygienic Only baggage belt on arrivals so easy to get baggage also very short walk from aircraft to baggage to exit Wifi is of no use either it wont connect and if connect wont be working properly Few chairs available near baggage belt UberOla available from airport also a prepaid taxi counter for booking No public bus available to city from airport If not travelling with heavy baggage then can walk to highway and then wait for bus going towards Udaipur
Friendly and fast service Enough toilets seats and bins But shops close early and have a extremely poor selection in duty free If you want anything make sure you get it before coming to the airport

It was the cheapest way to go back after yet another season in Asia and honestly I didnt expect too much But the plane was quite new and the cabin was in a good condition Departed on time unlike the connecting domestic flight by another airline before There was an inflight entertainment system available and it seems to be modern but after a night spent in two different airports I hardly used it for anything other than the D map Although the food was served not as elegantly as some airlines do it was quite delicious and I could choose what I preferred on both meals despite sitting not in the middle of the cabin Note that there are only soft drinks available but for me it doesnt really matter The seats are not exactly Emirateslike but still quite comfortable for an hours flight The headphones were usual cheap earbuds unfortunately but they also included an adapter which I took away and which will let me plug in my own headphones on some later flight great and I just dont understand why airlines besides those smart few who provide multiuse washablecup large headphones couldnt distribute just that on request rather than generating tons of cheap headphones waste The flight was smooth and arrived minutes early Definitely would fly Tianjin Airlines again if the price is right and the route will fit my plans and will stop at Chongqing or Tianjin where I havent been yet as well should I have time for that

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport

Checkin would not accept passengers until hours before the flight despite the monitors advising us to do so Check in person was blunt and almost rude not acceptable we are the customers It isnt my fault she was talking quietly and I had to ask her to repeat every time Then security they take possession of my backpack and without comment put it on a unit away from me and left it there A couple of minutes later another security man came along and started swabbing the bag because I had lots of camera equipment inside The toilets in departures need a good refurbishment Otherwise a great little airport modern clean with duty free and so on

This is a small new and very well designed airport There is only one runway so there is never too much traffic The business lounge is excellent clean and there is always food and drink and the service is excellent

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use

The crew were attentive and friendly and constantly checking we are ok I would especially like to thank flight attendant Osher who noticed I was upset and on the verge of crying and took me aside for a chat tissue and tea This made me feel I am already at home even before landing
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll

Monday th April what an absolute disgrace hours to get through security after being told minutes lifts out of order another reserved for staff when you escaped the great long queues conveyor belts working out of very little staff available On return hour wait for luggage an absolute disgrace A final comment I will never use Birmingham again and yet only minutes from home and have used this airports many many times and many times had problems but no more East Midlands much better
Macau Intl airport is spacious Security was efficient and fast Checkin counter queues not long and fast Staff at the counters were good and friendlyThe boarding gates were big and not crowded

Visited Uganda on and departed on Both arrival and departure experiences were smooth Arrival hall is rather large There is mandatory health screening before one can proceed to visapassport control Obtaining a visa is relatively easy Present valid passport and make payment Baggage claim appeared to be a rather large area with perhaps carousels At departure level the lighting seems rather deem There is the mandatory screening of bags before you can enter and check in for the flight The staff is very friendly The facilities are clean and the departure hall appears small given the amenities gift shops dining and duty free The Karibuni Lounge is excellent It puts to shame US airline lounges in the USA with its food offerings and amenities Bathrooms are cleaned frequently by an attendant Overall no issues with EBB airport Immigration control staff are very friendly The only drawback to this airport is that passengers have to be dropped off in the parking area and then make their way around the roadway to the departure level
Friendly of the staff a new huge mall had been opening Mall del Soll This is the modern and fully functional airport with the biggest mall of the country and four hotels between stars

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience

San Francisco to Indianopolis Nearly empty flight so there was plenty of space to stretch and move about Inflight entertainment and food ordering was easy using the touchscreen Food was decent there was an accessible box of water bottles towards the back I do wish they would clean the IFE remote and seatback pockets though

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience

Flying from Fayetteville to CLT on July The young man at AA was unfriendly like I never seen before Your ID put your bag take your bag were his only words No greeting no thank you no have a good flight I recently moved to Fayetteville for a job from New York Flying often Never flew from Fayetteville used Raleigh for that There was no soap in the restroom at am already Security was okay did not use thank you or please in their lexicon I will fly from Raleigh next time
Excellent except that the parking is free and hence clogged We landed taxied to within years of the terminal walked straight through the door to baggage arrivals and within minutes were in the car

The flight was about one hour and yet the flight attendants managed to hand out refresher towels then they gave each passenger a snack box and on the the third service round each passenger was given a drink All this was done unhurried with poise and a smile Such an unexpected level of star service In addition boarding was ontime flight departed and arrived on time What a great airline

Airport has a weird system for departure You have to go to a security check point outside the airport to be patted down manually by security guards while your vehicle luggage is sniffed by gaurd dogs Then you are dropped off at a terminal for security check again this time through electronic devices where you get a special colored sticker on your luggage Afterwards you proceed to a shuttle bus carry your own luggage that will take you to another terminal about a minute drive where temperatures reach degrees Celsius in the summer At the nd terminal a security check is done to ensure you have been security checked at the previous terminal Now some of this can be avoided if you have a special VIP pass that skips step And a VVIP that skips all steps The check in counters are ok about of them run by Dubais DNata Immigration is slow and queues are long Duty Free is small with tobacco chocolates and alcohol available One coffee shop available behind Duty Free After passing immigration but before your gate you pass through another security check point remove your shoes belts etc Plenty of seating at the gates plus one coffee shop although AC is never working in the summer and no wifi connection through out the airport Staff are all generally friendly

First impression of Minsk airport was given by its exterior grand Brutalist Sovietera architecture Very impressive Inside the terminal doesnt feel grand and impressive I was in transit only so I only saw the arrival gates transfer area and the airside departure areas The arrivals area is a bit of a maze and signage not that clear So be sharp when looking for the transit area after arrivals The transfer area was old fashioned with worn fakeleather couches that seem to taken from a landfill Queuing time at the transfer area was OK around minutes After boarding card check passengers process through security which was a bit of a joke as passengers are not checked at all after passing the walkthrough metal detector The departures area with its shops is a bit of a maze and the gate waiting areas are very small There is not a lot of choice in shops what I saw was mostly liquor or food and beverage outlets Seating in the gate waiting areas is limited but on the upper level of the departures area there is sufficient space to take a rest on one of the seats At the upper level there are also seats on which you can recline but these seats are quite hard and not very comfortable to take a good nap There are also sleeping cabins here Wifi works great login via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean especially at the upper level where not a lot of people go The terminal it not really fit for PRM passengers as there are a lot of stairs but not escalators and just a few lifts They did install stairlifts at the gates a rather silly solution in my opinion but is works This airport is fine when you have a short transfer In case of a long transfer it can be boring and FB options are very limited

What a lovely place The tiniest airport an aerodrome actually I have been to People are lovely they take care of you There is a bar free wifi if it doesnt work in some areas ask for the airlines it is kept clean The only thing is getting there taxi only as far as I know

Burbank is a very small regional airport serving the San Fernando Valley and northern Los Angeles suburbs with only gates and no jetways but its a very good alternative to the chaos that is LAX There are flights on Southwest dominant carrier United US Airways JetBlue American and Alaska to all major western USA airports plus DallasFt Worth and New York JFK The terminal is very small and can get overcrowded during peak times and foodbeverageconcession options are very Spartan but its easy to navigate has excellent free wifi and the security screening process is streamlined and wellrun You can also walk from the terminal to the longterm parking lot which you cant do at LAX

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Overall an excellent airport Coming in and going out immigration was fast efficient and friendly The airport is very clean and welllaid out for its size and does not feel crowded at all Decent choice of shops and places to eat
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

Excellent airport and decent size it is not as huge as other asian mega hubs but it means getting in the out of the airport is very quick From touching town to the taxi it took mins maximum Signposts are very clear and there are so many staff to help you all very friendly The airport is dated and is due for a refurb yet it is spotless Departure experience was also great Check in was easy immigration and security very fast and smooth despite not having priority lane for business class custmers There are some interesting shop aside the global boutique and plenty of seats to rest There are even free lounge area which is like a living room Airlines lounges in TPE arent good quality with the exception of Cathay Pacific but there are a lot of FB offers especially in Terminal

Terminal International The arrivals hall was a long walk from the gate to customs and immigration but aided by moving walkways and wide corridors Baggage collection was very rapid and despite the enormous volume of passengers clearance through immigration was superefficient with lots of staff ushering passengers to the right lanes Departure was a similar experience with long queues being very effectively managed by extremely helpful staff The free wifi is fast and effective throughout the airport Most of the food and beverage options landside are for Japanese or Asian food all of which are a bit pricey There is also a very good outdoor viewing deck a rarity these days Airside there are lots of shops and food outlets much more than the landside offerings Importantly the terminal offers a large open space with heaps of charging stations and comfortable seating PA announcements are clear and in multiple languages One word of caution walking from the central area to the boarding gates can take as much as minutes so factor this into your timing

Ljubljana Airport has undergone a major update over the last few years and has increased in size quite substantially Line of sight signage is good making navigation around the airport very easy Arriving from a Schengen country results in a very fast entry procedure to the country Departing was also a breeze with very friendly and efficient staff we were checked in through security customs and in the lounge in very short time Waiting areas are comfortable and duty free shopping and other outlets well staffed and spotlessly clean

The schedules are well respected and the staff is excellent Boarding and disembarkation are quick The plane is clean and the information is clear Les horaires sont bien respects et le personnel est parfait Lembarquement se fait rapidement ainsi que le dbarquement Lavion est propre et les informations sont claires

The gate agents are great but they might have the most inefficient TSA security checkpoint Ive ever witnessed It took them around minutes to scan bags and only one was flagged out of the They seem to be the only airport where the analogic machines have actually made the security checkpoint slower which is wild considering the technology of those things Everywhere else seems to have competent people to run them

Excellent small regional airport spotlessly clean with very friendly staff slight oddity that the baggage reclaim belts are in the arrivals hall but I was out within th mins of the plane touching down and you cant get much better than that

BMAMMX one way The flight was comfortable with professional and friendly staff The free food and drinks served onboard were top quality The central location of Stockholm Bromma was very advantageous for our city break but checkin and boarding was a hassle Checkin closes minutes before departure which means that half the passengers were cramming at the check in desks in the last minute Free seating onboard the plane resulted in more cramming after the security because everyone wants a good seat It was a real circus In my opinion min checkin deadline instead of min and allocated seats instead of free seats would have been optimal

Nouakchott to Dakar The new Nouakchott airport is about min from the city and opened only years ago Pretty efficient airport not crowded and only gates The lounge was surprisingly good English spoken fast WiFi and a decent selection of food and beverages Mauritania is a dry country The plane was less then a year old but very poor maintained The whole seating arrangement was mixed up Seat itself was old and relatively clean No welcome drink amenities or InFlight magazine Hot meal was served on a min flight Only coffee was served no other options The toilet had no soap nor towels Many passengers eat their meal with bare hands Crew was friendly but didnt speak English Not flag carrier worthy airline but for African standards pretty cheap and the hard product is pretty new Service in business class to Easyjet economy

Tallinn is my favourite airport of all airports Ive been to Its so small lovely and there are never crowds flowing around There are about gates The Business Lounge is quiet and comfy and theres always enough food Its main difference is the low ceiling compared to other airports There arent many restaurants or shops but the Tax Free Shop has almost everything needed for your flight Staff very friendly and WiFi works well

It always a good experience to fly from to Nuremberg airport because you have short ways It is connected with the metroline U so you are in minutes at the city centre You can eat some local stuff The staff is friendly and helpful The most important to the end WIFI is free

The airport is pretty clean Though its small its pretty cute like a park or resort This uniqueness suits the vacation vibe of the beautiful island of Koh Samui Different types of seating areas are available there are a few shops diners and a caf Checkin and immigration were both very efficient A courtesy corner full of snacks and drinks is available for free to all passengers However I wasnt able to connect to the airport WiFi

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec

Bari Airport looks new but they have not yet found a way to avoid a minute wait for security checks Leaving tourists in a minute queue for security is not a good way to attract tourists If the queue is minutes on th April what will it be in July and August Puglia is a great region to visit and Bari is an excellent gateway Pity the local autorities cant run an airport

Airport staff very friendly and helpful but airport is actually the modern building with a minor older satellite terminal from where a low cost company exclusively operates It needs better highlited signals
Flew LUGFLR via GVA and back Excellent airline Flights on time FA very friendly and service excellent Would fly with Etihad Regional again

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

A moderately sized airport some km away from the city center Its clean and modern and during the offseason security check was very fast and efficient Dutyfree shopping is in abundance and has some good offers Staff is very friendly far nicer than what you experience at other airports All arrivals and departures are busboarding only as there are no jetbridges Connection to the city is by taxi or bus X which cost only euro

BOSMKE I have flown to and from Mitchell countless times I grew up in Milwaukee and moved back here in June I agree with other reviewers that it is a clean friendly wellrun airport What stuck in my mind was how swiftly and well the baggage is handled I flew Southwest and sat fairly far forward in the cabin walked directly to the baggage claim area and by the time I arrived my baggage was already on the carousel This is something of a record in all of the flights I have experienced over the past few years at the other end is Copenhagen Kastrup in July where I waited close to minutes for the baggage to arrive with my own valise arriving some minutes later There is also a rapid bus to downtown with the stop now just outside the baggage claim area now that renovations of that area are completed There are also a couple of good Bartolotta restaurants on the concourses Piccolo Pizzeria and Nonna Bartolottas which I have enjoyed on previous departures All in all Mitchell is an excellent airport Now all they need is more nonstop flights
Singapore to Tioman Island We found the check in staff very welcoming friendly and helpful The flight in the dash was what real flying is all about Again the crew were very friendly

As per a previous review on checkin was advised that bags could only be sent as far as Haikou At that point I would have to enter China collect baggage then checkin for BKK flight And thats despite both flights being on a single ticket Upon arrival then had issues at passport control They wanted evidence of my nd flight The print out I had on me simply said SYD BKK And had no wifi access Eventually was allowed in The flights themselves were great Relatively modern planes with attentive flight attendants in business on the A and on the Western food options on the way over Very much Chinese on the way back For the price I paid it was a great option but hrs to BKK instead of hours might turn others off

LAN Peru flights from Bogota to Santiago via Lima Although it was a relatively small aircraft A I think and the flight departed am on time we did get a blanket plus pillow eye cover and ear plugs and headphones for free The flight attendants were extremely friendly and elegant The flight entertainment was pretty good not personal IFE though and the food was a small breakfast sandwich or muffin with complementary hot and cold beverages There was a choice of good Colombian coffee We were informed from the cockpit about the status of our flight and it landed on time enough to catch the connection to Santiago The seat space was more then average and overall a very good experience

I have used Monastir Airport now for years and whilst the queues at immigration can be slow at times I think the other facilities and friendly staff more than make up for this Transport links are excellent if you are an independent traveller

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

Ive flown via Narita Airport before and always found it to be excellent especially the connection between Terminals and via the free shuttle bus This review is specifically about Terminal which serves only a handful of regional airlines like JetStar Japan Spring and Jeju Air Prepandemic it was a functional but drab location By comparison the new Terminal is absolutely stunning easily the most spacious per number of airlines served Ive ever seen There are huge seating areas several appealing food outlets a bookstore and a Lawsons convenience store The beautiful art work complements the peaceful relaxed atmosphere an immediately noticeable contrast to the crowded scene at most of the worlds terminals I really didnt want to depart Congratulations to those responsible

This review is limited to Terminal A I havent flown through Terminal A in years but it still remains a very modern airport terminal It is spacious with plenty of seating and dining options especially at Gates A There is a rather long underground walkway from these gates to the main terminal A The walkway is beneath the tarmac and runways We dined at Legal Seafoods before departure to DFW Excellent food The terminal was very busy given the snowstorm and delayed flights Bathrooms were okay but could have been cleaner WiFi was very fast and easy to connect too Kudos to Logan airport snow clearing crews and the crews deicing planes Our flight to DFW was delayed but we managed to take off Throughout the storm planes kept taking off and landing

Airport was much better than expected In the general area are a few food options incl coffee shop icecream bar and a few fast food choices They even have a small duty free We were in the TAAG lounge called the Pearl lounge Clean comfortable with basic drinks food Staff are very friendly Did not see showers Internet is available but weak Other than internet this lounge is better than many US lounges I have visited I was expecting something much worse

I had my period during the departure and didnt have sanitary paper with me My departure was from Terminal and after entering it there was no place where I could get it It is important that such things as sanitarny paper or diaper for babies are available to buy on an airport It should be available in the toilet or in one of the shops I had to ask several women which were also waiting for a plane whether they have sanitary paper It was uncomfortable I found sanitary paper cause one of the women had it but I could be less fortunate

The airport has a quick checkin counter right outside where you arrive with the taxi This led to a checkin time for our Delta flight including one checked in luggage of just minutes after I got out of the taxi Security was fast too never experienced such a comfortable on boarding on any flight

This is a good smaller airport to fly in and out of The terminal is new and it shows Also staff are friendly and helpful This terminal is also well located as it is actually on the outskirts of the city not outside of the city In addition it is served by local transit However there is one accessibility issue While the lanes for commercial providers are covered and wide there is only a lane uncovered pickup area on the arrivals level for private vehicles This results in congestion during heavier arrival times

Cheap prices comfortable seats decent legroom inches on the former IndiGo airplane Check in at Bogota was done online but tourist pass for San Andres and bags had to be dropped off at the check in counter which was pretty easy Boarding was a breeze After take off many people switched seats since most didnt pay for an assigned one Flight was minutes late but otherwise good The only problem were kids running up and down the aisle like wild animals and nobody from the crew stopping them Unfortunately due to Colombias COVID rules there was no inflight service but you are able to bring your own drinks and snacks

One of the nicest and cleanest airports Ive experienced Thoughtful touches are everywhere from the piano in the food court to bags for wet umbrellas to a cart of peanuts and pretzels from Delta identical to what they give out in flight at the baggage claim Bathrooms are spotless And clocks throughout the airport

Excellent flights from Gran Canaria to Tenerife North with this super regional airline Well maintained clean aircraft both ways Short flights of around mins with friendly cabin crew Newspapers brought round before take off During the flight served glass of water with a chocolate biscuit followed by a sweet Just enough time to collect everything in before landing Check in easy with no queing at both LPA and TFN Luggage delivered on belt within mins of entering baggage reclaimat both airports Thank you Binter Canarias for excellent service

Bangkok to Taipei Having now taken four flights on V Air my comments remain virtually the same as my earlier review I arrived at the newly opened international terminal at Bangkoks Don Mueang airport about minutes prior to the scheduled departure Checkin took less than minutes even though the plane was around full The aircraft pushed back minutes late but arrived precisely on time The seat is comfortable with more leg space than is usual on budget carriers my preordered meal of chicken teriyaki was excellent and the FAs are efficient and cheerful One even came to my seat to welcome me back having seen me on my last flight almost months earlier I wish all budget carriers were of a similar standard

Great airport Good duty free Good fb outlets Just one question why do you clean all washrooms at the same time leaving just handicapped ones opened And to find a vacant one you need to pass several kms to find it

As per a previous review on checkin was advised that bags could only be sent as far as Haikou At that point I would have to enter China collect baggage then checkin for BKK flight And thats despite both flights being on a single ticket Upon arrival then had issues at passport control They wanted evidence of my nd flight The print out I had on me simply said SYD BKK And had no wifi access Eventually was allowed in The flights themselves were great Relatively modern planes with attentive flight attendants in business on the A and on the Western food options on the way over Very much Chinese on the way back For the price I paid it was a great option but hrs to BKK instead of hours might turn others off

Hiroshima is a small regional airport with virtually all flights internal Japanese flights Most westerners visit Hiroshima using land routes from other cities so the airport is not as western friendly as bigger Japanese airports This means there are few public announcements in English though the standard of English for check in staff was very good The food concession stands also cater to Japanese tastes only so you are out of luck if you only like western food There are also no magazines or books in any language other than Japanese Surprisingly wide range of souvenirs though most wont be much use to long haul travelers eg frozen salmon steaks oysters etc Transport to downtown very good as a limousine bus leaves from outside terminal and arrives pretty much next to the Bomb Dome which most people are going to
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD

Excellent small airport clean spacious good restaurant airline lounges collectively available to a great many airlines Arrival was to jetway Departure was by bus to plane from gate E the gates uses buses to go to aircraft The departure flight needed deicing since the aircraft was not parked at a gate it could be deiced in place before taxiing Frequent reliable bus service tofrom city Security personnel on departure efficient and courteous Time in security line minutes

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule

Small airport which was about minutes on bus to the city center Facilities was good and clean Baggage claim was fast and thoughtful as at many other Japanese airports Signs and directions were also clearly noted in English

Islip to Baltimore with SWA A hidden gem in the NY area for local flights terminal is clean and spacious with good facilities all round A much better option than the scrum at JFK or LGA particularly if you are out of the city and have a rental car

Singapore to Yangon Ontime departure from Changi terminal The economy cabin felt clean and the crew were friendly My expectation was for a basic and efficient service which was we got This was an evening flight so we had a basic dinner which was okay as good if not better than the Premium Economy meal from Melbourne to Singapore Same wine Sauvignon Blanc This time no other option so I opted for the red Comfortable good service no complaints

Upon leaving Europe back to Los Angeles my flights had me departing LJU to connect at CDG for my flight to LA For some reason my travel agent had booked the two flights separately under two different confirmation numbers while in Slovenia I had called the airline and even the hotels concierge did as well and we both found out only the gate agent can make sure and both flights are listed as one continuous trip mainly for the sake of routing checked luggage all the way through The gate agent with the assistance of a coworker easily got this done and I was only charged for an extra checked bag my initial flight was in economy while my connecting flight was in business Thankfully both flights were on the same airline in the end everything went smoothly Upon arrival at LJU I was amazed how much of a small town airport feel it had You could walk through the entire airport in minutes There were only about four checkinticket windows and no one was in line Proceeding to security there were about three rows to enter through and once again no one else was in line My time initially at checkin took about minutes to get my flights worked out and to pay the extra checked bag fee and then within ten minutes I was through security and enjoying a drink near my gate A very laid back and friendly experience Sort of a calm before the storm I would have at CDG in three more hours

I enjoyed my flight aboard Air Zimbabwe from Harare to Johannesburg the crew were very friendly and the service was excellent We arrived ahead of schedule checkin was fast and smooth and the seats were comfortable

Small airline but a good one Despite heavy turbulence on the flight from Kuala Lumpurs old airport to Tioman Island I felt safe and that the FAs knew what to do in the event of an emergency Cant be sure of course but it felt that way Good information from the crew about the turbulence Small planes but comfortable for the relatively short flight Good service during the flight

Beijing to Weihai with Shandong Airlines Comfortable clean and modern plane with ample leg room far more generous than Etihad and the other premium airlines I have experienced Some delay due to air traffic congestion however bags promptly delivered on arrival Water provided by friendly and attentive crew for the short flight

Very clean airport arrival and departure very well organized Lots of places to sit with a view of the runway in the departure hall The Billa supermarket located in the airport terminal is a good choice Transport fromto the airport very easy

vIve flown with Spirit several times and also contacted their customer service center in the past to cancel a flight Spirit can vary wildly in terms of cancellations delays timeliness and staff attitudes If using a ratio two experiences to every one have been overwhelming positive But the remaining one experience has royally sucked Still I take my chances with Spirit because theyve come to treat me more respectfully as a customer than most other US carriers pound for pound It helps that I understand the concept of ultrabudget airlines having flown them around the world and that I treat airline staff with courtesy and politeness This most recent trip from Orlando to Louisville was mostly positive friendly airline staff on ground and friendly though not particularly attentive in air they only came down the aisle once to collect trash Checkin online was easy though it helped that I wasnt checking a bag The flight took off and arrived early The immediate seat was clean enough but the seat back pocket and tray table were a bit nasty They tout their WiFi as being the fastest of any US airline though I havent tried it But I did manage to use their unpaid WiFi connection to track the flight route to Louisville on my phone so that was cool In all Spirit as great as long as you keep a good attitude and dont have any real expectations Thats the point of budget airlines right And just hope you dont get delayed by eight hours as I did once with Spirit years ago

A quick visit to Rome from Prague on Ryanair The airport location close to the city is great with a painless connection via Airport Link Bus Train The entire trip easily purchased on the Trenitalia app for only to Termini The airport terminal itself is large enough to accommodate flights at the same time could be stretched to capacity with more traffic Boarding and disembarking on foot with some shops available Staff was curtuous so our departure was on time The proximity to Rome is a strong selling point when comparing to FCO

I flew Yeti Airlines June from Bhairahawa the airport near Lumbini the birthplace of Buddha to the capital Kathmandu It was a morning flight on time the ground staff were friendly cabin crew was friendly They served soft drinks on this minute flight Reading material offered The jetstream is a turboprop engine aircraft and has seating capacity for person in an x arrangement The flight was smooth Yeti Airlines has the reputation of flying on time Though its safety record is not very encouraging but has been spotless and blemish free since it separated its mountains region operations in the name of Tara air as its subsidiary Sky miles their frequent flyer program is very popular and has many other benefits like discounts in hotels than award tickets The name Yeti also is an attraction to the visitors

I expected the worst but to my surprise its one of the smoothest flight I have ever hard Everything was good other than the seats that needs a mattress to make them comfortable for sleeping The staff were good I will fly it anytime I prioritise feeling safe
It was very great flying in Vistara today then any other Company I liked this because of several reasons like hospitality Seat comfort cabin staff service food Etc Keep it up

I flew from Blackpool airport to Belfast for the first time I always fly from Liverpool to Belfast with Easyjet but the flight times were better and it was slightly cheaper to fly with Jet from Blackpool I was expecting a small airport with limited facilities but nothing prepared me for the facilities here Parking is free which was a bonus for me when booking on arrival however both car parks P and P were full and ended up abandoning my car on a grass area known as an overfill car park This was a minute walk to the airport On arrival there was nothing before the departure lounge The cash machine was out of service and WHSmiths closed Paying the airport charge was no problem and I was assisted with my baggage tag by a very helpful Jet worker The worst experience was going through security where the staff were extremely rude not just with me but with an elderly couple in front of me I agree that security needs to be strict but not intrusive and this was made a much more uncomfortable experience by the rudeness and lack of customer service with the staff I will never be using this airport again and even after a drink from the limited choice in the cafebar I was still reeling I can safely say this is the st and last time I will use this airport

Not that much leg room If you are over cm tall you will be bashing your kneecaps but otherwise the seat is pretty comfortable The services from the cabin crew were friendly and efficient Due to Covid restrictions no snack was served on this flight There is no screen in the seats so you must supply your own inflight entertainment Would definitely use the airline again as their routes are handy and they were punctual

MSP Airport does a great job with stores and restaurant options and recently completed some moderate improvements in aesthetics to terminal They currently offer a total of electric parking spots which are spread out across sites It appears the planning team completely overlooked this aspect of the customer experience

The airport is much better now since the renovation is complete Plenty of parking when you arrive There are a range of shops Patchi chocolate Bookstore Coffee bean tea leaf bodyshop in the predeparture area and a restaurant There are ATM machines a baggage sealing service and currency exchange stand but they never have Singapore dollars Check in was a breeze done in several minutes Passport control is quick Once you enter the departure lounge to the right is a food court that sells food to order manly Asian dishes There is a convenience store some stores that sell traditional Bruneian foods and watch perfume stores I was told more stores will be added soon The waiting area has good lighting there are priority seats near the gate for those with young children and elderly people The toilets were clean There is a prayer room for Muslim travellers On arrival there is a short walk to customs and immigration Separate counters for local ASEAN Diplomatic and foreigners There are plenty of trolleys at the baggage carousel There is a green and red channel there are several officers always on duty I left a hand luggage on the plane luckily I was able to retrieve it There is a door at the side of KFC which leads back to the arrivals hall The bag was aleady in the office for me to collect In the arrivals hall there is a KFC and Burger King also Counters for DST and Progressif which are the mobile phone carriers You can purchase tourist sim cards which have minutes and data pre loaded There is a counter for tourist information and Hertz Avis car rental Upon exiting the terminal there is a taxi service taxis are metered You can also use the ride hailing app Dart There is a local bus service but its not available for the late flights If you have a long layover and and your passport lets you exit the airport the Airport mall is a minute drive or minute walk away but but be careful as there are no footpaths

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

Entire flight was smooth however boarding time was a little confusing and the assigned gate they suddenly changed it so it caused more confusion I ordered prebook meal it tasted good but the food itself was somehow cold For me airlines baggage policy was highly favorable as I was able to check in kilos regardless of number of luggage

Arlanda to Marsa Alam return All things considered it was better than the Tui equivalent where our and year olds were only offered coffee or tea no water as a beverage for paid meals Staff were friendly food looked great we packed our own and no price gouging on the drinks service

This is an extremely clean and well maintained airport They do updates regularly as needed Its very easy to get to and from Parking is pretty cheap compared to a bunch of other airports Ive been to but not super cheap Theyre already planning out the new rail connection to downtown that will be running by Currently there is a bus service as well as Uber and taxis if you dont have someone picking you up Lyft on its way to the city Its very easy to get around and if you come in from an international destination the customs is very quick What I do find bothersome is the lack of airport lounge in the US departures area The only lounges in the airport are Air Canada and Porter both on the domesticinternational departures area The food selection in the airport is pretty slim but you wont go hungry its just really limited in the US departures to one soso restaurant and a tim hortons Shopping is even more slim in all departures areas But does anyone really go shopping in an airport This airport is miles or kilometers ahead of those in a lot of US airports Ive been to despite all the drawbacks

Flew TACA Airlines from Lima to Bogota Only the outside of the aircraft and the food carriage were TACA The rest magazine and crew were Avianca Food service for the and a half hour flight was great full meal Full service of drinks juices beers alcoholic I would fly with them again

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

Stunning new terminal friendly staff pleasurable experience only thing missing was the airlines One scheduled flight to Moscow once a week and winter charter flights is not justified hope to see the scheduled operators move in soon

I agree that it is a small tidy airport with close proximity to the city It is great that the tram is literally as you walk out the front doors with a frequent service to the city Bremen is such a great little city

Honiara on the island of Guadalcanal is the capital of the Solomon Islands in the South West Pacific and the only international airport in the country The traffic flow into Solomon Islands is minimal about six or seven flights a week mainly filled with Australian government officials Asian businessmen and the odd tourist The terminal itself was built by the Japanese Government about It is not airconditioned and can be very warm and humid inside given that Honiara is in the middle of the tropics Due to water and plumbing problems the toilets can be unpleasant It is a good idea to check in two hours before hand as checkin queues can be long as departure time approaches Flights are often delayed but airport staff are unlikely to be able to tell you much one way of checking to see if your departure will be on time is to check the Brisbane Airport website to see if the flight left Brisbane for Honiara on time Customs and security is usually quick on departure but customs and immigration can be somewhat slower on arrival Forget duty free shopping on departure shop in Honiara town instead On arrival sometimes the duty free booth is open and if so it does offer good prices on alcohol All in all a hot humid experience which will not leave you feeling terribly comfortable On the plus side staff are usually helpful and cheerful and cleanliness has improved considerably over the last couple of years

Arrived mid night from Mumbai in a domestic flight aircraft attached to aero bridge in min we were at baggage area baggage arrived in next min Washroom were clean paid porters available plenty of baggage trolly No public transport during night only option is either prepaid or booking directly with taxi drivers We took prepaid going to Utorda around km paid approx inr during night a percent surcharge is applicable during day time should be around inr Just after you exit the terminal would be surrounded by taxi drivers prepaid cab counter is inside the building at arrival hall

Airport is easy to reach by metro train and taxi Check in area and departure area have been perfectly clean In the check in area only few shops and restaurant available departure area have more choice but I did not use them as I used the lounge Check in went fast and efficient same for security check Staff was professional
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

I like KM Malta airlines Between a faulty departure screen and me not paying attention I panicked when I saw my flight status on screen said gate closed Ran to the gate in minutes and it was indeed closed Much to my obvious delight and surprise they still let me board and ordered a bus to take me to the aircraft where having boarded they shut the doors and we departed No persuasion was necessary and I cant imagine any other airline being this reasonable Onboard service and food excellent
Madrid to Granada Excellent Efficient and attentive cabin crew Arrived and left on time New aircraft and comfortable seats Straightforward boarding and disembarking Highly recommended
