Tashkent Airport can be difficult to navigate Regulations are strictly enforced especially at departure Upon arrival I noticed that the people do not observe lines and not speaking Uzbek or Russian can be a disadvantage Make sure that you fill out and keep all official forms you receive There is one for each hotel you stay in and there are matching customs forms for arrival and departure you need to list valuables and cash and produce both forms when leaving the country Departure gate is a floor below the departure area There is now an escalator and carts are available for taking bags from the entrance gate to the escalator but only passengers may enter the departure gate Good luck if you have more than one or two bags There are no porters or at least not when I was there I had forgotten about the customs forms after I had to repeatedly insist to the airline representative that I was allowed to check in more than one bag and the customs official said I could not take my money out of the country without submitting both forms You will have to remove your shoes and socks and put on blue plastic booties before going through security The airport personnel were courteous and even friendly but it was clear that no exceptions would be made

Used to be very busy in the Soviet times since then reduced the traffic by at least At the same time the new terminal was built with more adequate waiting spaces It is rather modern and clean Food service is kind of slow Public transportation to the city is not on top and I used parknfly only once

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

Staff all very helpful in particular a lady from the special assistance team She went above and beyond what a lovely lady who clearly is very devoted to her job role We would choose to fly from Eindhoven airport again as our experience was so smooth and professionally handled Thank you such a small thing to say I hope this gets back to the whole team

Osaka to Vladivostok Second time to fly S very good experience from checkin to boarding timeprocedure and flight itself Checkin was smooth boarding was quick and efficient The aircraft was new the legroom was decent and the snack offered inflight surprisingly good Total flight time was about h we landed minutes earlier than scheduled Overall high marks for S

Excellent flights from Gran Canaria to Tenerife North with this super regional airline Well maintained clean aircraft both ways Short flights of around mins with friendly cabin crew Newspapers brought round before take off During the flight served glass of water with a chocolate biscuit followed by a sweet Just enough time to collect everything in before landing Check in easy with no queing at both LPA and TFN Luggage delivered on belt within mins of entering baggage reclaimat both airports Thank you Binter Canarias for excellent service

This small airport was a model of efficiency clean cool organised with a friendly restaurant serving Indian and Western food The Kingfisher Airlines ground crew were excellent The short walk to the plane will sadly end when a shiny new terminal is soon completed

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

The airport is good and surprisingly large for a city of this population due to large number of tourists Most depart on Terminal S South note the terminal as the other terminal is far away Check in and security were smooth and fast There are adequate facilities for shopping or a drink The airport as well as Alaska Airlines have a good record of on time departure A good airport though there is not many lounges

I was stopped by the airport because i had a problem with my passport the bluebird staff did everything to help me get on the plane on time The staff ran with me to the place where they make you a new passport and the Security head took me in his car to the airplane they all did a great effort to let me fly to my destination and not cancel it Thank you guys
Great airport not many flights so no hassle From check in to take off minutes Car parking also free

Airport is brand new after going through modern reconstruction Airport surrounding has also gone through a modern reconstruction Signage was seen throughout the airport passport control and security is upstairs accessed through an escalator Pens used to fill out a departure form were running out with no other pens in the surrounding area Passport control was quick and so was security despite there being a long line it soon disappeared Couple of food shops Chinese dim sum Khmer etc Overall the airport has been refitted to a modern state gates shops etc were new and staff were friendly

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

Used this airline for an internal flight in China last October from Kunming to Lijiang and just had to take some photos etc but not a joke crisp new airline with latest Boeings smart logos etc Short flight but adequate English used and friendly crew

Excellent services as usual by Singapore Airlines from Darwin to Singapore on March even though I was fasting and unable to eat my foods they didnt forget to give me a box of dry foods and drinks to break my fasting Thanks a lot to the cabin crews Flight from Singapore to BKK SQ on March was great too Always excellent service
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

Johannesburg to Bloemfontein This review is more for compliment for one of your service staff at domestic departures I had a connecting flight from CPT to Bloemfontein via JHB I flew Mango to JHB and SAA Express to BFN There was only hour between arrival in JHB and departure to BFN The baggage claims for Mango took way too long and l was going to miss my flight Without my bag l ran up to the SAA express checkin counters for assistance Staff really went over and beyond to assist me and make sure l didnt miss my flight He assisted to check me in and help to carry my bag from baggage claim up to the checkin counter and safely on the correct plane All in time Without is quick response and help l would have surely missed my flight Well done for excellent customer service Thank you

The international arrivals and departure section at Harare Zimbabwe airport is a revelation On arrival all the staff including Immigration and Customs were friendly and welcoming and this contributed to an excellent first impression and a speedy processing Possibly helped by having obtained visas before flying On departure check in was efficient and again the friendly staff were most helpful There is a full range of facilities airside and clean toilets At present there are not too many international flights but the experience was excellent

As living in the north of The Netherlands Bremen airport is a good alternative for Amsterdam Recently flown from the new low cost Ryanair terminal Its basic clean and blue There is a multipurpose shop which sells everything from a to z at somewhat inflated prices and small coffee shop Seating is mostly in plastic chairs which you could find at your local dentist Reasonable but we had an early flight so it was not so crowded Would not like to be there when its get full There are also some paid internet terminals The airport is well situated from the city center and freeway from the parking garage you are within minutes in the main terminal building Bremen is still a great small airport but they need to get some other low cost airlines on board besides Ryanair

Easy access by bus or taxi Two terminals International on the right Domestic on the left as you face them but only metres apart Signs in English as well as Russian although all announcements are in Russian as you would expect How many of the staff speak English may be a good question one who does is the AviaNova manager Easy layout to navigate in domestic terminal although there is not much space for the checkin queues so they snake around the room However the staff for my flight anyway were very efficient and the queue moved quickly Security check was quick and easy Airside has an expensive cafe and coffee shop as well as a newsstand and gift shop Plenty of comfortable seating WiFi is available good signal but every site I tried came up with Security Certificate not issued by Trusted Source so theres possibly some bug in their software I didnt do any more than just log in Bussed to plane only complaint as with so many of these airports is that you go upstairs to a departure lounge and then have to walk back down for the bus

My first time flying with Malindo now Batik Air Fabulous experience smooth checkin luggage included Friendly attentive staff Much more comfortable seats that either Air Asia or Jetstar Good pricing I have already booked another flights Impressive economy airline for the price you pay
The set of counters of Cathay Dragon was a bit out of order since every counter was excessively full due to the great number of passengers Business Class and Marco Polo Club and Oneworld Members

SVOSVXHEL Arrived mid morning from Moscow on domestic flight There seem to be a good number of piers to allow access to the terminal building Airport in the middle of being fully upgraded with building work everywhere estimated to be finished some time in Arrival was via various corridors that would not normally see passengers but the luggage was on the belt when we got there and then out into Arrivals Airport not that busy so things seemed to run OK Early morning Checkin for departure required basic suitcase scanning before Checkin which seemed a little slow Security Scanning perfunctory no need to get laptops out and shoes off with minimal queuing Facilities in Departure Lounge limited but sufficient Free WiFi available which was OK Boarding directly via pier smooth

Every time on arrival from either holiday work meetings interstate or visiting relatives in Melbourne I feel all the renovations look great but please put the car park ticket machines near the carousel arrival hall out of the weather When some people pay at the gate they hold up the traffic I travel with Virgin regularly and cant wait for the renovations to be finished

Smooth flight and comfortable seat Premium economy still a good value on Finnair The cabin chief was competent as I got a problem with only one choice of meal Im platinum and I was upset to see the poorest service during the dinner on board he went to apologize so its good but when you pay euros you expect a better service concerning the food The flight attendants have to be more smiley

Lovely experience through check in and security at around am this morning th July The chap at Tui desk was friendly professional and helpful All four members of staff at security were great Helpful friendly and professional Lovely atmosphere At the caf a lovely women served me Smile on her face Finally going through to boarding gate yet again a friendly cheerful and helpful lady checked me in am by this stage Its a small airport The shop and caf are small Im not here to shop or sit drinking Im here to have an ideally stress free start to my holiday The staff make this place Thank you

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal

I guess the main factor to consider when assessing TVM aiport is perspective Most visitors to the airport are NRI returning home Hence issues like good shopping and dining dont really matter to most As an NRI what I really want is fast processing whether it is arrival or departure This has historically been the major lament about Indian aiports In this regard TVM airport gets top marks It is easy to drive into and there is good parking space Ticketing security checks and immigration are fairly quick and the aiport staff do not hassle you as long as you have your valid documents ready it is better to have a printed ticket with you It is not a fancy airport although the buildings are modern and clean but I am very proud of it

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

Flew out of Maputo up the coast to Inhambane Found it to be clean well organised free of queues and with fairly friendly staff We used the domestic terminal which was largely devoid of facilities apart from a couple of shops but also virtually devoid of passengers A surprisingly pleasurable experience

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice

TimisoaraMunich The flight was h min and operated on a SAAB which was in pretty good shape I believe these are former Crossair props Was offered a decent breakfast on this flight although a little bit disappointed that the cheese omlette was cold Otherwise good selection of drinks and friendly crew Overall a good deal for the price Would fly them again
Plane clean and on time Ran out of water after row economy Its a short flight so bring back water in seat pockets of you cant cope No coffee tea or drinks for anyone

Cheap prices comfortable seats decent legroom inches on the former IndiGo airplane Check in at Bogota was done online but tourist pass for San Andres and bags had to be dropped off at the check in counter which was pretty easy Boarding was a breeze After take off many people switched seats since most didnt pay for an assigned one Flight was minutes late but otherwise good The only problem were kids running up and down the aisle like wild animals and nobody from the crew stopping them Unfortunately due to Colombias COVID rules there was no inflight service but you are able to bring your own drinks and snacks

Fly or times a year Mexico City to Ciudad Victoria Planes are small Fokker Turboprops Always very friendly staff and have been on time Seats are rather small an excellent lounge with drinks and snacks at a number of airports Service onboard with snacks and drinks are adequate

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

I had forgotten what the airport was like but it was great very small and compact no air bridges to aircraft just a quick walk across the airfield Immigration was very easy and efficient as international flights seem to land one at a time The luggage was swiftly off the aircraft and minutes you are in your taxi off to your Hotel Check in again was very quick we arrived very early and were first in the queue your taxi drops you off curbside and you walk about paces and the checkin is in front of you Immigration was very quick minutes and you are airside very limited space and a sad sight of a Burger King Fortunately we went upstairs to the BusinessFirst Lounge shared by most airlines it was empty when we arrived but filled very quickly good tea and coffee a bit limited offerings but ample really Called when the flight was boarding chaos downstairs but they were calling priority boarding and eventually all went as planned
It is not big The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean and not crowded

Contrary to what I had expected to find at a small domestic airport the terminal was beautifully clean well laid out with the benefit of some shops friendly staff who helped us through the security and check in process Ladies toilets both Indian and Western style were acceptably clean AC was okay if you were standing under it I would have no hesitation in travelling through this airport again on future visits to India Well done to those who maintain the Airport keep up the good work

Luangpraban to Vientiane This airline was above expectations The checkin opened on time The staff where very helpful and gave me a seat with extra leg room The flight left on time and arrived early Will use again for sure

I flew Yeti Airlines June from Bhairahawa the airport near Lumbini the birthplace of Buddha to the capital Kathmandu It was a morning flight on time the ground staff were friendly cabin crew was friendly They served soft drinks on this minute flight Reading material offered The jetstream is a turboprop engine aircraft and has seating capacity for person in an x arrangement The flight was smooth Yeti Airlines has the reputation of flying on time Though its safety record is not very encouraging but has been spotless and blemish free since it separated its mountains region operations in the name of Tara air as its subsidiary Sky miles their frequent flyer program is very popular and has many other benefits like discounts in hotels than award tickets The name Yeti also is an attraction to the visitors

Vientiane to Bangkok UPlane was clean food was excellent tuna sandwiches plus water and a second drink of either Pepsi Coffee Tea Miranda Orange or more water The crew made this flight excellent for a start there are cabin crew in total which made a difference to the service time delivery Every member of the crew smiled were courteous served ladies first to emulate their countries values and did a great service One small minor point was that my seat back pocket was broken slightly in A Will definitely use again

Mid size airport with Indian standard with connectivity to most big cities in India after covid no international flight For arrival its easy to use we arrives at baggage hall and same hall have a prepaid taxi counter and a snack shop and a liquor shop Toilets were clean and also the terminal looks clean plenty of baggage trolleys also have paid porter facility Cabs are available book through their kiosk and avoid taking from touts outside It is situated within the city so if travelling light may walk towards outside and get auto that would be cheapest option to travel Ola Uber also available

Thoroughly enjoyed our experience Friendly staff seats felt spacious Delicious meals Our inter island flights were great too loved being able to disembark through both doors Take note interisland flights have lower weight for carry on but checking a bag is free so it was just fine
Excellent flight left on time and arrived on time Amritsar to Kullu Small aircraft which was about full Great price no complaints from me and would happily fly with them again

My flight had been delayed so I arrived later at the airport however checkin had closed as checkin times had not been amended The security team were really helpful in scanning my bike box and ensuring it got to the gate to be loaded on the plane The team were very friendly and supportive with a great result Thanks

Earlier I reviewed here the disastrous departure with AA from MIA and it seems only fair that I should write about the excellent arrival procedures at Santo Domingo airport On the short walk from the plane to the arrival booths there are some people randomly checking Covid documents At the booth you need to show by phone or paper your electronic E ticket and then it is a breeze When I arrived at the booth there were officers on duty and the line was very short The luggage was on the carousel within minutes of landing and an official will check your bag tag with that on your luggage Plenty of taxis but a bit pricey and a great start to arriving in the DR

I travelled from Coventry to Naples this year and found the airport limited but satisfactory The checkin area reminded me of the old days with cardboard flight destination signs and this was an area that could be easily changed for the better The lines crossed each other to the destinations and did cause some friction between customers The car parking was an experience but again was satisfactory I do not understand why the local bus companies especially those going to Leamington Stratford do not call in On returning the baggage was certainly a LOT better than Birmingham so a plus there In the departure lounge there was a good choice of food and drink at great prices no rip off here Also a small point The newspapers were out and available from about Birmingham they are still under wraps at Good value and friendly Hope they get permission for the bigger one soon

Myself and my wife were on our first visit to Lanzarote and my first time as an assisted passenger The team who took care of us were excellent friendly and so helpful This made our holiday so much more enjoyable Thanks to the team well done assistance team at Lanzarote airport Thank You

Boarded by bus on an distant location AN on a very good condition crew was young people friendly and eager to help passengers to place carryons to the bins Legroom was tight I was lucky my next seat was left empty and the flight was barer able We departed on time min after departure they served coffee no free and hours within the flight they served lunch from Buy on board Menu Flight was full and almost all passengers transferring to North American destinations

This airport was very wellrun when me and my family were here We were going to Punta Cana for a family vacation through jetBlue We were able to get through security smoothly and the customs and shuttles were fast The food court provided a wide variety of foods for me and my family to choose from and everything was very modern The bathrooms were clean enough for usage The only con about this airport was the lack of the jet bridge It didnt help that it was raining upon our leaving Punta Cana We experienced torrential downpour and had to quickly get onboard and we were drenched by the time we were on the plane But there were also many good things about this airport and I would not mind visiting it again

I booked this flight solely because it was by far the cheapest option for me to get to my destination on new years eve I hadnt known much about Garuda Indonesia before except for the fact that its a star airline I must say I was pleasantly surprised Everything from checkin transfers food and service was excellent I was travelling with my elderly relative for whom wed requested a wheelchair for who was escorted by hand to her seat upon boarding something which Ive ever seen on another airline We had a very tight connection in Jakarta minutes which was managed very well by ground staff at all airports The ground staff at Melbourne Airport assured me that our luggage would be loaded onto the connecting flight I was panicking when our flight from Melbourne departed slightly late due to our already tight connection but the ground staff at Jakarta Airport were preprepared and were ready waiting for us to escort us quickly to our connecting flight and we thankfully made the connection Overall a great experience

General Mitchell is a breath of a fresh air Its clean friendly and efficient Theres actually a classy little used book store and a museum full of model planes and blimps and whatnot If you get lost it is your fault my friend The whole place is like one of the models in the museum accurate well labeled and miniature Everything is right in front of you Theres an Amtrak station a block away minutes and to get to Union Station in Chicago is hard to beat This airport is tiny but its the easiest one Ive ever dealt with

This is a small new and very well designed airport There is only one runway so there is never too much traffic The business lounge is excellent clean and there is always food and drink and the service is excellent
On time departure Excellent value and they gave a meal on a hour flight We arrived mins early Staff was professional Bags delivered in a normal amount of time

I enjoyed my flight aboard Air Zimbabwe from Harare to Johannesburg the crew were very friendly and the service was excellent We arrived ahead of schedule checkin was fast and smooth and the seats were comfortable

Recently flew to and from Roissy CDG to Biarritz International in the Basque country in south west France for the first time The airport itself is small but there is a good bus service which will take you into the city centre pretty quickly On arrival on the HRS AF flight from CDG this flight seemed to coincide with a number of other flights from the UK which made the baggage arrivals area chaotic In addition the toilet facilities landside need some upgrading and definitely could do with the cleaners visiting there on a more frequent basis especially midafternoon which seems to be the peak time for the airport The rubbish bin in the gents toilet was overflowing when I was there which left a poor initial impression The airport does have an excellent tourism booth with very helpful staff however In addition from the airport one can get onto the nearby motorway very quickly and the care hire agencies also had very helpful staff at the airport especially Europcar On departing Biarritz back to Paris however I discovered that the departures area has only one very small cafe so passengers may not want to enter this area too quickly as the wait could be long and somewhat boring In summary the airport is convenient but it falls well short of the new fresher and modern design of nearby Pau airport which is excellent

Departing from Terminal for a domestic flight The airport was well connected with the public bus and train The terminal in general was clean modern and efficient Check in was fast and completely automatic via machines with ground staff was ready to help Surprising no long queue at the security and everything was smooth There were numerous comfy seats available for passengers Shopping and dining were also really good and at reasonable price

It was my first time to fly with Asiana Airline Service is world class check in counter staff are super friendly Flight crew are very friendly excellent service always there on call you press button and the air hostess is there Always smiling Food was beyond and above the first class standard I flew Sydney to New York via Incheon Seoul all flights had the same standard Desk crew in JFK New York was just as friendly I give Asiana Airline for punctuality on time arrival and departure I give them for flight crew I give them for food quality

I have flown several legs with Qantaslink over the past months The Q has a more comfortable seat than the new seats in Qantas Boeing and soon to be Airbus s apart from their newest aircraft VHA which has seats so hard that a wooden bench would be more comfortable Ground Service Im pretty disappointed that you cant select your seats until hour before you leave for us less desired Red FF or no FF customers and all the seats up the front are blocked off for Qantas preferred customers Baggage drop and collection has been efficient on all flights where I have checked my luggage On board cabin crew do their jobs and the pilots are friendly Most delayed departures have ended in on time or early arrivals Food they may as not bother I dont consider tiny cent sized corn chips with some sauces a meal or even a snack I think Qantas and Qantaslink need to do alot better here One bonus is that unlike Rex you can purchase a lounge pass with your flight to allow you to relax have some food or drinks and get away from the crowds before our flights out of capital cities Lounge passes unless youre a Qantas Club member or Gold FF and higher cost Boarding disembarking When they dont use those ramps which are great for people with mobility issues disembarking is pretty efficient but when the ramps are used it can take up to minutes for them to put the ramp onto the aircraft The buses that take passengers to and from remore stands are a safety hazard if you have mobility or balance issues then sit in a seat as the drivers seem to be very heavy on the brakes

Lovely airport and great shops for an airport of this size Paying a the counter for taxis removes the touts that descend on you in other places Food options are limited but then who would want to spend too long checking in too early and getting hungry when on such a lovely island
Very convenient airport as it is not very large Signs are clear getting to and from the airport is easy too Shops are available post office included The terminal is clean

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

Lovely little airport Check in was very quick as was passport control and security Good selection of shops after security Airport was very clean including the toilets A couple of dining options available and a drinking water dispenser provided to top up your bottles Mineral water can also be purchased for US Plenty of seating available by the gates On departure there are no gates just a short walk to the plane All in all a great little airport

A newly started airport in North Bihar catering large population of North Bihar and even some area of NepalThe airport is actually an operative airport of Indian Airforce and runway is simultaneously used for civilian service The Terminal being used is a temporary one and a new terminal will come soon is years This airport should be seenused for service and facilities but for logistically importance for reaching some of the most undeveloped area in India with ease Terminal is one of the smallest in India but managed nicely no parking available have to park outside the campus on the road from main gate the terminal is just min walk so not an issue trolleys are there washroom are clean there is one tea and snacks shop just near main gate in the campus and use that if you need anything after that wont find anything inside Hope they construct a new terminal soon Though cabs are available outside but no option of prepaid or authorized cab inside better to book cab in advance

Each time I have flown in and out it has been easy The lines moves quickly and everyone is friendly and helpful Upon arrival after passing through immigration you proceed to the baggage carousel and hope that your luggage has made it to your destination with you but dont try to walk away with your suitcase that easily someone will be standing by to check your baggage tag and your passport

Was expecting the worst after the number of negative reviews but was very pleasantly surprised at how quick efficient and friendly the service was Traveling in September probably has a substantial bearing on numbers but we were through checkin and passport control in minutes which is much better than most airports weve used in the recent past Water is available to top up bottles for free or just from a machine as you exit security far from the exorbitant prices encountered at other airports The service selection and seating area at cafe Soho are excellent assuming our flight is on time Ryanair its a five star experience
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

Unprofessional but aircraft is new and clean They cancelled my flight replaced with one with stopover and to change it for a flight on the same day took me a lot of emails to do it New flight was on Lisbon to Sal via Praia they issued tickets to Lisbon to Praia then they corrected it and then my reservation was appearing on a different date Finally after a month of exchanging emails they got it right On their site there is web checkin but is not working They want physical checkin to make sure you preregistered to enter the country and paid euro to do it They have often delays but our flight was on time because aircraft arrived to Lisbon on time Plane BM was new and clean front rows have great legroom Crew was friendly There was no IFE but inflight service was good and sandwich was tasty

VIP Boarding is a scam VIP Seats are a scam Too many flight cancellations without warning Every question I ask the response is I dont know Uncomfortable seats Always super late and they lie about being on time I will stick to USbased airlines from now on This is the last time I fly VivaAir
Great airport Excellent shopping facilities Very clear directions Very helpful staff A cut above the rest of the small airports I have visited

Flew STNBIO BIOSTN modern stylish terminal architecture some way outside Bilbao but perhaps the nearest bit of flat land to be found amongst all those hills No problems on arrival speedy passport check and luggage quickly up on the belt Same when leaving fact luggage drop and security control Airport is clean staff friendly and helpful Minor gripes no free wifi no post office to buy stamps souvenir shop did not have any postcards food and drink airside expensive lifts seem to have a mind of their own not enough seats on the groundside Bilbao well worth a visit even for a day but certainly a weekend

XIYCTUAUH Arrived from Xian on domestic flight in Terminal which was newly opened in Spring All very clean and tidy with clear signs in Mandarin and English Quite a long walk to Baggage Reclaim for the furthest gates but not unreasonable Toilets clean and plentiful with both squat and regular options For International Departures there are main dining options before Checkin either KFC or local Chinese food There are a few stores selling various local foods and some souvenirs CheckIn pretty good and Passport Control and Security all pretty smooth No requirement to remove belts or laptops for security scanning but do enforce the ml liquid rules from Europe In the International Departures no dining opportunities but a couple of coffeeshop options along with the usual array of Duty Free shops Most departures are from one of the airbridges Announcements made in both Chinese and English Toilets are clean

The mid morning flight took off on time from CCU and as I had to go to Bangalore for work my company had booked this flight for me Web checkin and baggage drop were smoothly done Boarding also started on time Landing and disembarkation also happened swiftly along with baggage retrieval which was good IndiGo may not be a glamorous carrier but it gets the job done of taking you from point A to point B efficiently

Bari Airport looks new but they have not yet found a way to avoid a minute wait for security checks Leaving tourists in a minute queue for security is not a good way to attract tourists If the queue is minutes on th April what will it be in July and August Puglia is a great region to visit and Bari is an excellent gateway Pity the local autorities cant run an airport

PointePitre to Paris Orly Good service on this route in Classe Madras business class Flight took off and arrived on time A good dinner was served shortly after takeoff and a breakfast shortly before landing The cabin crew were friendly and professional However I have to say that I prefer the layout in the business class on their A The layout on this newer aircraft certainly has more functions but it looked quite cumbersome and crowded to me Incredibly the selection of French songs was also very limited Lounge in PointePitre was also quite small and very limited food good if you are on a diet as they were very slow to replenish the food supply Overall I think Air Carabes is good for this route but a few improvements can be made

Having read reviews here I expected a nightmare but everything went very smoothly Terminal A seems to be new and very efficiently organised Staff friendly and helpful and lines short It was a quiet period so it might be different at Thanksgiving and other busy times

Worst Airport in the world arrived to check in then security on baggage Then Passport machine thought great all good Walked through Duty Free then a mile long queue to get through to B gate BA is B gate Poor shops nobody could shop or eat unless you had got their hours early This queue apparently is normal and is called the new fast track what a joke One person in a box checking passports again Run to B hundreds of people standing there no way could you board in Groups just a free for all Again with one woman at the gate before you got on the coach to the plane still coaching you out to the plane She was checking everyones passport again Why havent they upgraded this system by now and built satellite gates off the main airport Not going back there

Newark to Paris As a result of the delays in receiving their ALR aircraft Premera air contracted EuroAtlantic to fly the Newark ParisCDG routeThe check in took about mins as it was a full flight It took about mins to get through security at Newark due to the lack of TSA staff and screening equipmentThe seats were comfortable ahd a personal TV screen in each seat which had a limited selection of films and TV shows There was also a USB port to charge personal devices There were no headphones offered on board luckily we had our own set The scheduled flight time was hrs mins we took off about mins late but we managed to arrive on time into CDG The EuroAtlantic staff were friendly and attentive and looked after the passengers on the flight Meals and drinks were provided to those passengers who booked their meals through the Primera air website Overall this flight was great value for money

Please dont heed old reviews Baku airport is modern immaculately clean entirely non smoking It has plenty of landside facilities including business lounge when it is open toilets cafebar and McDonalds Plenty of comfortable seating areas Sheraton hotel on site Good free WiFi Staff speak English and are helpful No hassling taxi drivers Cant fault it

Surprisingly good experience Cabin staff were unbelievably attentive and helpful Food and beverages were excellent for airline food Boarding and deboarding were well organized Only downside was business configuration was and flat bed was not as comfortable as on other airlines

Small super convenient airport Its small but efficient Has one food counter with the really good food Better than most airports Have to walk out on tarmac to plane Arrival and exiting are quick and easy Wait about minutes to minutes for bag and out the front door in steps Outside attendant are great The give directions and keep pick up lines organized enough Gets a for Convenience

Small but efficient and clean airport There was not much rush and check in to gate was minutes in the evening I fly from this airport once a year and never have any issueso far Customs and immigration takes less time than any other airports in India experienced

I prefer using this airport over almost any other in Texas major cities but in true American airport form there are advantages and drawbacks to using San Antonio SAT Here are the pros Access from either I or US is pretty easy considering that interchange is one of the busiest in the city Access to the very busy touristic downtown is relatively easy as the airport isnt far away by rideshare Parking is easy access from the parking garages to the terminal is easy signage leading to and within the airport is pretty easy to follow Delta checkin was quick and friendly Gate agents were professional and helpful Staff in the stores generally seemed friendly The terminal is mostly clean the presecurity checkin area is very spacious and modern Using CLEAR and PreCheck I breezed through security However here are the drawbacks Security TSA had an officious dour attitude that Id expect much more in Houston Miami LAX or NYC not San Antonio Dont know what that was about The restrooms were filthy Seating throughout the terminal was not at all ample for the crowds of people waiting to fly out the airport desperately needs expansion and that includes more seating and general modernization postsecurity Upon return baggage claim was remarkably slow for a small airport albeit a small airport serving a large metropolitan area So pound for pound SAT is an overall good option and Id still rather use them than anything in Houston or Austin but there is still room for improvement

CPTGBE GBEJNB First flight a clean Bae in very good condition half empty with loads of leg room Food excellent for an airline and service find Second flight on an equally clean ATR with equally good snacks All flights on time Much prefer them to SAX or Airlink

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point

Xian to London on th Feb Aircraft only years old Good amount seat recline with charger available however the entertainment system need an upgrade It is the coronavirus outbreak at moment the crew did an excellent job measuring temperature and disinfected the aircraft Excellent cabin service I went back to spoke with cabin crew they are willing to share their stories and experiences The lack of entertainment system is covered by the excellent crew service
Havana Cayo Coco return A one hour flight with an old ATR turboprop Seats surprisingly comfortable and we were offered a free drink plus candy onboard Nothing special but we arrived on time

Have flown with Air Canada many times and have always had a good experience Our last trip was to Florence via Zurich Flights LX out and LX in No issues whatsoever Check in was smooth boarding in Toronto was about the easiest we have experienced in a while seats were fine service was good The only minor issue was that the seatback in the seatback in front of me was broken somehow and I couldnt put the tray back easily Also whats with offering WiFi but only to Aeroplan members of a certain level I find that annoying Other that that everything was good

This airport has improved phenomenally in the last years Apparently some operations have been outsourced to a private company and gone are many of the inefficiencies we used to run into earlier Immigration plus custom is now a breeze and the officials are actually customer friendly Food services have come a long way The guys who used to scan baggage before check in are gone so the check in process is much faster More helpful signs posted Bathrooms much better but need to improve further Scan of carry on baggage post immigration gets a bit painful at peak hours but not any more than at Dubai or Abu Dhabi Since the traffic through this airport is modest its peak hours late evening early morning do not cause shortage of seats Parking is a different problem you might waste a long time trying to find a spot during peak Ambience is great helped by sound architecture bright lighting vast open spaces

My jewel among low cost airlines Courteous efficient and highly safety oriented cabin crew Very enjoyable flying experience thru out Every time the washroom had been used the crew checked it for cleanliness Great public announcements

DYU to FRA Somon Air flights are very difficult to book outside Tajikstan so although their flight times suited me I ended up booking my outbound flight to Tajikstan with Turkish Air I did manage to book my return flight with some local help whilst in Tajikstan and was pleasantly surprised Aircraft was a new Boeing flight was comfortable and the cabin crew very good There were only approx passengers on the flight which is probably more to do with the problems booking rather than the quality of their service There is no TV IFE but as most of the Somon Air flights are through the night this wasnt a problem I wouldnt put anyone off flying with Somon Air but they really do need to offer flight booking outside Tajikstan with the major travel agents in order to be competitive

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus

BrusselsAleppo DamascusBrussels Cheapest tickets to Syria direct flights from Brussels to Aleppo and Damascus friendly crew adequate food Although older Airbus they were clean and looked well maintained and a lot of legspace

Recently flew throughout Myanmar on the following routes YangonMandalayHehoMandalayNyaung U BaganHehoThandweYangon on their Fokker and ATR aircraft Checkin interesting as there are no computers and everything is weighed manually Ground crew cordial but not overly friendly Flight crews were friendly and always helpful Catering is good for the short flights with croissants and drinks being offered on even the shortest of flights unthinkable in Europe Aircrafts were always spotless and comfortable

Cute little airport everything functions as it should No big lines its nice and clean and organized It was very easy getting into a shuttle after landing and getting to the hotel a great price too Im always a fan of getting to a new place and not having a chaotic mess of people trying to rip you off on transportation that was definitely not the case in Ko Samui

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

Being first time flyers with Rex we were delighted with the personal service at airports and in the air Assisted with booking in luggage and seating details Being tall enough leg room to be comfortable We would choose to fly rex whenever possible

A nicely laidout airy and spacious airport with excellent facilities and courteous staff a proper Estonian showpiece With TLL only km from the city centre taxi fares are very reasonable Security was efficient and from a UK perspective refreshingly unofficious

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

Small airport with helpful staff In the arrivals hall there is nothing special On departure you can enjoy your time on the st floor snacks bar with some good choices The view to the apron is good from the departure hall The only negative side is that the air conditioning system is not good at all

We flew Qantas on a flight operated by Finnair on their behalf from Sydney to Bangkok It was a great experience from start to finish staff smiley and helpful Finnair my special GF food great good entertainment offer and we left on time from Sydney and touched down a few minutes early in Bangkok It was the distinct mixture of experiences on this flight which have made me post A collaboration of Scandinavian Australasian and Asian continents More like this please Just great My husband would have liked just a bit more legroom in economy for a long flight

Just wanted to shout out the excellent customer service and help I received recently at Denpasar Bali airport I stupidly left two bags on the carousal when I went through customs Airport security were very friendly as the guided me through a secure area to go back behind the luggage area to retrieve the bags and customs did not hassle me for going through twice Cant imagine doing this so easily in a North American airport Bali people are great

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

Great employees service schedules but I have stopped flying with Horizon because they are now using Turbo Prop planes Q Its slower has more noise and vibration and most of all they cannot fly at altitudes where the ride is smooth This is compared to the full size jets that Southwest flies on the same routes as Horizon I used to have the credit card had Frequent flyer status and earned oodles of miles Those days are gone

Please dont heed old reviews Baku airport is modern immaculately clean entirely non smoking It has plenty of landside facilities including business lounge when it is open toilets cafebar and McDonalds Plenty of comfortable seating areas Sheraton hotel on site Good free WiFi Staff speak English and are helpful No hassling taxi drivers Cant fault it

Highly recommended airline offering excellent value for money I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals a hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my hour transit a free single hotel room and a free shuttle from airport to hotel all for It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only

The airport has definitely improved and it looks a lot more modern than it used to be before They have a decent dutyfree shop with a good selection of items I really liked the sports bar that they had there which was also showing the Fifa World Cup games live and the food was good too The airport staff is very friendly and welcoming and there are also stalls where you can get a massage There is also enough seating if you are traveling in transit

Morning flight on PR from Daraga to Manila I have international connection in a separate booking booking but check in agent made it sure my luggage was checked through to my final destination which was so much appreciated as it saved me time and effort at Manila Airport Flight was smooth and on time Ticket price was reasonable

I would like to say a huge thank to Yasmin who went to great lengths to find us a new flight the same day but from Bristol airport flight missed just Start of holiday delayed by hours only her professional and helpful support was greatly appreciated Thank you again

Flew Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air As I knew nothing about this airline I was a bit apprehensive but there was no need to be Checkin was fast and friendly Boarding was by bus and once on board the courteous cabin crew made us feel very welcome The plane was definitely old but very clean and our exit row seats had plenty of legroom Other seats looked a bit cramped but the flight was short Surprisingly a quick drink was served during the minute flight which operated minutes early Overall a pleasant experience The only negative was that the Fasten Seat Belt signs in the cabin were not working

One way Jetairfly flight from Antwerp to Berlin Tegel minute delay was only announced at the planned time of departure Nearly new aircraft the largest that is able to fly on Antwerps runway thin seats but ok for short holiday flights Very quiet and clean Friendly professional cabin crew excellent service Prices of onboard food and drinks are for airline service reasonable This airline often has very good deals available even on short notice Very reasonable price but the available fares vary a lot Flight was about full so they dont seem to be doing too bad The airline tries to be something in between a fullservice carrier a charter operator and a lowcost operator
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the flight departed on time The staff were friendly and efficient The seat was comfortable too Only tea coffee and water is available free of charge which is no big deal given its such a short flight
Their airport is pragmatic on the right size to be passenger friendly and with all major needs served like SIM cards and ATMs available Beware of overpriced rides to the city center or your hotel

Excellent small airport clean spacious good restaurant airline lounges collectively available to a great many airlines Arrival was to jetway Departure was by bus to plane from gate E the gates uses buses to go to aircraft The departure flight needed deicing since the aircraft was not parked at a gate it could be deiced in place before taxiing Frequent reliable bus service tofrom city Security personnel on departure efficient and courteous Time in security line minutes

This is a comparatively new airport in Tunisia and I have nothing but praise for it It is clean smart and well organised Check in and Security were quick and once through to airside a really good duty free shop and a bar Great views from the glass fronted terminal although the view of some aircraft can be obscured by the piers Everything ran smoothly and just a pleasure to travel through this airport

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

This is a large airport that is undergoing runway expansion which is very visible on takeoff and landing For a midmorning flight the C concourse was very but not very crowded Seating at the gates can be a premium however we had no difficulty finding seating The connecting hall has all kinds of restaurants both fast food and sit down Airport WiFi is easy to connect and fast The bathrooms are impeccable There is an attendant on duty who is constantly cleaning the bathrooms after every use The attendant greets passengers saying welcome to the cleanest bathrooms in CLT Kudos to Airport management
My budget airline fare turned out to be a complete surprise with full service and a fairly new A plane The service friendliness and cleanliness are no less than those of Singapore Airlines

PSP is a great little airport The s style terminal is fairly well designed but with the advent of security screening areas its a bit harder to negotiate Rental cars are right outside the door from the baggage carousels The weather is seldom a problem so flights stay pretty close to their schedules Parking is reasonably priced and convenient to the terminal

Return journey Clean modern aircraft comfortable seat tasty food and drying and great cabin crew On the way back ground staff checked our bags through to EDI on BA even though we did not have the journey on a single ticket Impressive and enjoyable journey and I would happily use them again

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

Upon arrival in Chiang Mai we had to take the bus to the terminal which thankfully was a quick trip Customs was fast and the baggage claim was easy Even as a small airport there were friendly and helpful employees It was easy to get around especially finding taxis I would prefer Chiang Mai over Bangkok airport and I will continue to go to this airport

A short flight with this airline on behalf of Swiss Plane was all clean and modern and had USB outlets Staff was friendly and professional Food and beverages were buy on board unfortunately but a bottle of water and a chocolate were complementary All in all a rather uneventful flight but good and professional as it should be

Neos airline division of TUI Germany You can web checkin and you can change seat allocation without pay Plane arrived on time boarding and welcome was professional and crew was helping passengers with their carryons to be placed on bins New and clean aircraft service was great with two servings with tasty food and good variety of juices do not offer beverages but have wine coffee tea IFE is only drop screens to see the flight path and you can hear music from channels with earphones buy or your own

Small airport yet very efficient Dont come too early as there is not much to do Queuing is almost nonexistent staff checkin and security are very friendly There is a restaurant with view on the tarmac and a small airport shop before the security Arrival is very fast to minutes including bagage reclaim There is a bus stop right before the terminal taking you to AntwerpenBerchem train station a major train station with fast connection to Brussels or anywhere in Belgium Very close to the city center Highly recomended for users who like fast airports

Brussels to Punta Cana with Jetairfly on Boeing I was really surprised about this professional service and crew Very good entertainment decent food new plane and friendly service I was lucky to be on a plane which was not fully booked

We booked the flight because it was rather cheap on ctrip hours before departure my wife got a message that my flight from Changsha to Chengdu was cancelled and we should call the airline company Due to Chinese New Year and the Coronavirus it was pretty hard to contact anybody so we decided to take the car to the airport At the airport the ticket desk was unable to change my ticket Sichuan Airlines was unable to change my ticket so we had to call ctrip After nearly hours we got the schedule change and I was able to get an earlier flight Would have wished the airlines had offered me the schedule change by themselves Service on the flight ChangshaChengdu was nonexistent I am not sure if that was due to turbulence or to the virus but it was just a twohours flight and I had brought some food of my own In Chengdu I had to get my luggage and wait for hours to check it in again fortunately there is a good lounge for transit passengers at Chengdu Airport At pm the Sichuan Airlines counters got really busy as there were many flights departing It was really crowded but service was quite quick I was pretty surprised when the flight to Rome got cancelled maybe due to personnel shortage because of the virus My gutfeeling says the flights to Prague and to Rome were pretty empty so they cancelled one flight Passangers to Italy got rebooked to our flight and even that one was not full Seats were a bit narrow and my earphones did not work but I was so tired takeoff at am that I did not need any inflight entertainment Luckily there was no foodservice at the start so passangers were able to sleep The flightattendants handed out bottled water and snacks when I awoke I found snacks and water on the vacant seat next to me Very thoughtful hours before landing they served breakfast It was not a lot we did not even get trays It was Chinese food and I liked it but for Europeans who cannot eat spicy food the choice was not good I am used to spicy food but even I considered the breakfast to be quite spicy No drinks were offered for breakfast Luckily I always try to get a seat near the galley so I could get hot water during the flight for my tea Allinall Sichuan Airlines was quite cheap the aircraft semiclean and inflightentertainment choices were okay If you are not too tall and do not need to many amenities I can recommend this airline Worst flight I ever had to China but still reasonably comfortable

Cusco Airport is another wonderfully crowded and poorly designed airfield in Peru ie Lima Chiclayo Byzantine brutalist concrete architecture aside this airport is by far the worst designed for providing any kind of logical flow for a singlerunway airport serving a large metropolitan area It would seem that nobody in government has looked at what can be done with the cramped space and volume of passengers to try and make a more hospitable clean and userfriendly facility Unfortunately this airport will remain the sole thoroughfare for all international Machu Picchu travelers for the foreseeable future Maybe Peru can step up to the plate and make some major changes to this facility and take a field trip to Quito and check out their new airport which is very nice

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry

Lovely and clean little country airport offering frequent flights to BNE Short and long term parking in front of the terminal is free Restroom facilities very clean and in good working condition Airport has gates but they are pretty separate doors right next to each other leading on to the tarmac no air bridges Security staff well mannered and friendly Free Wifi in the terminal Only one fast food type of restaurant with very average food and rather expensive prices Seating in the terminal is rather uncomfortable hard metal type of seats so suggest you buy a coffee or chocolate bar and find a seat at the fast food restaurant Overall a very friendly and efficient environment
A small but full service airport Doesnt have some of the amenities of larger airports but you would not expect them Clean Great service Short wait times Highly recommended

Overall I like BHM Its small staff at least at Delta check in and gate are super friendly The amenities are good for a small regional airport Bags are usually quick to retrieve My one gripe is parking The parking deck is always almost very nearly completely full so finding a space can often take as long as the short flight to connect in ATL The one other thing that annoys me every time I do find a space is total lack of smart carts in the parking lots Hey listen up Airport managers This is an airport and customers travel with baggage Dont you think it would be a great idea to facilitate this process of getting bags to terminals by offering a cart service in the parking lots

Excellent safe clean on time and we got a hot meal on board which I did not expect given the fact that during the ticket purchase I was prompted to buy a meal which I did not want to do They are a little bit expensive but the flight took a long time hrs Excellent service thank you

Flew out of EMA on the to CFU on an afternoon flight Pre booked short stay car park online entrance and exit worked without problem via number plate recognition Short walk to departures and through luggage drop off with minimal delay Security was very quick and staff friendly Used the escape lounge whilst waiting for boarding and this was very relaxing and the staff were friendly and working hard to keep the food topped up a very good experience Boarding went smoothly and flight away only minutes behind schedule On return on the flight landed minutes ahead of schedule deplaned quickly and through passport control via Egates with no delay Baggage already available to collect by the time we entered the collection area and straight out to the car So all in all another very positive experience at EMA

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

Highly recommended airline offering excellent value for money I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals a hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my hour transit a free single hotel room and a free shuttle from airport to hotel all for It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only

HELCPHHEL HELCPH on Avro RJ ontime both ways Clean aircraft crew and service are nothing special but seats comfortable and spacious in the x configuration CPHHEL on B food for purchase in both directions drinks free In general this is competitive to SAS on the same sector but definitely a lowcost feel without a particularly lowcost price

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

First time from and to the new A terminal Didnt believe it but everything worked excellently No queues at checkin security passport control customs Bus gate had enough lift capacity so went down without wait On arrival baggage was on the belt in minutes and then in minutes off the airport Again no wait at immigration Food choices are fine both airside and landside Take into account this is just minutes some km from downtown Good choice and far superior to overcrowded Borispol with long queues dingy terminals and km from the city centre

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

China Eastern really surprised me with this recent flight I took with them Their business class product is pretty solid and competitive in my opinion Cabin crew were very hospitable and spoke excellent English Meals drinks and snacks were free flowing and quite scrumptious I had the Asian option and their three course meal didnt disappoint I was even taken aback by pajamas being an amenity that was offered There was free wifi too albeit slow I have a couple of very minor gripes though First is my dislike for the slanted seating arrangment which obstructs the feet when in the lie flat position Next had to do with their website which is barely functional I also would of liked a few more film offerings Nevertheless I arrived well rested and well fed so ended up with a completely different outlook of China Eastern for the positive If they can remedy their website and invest a bit more onto their AVOD system they would be a force to be reckoned with I wouldnt hesitate to fly them again

Avoid at peak times security is a mess Gone are the days of the minute check in and smooth easy journey This used to be my go to airport due to the ease of transit Such a shame they have added so much flight capacity and not matched it with security

The queue for the border was moving quite fast the border guards were working fast The toilets in the baggage reclaim area was clean although there was a queue to them one of the two urinals wasnt working The toilet would be better if they were bigger albeit they were quite clean
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

Ohrid St Paul international airport was in terms of size like a trip with the time machine The aircraft is parking literally in front of the Arrivals door where passengers are directed to the Passports control There were only desks working out of which for an airport with flights daily can be considered a good performance Nevertheless despite the size the airport is well organized and clean showing the travelers how flying was at the past times when holding an airline ticket was considered a luxury As an improvement for the administration I think that a shuttle bus from airport to the city roughly km Distance would be to consider synchronized with the flying schedule

International arrival hall is small immigration is crowded does not provide much facility except toilet and carousel With its size luggage come very quickly and most passengers only need to spend minutes from gate to pick up area Once you get out of terminal there are plenty of food shops coffee shop including Starbucks on ground floor and food center on the nd floor For Departure facility is much better Check in area is large clean and modern Departure hall have a lot of shops cafe and restaurant but International departure need to make sure to reserve enough time to pass immigration which is at the farthest end of the airport and no more shop beyond that point

The security staff at Aberdeen airport are not up to standard Many of them are aggressive and argumentative and their main aim is not to be friendly or courteous I have been fortunate enough to travel to many countries and I say without hesitation that the security staff at Aberdeen airport are either the most poorly trained that I have encountered or that they are paying no attention to the training they receive The management team needs to review the training of the security staff at Aberdeen airport urgently

Harrisburg MDT is a great airport Small but connected to many international gateways Security lines are short Food options are limited but good I only wish they offered a NYC area connection My airport of choice

Contrary to what I had expected to find at a small domestic airport the terminal was beautifully clean well laid out with the benefit of some shops friendly staff who helped us through the security and check in process Ladies toilets both Indian and Western style were acceptably clean AC was okay if you were standing under it I would have no hesitation in travelling through this airport again on future visits to India Well done to those who maintain the Airport keep up the good work

The airport is much better than before after the construction of the new terminal and the renovation of the old one Much cleaner more shops better signage etc However the passenger experience is affected by the lack of jet bridges and the use of buses for going to and from the aircraft The buses are hot in the summer and cold in winter and they are probably unsafe during the pandemic If jet bridges cannot be added then passengers should be allowed to walk to and from the aircraft with buses used only during poor weather The external spaces also need some greening up and better maintenance

Great medium sized airport Travel fairly frequent from Hannover mainly from Terminal B to the UK The three terminals are very similar Good city centre connection with SBahn Fast checkin to gate usually same for arrival to out of door
It is easily accessible from the city center by metro within minutes It is clean and modern Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear Goods are bountiful

Boarded by airbridge on an AN with very good condition crew was very friendly Legroom was plenty and seat was very comfortable We departed on time Soon after departure they offer free coffee and water and buy food from a menu Captain made announcements of the flight path We had a great experience with them

This is a great airport and the T terminal is newly established everything inside this airport are symbols of a modernized airport Staff were friendly and helpful in helping directing me to the baggage claim area upon arrival as well as help me check in efficiently by asking my seat preference which I havent experienced during check in before Only disadvantage would be the WiFi in the airport when I arrived in the airport I do not have a Chinese mobile phone and in order to connect to the airport WiFi I need to have a valid Chinese phone number so I could receive verification code unlike my transfer flight in Guangzhou where I could simply connect to the WiFi using my WeChat account Overall my experience with WNZ is great but please fix the WiFi issue so international traveler can connnect to the WiFi

The airport has definitely improved and it looks a lot more modern than it used to be before They have a decent dutyfree shop with a good selection of items I really liked the sports bar that they had there which was also showing the Fifa World Cup games live and the food was good too The airport staff is very friendly and welcoming and there are also stalls where you can get a massage There is also enough seating if you are traveling in transit

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional
Taipei Hualein TaiChung Both flights by ATR cabin was clean and comfortable Very friendly crew Drinks service on both flights

I flew China Airlines from Singapore to Vancouver on the st June by Premier Economy The flight was not very full but dep from Singapore again delayed by minutes Due to this the Airline allows another extra minutes in its schedule We landed at Taipei minutes late only after a wait of hrs took off for Vancouver on the second leg of my journey This flight was unfortunately delayed by minutes at
