Taipei due to baggage loading issues etc We landed at Vancouver minutes late as a result of the late take off The flight however was very smooth comfortable Cabin Crew was very good cleaned the toilets every hrs so they remained spic span were well stocked Entertainment system was very good though on SingaporeTaipei sector my Screen had no sound I had to change my Seat The food I always eat on flights is AVML Indian Veg Meal this varied in quality SingaporeTaipei meal was very good though it lacked Indian Bread bun provided No Plain Yoghurt I would rate it On the Taipei Vancouver Sector the Dinner was below par only the fine quality basmati rice north indian tasting veg fruits was edibleI would rate this only The breakfast second meal was better as they provided Parotta with Indian cauliflower potato curry cabbage curryboth tasty Again fruits were provided Banana should have been given I would rate this meal No Plain Yoghurt an essential part of every Indian Veg meal was provided Fortunately I always carry my own Yoghurt Indian Pickle packets so I could repair the meals enjoy them I hope China Airlines pays attention to my comments modifies their AVML meals to include more Yoghurt Indian breads in future The Seat was very comfortable with seating in Premier Economy Baggage was well handled no damages was quickly discharged at Vancouver Airport Overall view of China Airlines the Flight can be described as relaxed comfortable with good service ambience A last word on the A Aircraft which in my view is excellent for such a long flight smooth stable very spacious I will continue to fly by China Airlines in my future flights to Asia

vIve flown with Spirit several times and also contacted their customer service center in the past to cancel a flight Spirit can vary wildly in terms of cancellations delays timeliness and staff attitudes If using a ratio two experiences to every one have been overwhelming positive But the remaining one experience has royally sucked Still I take my chances with Spirit because theyve come to treat me more respectfully as a customer than most other US carriers pound for pound It helps that I understand the concept of ultrabudget airlines having flown them around the world and that I treat airline staff with courtesy and politeness This most recent trip from Orlando to Louisville was mostly positive friendly airline staff on ground and friendly though not particularly attentive in air they only came down the aisle once to collect trash Checkin online was easy though it helped that I wasnt checking a bag The flight took off and arrived early The immediate seat was clean enough but the seat back pocket and tray table were a bit nasty They tout their WiFi as being the fastest of any US airline though I havent tried it But I did manage to use their unpaid WiFi connection to track the flight route to Louisville on my phone so that was cool In all Spirit as great as long as you keep a good attitude and dont have any real expectations Thats the point of budget airlines right And just hope you dont get delayed by eight hours as I did once with Spirit years ago

Would like to give big thumbs up to boarding crew Ms Noor at Tiruchirappalli Airport We are four family flying from TrichyIndia to Singapore Boarding process went very smooth with her providing detailed explanation before keep luggage what can bring and what cannot She is quite knowledgeable and inform the passenger upfront to complete the boarding process smooth and fast

An enjoyable flight It left on time and check in was easy The seat was quite comfortable for a short flight The staff were very friendly and efficient The food was surprisingly good as well The flight offered refreshments twice In fact more food then my flight on QANTAS from Sydney to Cairns

Very modern terminal which is a lot better then the old one It is spacious and clean There are a few cafes my favourite one is the Ciao which offers lots of tasty food snacks deserts and coffee Going through the passport and security check doesnt take much time The Airport has x Business Lounges one for national and one for international flights There is also free wifi which is really fast and available throughout the whole airport area The staff there are very friendly and ready to help you
Flew LUGFLR via GVA and back Excellent airline Flights on time FA very friendly and service excellent Would fly with Etihad Regional again

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre

A satisfactory experience overall the first leg slightly better than the second one Clean modern aircraft leg space ok food better than average and service more than acceptable For the fare I paid I can have no real complaints Would fly with this company again if the opportunity arose

Although I had a long layover here and as a single female passenger I was a tad concerned after having read other reviews However the airport is absolutely fine interesting architecture in the landside area a few cafes small shops selling local goods and lots of banks People were very friendly and there was a sense of calm compared to most airports I have been to especially in my home country Scotland and the UK Customs and security were a doddle and once airside there are the usual airport shops plus a few local and individual shops with interesting goods on sale The gate area was modern bright and airy again it was very ordered and peaceful

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

Arrival was a very good experience as the new airport layout is a great improvement Departure was problematic I have always used Brussels Airlines which allows you to check in a dedicated facility in the city This time I was with Kenya Airlines and the check in process was chaotic with only one small kiosk and many people with no idea of a queue trying to check in Once through into the departure lounge things improved greatly and the business class lounge was a revelation comfortable air conditioned and well appointed

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

Mid size airport with Indian standard with connectivity to most big cities in India after covid no international flight For arrival its easy to use we arrives at baggage hall and same hall have a prepaid taxi counter and a snack shop and a liquor shop Toilets were clean and also the terminal looks clean plenty of baggage trolleys also have paid porter facility Cabs are available book through their kiosk and avoid taking from touts outside It is situated within the city so if travelling light may walk towards outside and get auto that would be cheapest option to travel Ola Uber also available
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

Brussels to Punta Cana with Jetairfly on Boeing I was really surprised about this professional service and crew Very good entertainment decent food new plane and friendly service I was lucky to be on a plane which was not fully booked

MadridRome return over the weekend Both flights departed and arrived on time Boarding priority worked well seat comfort ok but nothing special just middle seat empty and a bit more legroom than economy Service was great the food service is tasty Pre lunchdinner drinks served then a full meal Open bar during the flight Lounge in Madrid is great not the one in Fuimucino but it does the job Overall it was a great experience

The seats were excellent with a feel of much more room than the official seat pitch I am ft in We could sleep for a couple of hours daytime flight with the blinds down as they should be no point booking a window seat in my view I focus on seat quality much more than smiley faces and food the food was middling and the second meal before landing was distinctly subpar

Good arriving experience domestic Not too busy not long walk from aerobridge Baggage arrived fast wifi available but as most of the airport in India only if having Indian sim almost impossible for non Indian sim Washroom were ok should have better and cleaner Only one cafe at arrival not any other option No public bus from airport only option is auto or cab prepaid cab counter is there also UberOla

Berlin to Paris Flight on time clean and modern plane It was impossible to buy any drinks due to an issue with their visa machine The crew was ok but they could smile a bit more At Orly airport we had to disembark by bus which took minutes to finally be at the south terminal

On the whole SSA is everything youd expect a mediumsized airport to be Its spacious well signposted and safe Checkin is usually fast except for charter flights to Europe security is fast and friendly domestic arrival also fast and efficient The one major problem at SSA are the long queues at customs in the afternoon when several international flights arrive pretty much at the same time If you dont carry a Brazilian passport expect to stand in line for over an hour There are just enough shops and food amenities SSA is still thankfully first and foremost an airport not a shopping mall If you are taking a bus from the city centre to the airport or vice versa be aware that traffic in Salvador is horrendous and the journey at peak times will take at least two hours

I have flown times on La Companie so far and could not be happier It makes me laugh to see complaints about ground accommodations and old planes etc this is an airline that flies to a manageable airport Orly with lower taxes than for example CDG it is a boutique operation with limited flights and proposes business class flights RT for as low as vs on poorer major airlines It is great value for the price and grumpy people can still spend their on a coach ticket booked on United coping with the CDG mess and see if they are offered hot towels full meal champagne and most importantly business class seats with better air quality

London City to Berlin British Airways subsidiary BA CityFlyer really exceeded my expectations for such a short flight London City is a great alternative to London Heathrow as flight prices are similar and it is much more convenient and less crowded as it is in the city centre and is a smaller airport The checkin and bag drop were all selfservice but could be done easily and quickly with staff present to assist We boarded the aircraft very orderly in different boarding groups The seats on the aircraft an Embraer E were wide and comfortable with more than enough legroom for economy class especially for an hour flight The cabin was arranged in a layout so it was pretty spacious Service provided by the crew was excellent and they provided a packet of chips and a drink Overall the flight was very enjoyable and we arrived in Berlin on time

This was my first time on EVA Air and I must say that it was a highly impressive experience Yes it was pricey flying premium economy but at this will be the only way to fly when traveling to Asia from here on out unless traveling business I found the premium economy cabin to be more than satisfactory The seats of course were not lie flat but they still had enough pitch to be comfortable And the one thing that stood out were the cushions in seating There was enough padding that I wasnt even remotely uncomfortable throughout the entire flight I arrived in Taipei from LAX comfortable and refreshed The service was good and the food though not Michelinrated was still perfectly fine I would fly them again While some may say its not different enough from coach to make it worth the money when youre it makes a big difference Ive flown economy to Asia and never again

Nouakchott to Dakar The new Nouakchott airport is about min from the city and opened only years ago Pretty efficient airport not crowded and only gates The lounge was surprisingly good English spoken fast WiFi and a decent selection of food and beverages Mauritania is a dry country The plane was less then a year old but very poor maintained The whole seating arrangement was mixed up Seat itself was old and relatively clean No welcome drink amenities or InFlight magazine Hot meal was served on a min flight Only coffee was served no other options The toilet had no soap nor towels Many passengers eat their meal with bare hands Crew was friendly but didnt speak English Not flag carrier worthy airline but for African standards pretty cheap and the hard product is pretty new Service in business class to Easyjet economy

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

The airport was not busy when we arrived but this did not stop it taking minutes to pass through immigration and collect bags Facilities are what you expect from an airport about years out of date and did not expect anything different I guess Found the staff to be unfriendly and there were no painted on smiles available here
Very good array of shops ahead of security Very modern very clean Far nicer than the other airports that Ive encountered in Brazil

Manageable and friendly this feels like an airport from the s Coming in and going out immigration facilities are fairly efficient Going out after immigration there are a few shops a barcafe and a sitting area The layout is semiopen and you can watch the planes land not that many do this is an airport with very few international flights daily You go through another security when heading to your gate where you can have your last beer before leaving the country Overall a good reflection of the country unpretentious clean friendly and relatively efficient

I have flown here only on private aircraft The commercial airlines have yet to discover this often overlooked resource The parking and terminal buildings are great Reminds me of how Chicago Midway used to be before the most recent spate of reconstruction like a hometown feel Very clean facilities and the commercial pax I have spoken to all seem to enjoy it Mostly the lack of a commute to Chicago I think

This airport is situated good one hour away from Udaipur Small and basic airport Nothing at arrival hall not even a teasnack shop Toilets need to be more clean and hygienic Only baggage belt on arrivals so easy to get baggage also very short walk from aircraft to baggage to exit Wifi is of no use either it wont connect and if connect wont be working properly Few chairs available near baggage belt UberOla available from airport also a prepaid taxi counter for booking No public bus available to city from airport If not travelling with heavy baggage then can walk to highway and then wait for bus going towards Udaipur

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

We used the airport facilities both for international arrivaldepartures and domestic sea plane The international part was no so bad at all the Covid Clearance was fast and correct luggage arrived within a reasonable time and all worked pretty well Not really first class but not as bad as some reviews should indicated Staff was courteous and friendly The transfer tofrom the sea plane terminal was bumpy literally speaking and luggage handling somewhat chaotic but somehow it worked and with a bit of positive attitude we really found it pretty good and quite amusing The business class lounge was not the most modern and delicate one for sure but had what we needed and was quite comfortable Check in Qatar was very well organized friendly and correct in every way Same for immigration and document control We give the airport good marks not need to worry when going tofrom Maldives

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

Long Beach is a great little airport It has the most efficient TSA checkpoint I have ever seen with the longest line ever being about three minutes and I fly through here quite often While the south concourse is the only gate area I have used I am sure the airport is the same throughout the terminal The staff is great and friendly and you can chat with everyone The gate numbering can be a bit confusing but so long as you dont immediately exit the terminal to the left you should be fine They even give you an umbrella when it rains to walk onto the plane
Clean airplane departed on time Crew were professional and friendly Good announcement from the pilot Offered a cookie and a bottle of water No in flight magazine

Excellent safe clean on time and we got a hot meal on board which I did not expect given the fact that during the ticket purchase I was prompted to buy a meal which I did not want to do They are a little bit expensive but the flight took a long time hrs Excellent service thank you

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him

Tashkent Airport has become very efficient on the international side Immigration and customs both on the way in and on departure were quite user friendly Not a lot of shops and restaurants but that was not inconvenient Readers should be aware that the domestic terminal is on the other side of the runway and it could take up to minutes to connect from one side to the other side using a taxi
Its not crowded Its very new and clean airport Sign and directions are easy to follow Before my departure time I really enjoy spending time Ankara airport Esenboga

Thumbs up for Belfast City Airport Excellent revamp New improved security area Bigger Duty Free Shop not sharing any space with other retail Much more passenger seating Good new bar with charging points and a family table service area The views of the apron have not been compromised This makeover is long overdue now gives Belfast International a run for its money and much more user friendly than London City my final destination today

Great airport to travel from and return to No great distances to walk easy access to check in counters TSA actually seems to care and think rather than defaulting to lowest level of acceptable service ie Denver Early morning flights are great as the food court has great breakfast burritos and coffee The only problem seems to be the luggage getting from the plane back to you Once you have your bags the rest of the trip out is a breeze

Ive flown via Narita Airport before and always found it to be excellent especially the connection between Terminals and via the free shuttle bus This review is specifically about Terminal which serves only a handful of regional airlines like JetStar Japan Spring and Jeju Air Prepandemic it was a functional but drab location By comparison the new Terminal is absolutely stunning easily the most spacious per number of airlines served Ive ever seen There are huge seating areas several appealing food outlets a bookstore and a Lawsons convenience store The beautiful art work complements the peaceful relaxed atmosphere an immediately noticeable contrast to the crowded scene at most of the worlds terminals I really didnt want to depart Congratulations to those responsible

I have been travelling to the Gambia for six years now and have seen alot of changes at the airport over the years Security are very friendly people You can even sit out in the open and have a drink and a bite to eat and watch your plane land
Excellent service very cheerful and professional cabin crew Delicious catering punctual Honestly EgyptAir deserves a much better rating Keep up the excellent work

Brand new airport On the positive side for Chinese standards it certainly is welldesigned and wellconnected Bright and clean checkin area Good choice of restaurants and cafes both before and after security controls As to the negatives the security controls are quite inefficient and slow the airline lounges are all quite poor and certain gates from upward are very far up to min walking

I flew Brisbane to Honiara on the th April Flight Left early was only full and arrived minutes early Add kg of luggage good plentiful food and beer what more could you want Entertainment was poor but its only a hour flight so I survived Staff friendly which is much more than I can say about the BA Qantas staff on the Flights coming out from Ireland

The security staff were incredibly slow and seemed to be more interested in personal chats than getting customers through the security process as quickly as possible Why not be more proactive you will get less tension with customers shorter queues and a better job satisfaction You dont need to be unfriendly and impersonal

At last a quiet clean and efficient airport Terminal F without the tiresome duty free The hourly Borispil Express train will drop you off near Terminal D and you need to catch a halfhourly shuttle bus to Terminal F mainly for LCC flights as its something like a m walk otherwise The number of flights is fairly small and seemingly mainly Ryanair Plenty of room to wait just a couple of refreshment options Straightforward passport control and security no queues Plenty of seats in the departure lounge easy access to gates good view of airport operations No duty free Hooray A couple of refreshment stands No air bridges but then LCCs dont use them anyway A very relaxing experience particularly in contrast to departing from a UK airport

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The check in was fast and the staff friendly The departure arrival were punctual and the aircraft made an average good maintained impression The seat distance was sufficiently good Despite the short flight there was a small bite and water Overall a good experience

Used Hamilton Airport as an alternative airport to Toronto A much smaller airport than Pearson a good thing resulting in much less walking and waiting and much easier to get in and out of A great option if youre visiting Southern Ontario or Niagara Falls if you want to avoid the Toronto traffic and is km from downtown Toronto Not the greatest airport for public transit links to Hamilton and Toronto and beyond likely due to the airports small size Airport was slightly built on the cheap has exterior siding and drop celling interiors reminding me of a bus terminal and has very limited foodshopping options Despite these minor complaints overall a good alternative to Pearson for direct flights and would use it again

I would like to express my gratitude to the airport staff for caring about my comfort and positive impressions of the company I would like to express special gratitude to the employee Annette for helping me resolve the issue with my luggage The flight was comfortable and in a safe atmosphere for me

The Plaza Business Lounge at Brisbane Airport was comfortable enough with a range of food and drinks but no tonic for a GT There were very few toilets in the lounge though On board the A the seat was comfortable and the service was friendly and responsive My vegetarian meals were good but breakfast was served far too early interrupting sleep The plane for the connecting service to Sapporo was an unreconstructed A with oldstyle business class seating but comfortable enough for a hour flight The service and vegetarian food out of Taipei were both excellent Overall China Airlines is a good way to travel between Australia and Japan at a reasonable price

Sawyer is a small airport in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan with flights to Detroit and Chicago provided by Delta and American respectively There is a small store selling Northern Michigan University paraphernalia some basic snacks and coffee The major car rental firms have desks in the terminal with the cars parked just outside The parking is excellent you walk out of the terminal into the parking lot Less than a minutes walk from the airport entrance to the security check area The terminal has excellent free wifi service courtesy Northern Michigan University Very friendly and efficient staff Taxi service is available to the city of Marquette about miles away

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell
Our team fly weekly and we reckon Rex are the most reliable airline in Aus Boarding is easy flights are on time crew are great WiFi on all flights would seal the deal Yet to be disappointed
Its easy to get around very friendly people and easy to get bags and leave Always a good experience and they have free wifi so never a problem with communication

I flew Lao Airlines from Luang Prabang to Hanoi It was a short one hour flight and the service revised by Lao Airlines was everything you could expect for a flight like this They served drinks and a snack which was a tasty sandwich although there was no vegetarian option The staff were friendly There was no inflight entertainment but that didnt bother me as the flight was so quick

Taipei TSA to Makung and then Makung to Kaohsiung Taipei to Makung served by A Checkin was very smooth and there was no queue Agent was extremely friendly and helpful A lot of boarding calls far too many in the departure halls Plane was spotless and comfortable with generous leg room They served drinks for this very short flight minutes and a choice of newspapers Service was very efficient with a smile much better than most of the international long haul flights nowadays Crew were very well groomed Makung to Kaohsiung on an ART Checkin agent again very efficient and friendly Very old plane and has started to show its age However still good leg room and very high standard of service A drink and newspaper were served Crew again provided first class service to all passengers

Tiny but well kept airport different design not too many flights but departure lounge seemed chaotic Immigration is friendly but takes a long time a few shops you need to pay attention to the counters to find out where youre going to checkin Overall experience fair

With flights starting at around USD between Seoul and Yantai Shandong Airlines proved to be the cheapest option beating Asiana China Eastern and Korean Air Given the price I was a little hesitant to believe the service to be of a high level however I was pleasantly surprised I was given a friendly greeting in English on boarding crew holding a basket of sweets for passengers to take as they headed to their seat For the rest of the flight the crew seemed to conduct their service pleasantly with a smile On the outbound flight to China apple chips and bottles of water were offered however on the return leg a delicious hot meal was offered consisting of a sweet and sour type meat dish with rice Highly surprising considering the flight time was less than an hour Interestingly on both flights the captain performed a detailed speech in Chinese and English Despite the fact that the Boeing was several years old it was fitted with Boeings Sky interior and its interior seemed to lack any signs of wear and tear The interior including the toilets appeared to have been cleaned well The seats were comfortable and had ample legroom for the short flight The IFE onboard consisted of overhead screens these played the moving map on the outbound flight at Mr Bean on the return journey Overall a good journey

We have used this airport in the past there is noticeable improvement in the facilities and services The check in are is spacious with adequate seating and few shops The check in process was smooth and the security swift and friendly After security there is a large waiting area with free newspapers and view of the apron the separture lounge is upstairs and they have aerobridges A good regional airport if you want to go to see the Big Cat Tigers

Great little airport used mainly by Porter airlines Check in was efficient and you go down to an airport lounge open to everyone They serve free tea coffee and soft drinks along with cookies and nuts The wifi is free and fast Boarding is effortless and the scenery on take off is stunning The only downside was that when the lounge is busy it gets a little grubby with dishes lying everywhere Otherwise it comes highly recommended

Infrastructure lacking excellent welcoming courtesy Plane from VIE landed on the one runway turned around and taxied to a parking area from which we descended staircases promptly rolled up to the front and rear doors This airport does not know the concept of gate We walked to a huge barn of a building and all joined the line of nonUkrainians At this point some passport control official undertook a mental exercise called thinking lets open the other line for Ukrainians for these passengers That immediately cut the wait in half my wait was minutes The passport official who stamped my passport smiled note to US CBP agents thats when the ends of the mouth go up and said Welcome Then enter the other half of the huge building with a currency exchange a clean bathroom and not much else Overeager taxicab drivers were in abundance but I and many of us took the Viking bus to our river cruise ship

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

When I landed in Anchorage late at night the first thing I noticed was how busy the terminal was I was really hungry after a long hour flight from LAX so the first thing I did was grab something to eat from Cinnabon one of many restaurants at this airport Baggage claim experience was smooth Taxi was readily available outside for transportation to hotel While returning back I had a very smooth checkin and security experience If you enjoy watching beautiful scenery and planes Anchorage will not disappoint As you walk around the terminal you will notice many photo opportunities both inside and outside the terminal

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

Friendly ground staff at checkin Immigration a breeze Duty free shop limited though Smoking area present in departure lounge Some restaurants available for those feeling peckishat cut throat prices considering the price VIP lounge looked cozy enough didnt go in Departure area great for plane spotting All in all a clean facility well run not overwhelmed yet
My mother travelled alone in Air Asia on June The flight was very comfortable Services were good Ground staff was extremely helpful Sincere thanks to the ticketing staff

I have a been a frequent traveler of AustinBergstrom Airport AUSKAUS since the airport opened back in I have seen the airport grow and change over the years The changes over the years have been for the better Notable things about AustinBergstrom International AUS there are two terminals the main Barbara Jordan terminal where all the restaurants lounges and stores are and the South Terminal currently Allegiant and Frontier Airlines there is a family viewing area outside the airport for watching planes and having a picnic There are currently lounges AA UA DL and a Chase Sapphire Terrace there are many good places to eat including many local restaurants my favorite are Taco Deli Salt Lick BBQ Second Bar Kitchen Annies and Juiceland it takes about minutes to walk from one end of the terminal to the other along the way you will see lots of places to eat drink and shop Pros clean great dining bars and rest areas The Delta lounge is the nicest lounge in the airport Cons restaurants close early so if you arrive on a lateish flight you will not have food options

I fly this airport several times per year The name and location sounds like a bigger adventure than it actually is The airport is small so boarding an A is already something that keeps everybody busy However there are not that many flights ground staff are friendly and helpful

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues

Stockholm Bromma is a small airport Its very clean and the service was efficient Great proximity to the city centre Landing baggage collection and exit was super easy Taxi driver able to wait right by the carousel so there is no confusion about meeting places

Due to the relatively low number of flights planes dont have to wait circling around in the air or on the tarmac The airport itself is perfectly connected to the inner city and the central station trains from there take you to Munich Wrzburg and Regensburg in about hour to Frankfurt and Stuttgart in hours by a minutes metro ride Passport and security checks as well as baggage handling are a breeze Staff is very friendly and helpful

Isnt it fascinating that you can buy any spirit in a one liter bottle but water only in l bottles I asked and the not so friendly stuff assured that the whole airport just sells little bottles at the gates that is after security check Oh and when I asked why she cleverly replied just because I have never seen an airport that poor with food and beverages Dont come hungry or thirsty

While this is a very attractive airport with few flights off season transfer between plane and terminal can be hazardous to elderly and infirm passengers A bus with very high steps caused my wife to hurt her leg and later she needed medical attention We witnessed other elderly travelers and children finding the bus steps difficult On our return trip to Buenos Aires the Pluna station manager alerted by our hotel concierge arranged for a golf cart transfer and early boarding to the second row of the all economy jet Why the Airport authorities dont operate a more customer friendly vehicle is a mystery The airport departure tax at each for the minute flight is way out of line considering Ezieza in Buenos Aires charges for long haul flights to the US Once through the first of two security checkpoints travelers find themselves in a sizable duty free considering the size of the airport For those heading to and from Punta del Este and other nearby Uruguayan resorts PDP is certainly the most convenient and is an hour closer to those towns than Montevideo Airport

I never thought I would find myself reviewing a TSA department but I felt compelled to after my recent positive experience My family and I were unexpectedly transiting through Newark on June We had several mishaps happen beyond our control after an extended travel day hours The TSA department at Newark airport in particular a man named Fontaine helped greatly alleviate our stress and help expedite us through the security line and airport correcting the mistakes of our airline workers I cannot begin to tell you how appreciative I am for their help empathy and services

There are two options for getting from Dar es Salaam to Zanzibar a twohour ferry journey or a minute flight The main airlines flying this route are Auric Air and Air Tanzania Ordering the ticket via Opodo was easy and the airline operates from Terminal a small building about km from the main terminals Checkin was efficient and the waiting room had several powerful air conditioning units You could even buy food and drink Tickets were checked and we were walked across to the Cessna It had three seats in each row and although tight it was not uncomfortable It only had a pilot and we flew at about feet giving us a clear view of the sea and then the island It ended with a very smooth landing close to the terminal

A very friendly team of airport workers overall Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

Naha airport has undergone some renovation and expansion it keeps improving each time I go there Being a small airport arrival is easy and luggage waiting time is not too long customs are also friendly and easy to pass through There is a major improvement in checkin areas for international flights and some domestic Used to be in a cramped little area now its a lot more spacious There is also a big improvement in food offering before immigration Once passed international immigration you will be left with very little choice I believe they are still undergoing some major facelifts for the departure gate areas maybe more stores will be added soon Overall this is a charming little regional airport which is easy to move around

Dont understand all negative reviews yes you can not compare this airport to a modern European or US one but short lines friendly people despite unfriendly behaving tourists enough seating to wait Smooth entry into the country expect to enter a country that is years back in time and you will enjoy your trip

Great airline punctual The cabin crew is very welcoming and provides excellent service Excellent flight tracking with announcements from the captain Great loyalty program with MegaVolotea Super compagnie ponctuel Le personnel naviguant est trs accueillant et propose un super service Bon suivi de vol avec des annonces micro du commandant de bord Super programme de fidlit avec megavolotea

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

La Paz Sucre in an exMexicana Ticketing process is manual and very slow beware and get your tickets before the airport We were handed a little snack bag as we boarded then served drinks on board a great way to provide good service on a short flight

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

They canceled my flight and no refund My boyfriend and I booked tickets from Cusco to La Paz for just on I received an email saying that the flight was canceled Reason From that moment on they were no longer flying to La Paz We were already in Cusco when I received the email so we looked for a customer service point Arriving we were super poorly attended the lady who answered us checked the system that was really canceled was when we knew the reason and could not do anything We had to swallow it dry for to make a scandal was not going to do any good We returned for our stay and started looking for air tickets again Great illusion at that time of the championship prices were very high and schedules that did not favor us because from La Paz we went to Uyuni where we had reservations that we did not want to have to change them Anyway we had to buy same bus tickets and face h of travel We put it in our head that if it was happening this way it was because it was supposed to be like that and in the end we were saving I contacted them as requested in the email I received advising about the cancellation to this day nothing I only receive automatic responses I already sent to the emails available on the site and also nothing these nor automatic response I receive The phones look like nonexistent I do not know what to do to get my refund

Ohrid St Paul international airport was in terms of size like a trip with the time machine The aircraft is parking literally in front of the Arrivals door where passengers are directed to the Passports control There were only desks working out of which for an airport with flights daily can be considered a good performance Nevertheless despite the size the airport is well organized and clean showing the travelers how flying was at the past times when holding an airline ticket was considered a luxury As an improvement for the administration I think that a shuttle bus from airport to the city roughly km Distance would be to consider synchronized with the flying schedule
The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green

This is a good airport The cleaning can be improved but I do like the layout its not a very very long walk but it is long if you ask me I go here for my vacation flights instead of having to drive hours to the nearest true international airport Overall Columbus has a good airport Would definitely fly here again

Cabin was clean Personal screen was big enough and a lot of entertainment programs were available Seat was very comfortable My personal area was spacious Tullys Coffee was offered with tasty chocolate Flight attendants provided quick and responsive service Everything was excellent

Gatwick to Joburg troubles just beginning to brew in Libya The start seemed off putting when I noticed an extra three hours on the flight time from Tripoli to Joburg which the booking office could not explain also when I was not on the reservations list at checkin However the latter was sorted without hassle Service on flight to Tripoli was fine plane new and clean food good However we landed in a sandstorm which was worrying Fortunately we were herded along to the departures lounge as all signs in Arabic Onward flight delayed by a couple of hours due to sandstorm Toilets at the airport were inadequate in number but reasonably clean We were then taken on what felt like a mystery tour on an airport bus down a dirt road turned out to be to the other end of the runway where our plane sat all on its own amidst military aircraft The three hour extra time was now clear as it was a much smaller plane than expected a few passengers had seats allocated on row numbers which were not on the smaller plane however there was enough room and extra for everyone boarding Once again food and service fine There was a refuelling stop at Kinshasa During my week in S Africa the revolution in Libya took off I expected to lose my money and have to rebook myself back on an alternative carrier However when I contacted Afriqiyah in Joburg they said I was rebooked on Egyptair travelling back same night as my original booking They sent me email confirmation and my trip home went smoothly The Afriqiyah staff were helpful and efficient in spite of what was obviously a stressful time for them On the basis of value for money Afriqiyah is excellent but be prepared for a journey with a difference

A modern and moderate sized airport for the capital of Finland Staff was friendly and helpful queuing times were very short due to modern handluggage scanners The terminal itself isnt very big but has an easy to follow layout There are a lot of dutyfree stores and foodcourts of course theyre all overpriced as one might expect Connection to town is offered by trainconnection All in all a good experience

Arrival Clean and spacious airport However the luggagebaggage arrival area appears small and congested Taxi counters are available near the exit Departure Checked in online and print ticket using the kiosks available in the airport Thumbs up However upon entering the departure gate the officer who are on duty did not recognise the ticket ticket from kiosk is thinner more plasticky compared to thicker ticket from the counter and questioned me of having a fake ticket She maintained her politeness though but still how come your own staff didnt recognise ticket which you own airport albeit kiosk produce Otherwise the rest of the experience was good Spacious and clean airport with abundant seats A bit too cold

Only used this airport in transit tofrom FrankfurtQingdao so this is a comment on the transit facilities Speedy visa check and immigration service quick security check and throughout friendly English speaking staff Excellent signage to transit space which features plenty of seating souvenir and duty free shop coffee bar and small childrens play area In transit one is issued a transit card which has explicit instructions on how to proceed

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

Warsaw to Tallinn Our flight was in codeshare with LOT Polish Airlines Between our arrival and departure there were minutes gate opens mins before departure the ground crew worked very well so we could catch our Nordica flight to Tallinn with ease The seats are comfortable the legroom is more than okay Bigger meals and drinks are available on purchase but they serve complementary drinks coffee tea water and snacks chocolate bar The cabin crew was kind and the cabin was clean

The staff are friendly and its clean and offers a good service most of the time I do have two constructive comments however I wish you would put your flights on sale way in advance Eg I want to book for next summer now but have been told to wait until the end of the year This is not good for their own business as most people want to book summer vacations for next year now and if they are not on sale people will go to other countries like the Canary Islands etc and this is a shame I had booked for trip returning to Dublin via LGW on th November and bought flight from Dublin on Ryanair now told change to Heathrow New flight to Dublin from LHR required Additional expense for people using you to route home

Titan Airways flew us back from Mytilene to Manchester Flight ZT as part of the repatriation after TC collapsed The flight was excellent particularly the stewardesses who were helpful efficient and courteous The plane was very clean with better leg room than Ive had before on a typical economy class carrier at anytime in the past outside of long haul flights The only gripe I had was the in flight entertainment it didnt work even though it said I was connected I got no connection to it at anytime of trying This is why its only a and not a star review

airport Aircraft was a newer Dreamliner B filled to last seat Was in the middle of a midsection in the back surrounded by passengers all over However the seats are spacious and can recline cm I felt comfortable and slept quite well Food was served on large trays and main course was very delicious spicy seafood with plenty of support like heavy salad desert cheese and chocolate I could choose my and beers Staff are Moroccan males are professional hardworking focused and pragmatic They may appear being blunt but on firm requests they act well They relocate seats up to last Minute and beyond to accommodate passengers wishes allowing couples and families to sit together Amenity kit hearsets pillows blankets provided to all IFA promised a lot with big screens and options However it was not working properly for approx half of the cabin it froze again and again or ran into endless loops In Casablanca RAM kept their announced promises of providing a smooth STPC hotel meals and transport
