Paris to Newark Service on board adequate and friendly staff But the issue was that my checked luggage did not arrive in Newark From that moment no feedback customer care nonexistent The staff was not concerned and blamed the situation on Orly airport No support

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

MalagaSan Sebastian Approach looked a bit dodgy as the airport is sandwiched between the Pyrenees and the sea but in reality it was a gentle descent From aircraft to baggage yards Baggage arrived very rapidly my host had parked in the free carpark only another yards away Clean modern airport not actually in San Sebastian but Irun about minutes from the French border very convenient for Biarritz

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry

MAO is an old airport far away from the city but with good and cheap connections They have a lot of security food is expensive so come prepared a simple burger will cost you dollars or so and internet dollars one hour Tourist information center is very friendly and helpful

Short hour hop from Vancouver to Castlegar and all good The plane looks tiny on the ground but the ride was smooth and on time Not much time for more than a swift Sprite and pretzels before we made the descent This landing is one which all Air Canada pilots practice over and over on the simulator as it is apparently one of the most challenging in Canada Not bad on a sunny day such as we travelled but I am sure on a wet evening it would be quite a tricky path through the mountains Also advised that the route can get cancelled for days at a time due to fog No such problems for us as flights out and back were fine Great to arrive at an airport and your bag is there in literally minutes Give this route a go but make sure to check the Castlegar weather first

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use

This airport was previously known as London Manston which is a bit of a joke because of how far it is from London However with a name change new terminal and new budget airline EUJet has started to raise its profile I travelled through there on the way tofrom Amsterdam The airport is small which works to its advantage Check in was very fast and the staff very helpful The car park is right outside the terminal entrance and is very cheap day or week The small cafeteria is good and clean The aircraft are right out side the terminal so no long bus rides or endless walkways On the way back it took less than minutes to reach my car from the time the wheels touched the ground I had no luggage All in all a very good experience

Boarded by bus on an distant location AN on a very good condition crew was young people friendly and eager to help passengers to place carryons to the bins Legroom was tight I was lucky my next seat was left empty and the flight was barer able We departed on time min after departure they served coffee no free and hours within the flight they served lunch from Buy on board Menu Flight was full and almost all passengers transferring to North American destinations

A totally stressfree experience as sampled on a return charter flight from the Tampa Bay area Just eight departure gates but ample seating and a friendly barcafe No TSA hassle either A good gateway to Biloxi the Mississippi Gulf Coast and even Mobile AL Close to I

Lufthansa operated by Germanwings from Barcelona to Berlin Tegel and back Both fights on time with very quick boarding and ground service First flight was a year old A plane was very clean and comfortable The return flight on a year old A despite the old age of the aircraft it was very clean comfortable and showed signs of great maintenance service You cold only tell that it was that old becouse it was considerably louder but the journey was very enjoyable The snacks are not very good but I can forgive that on a h min flight Great comfort in the seats with more legroom Great value for money and going to try Eurowings

Check in was fast and efficient Boarding was set out in groups the gate was small but boarding was very speedy Our seats were in economy but the IFE screen was larger than most economy cabins Ive been in Seats were comfortable and legroom was okay The cabin crew were so friendly and attentive We were offered drinks and snacks to begin with followed by a sandwich then a hot meal before landing with a few more drink and snack services in between Ive flown with Virgin to JFK a few times and wouldnt hesitate to fly with them again Never have any issues and staff are always on hand to help

Airport staff very friendly and helpful but airport is actually the modern building with a minor older satellite terminal from where a low cost company exclusively operates It needs better highlited signals
Our team fly weekly and we reckon Rex are the most reliable airline in Aus Boarding is easy flights are on time crew are great WiFi on all flights would seal the deal Yet to be disappointed

We had an enjoyable flight experience with AC Rouge The flight attendants on this crew worked very well together and demonstrated great cooperation and team work The crew was welcoming personable and professional In particular we enjoyed excellent service from Victoria and Heather

We had airport assistance for my elderly mother and the chap who met us at the plane Giorgious was excellent He spoke very good English and was super courteous and respectful and helpful throughout our transit He took us through immigration and then onto our lounge for a flight to London with Aegean Airlines He knew us by name within an instant and always explained what was happening next He should be celebrated The staff at the boarding gates were also very courteous and respectful as well I cant speak highly enough of everyone we dealt with at Athens Airport Even the ladies serving at the cafe considering how busy it was was excellent friendly and on point Its always a pleasure when you meet good people doing good things Well done Athens airport

The main airport of Armenia has been completely rebuilt and the old Soviet style one is no longer operating The new terminal is clean and modern dutyfree shopping is in abundance As most fights arrive at midnight border control takes at least min During covid times all boarding passes need to be printed so take extra time in mind Taxis easily overcharge dram should be more than enough Overall a good experience

Facing similar difficulties in redeeming miles as mentioned in our recent BKKKIX review we had to additionally pay for possible unusable future miles for this route class We were contacted at least thrice for seat changes to end up with this aircraft The aircraft has seat configuration seats A G K The seat seems narrow storage space is limited fully reclined bed is possible but youd need to rise up to use this feature Although the A seat is a window seat but your feet always point to the aisle and some seats may not be able to see out of the window The G K seats are worse since both have feet pointed to the opposite and face each other Thus no privacy is assured as hypothesised The IFE has no map features only elapsed times are available aircrew couldnt get the map features for me Honestly we notice that service quality varies depending upon who youre ROPStar Alliance status ages familiarity with crew etc This flight was over booked and some were offered to downgrade to PE with USD compensation experiencing what just described we regret that we didnt take that offer As THAI loyal customers wed suggest the airline to consider our comments to improve its quality to be competitive with other Star Alliance carriers in the similar routes which we had rated all of them as excellent

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

Flew Shanghai to Tinajin Although crowded at times in the summer heat everything went well Checkin queues were very long I was lucky to check in at one of the numerous golden pass counters as have been invited by my companion Although Hongqiao is for domestic flights it is not difficult for a foreigner like me to have the right orientation Airport is clean and very clear and correspond to high international standards

Have used this airport twice in the last year and found it very smooth From plane arriving at terminal only ten minutes to clear border control collect bags and exit airport Bus to Gothenburg outside terminal to meet each flight and in to city in about minutes quicker than from the main Gothenburg airport Adequate facilities in airport and an outside area airside for smokers to sit in the sun with a drink

JNZDLC Flight departed and arrived on schedule Aircraft was newish MA clean and tidy Cabin announcements in English as well as Chinese but no cabin service only hour flight so acceptable especially given price of ticket RMB Aircraft named Modern Ark apt as modernised Chinese version of old Antinov design Overall perfectly acceptable

Sukhothai Airport owned by Bangkok Boutique Airlines is a great little secret gem not to be missed Due to its size you feel like a celebrity A flower festooned approach greeted by security officers in their shorts and old colonial hats checking in outdoors the open feel the gardens water dripping from the roof to keep customers cool The check in staff all line up and wai you to send you off and the ground staff at the aircraft do the same Priority boarding for monks of course Exotic and fabulous with the usual Bangkok Airlines free drinks and snacks
I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and helpful Only water coffee and tea were complimentary which is no issue on such a short flight

CAA replacement for Thomas Cook flight repatriation back to the UK after firms collapse Staff were excellent plane a little dated but clean and spacious also under subscribed Comfortable great service thank you all

This review applies to Terminal only American Airlines Transited through a rather busy Reagan National There are great views for the airfield from the D concourse terminal building and E concourse The walk from the end of D concourse to the end of E concourse is rather long and with only a minutes connection I made it to the connecting gate in E concourse with minutes to spare Overall a good airport and terminal to transit through

Passenger wise Indias th busiest airport but infrastructure wise one of the most smallest airport in India When flight lands they dont even provide bus to arrivals but needs to walk from aircraft to terminal via on tarmac Arrivals is very small only baggage belt in a limit spaces but baggage can take more time Toilets are just ok should be more clean Prepaid cab and also uber have pick up point just after exit no issues finding them at the same time many taxi drivers will approach you offering ride Airport needs proper management new terminal is under construction and hope that it is better managed

Great airport Good duty free Good fb outlets Just one question why do you clean all washrooms at the same time leaving just handicapped ones opened And to find a vacant one you need to pass several kms to find it

Singapore to Yangon Ontime departure from Changi terminal The economy cabin felt clean and the crew were friendly My expectation was for a basic and efficient service which was we got This was an evening flight so we had a basic dinner which was okay as good if not better than the Premium Economy meal from Melbourne to Singapore Same wine Sauvignon Blanc This time no other option so I opted for the red Comfortable good service no complaints

HKGBKK I booked with them because it was the only airline available Check in took hr in HKG and plane was a year old B Entertainment was pretty much nothing and seats were the most uncomfortable Ive ever experienced Plane and bathroom were unclean I booked a seat in the upper deck and it was quiet Food was horrible Only good thing was the value because I you pretty much get everything for that cheap price

It was years ago I used this airport and wow so much has changed The check in on nd level had moved to a much more spacious rd level It made the experience totally different in a positive way No longer does it feel cramped Staff are friendly and signage are very clear The only thing that still need improving is the variety of shops available air side and food options It is still pretty basic at this stage With more and more airlines flying to OKA they can be more ambitious and open up more shops and restaurants to cater for us
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Not bad
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

I had a better experience than most of the other people who posted reviews here The airplane departed on time in Tblisi and arrived even a bit earlier Seats are comfortable Checked luggage is free which is very rare these days Be prepared for zero interaction with the staff members in the plane though Only at the entrance the staff greets you They seemed quite friendly though Theres no option to buy food and no information apart from an announcement that the landing has started The life vests looked quite old frayed and stained at least the one that the safety instructor showed maybe the ones stored under your seat are newer If you dont need luxury and you bring your own food this airline is really fine I dont know how they act in case of delays or cancellations though

A fine small airport great personal service clean well decorated easy parking simple and efficient signage has a luxury feel befitting the Palm Beach Clientele Food selection adequate and reasonable Parking is a breeze Always many security personnel and queue times very short A pleasure to travel to or from

Upon arrival we were herded into two huge queues in passport control Plenty of people to herd you but only two actually processing passports After minutes one of the herders pointed the remaining twenty or so people in our queue to the automated passport machine She then promptly walked away Unfortunately no one bothered to walk through them as you could simply walk around so we all did Spain has no record of me entering its island Arrivals is like revisiting the s it all needs replacing Departures by comparison was like a different airport well managed very short queues and modern Toilets are very clean

Departure experience was relatively smooth an early morning flight on Ryanair so airport was very quiet Security was well managed clear markings on the floor to encourage social distancing However there was no coffee shop open so nowhere to buy a drink or a bite to eat Arriving back was very quick there were a number of staff members on hand to organise passengers no queue at passport control and bags were out within minutes however this was to be expected due to a very quiet flight and an empty airport Overall whilst the airport appeared clean we did not see any staff members cleaning while we were there with no hand sanitising stations available to passengers

Nanjing to Xian The check in process for this flight was smooth Cabin crew were friendly and courteous Hot meal with beverages were served However the standard of the in flight catering was neither appealing nor appetizing The passengers who sat next to me even returned the meal to the flight attendant It is indeed below average Only Chinese movies is available from the drop down LED screen Tianjin Airlines have plenty of room for improvement

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane
Great little airport all staff friendly and helpful Security checks speedy and done with a smile Could some of the staff be used to show other airports how it is done

Excellent services as usual by Singapore Airlines from Darwin to Singapore on March even though I was fasting and unable to eat my foods they didnt forget to give me a box of dry foods and drinks to break my fasting Thanks a lot to the cabin crews Flight from Singapore to BKK SQ on March was great too Always excellent service

It was first time at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport it was is one of the nicest and biggest airports I have come through in the USA anywhere in the world This multi level airport has many boarding bridges There are many shops and restaurants The staff were friendly and welcoming The airport is welldecorated and wellmaintained and easy to get in or out Public areas are a huge clean and bright
LuganoAgno is a little airport maybe the smallest in Switzerland but I think its the most efficient Its commercial says Youll be in the air in minutes and its the truth I think its a great airport

Tontouta International Airport is located km outside of Noumea If you catch a cab to the airport be prepared to pay for a twoway journey as cabbies are not guaranteed a return fare back into town Theres no point turning up early for your flight The airport only operates when flights are due to arrivedepart Checkin counters the small souvenir shop and cafe dont open till minutes prior to scheduled departures Duty free shopping is only available airside which can only be accessed minutes prior to departure Surprisingly smoking is permitted in all parts of the terminal In summary Tontouta is a very basic facility offering very basic services On a more positive note all the airports ground staff were exceptionally friendly helpful and good natured including checkin agents security immigration and customs officials

This is a small airport but the new passenger terminal is great Fast service helpful people and clean This is a good alternative of Brussels airport We like it and for sure if possible we will try again

You might use Moscow Vnukovo when flying to cities within the CIS on regional airlines or catching a charter flight to Turkey Egypt etc The airport is located southwest of the city it takes about minutes and Roubles tofrom Yugo Zapadnaya metro station by minibus in normal traffic taxi drivers ask the usual extortionate rates as in Sheremetyevo The building is very small and displays a bizarre mixture of typical drab Soviet facilities and shiny renovated areas that you could almost call Scandinavian Arriving at about am on a redeye flight I was greeted by a pack of stray dogs roaming the street outside the terminal but then I was able to wait for the first bus into town while having an excellent cappuccino in the new cafe inside the arrival area with plenty of seats and cheerful service from the very friendly staff Immigration is the same as everywhere else in Russia even though this was the only place where I was asked to produce a copy of my invitation and health insurance On an afternoon visit the departure sector which is located on the same level as the arrivals was almost deserted Services on offer are scarce one exchange office with ridiculously short opening times one Atm one cafe a couple of windows selling airline tickets and providing general information in Russian exclusively Everywhere around the airport there are obvious signs of big renovation works going on Im really curious to see what comes out of it in the future All in all one of the most relaxed ways tofrom Moscow and Russia

Very basic domestic airport Probably the most basic Ive ever experienced Probably built late s early s and left Old Lino on the floor broken last Id strips where your luggage goes straight to the tarmac one coffee shop Surprisingly the toilets were very clean even with fresh flowers Nothing airside just uncomfortable plastic chairs I felt offended in that only non Caucasian people were scanned with the wand Did not seem right or fair Boarding of course was by steps Despite its limitations it was ok Just annoyed when those with too much baggage holds up the rest as they argue about it

Arrived mid night from Mumbai in a domestic flight aircraft attached to aero bridge in min we were at baggage area baggage arrived in next min Washroom were clean paid porters available plenty of baggage trolly No public transport during night only option is either prepaid or booking directly with taxi drivers We took prepaid going to Utorda around km paid approx inr during night a percent surcharge is applicable during day time should be around inr Just after you exit the terminal would be surrounded by taxi drivers prepaid cab counter is inside the building at arrival hall

This is a quite modern airport and serves the country well after that being said I felt the airport is terribly connected to the other parts of the island and it makes you rely heavily on taxis or hotel transfers On arrival they will ask you for the Mauritius all in one form if you do not have it they will send you to the end of the line so that you can fill it online the airport provides free wifi for that then they will ask for hotel accommodation and return tickets make sure you have then handy or this will delay you and everyone else standing in line The staff seem to be friendly specially if you speak French Bathrooms were clean and after immigration and security on departure there are plenty of food options including global fast food giants I would say that I enjoyed my time while using this airport

Airport Facility Check in staff service Staff was not really friendly Lounge the airport Lounge not airBaltic In this Lounge you can find some light snacks and beverages but the price of entry is not worth it Seat comfort Seats were good for Economy on domestic European flights Seat pitch A bit more than enough Legroom A bit more than on the vast majority of European flights Cabin safety videoinfo they have video displayed on screens above passengers seats Comfort items almost do not exist Cleanliness Its usually clean on airBaltic flights Lavatory cleanliness it was clean Selection of meals preorder the passenger has a lot of options Selection of drinks onboard a wide selection several seasonal drinks are available Selection of snacks onboard different snacks are available and light meals are available Good quality Food a bit overpriced Only one magazine but it is mostly advertisement WiFi was not available on that flight This airline is good for flights up to hours Ticket prices are not high so if person needs to get from point A to point B airBaltic would be a good option

There are substantial and ongoing improvements to Freetown Airport They have been rebuilding the terminal building around the old structure for the last few months Departure and arrival procedures are now quite painless compared with the hot and basic conditions before The check in area is large and clean and I did not have to queue for long They could still do with increasing the air conditioning in that area though Security is good and immigration is using new computers and biometric systems The departure lounge is now quite big and comfortable There are a few well stocked duty free shops The original restaurant is still available as well as a new one upstairs The new one is not well signposted Overall a big improvement FNA now compares favourably with other airports in Africa

Airport is easy to reach by metro train and taxi Check in area and departure area have been perfectly clean In the check in area only few shops and restaurant available departure area have more choice but I did not use them as I used the lounge Check in went fast and efficient same for security check Staff was professional

Tiny yet functional airport which serves this remote South Pacific Island with regular flights by LATAM from Santiago and Papeete Airport is only open when these two flights arrive The terminal is a single storied structure very user friendly The airport has all the ambience of a tropical island palm trees open structures walk across the tarmac to disembark and board the aircraft even a moai a specimen of the islands iconic stone statues Before the baggage claim area is a stall where one can buy the National Park ticket in Chilean pesos or by credit card or US dollars On exiting the baggage claim area you find you hotel pick drivers waiting holding up your name There are also taxis The town is so close that you can even walk to your hotel if you have light luggage On departure the terminal hall becomes a bazaar with many stalls selling local souvenirs There is also a cafeteria Bathrooms are clean There is an exit check by the security services where they collect the stamped form that you have fill out before boarding the flight to IPC Rules limit stay on the island to days for both foreigners and Chileans There are also souvenir stalls restaurant and bathroom beyond the security check The covered gate area is open and you can watch your plane getting readied for your flight All very relaxing

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance
Excellent experience at this airport Not just departing but upon arrival as well Very smooth quick organised and excellent staff Look forward to returning soon

Morning flight on PR from Daraga to Manila I have international connection in a separate booking booking but check in agent made it sure my luggage was checked through to my final destination which was so much appreciated as it saved me time and effort at Manila Airport Flight was smooth and on time Ticket price was reasonable

Got to be one of the worlds smallest airports The terminal is the size of a large living room You can literally drive up to the front door and walk in This made the airport very efficient and easy to use but dont bank on having a gourmet burger before your flight You will have to make do with a snickers bar and an Irn Bru from the vending machine To be fair it was very clean and is a good hub for the northern extremities

Flight SN on the st of October Efficient boarding welcoming crew and comfortable seats The flight left with a slight delay of but arrived earlier in Stockholm The highlight was the crew Charming well groomed cheerful and carried out an excellent cabin bag management during boarding The seemed to be enjoying their jobs and their enthusiasm was contagious It was a pleasure to fly them

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

Titan Airways flew us back from Mytilene to Manchester Flight ZT as part of the repatriation after TC collapsed The flight was excellent particularly the stewardesses who were helpful efficient and courteous The plane was very clean with better leg room than Ive had before on a typical economy class carrier at anytime in the past outside of long haul flights The only gripe I had was the in flight entertainment it didnt work even though it said I was connected I got no connection to it at anytime of trying This is why its only a and not a star review
This is a smashing little airport friendly well laid out and very well run Because of its location very attractive to fly in and out of too always a big shock returning to Gatwick Good ice cream too

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

Manila to Legazpi DRP on Christmas Day Flight was full but went smooth Checkin was a breeze Mabuhay Lounge food was OK though I was hoping for some extra flare on this special day Wasnt a problem though Flight took off slightly ahead of schedule Bags first to arrive at DRP due to Elite status Ticket price was reasonable for this season
Great airport not many flights so no hassle From check in to take off minutes Car parking also free

Having gone through so many different airports around the world Kuching Airport is definitely one of the better airports to use Airport workers here checkin counters security immigration etc are generally fine but can be improved especially on the level of professionalism in their communication with passengers The airport may look very new but there is a need to improve some facilities such as seating areas especially the terminal Air Asia uses at one end of the single terminal and the automated passport gates at the arrival hall Cleanliness can be improved as well particularly on the toilets Overall Kuching Airport is a good and hasslefree airport to use

Airport is acceptable staff is not overly friendly kinda seems like theyre just hanging out On our way through this airport the first time they lost our babys stroller never to be located by Arajet again and then on the way back I was unpleasantly surprised to learn that they dont have any drinkable water water fountains etc You can only buy water for roughly USD Thats when I decided it was time to leave my opinion Hope this helps

MalagaSan Sebastian Approach looked a bit dodgy as the airport is sandwiched between the Pyrenees and the sea but in reality it was a gentle descent From aircraft to baggage yards Baggage arrived very rapidly my host had parked in the free carpark only another yards away Clean modern airport not actually in San Sebastian but Irun about minutes from the French border very convenient for Biarritz

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

I tried to arrange a group trip with SyrianAir from London to Aleppo via Damascus and back Initially all was fine until they cancelled the first leg of the journey to Damascus a week prior to us leaving The next flight was days later but there was no immediate plane to Aleppo once we had arrived at Damascus which meant we would have to take a bus up instead a journey we werent too keen on While friendly the staff are fairly useless and I sat for MANY hours trying to sort things out We changed the flights to stay the same number of days but decided to go to Aleppo at the tail end of the trip under our own steam and the fly Allepo to London again via Damascus on the same ticket Unfortunately the staff didnt really get the group concept and kept issuing tickets for the wrong dates for different members of the group It took too many visits to their offices in Baker Street to finally get everyone on the same flights at the same time The flight to Syria was fine late and we managed to get up to Aleppo ourselves but the day before we were to fly out again we went into the Syrian air offices to confirm everything was ok IT WAS NOT They had cancelled the flight to Damascus without informing any of us and we had to arrange a midnight bus from Aleppo to Damascus Airport to make the correct flight back to London Luckily this one hadnt been cancelled But it was late My advice Dont Fly SyrianAir and if you do check on your flights constantly

The airports renovation seemed to come in handy no looking much more sophisticated On the way to the airport I couldnt but help notice the new terminal that is in construction Duty free is excellent with well anticipated manners displayed by staff The airport itself handles more than Beirut international airport although it is much smaller in size Restaurants sell reasonable food at magnificent prices New bars have opened throughout the airport as well as ATMs and other necessities

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

The airport was renovated in before the Olympic games it looks like Miami International Airport nothing special good duty free some good lounges all in all good airport with some problems with queues and not so friendly staff

Excellent small airport Arrived from JFK and departed to JFK homepoint DTW Arrival It was raining so as a courtesy we were bussed to terminal ride minutes Passage through passport control took minutes The passport control officer smiled and welcomed me Ample shops landside I was able to buy postcards and stamps to mail them to friends Taxicabs to town do not have meters rate is fixed at euros Careful driver clean taxicab Departure minutes at security minutes at passport control Passport control officer smiled again why are US CBP personnel so unable to master the skill of smiling Airside only tiny snack shop Lovely sunny morning so we walked a few feet on tarmac and up staircase into airplane
